The state secretary confirmed the Dutch contribution, explained that energy and water tariffs would otherwise rise sharply and that bridging contributions and the 10 million would come from delayed programme budgets without extra cuts in the Netherlands.

At the request of the Bonaire executive council, the Representative of the Crown and the Ministry of the Interior, my colleague and I were asked to lay down in law that energy and drinking water tariffs and the sewerage levy are set in an efficient, cost-covering and affordable way.

Door het bestuurscollege van Bonaire, Rijksvertegenwoordiger en het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken is aan mijn collega van EL&I en mij verzocht om in de wet vast te leggen dat de energie- en drinkwatertarieven en rioolheffing op een efficiënte, kostendekkende en betaalbare wijze tot stand komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren  over Odfjell: “Heeft u kennis kunnen nemen van het artikel ‘Onafhankelijkheid inspectie is bijna geheel verdwenen’?”

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the government would act on the Chemie-Pack and Odfjell cases, why enforcement in the chemical sector lagged, whether budget cuts were to blame, and whether an independent supervisor should be created. The state secretary admitted compliance problems, pointed to uniform enforcement strategy, legal safeguards and regional consolidation of inspections, and declined to pre-empt the Safety Board's ongoing investigation.
I do not want to anticipate the conclusions of that investigation.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de conclusies van dat onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de commissie-Alders over selectiviteit op Schiphol

An MP asked the state secretary about the Alders commission on selectivity at Schiphol, arguing it includes only KLM and questioning tariffs, competition and the slow relocation of airlines. The state secretary replied that the commission only tests how the shared vision on selectivity is applied, that KLM's role as home carrier justifies its place, and that no change to the commission's composition is needed.
For the formulated assignment to the commission chaired by Mr Alders, I refer you to the appendix.
Voor de geformuleerde opdracht aan de ingestelde commissie onder voorzitterschap van de heer Alders verwijs ik u naar de bijlage.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Werf over de brief van verschillende organisaties inzake de uitvoering van het advies Duurzaam Inkopen

An MP asked the state secretary about a letter from business and sustainability organisations claiming that the implementation of the Duurzaam Inkopen (sustainable procurement) advice lags, and proposed faster action, coherence and a single contact point. The state secretary rejected the claim of insufficient progress, said a single desk would not fit existing ministerial responsibilities, and pointed to a forthcoming progress letter as the requested update.
No, see the letter on progress on sustainable procurement sent to the House of Representatives in September 2012.
Neen, zie de brief over de voortgang duurzaam inkopen aan de Tweede Kamer van september 2012.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dikkers over het bericht dat de NAM gebruikt gaat maken van fracking nabij Blija

MPs Jacobi and Dikkers asked whether NAM's fracking near Blija is permitted under its existing licence, how often fracking is used in the Netherlands, and what objection rights residents have. The minister answered that the licence allows fracs, that notification was given under the general rules, that no formal objection or appeal route exists for fracking in existing wells, and that residents were informed through local newspapers.
Current laws and regulations provide no formal objection or appeal possibility when applying this type of technique in existing wells.
De huidige wet- en regelgeving biedt geen formele bezwaar- en beroepmogelijkheid bij het toepassen van dit soort technieken in bestaande putten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucas over de dijkversterking bij Den Oever

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary whether the Den Oever dike reinforcement is being pursued despite a unanimously adopted motion calling for postponement, and how the motion is being implemented. The state secretary answered that the regional water board and municipality postponed the choice of preferred alternative to December 2012 to integrate it with the Masterplan Den Oever and the Afsluitdijk structure vision, while stating the project should not face further delay.
In line with the intent of your motion, more time is being taken to examine the relationship with the Afsluitdijk future structure vision.
In lijn met de strekking van uw motie wordt meer tijd genomen waarin de relatie met de Structuurvisie Toekomst Afsluitdijk wordt onderzocht
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een klimaatambassadeur voor stadslandbouw

MP Ouwehand asks the state secretary what happened to her proposal for a climate ambassador for urban agriculture, whether it is a topic in Rijk-decentral consultations, and whether she is aware of municipal permit obstacles facing a Nijmegen urban farm. The state secretary replies that urban agriculture is adopted by the Rotterdam alderman under the Lokale Klimaatagenda, a learning group is being set up, a Green Deal exists, and the Nijmegen permit issue is a municipal competence to be raised in the learning group if it recurs.
Under the LKA a learning group on urban agriculture will be established focusing on knowledge exchange, bottlenecks and solutions.
Onder de LKA wordt een leergroep Stadslandbouw opgericht die zich zal richten op kennisuitwisseling, knelpunten en oplossingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dikkers over het bericht dat de inspecties van de Milieudienst Rijnmond fors zijn gedaald

An MP asks whether inspections by the Rijnmond environmental service (DCMR) fell by tens of percent over ten years and what the consequences are for safety. The state secretary answers that the decline is not of that magnitude, partly due to changed counting definitions, that high-risk Brzo inspections have increased, and that safety remains paramount.
There is no decrease of tens of percent as stated in the report.
Er is geen sprake van een afname met tientallen procenten zoals in het bericht wordt vermeld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Koopmans, Wolbert en Snijder-Hazelhoff inzake sierkolen

MPs Koopmans, Wolbert and Snijder-Hazelhoff asked why pesticides approved for food cabbage cannot be used on ornamental cabbage, whether the small-use definition excludes such crops, and how other EU states treat them. The state secretary explained the separate authorisation procedure, said the small-use area limits will be widened to 5,000 ha open and 1,000 ha covered, and that the Ctgb will be asked to apply this.
I will ask the Ctgb to act in accordance with the above.
Ik zal het Ctgb verzoeken conform het bovenstaande te handelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dikkers over Douwe Egberts en de aanbesteding voor warme dranken- en vendingautomaten

An MP asked the government about the award of a hot drinks and vending machine tender for the Ministry of Defence and FMH to Douwe Egberts, including how fair-trade and living-wage criteria fit EU case law, how they are enforced, and whether the listing coincided with the company's stock market debut. The government answered that the tender followed EU-compliant special performance conditions, set out three living-wage compliance regimes with Douwe Egberts under regime 1, and stated the award was objective and unrelated to the listing.
The award was based on the most economically advantageous tender and is entirely separate from the stock market listing.
De gunning is op basis van de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving geweest en staat geheel los van de beursnotering.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over een hectarevergoeding Schipholboer voor weren ganzen

An MP asked whether the state agreed a per-hectare payment of 853 euro with farmers near Schiphol to plough under grain stubble quickly to deter geese, why the Chamber was not informed, and why food crops are not banned near the airport. The State Secretary confirmed the payment under a voluntary convenant, defended voluntariness and the four-track approach, rejected a crop ban as too drastic, and said no changes to state-owned land leases are planned.
The Chamber was not informed about this because it concerns implementation of established policy, namely the convenant on reducing the risk of bird strikes at Schiphol.
De Kamer is hierover niet geïnformeerd omdat het uitvoering van vastgelegd beleid betreft, te weten het convenant reduceren risico vogelaanvaringen Schiphol.
Antwoord vragen Leegte over een oneerlijk speelveld REACH

An MP asked about complexity of the REACH chemicals registration regime, whether SMEs can comply without outside help, and whether uneven EU enforcement distorts the level playing field. The state secretary answered that SMEs get tailored support, that enforcement is a national competence coordinated via the ECHA Forum, and that the Commission's REACH evaluation will address the competitiveness concerns.
Incidentally, I do not share the view that there is a distorted level playing field at European level.
Overigens deel ik niet de opvatting dat er sprake is van een verstoord level playing field op Europees niveau.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gebruik van de Buitenveldertbaan

MP Kuiken asked about the use of the Buitenveldertbaan at Schiphol, whether it is used more than agreed under strict preferential runway use, and how transparent and enforceable the system is. The State Secretary replied that no maximum runway movements were agreed, that the 2011 figure of about 41,000 movements falls within the forecast range, that the new norms system is being evaluated and enforceability tested, and that the old enforcement points should not be retained as a back-up.
No agreements were made on a maximum number of landings or take-offs on a particular runway, so also not for the Buitenveldertbaan.
Er zijn geen afspraken gemaakt over het maximum aantal landingen of starts op een bepaalde baan, dus ook niet voor de Buitenveldertbaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over compensatie van passagiers met grote vertraging door vliegtuigmaatschappijen

An MP asks the government why airlines still inform passengers poorly about compensation for long delays, and whether they should be forced to act, adopt a uniform claims procedure, and revive the aviation complaints committee. The State Secretary replies that inspection finds compliance on information provision generally good, that the main problem is the Sturgeon ruling on delay compensation pending European Court clarification which blocks sanctions, and declines new national rules or a revived complaints committee while pointing to existing inspectorate complaint handling.
Pending the legal clarity that only the European Court can give, or an amendment of the Regulation, the inspectorate currently cannot impose sanctions for violating the Sturgeon ruling.

In afwachting van de juridische duidelijkheid die alleen gegeven kan worden door het Europese Hof, of door aanpassing van de Verordening, kan de inspectie momenteel geen sancties opleggen voor overtreding van het Sturgeon-arrest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leegte over het artikel ‘CO2-prijsverhoging ramp voor ons land’

A VVD MP asks the state secretary whether the 2020 CO2 reduction target is already assured and what the government will do to block the EU proposal to postpone auctioning of emission allowances, which the MP called ruinous for the Netherlands. The state secretary replies that ETS emissions are fixed by the cap and the non-ETS target is likely to be met, opposes the postponement as raising costs for competing firms, and says he will press the Commission for structural ETS reform.
I will inform the European Commission that the Netherlands does not support the proposal at this time for the reasons stated above.
Ik zal bij de Europese Commissie aangeven dat Nederland het voorstel op dit moment om bovengenoemde redenen niet steunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Alarm over gifalg’

An MP asked why water from the Ouwerkerkse Kreek was pumped into the Oosterschelde after a toxic algae species was detected and a swimming ban issued, who decides on discharge of poor-quality water, and whether water boards can isolate contaminated water. The state secretary answered that discharge stopped on 7 August after joint Rijkswaterstaat and water board decision, that Rijkswaterstaat as waterbeheerder decides on admissibility, and that the water board isolated the creek and adjusted drainage.
Rijkswaterstaat, as water manager of the Oosterschelde, decides whether discharge is admissible.
Rijkswaterstaat beslist als waterbeheerder van de Oosterschelde of spuien toelaatbaar is.
Antwoord vragen Koppejan en Holtackers over de stand van zaken op het gebied van meting van actuele grondwaterstanden

MPs Koppejan and Holtackers asked the state secretaries about recent developments in measuring groundwater levels, the independence of DLO research, the reliability of piezometer data and the NHI model. The government answered that the Alterra report on groundwater measurement is attached, that it sees no societal damage from possible measurement errors, and that screening of piezometers for soil structure is not centrally available and is the responsibility of provinces and water boards.
This detailed information is not centrally registered, and collecting it across a large variety of projects is very labour-intensive.
Deze detailinformatie wordt niet centraal geregistreerd en het verzamelen daarvan bij een grote verscheidenheid aan projecten is zeer arbeidsintensief.
Antwoord vragen Van der Werf en Holtackers over het bericht “teruggestuurd oud-papier”

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about reports that China returned contaminated waste paper shipments to the Netherlands, asking about inspections, enforcement, export trends and new policy. The government answered that the containers were verified and sampled, that the enforcement issues stem from a criminal investigation and a court ruling on ILT policy rules, and that no new policy is planned beyond pursuing EU-level harmonisation.

In the criminal investigation referred to in the reporting in question 1, it has been suspected that the company concerned mixed waste paper for export to Asia with other (household) waste and concealed the true nature of the waste.

In het strafrechtelijk onderzoek, waar de berichtgeving uit vraag 1 naar verwijst, is het vermoeden gerezen dat het betrokken bedrijf papierafval voor de export naar Azië heeft vermengd met ander (huishoudelijk) afval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Holtackers en Omtzigt over het bericht “Problemen Odfjell zijn er na 30 jaar kennelijk nog steeds”,

MPs Holtackers and Omtzigt asked about news reports on safety problems at Odfjell's Rotterdam tank storage site, including the changing deadline for emptying tanks, past fire-line testing and enforcement, and whether DCMR's oversight will be investigated. The state secretary explained the deadline extension for safety reasons, noted that the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) is investigating, and gave limited information on past live testing, saying the rest should be left to that investigation.
I do not want to obstruct the OVV in gathering information, so I limit my answers to information that is directly available and sufficiently valid.
Ik wil de OVV niet in de weg zitten met het vergaren van informatie, zodat ik de beantwoording van de vragen beperk tot die informatie die direct voor handen is en voldoende valide is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het bericht dat Inspecties zich onafhankelijker moeten opstellen

MP Dikkers asked whether inspectorates should operate more independently to intervene earlier, as in the Odfjell case, and whether an independent review of DCMR is needed. The state secretary answered that several independent inspectorates supervise Odfjell, that he is considering giving the Inspectorate national enforcement power (doorzettingsmacht) within existing law, and that the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid is investigating Odfjell and DCMR.
At the general debate on risk policy and external safety of 27 June 2012 I deliberately indicated that I am considering giving my inspectorate more enforcement power.
Ik heb in het algemeen overleg Risicobeleid en externe veiligheid van 27 juni 2012 bewust aangegeven dat ik overweeg mijn inspectiedienst meer doorzettingsmacht te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leegte over het bevoegd gezag ten aanzien van het Tankopslagbedrijf Odfjell

MP Leegte asked whether the province of Zuid-Holland is the competent authority over the Odfjell tank storage company, what sanction powers provinces have against firms breaking safety rules, and what should change so provinces can act effectively. The state secretary confirmed provincial competence under the Wabo, listed available sanctions (including bestuursdwang, dwangsom, licence withdrawal and fines), said the province has sufficient instruments, and pointed to a planned national network of regional enforcement services.
A national system of regional enforcement services is being developed, through which I expect the available supervisory instruments to be deployed more effectively and efficiently.
Er wordt gewerkt aan een landelijk stelsel van regionale uitvoeringsdiensten, waarmee ik verwacht dat de beschikbare toezichtinstrumenten effectiever en efficiënter ingezet worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over een incident met een lekkende wagon op station Oss

An SP MP asked the minister about a train carrying hazardous goods that caused a leak and disruption at Oss station, including its route, frequency of such incidents, false alarms, liability for damage, and whether procedures and preventive inspections should be tightened. The minister said the operator may choose its route, reported 35 leaks and four station evacuations since early 2011, stated liability rests with the infrastructure manager who can recover costs from the operator, and announced an ILT thematic inspection action while seeing no need to change reporting procedures.
No registration is kept of cases of false alarms.
Er wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van gevallen van loos alarm.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de benoeming van de raadsleden van de Raad voor de Leefomgeving en infrastructuur (RLI)

An MP asked whether the newly created RLI advisory council, which replaces the abolished Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen, has adequate external safety expertise, whether former AGS members are included, and what budget and concrete plans exist. The minister answered that one member with external safety expertise was appointed, that no former AGS member was appointed formally but all will be invited as associated members, and that concrete programming is left to the next cabinet.
Because of the start of the Rli and the caretaker status of the cabinet, it was decided to leave the making of concrete agreements on programming for the coming years to the new cabinet.
Vanwege de start van de Rli en de demissionaire status van het kabinet is besloten om het maken van concrete afspraken over de programmering in de komende jaren over te laten aan het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de benoeming van de raadsleden van de Raad voor de Leefomgeving en infrastructuur (RLI)

An MP asked the minister what the three knowledge platforms (relEVant, the Kennisplatform Externe Veiligheid and the specialists' forum) did last year to replace the abolished Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen, how often the Strategisch Kennisplatform met, and how the government justifies its claim that strategic knowledge cooperation is adequately safeguarded. The minister listed activities of relEVant and DORA, noted the SKP met in early 2011, and argued cooperation is sufficiently ensured given existing universities and institutes.
All things considered, I believe that cooperation in the area of strategic knowledge is sufficiently guaranteed.
Alles bij elkaar genomen, meen ik dat de samenwerking op het gebied van strategische kennis voldoende gewaarborgd is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over subsidie op schone motoren voor de binnenvaart

MP Bashir asks why a subsidy for clean engines applies to road freight but not inland shipping, and whether a scheme for engines meeting the highest CCR standards will be developed. The state secretary answers that a subsidy is only effective alongside tighter EU emission norms, which are not expected before 2013, so he invests instead in milieuverbeterplannen and an LNG Green Deal, and sees no need for a new CCR-compliant engine subsidy.
A subsidy scheme is not by definition the most effective way to make a sector more sustainable.
Een subsidieregeling is niet per definitie de meest effectieve manier om een sector te verduurzamen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over het bericht dat “de luchtvaart een bom legt onder de uitbreiding van Schiphol”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about reports that the aviation sector was undermining Schiphol's expansion, including a meeting with Schiphol and KLM, whether the 510,000-movement cap under the Alders agreement would hold, and the implications of state co-ownership and climate science. The state secretary confirmed the meeting concerned the investment masterplan and the Alders vision, that the 510,000 cap is not up for discussion, and that a commission was set up to review implementation.
That agreement is not up for discussion.
Die afspraak staat niet ter discussie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Koopmans over het onderzoek van de Wageningen Universiteit “Storen broedvogels zich aan het geluid van race-evenementen?”

An MP from the CDA asked ministers whether a Wageningen University study finding no significant negative effect of race events on breeding birds in Witterveld undermines the noise rules for Natura 2000 areas, and whether those rules could be relaxed. The state secretary replied that the study is useful for Witterveld only, cannot be generalised to other Natura 2000 sites, notes that increased bird song after events indicates some disturbance, and will make the report available online.
Because the circumstances in Witterveld (closed to the public) are specific to this area, the results of this study cannot simply be translated to other Natura 2000 areas.

Omdat de omstandigheden in het (voor publiek afgesloten) Witterveld specifiek zijn voor dit gebied kunnen de resultaten van dit onderzoek niet zondermeer worden doorvertaald naar andere Natura 2000-gebieden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het onderzoek van de Europese Commissie en het Europese Milieuagentschap naar de kwaliteit van het open zwemwater in de Europese Unie

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the state secretary about EU findings that Dutch open bathing water quality is weak, the role of agricultural runoff, pesticide risks, climate change, and whether Dutch bathing water can meet EU targets given budget cuts to the Water Framework Directive. The state secretary answered that quality improved in 2011, that pollution sources are varied and location-specific, that pesticide exposure is well below the ADI limit, that climate change poses no urgent need for action, and that meeting all EU targets cannot be guaranteed.

Despite the efforts being made, I cannot say with certainty whether the objective in Article 5(3) of the Bathing Water Directive will be met for all official bathing water locations in the Netherlands.

Ik kan ondanks de inspanningen die gepleegd worden niet met zekerheid zeggen of voor alle officiële zwemwaterlocaties in Nederland de doelstelling genoemd in art 5 lid 3 van de Zwemwaterrichtlijn gehaald zal worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dikkers en van Tongeren inzake het verpakkingenakkoord

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether the deadline for signing the packaging agreement with industry could be moved to 5 July, and what the legal basis was for refusing. The state secretary answered that the deadline cannot be moved, pointed to the Belastingplan 2012 requirement to report by 30 June, and said the agreement was already signed.
It is not possible to postpone the agreement to 5 July.
Het is niet mogelijk het akkoord te verschuiven naar 5 juli.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over een sloopwerf voor zeeschepen in Harlingen op 11 april 2012

An MP asked whether the Harlingen port's plan for a ship-breaking yard in the protected Wadden Sea would be assessed, its effects on the World Heritage and Natura 2000 area, dredging, pollution and transport of old ships. The state secretary answered that the plan is a local initiative still without detail, that the municipal council is first responsible, that existing rules will apply, and that the Rijk does not develop such sites itself.
It is primarily up to the Harlingen municipal council to assess the proposal and decide whether to support it.
Het is in eerste plaats aan de gemeenteraad van Harlingen om het voorstel te beoordelen en al dan niet te ondersteunen.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de Nederlandse toestemming voor het massaal doden van ganzen met behulp van CO2

An MP asks why the minister granted an exemption allowing mass gassing of geese with CO2 near Schiphol despite the EU biocides directive, and questions the necessity, animal welfare basis, costs, and preventive measures. The minister answers that the exemption rests on a convenant and motion, that the Commission was informed, that the welfare basis is a Wageningen study, and that the risk increase was not foreseeable.
I refer to the explanatory note accompanying the exemption (No. IenMbsk-201269716) of 10 May 2012, published in the Staatscourant on 15 May 2012.
Ik verwijs naar de toelichting bij de vrijstelling (Nr. IenMbsk-201269716) van 10 mei 2012 welke op 15 mei 2012 in de Staatscourant gepubliceerd is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over olieboringen in het Noordpoolgebied

MP Ouwehand asked the Dutch government whether it shares concerns about Shell's planned Arctic exploratory drilling, the risk of an unstoppable oil spill, and whether it will oppose or urge against the drilling. Minister Verhagen answered that the US authority is the competent regulator, that he sees no reason to doubt its decision, and that he will not call on other states or Shell to stop, while promising only to keep encouraging Shell toward responsible business.
It is not for me but for the permitting authority – in this case the US government – to weigh whether activities may be allowed.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de vergunningverlener – in dit geval de Amerikaanse overheid – om de afweging te maken of activiteiten toegelaten kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de meldingsplicht voor asbestsanering

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked whether asbestos removal firms must make four separate notifications before work starts, whether the Arbeidsinspectie portal could auto-forward them, and why the Bouwbesluit notification should not be dropped as duplicative. State Secretary Atsma replied that there is no Wet milieubeheer notification, that two notification moments apply (four weeks before for the municipality, two days before for inspectorates and certifiers), that the portal forwards automatically, and that the Bouwbesluit notification will be kept.
There is no notification under the Wet milieubeheer, but before asbestos removal in buildings, a notification/communication must be made at two moments.
Er is geen melding op grond van de Wet milieubeheer, maar voorafgaand aan een asbestsanering in gebouwen, moet op twee momenten een melding/mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over een lijst van 200 gebouwen waarin op grote schaal spuitasbest is verwerkt

An MP asked the state secretary about a 1997 Labour Inspectorate report finding sprayed asbestos in 200 buildings, and whether the follow-up measures were carried out and whether a list of current buildings with public functions could be provided. The state secretary answered that the measures were implemented by 2001, that asbestos policy now places responsibility on owners, and that no inventory exists so the requested list cannot be provided, though schools suspected of asbestos can be viewed online.
No inventory of asbestos in buildings outside demolition situations has been carried out, so the requested list cannot be provided.
Er is niet overgegaan tot (al dan niet verplichte) inventarisatie van asbest in gebouwen in niet-sloopsituaties zodat de gevraagde lijst niet kan worden overgelegd
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken over compensatie aan passagiers bij vertraging luchtvaart

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked whether airlines that refuse compensation for delays over three hours, cancellations or overbooking act unlawfully under EU Regulation 261/2004 and the Sturgeon ruling, and whether the state will enforce it. The state secretary answers that the Sturgeon ruling is binding, that the inspectorate enforces it but has paused new sanctions pending test cases and preliminary questions to the European Court, and that complaints are normally handled within six months.
For failing to comply with the Sturgeon ruling, the inspectorate has imposed a penalty order on each of four Dutch airlines.
Voor het niet naleven van het Sturgeon-arrest heeft de inspectie vier Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen elk een last onder dwangsom opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers en Omtzigt over mogelijke illegale asbestopslag

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about reports of possibly illegal asbestos storage at an Enschede demolition firm, including whether the inspectorate had acted and whether abolishing the landfill tax and planned asbestos landfill ban could encourage illegal storage. The state secretary answered that the province of Overijssel is the competent authority, that the inspectorate has no enforcement role here, that no signals link the tax change to illegal storage, and that illegal asbestos storage is not considered a structural problem.
The ILT has no supervisory and enforcement role in this case.
De ILT heeft in deze zaak geen controlerende en handhavende rol.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Meer asbest Derde Merwedehaven dan gedacht’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of more asbestos at the Derde Merwedehaven waste dump, its health risks, the inspectorate's role and whether the province is acting. The state secretary said the province is the competent authority, that asbestos has been landfilled with low concentrations within permit limits, that quarterly asbestos measurements continue until closure, and that the provincial investigation was resumed.
Until the closure of the waste deposit on 31 December 2012, the province carries out an asbestos measurement every quarter.
De provincie voert tot aan de sluiting van de afvalberging op 31 december 2012 elk kwartaal een asbestmeting uit.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Recourt en Jacobi over de gevolgen voor Den Oever van een dijkverhoging door het Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier

MPs Dikkers, Recourt and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the consequences for Den Oever of a dike raising by the Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier, including whether an integrated approach was considered and whether a commission's recommendations were taken into account. The state secretary replied that the water board is primarily responsible under a subsidy programme, that an integrated alternative was studied and rejected on cost grounds, and that the concept preferred option can still be adjusted with the parties while the province safeguards regional interests.
The manager, in this case the Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier (HHNK), is primarily responsible for carrying out this project.
De beheerder, in dit geval Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier (HHNK) , is primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van dit project.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over Van Gansewinkel en private equity

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the financial situation of Van Gansewinkel Group under private equity ownership, whether he had been misled about its equity, its waste-processing quality, layoffs and whether he would intervene. The state secretary answered that the company says its finances are stable, found no grounds to say he was misled, relies on existing waste law and the national waste plan rather than ownership, and sees no need to mediate, while offering to talk with the company.
In light of this information, I cannot conclude that the company misled me earlier.
Gelet op deze informatie kan ik niet de conclusie trekken dat ik eerder door het bedrijf ben misleid.
Antwoord vragen Leegte over het artikel ”Industrie wordt gestraft voor goed milieugedrag

MP Leegte asked the state secretary and minister whether they knew a Telegraaf article claiming industry is penalised for good environmental behaviour under the EU emissions trading system, and how clean industry leaders would be protected from competition-distorting measures. The government replied that the free-allocation rules from 2013 use benchmarks based on the 10% most efficient firms, so clean firms benefit, and that the cited company is not disadvantaged, though it acknowledged its free allowances will not cover all emissions.

The allocation method for free allowances for the trading period starting in 2013 has been improved compared with previous periods, precisely to ensure that clean industry leaders do not suffer unnecessary harm.

De toewijzingssystematiek van gratis rechten voor de handelsperiode die start in 2013 is verbeterd ten opzichte van de voorgaande handelsperioden, juist om er zorg voor te dragen dat schone industrieleiders geen onnodige schade ondervinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over de ernstige vervuiling van het Gotomeer te Bonaire

An MP asked about contamination of the Gotomeer nature reserve on Bonaire after the 2010 BOPEC oil terminal fires, including prior preventive measures, the PFOS findings, and liability. The state secretary said the island authority was responsible for the terminal's rules and supervision, that further environmental research via RIVM is being considered, and declined immediate measures and liability action until the facts are established.
It was the competent authority (now the public body of Bonaire) that had to set rules and supervise compliance with them.
Het was aan het bevoegd gezag (nu openbaar lichaam Bonaire) om regels te stellen en toe te zien op de naleving daarvan.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het stimuleren van duurzame eiwitconsumptie

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the price gap between meat and plant-based meat substitutes should be closed through taxes or subsidies and whether the external costs of meat should be included in its price. The government answered that it sees no short-term options, is awaiting a LEI study on external costs, uses voluntary sustainability initiatives and does not plan stimulation schemes for meat substitutes.
At the request of my ministry, the LEI will publish a study on this subject this summer.
Op verzoek van mijn ministerie brengt het LEI deze zomer nog een studie uit over dit onderwerp
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven over het artikel ‘Gif in kleding is verboden, maar komt toch in grondwater terecht’ en van de daarin genoemde rapporten van Greenpeace en RIKILT

An MP asked the state secretary about reports by Greenpeace and RIKILT on nonylphenol and nanosilver released from textiles into water, and about possible EU import bans and REACH amendments. The state secretary answered that nonylphenol exceedances are rare, that import restrictions are not yet in place and a Swedish proposal is not yet formulated, and that nanosilver risks will be evaluated in 2013 with further steps to follow.
However, it is not known to what extent NF is released into surface and drinking water through import and washing of clothing containing NFE.
Het is echter niet bekend in welke mate NF via import en het wassen van kleding NFE vrijkomt in het oppervlakte- en drinkwater.
Antwoord vragen De Mos over het bericht dat 49 voormalige NASA-wetenschappers afstand genomen hebben van het standpunt dat CO2-uitstoot een belangrijke oorzaak is van het broeikaseffect

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary whether the government will respond to a letter from 49 former NASA scientists disputing that CO2 emissions are a major cause of climate change, and whether scientific debate is unsettled and CO2 reduction spending should stop. The state secretary replies that open debate is needed and that there is no risk to scientists, but rejects halting CO2 reduction spending, citing the need to weigh present costs against future risks.
No, I explicitly do not share that view.
Nee, die mening deel ik uitdrukkelijk niet.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het verzuimen van de zorgplicht door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

The MP Bouwmeester asked the ministers whether low-cost airlines Ryanair and Vueling unlawfully refuse care to passengers delayed by strikes and whether a dedicated airline complaints committee should be reinstated. State Secretary Atsma answered that EU Regulation 261/2004 requires care, that the pending Court of Justice case (McDonagh/Ryanair) will decide the matter, that the inspectorate (ILT) enforces the rules and handles complaints, and that reinstating a complaints committee is primarily for private parties to decide.
The inspectorate does establish infringement of the Regulation, so passengers can, if they wish, start civil proceedings on the basis of that decision.
De inspectie stelt wel overtreding van de Verordening vast, zodat passagiers met dat besluit desgewenst een civiele procedure kunnen starten.
Antwoord vragen De Caluwé en Haverkamp over Vliegveld Valkenburg

MPs De Caluwé and Haverkamp asked about the redevelopment of former Valkenburg airfield, the early end of recreational flying there, and alternatives such as a glider airfield. The state secretary answered that accommodating general aviation is primarily a provincial and municipal responsibility, that the RVOB needs the site cleared for preparatory work in 2012, and that the province is still looking for an alternative location.
The accommodation of General Aviation (GA) is a shared responsibility of the national government and the province.
De accommodatie van General Aviation (GA) is een gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid van het Rijk en de Provincie.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Dikkers over de berichtgeving dat woningcorporaties geen prioriteit geven aan recycling

MPs Monasch and Dikkers asked whether housing associations are neglecting recycling of lamps and luminaires and whether the government should improve their recycling results. The state secretary acknowledged that only about half of discarded lamps are collected, called the missed opportunity a gap in the collection system, and promised to alert housing associations via their association and to examine collection options in implementing the revised EU WEEE directive.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Kuiken over lange reistijd bij low budget vliegmaatschappijen

Two MPs asked whether low-cost airlines misleadingly advertise airports as central to the capital while the transport from those airports is long and costly, and whether this breaches consumer protection and creates unfair competition. The minister says the Consumentenautoriteit and courts can judge misleading advertising under Dutch civil code rules and the travel industry code, and that the Consumentenautoriteit has sufficient powers and means to act.
I leave the judgement on whether these specific cases involve misleading or unfair commercial practices to the supervisory authority and the courts.
Ik laat het oordeel of er in deze concrete gevallen sprake is van misleiding of een oneerlijke handelspraktijk over aan de toezichthouder en de rechter.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over de SO2 uitstoot van afvalverbrander van Sita

An MP asked whether the ILT (formerly VROM-Inspectie) considers the Sita waste incinerator's SO2 emissions too high and whether the emission norm will be lowered. The state secretary replied that the ILT sought a stricter norm but the Raad van State did not side with it, that the permitted value falls within the EU best-available-techniques range, and that no change is planned, while noting alternative abatement techniques exist.
No, the Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT, formerly VROM-Inspectie) tried to have a stricter SO2 emission norm included in the permit issued by the province of Noord-Brabant.
Nee, de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT, voorheen VROM-Inspectie) heeft getracht in de vergunning van de provincie Noord-Brabant een strengere norm voor SO 2 -uitstoot op te laten nemen.
Antwoord vragen Grashoff over een verbod op glyfosaat

MP Grashoff asked the state secretary about a ban on glyphosate, including whether non-commercial use would be banned, the timing of a ban for professionals and private users, and the Ctgb's approval of Roundup Powermax. The state secretary replied that the certification requirement applies only to professional use on paved surfaces, that a ban will be addressed in the second Nota duurzame gewasbescherming expected in June 2012, and that restrictions do not affect product approval, while declining to discuss non-commercial approval with the Ctgb.
I aim to submit both documents to the House of Representatives in early June 2012.
Ik streef ernaar beide documenten begin juni 2012 aan de Tweede Kamer voor te leggen.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp en Ouwehand over het ontduiken van de m.e.r.-plicht voor vergunningverlening van intensieve veehouderij

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether municipalities are evading the EIA (MER) obligation for intensive livestock permits by approving stepwise expansions just below the threshold, and what consequences, oversight and enforcement follow. The minister answered that the matter rests with competent authorities (municipalities), that only incidental signals were received, that a mandatory EIA screening applies below the threshold, that inspection can act against structural negligence, and that supervision will shift to provinces under the pending Revitalisering Generiek Toezicht bill.
However, these are incidental reports, which gives me no reason to launch broader research into this.
Het gaat echter om incidentele berichten, hetgeen mij geen aanleiding geeft om hier een breder onderzoek naar in te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Van der Werf en Holtackers over het terugsturen van afval door Indonesië

MPs Van der Werf and Holtackers asked the state secretary about hazardous waste containers returned by Indonesia, whether their contents matched the export documentation, which substances were found, the Dutch share, responsible companies, the roles of the ministry and Agentschap NL, and whether more containers were involved. The state secretary answered that the 24 Dutch containers, documented as scrap metal under the green list, were exported without a permit under the EVOA; contents will be assessed by the ILT on return, companies may face measures, and no further Dutch containers are signalled.
The contents of the containers will be assessed upon their return to the Netherlands.
De inhoud van de containers wordt bij terugkomst in Nederland beoordeeld.
Antwoord vragen Leegte en De Caluwé naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Vliegtaks EU nekt Schiphol’

MPs Leegte and De Caluwé asked the state secretary whether he endorses the KiM report finding that the EU emissions trading system will cost aviation heavily and weaken Schiphol and European carriers, and what he will do about it, including pursuing a global instead of EU-only approach. The state secretary agreed the report shows the ETS is effective but may harm competitiveness, said he raised the report at the Environment Council and asked for comparable studies, and stated he backs a global system through ICAO.
At the Environment Council of 9 March I promised the European Commission that I would send it the report, and asked both the Commission and the member states to carry out a comparable study.

In de Milieuraad van 9 maart heb ik de Europese Commissie beloofd het rapport te zullen toesturen en zowel de Europese Commissie als de lidstaten gevraagd een vergelijkbaar onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen De Mos en Graus over het treffen van CO2-maatregelen op Europees niveau

PVV MPs De Mos and Graus asked the state secretary about Dutch efforts on the EU aviation ETS, the Chinese retaliation against it, and calls to suspend it. The state secretary answered that he pressed for EU-wide study of retaliation risks and a global ICAO system, but that the EU should keep a coordinated front and not withdraw the ETS unilaterally.
I urged the European Commission to 'pull out all the stops' to prevent countries such as the US, Russia and China from taking countermeasures to the detriment of the EU or its member states.
Ik heb erop aangedrongen dat de Europese Commissie «alles op alles zet» om te voorkomen, dat landen als de VS, Rusland en China tegenmaatregelen nemen ten nadele van de EU of haar lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Holtackers over het artikel “Aannemers geven uitleg – bijeenkomst moet zorgen wegnemen"

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the contractor on the Noordwaard 'Ruimte voor de Rivier' project would bring in external soil despite a planned closed soil balance, and whether thermally cleaned soil is suitable near homes. The state secretary answered that logistics explain the external soil, that Deltares did not draw the conclusions cited, that thermally cleaned soil is acceptable under the soil quality decree, and that after residents' concerns Rijkswaterstaat agreed no such soil will be used in the new dwelling mounds.
To rule out this risk, Rijkswaterstaat, in good consultation with the residents concerned, has decided that no thermally cleaned soil will be applied in the dwelling mounds yet to be built.
Om dit risico uit te sluiten heeft Rijkswaterstaat in goed overleg met betreffende bewoners besloten dat er geen thermisch gereinigde grond zal worden toegepast in de nog aan te leggen terpen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over de trage afhandeling van klachten over en door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

An MP asks the state secretary why the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport takes up to six months to handle passenger complaints about airlines, and what will be done to speed this up. The secretary defends the procedure as necessary for complex cases, reports added staff and an informing letter to complainants, and says the inspectorate will adopt the Ombudsman's recommendation to keep complainants informed.
The inspectorate has since informed the National Ombudsman in writing that it will adopt his recommendation to keep the complainant informed in the interim.
De inspectie heeft de Nationale ombudsman inmiddels schriftelijk laten weten zijn aanbeveling over te nemen om de indiener van een klacht tussentijds te informeren.
Antwoord vragen De Mos over het bericht ‘Vergaande acties tegen opwarming zijn onnodig’

MP De Mos (PVV) asked the state secretary about a newspaper report claiming climate action is unnecessary, questioning climate science, IPCC models, the claimed absence of warming over ten years, and cost-benefit findings. The state secretary answered that the IPCC Fifth Assessment Report will set out the latest science, that a cost-benefit study through 2050 will follow a parliamentary motion, and rejected the other claims as not recognised or as misreadings.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Dikkers over het ontbreken van een deugdelijk rampenplan bij TWO Chemical Logistics

Two PvdA MPs asked why TWO Chemical Logistics in Nijmegen reportedly lacks an adequate disaster plan and what inspections found. The minister reported 2011 Brzo and environmental inspections with remedial deadlines, and said the regional safety board aims to adopt an updated disaster plan on 10 May 2012.
The board of the Gelderland Zuid Safety Region aims to adopt the new disaster plan on 10 May 2012.
Het bestuur van de Veiligheidsregio Gelderland Zuid streeft naar vaststelling van het nieuwe rampbestrijdingsplan op 10 mei 2012.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over het rapport van milieudefensie over Biokerosine

An MP asks the ministers about a Milieudefensie report criticising biokerosene, including food security, social sustainability criteria, indirect land-use change, climate neutrality under the ETS, and government support. The state secretary answers that EU sustainability criteria apply, that the government supports indirect land-use change inclusion and advanced biofuels, and describes existing funding and initiatives.
The Netherlands, together with other member states, has repeatedly urged the European Commission to include ILUC at European scale in the sustainability assessment.
Nederland heeft, samen met andere lidstaten, meermaals bij de Europese Commissie erop aangedrongen ILUC op Europese schaal mee te nemen in de duurzaamheidsbeoordeling.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Timmermans over de steenkolendialoog

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the government about the stalled coal dialogue, supply-chain transparency for coal origin, and whether Nuon's commercial interests justify withholding it. The government replied that the dialogue is progressing, that origin disclosure is commercially sensitive and an imperfect indicator, and that it will invite parties to be transparent without itself publishing results.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation will, from its observer position, call on the parties involved to be transparent about the progress of the dialogue and the results achieved when the occasion arises.

Het ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie, zal vanuit zijn waarnemerspositie, de betrokken partijen oproepen bij gelegenheid zelf transparant te zijn over het verloop van de dialoog en de bereikte resultaten.
Antwoord vragen Smilde en Haverkamp over traumahelikopters

MPs Smilde and Haverkamp asked the health minister whether a study finding no proven added value of trauma helicopters over regular ambulance transport was valid and what criteria govern dispatch. The minister disagreed with the study's conclusion, explained the dispatch criteria, and said no obstacles are known to limiting helicopter response.
I think differently about that; in my view that conclusion cannot be drawn.
Daar denk ik anders over, die conclusie kan naar mijn idee niet worden getrokken.
Antwoord vragen De Mos en Van Vliet over de metallurgische industrie

PVV MPs De Mos and Van Vliet asked the ministers whether the government will act to protect the metallurgical industry's level playing field against the EU emissions trading system and the German nuclear phase-out, and urge that the system be scrapped. The minister answers that the Dutch government supports the ETS and only seeks compensation for genuine carbon leakage risk, while the Commission's state-aid guidelines are still pending.
The aim is to maintain a level playing field in Europe and to prevent member states from using state aid to distort European competitive conditions.
Het doel is handhaving van het gelijke speelveld in Europa en daartoe voorkomen dat lidstaten door middel van staatssteun de Europese concurrentieverhoudingen kunnen verstoren.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Smeets over de berichtgeving dat er wederom problemen zijn met de vaargeul tussen Holwerd en Nes op Ameland

MPs Jacobi and Smeets asked about reports of renewed problems with the Holwerd–Nes ferry channel to Ameland, including its width and depth, and what the government is doing. The minister acknowledged the problem, described a contract penalty, a failed alternative dredging trial and a demand for faster dredging, gave no firm completion date, and rejected restoring the old channel by dredging a sandbank because the Nature Conservation Act and the Waddenzee policy prohibit it.
Rijkswaterstaat is doing its utmost to ensure a good connection to and from Ameland and has taken measures to solve this problem.
Rijkswaterstaat zet zich maximaal in voor een goede verbinding van en naar Ameland en heeft maatregelen getroffen om dit probleem te verhelpen.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers en Omtzigt over het benzeenconcentratie op het meetpunt A15 Botlek

Two MPs from the CDA asked why a brief benzene peak of 75 µg/m³ at the A15 Botlek measuring point on 4 February 2012 was not reported more promptly, whether a company caused it, and what follow-up supervision applies. The state secretary answered that the annual EU limit does not apply to short peaks, that DCMR investigated and linked the peak to a frost-related gas release at an NAM installation, and that SodM as mining supervisor is examining the causes.

Following the benzene peak and the concern it caused, the procedure has been extended: for certain high benzene peaks, such as that of Saturday 4 February, the DCMR publishes a notice on its website as quickly as possible with information about the investigation.

Naar aanleiding van de benzeenpiek en de onrust die dat gaf, is de procedure uitgebreid: bij bepaalde hoge benzeenpieken, zoals die van zaterdag 4 februari, publiceert de DCMR zo snel mogelijk een melding op de website met informatie over het onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers en Omtzigt over het bedrijf Odfjell

MPs Holtackers and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the state secretary about chemical storage firm Odfjell: the 64 inspection violations, details of leaks, why the firm was left out of a quickscan, inspection frequency, whether inspectors avoided the site, and cost recovery. The state secretary answered in detail, giving violation and leak tables and inspection history, declined to publish reports (left to the competent authority), said cost recovery needs a law change, and gave no guarantee of safety.
It is up to the competent authority concerned to make the reports public, observing the rules that apply to publication.
Het is aan het betrokken bevoegd gezag om de rapporten openbaar te maken met in achtneming van de voor openbaarmaking geldende regels.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers over de wateroverlast in Groningen

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary about flooding in several Groningen villages, whether it was exceptional, what measures are needed for dikes and water storage, and the effect of German flood measures. The state secretary answered that the situation was a combination of circumstances rather than exceptional, that regional water authorities and provinces are responsible for dikes and storage, a decision on an extra pumping station is expected by mid-2012, and German measures would lower river levels in the Netherlands.
Regional water defences must meet certain standards regarding height, strength and stability.
Regionale waterkeringen dienen te voldoen aan bepaalde normen ten aanzien van hoogte, sterkte en stabiliteit.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Van Dekken over het hoogwater in Woltersum en andere plaatsen in de de provincies Groningen en Friesland en de roep om de aanleg van een extra gemaal in Lauwersoog

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary why flood-defence weaknesses on the Eemskanaal dike at Woltersum were not fixed earlier, how long reinforcement will take, why the FUGRO report was not accessible, and whether a new pumping station at Lauwersoog will be built. The state secretary replied that the regional water boards are responsible, that work is underway with completion targets, that the FUGRO report is now public, and that the regional water manager decides on the Lauwersoog pumping station.
This is a responsibility of the regional flood defence managers, the water boards Fryslân and Noorderzijlvest.
Dit is een verantwoordelijkheid van de regionale waterkeringbeheerders, de waterschappen Fryslân en Noorderzijlvest.
Antwoord vragen Koopmans over ganzen in de motoren van een Boeing op de polderbaan

An MP asked the state secretaries about a January 2012 goose strike on a Boeing 767 approaching Schiphol's Polderbaan, the number and costs of bird strikes, prevention measures, and urgency of action. The government confirmed the incidents, listed prevention and population-control measures, and committed to pilots, a 2012 inventory and an AMvB, though CO2 use depends on pending procedures.
Furthermore, in 2012 an inventory will be made of spatial developments in the zone between 6 and 13 km.
Verder zal in 2012 een inventarisatie worden gemaakt van de ruimtelijke ontwikkelingen in de zone tussen de 6 en 13 km.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de Schipholrun

An MP asked the state secretary about the planned Schipholrun, a race partly across Schiphol's closed terrain, and its security risks and costs, and whether inspection or counter-terrorism bodies had approved it. The state secretary answered that the organisers cancelled the event, that Schiphol confirmed no effect on operations was allowed, and that no inspection or NCTV review was deemed necessary.
The organisation of the Schipholrun has since announced that the event will not go ahead.
De organisatie van de Schipholrun heeft inmiddels bekendgemaakt dat het evenement niet door zal gaan.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over een vrijwillig wetenschappelijk moratorium van 60 dagen op onderzoek naar levensgevaarlijk vogelgriepvirus

An MP from the CDA asked the government about a voluntary 60-day scientific moratorium on research into H5N1 bird flu virus, the planned international forum, publication safeguards, licensing of other potentially dangerous micro-organisms, and bioterrorism risk oversight. The minister answered that the government supports the WHO-facilitated international discussion, that transparency on licensed projects is limited for state security reasons, and that a body to review risks is under consideration, with a letter to follow.
Precisely in the interest of state security, no public overview of those projects can be given.
Juist in het belang van de staatsveiligheid kan er geen openbaar overzicht van die projecten worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schaart en Lucas over het artikel ‘Slimme dijken op komst’

MPs Schaart and Lucas asked about a newspaper report on 'smart dikes', including whether broadband cable ducts in dikes could be shared with telecom companies at marginal cost and how water boards are encouraged to combine projects. The minister answered that sensor dike technology is still being studied, that a convenant between water boards and cable operators is in preparation, and that she will consider cost-sharing when the moment is right.
A convenant between the Union of Water Boards and the Platform of Network Operators is currently being prepared.
Er wordt op dit moment gewerkt aan een convenant tussen de Unie van Waterschappen en het Platform Netbeheerders
Vragen van het lid de Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Atsma; Nederland komt niet onder CO2-taks uit» (ingezonden 19 december 2011).

The MP asked the state secretary whether he would lobby all 27 EU member states against the EU ETS in its current form, what sanctions Europe would impose if the Netherlands refused to implement aviation ETS, and whether he would reject ETS for shipping if it is not global. The state secretary confirmed the statement, said the Netherlands is bound by the implemented directive, promised to keep talking with third countries and press the Commission for concrete steps, and gave no commitment to refuse ETS or lobby all member states.
To prevent any negative consequences for the Netherlands, it is of great importance to remain in dialogue with third countries.
Om eventuele negatieve consequenties voor Nederland te voorkomen is het van groot belang met derde landen in gesprek te blijven.
Vragen van het lid Houwers (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de individuele watermeters (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Consumer Authority can rule on whether water company Evides lawfully installs individual water meters, where to citizens can turn, and asked for Evides' reply on a fixed charge as a reason for meters. The state secretary answered that the Consumer Authority only acts on collective infringements, so consumers can turn to the Geschillencommissie Energie en Water or the civil court, and attached Evides' reply.
Furthermore, the Consumer Authority only acts in cases of collective infringements of laws and regulations, and not in individual cases.
Tevens treedt de Consumentenautoriteit alleen op in geval van collectieve inbreuken op de wet- en regelgeving, en niet in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen De Mos over de verhoging van de prijs van vliegtickets door het ETS

An MP asks the state secretary about the rise in airfares caused by the EU Emissions Trading System, the risk of foreign countries retaliating (such as cancelled Airbus orders), and whether the ETS charge should be suspended pending a KiM study. The state secretary replies that airlines may pass on costs under the polluter-pays principle, that retaliation is being discussed diplomatically without knowing its form, and promises the KiM study results around 1 March, while pursuing a global ICAO solution.
I expect to be able to share those results with the House around 1 March.
Ik verwacht die resultaten rond 1 maart met de Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over het bedrijf Odfjell

An MP asked the government about benzene emission peaks at Odfjell, the status of a criminal investigation into incident reporting, the action plan, and protection of whistleblowers. The government answered that the emission source and criminal investigation scope are for the relevant bodies, that enforcement pressure is being applied through joint inspections, and that no legal obligation exists to protect whistleblowers.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to determine the scope of the criminal investigation.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om de reikwijdte van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek te bepalen.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «Sportvliegtuig gevaar in lucht» (ingezonden 11 januari 2012).

An MP asks the state secretary about a newspaper report quoting air traffic control (LVNL) calling sport aircraft pilots careless, questioning whether the inspectorate (ILT) acted adequately, LVNL's communication via the press, airspace (TMA/CTR) changes, minimum flight altitudes, the strategic vision on General Aviation, consultation on the airspace vision, and the independence of the ministry from LVNL. The state secretary replies that the ILT acted adequately within its powers, LVNL distances itself from the labels and communicates directly with authorities, the airspace was only partly expanded in 2007 and 2010 with no link to the incident, and the ministry will revisit the institutional arrangement and report to the Kamer around summer.
The ILT may use the OVV material to take administrative measures after all and is currently considering this.
De ILT mag het materiaal van de OVV gebruiken om alsnog bestuurlijke maatregelen te nemen en overweegt dat nu.
Antwoord vragen Holtackers en Van der Werf over het artikel Asbest-overtreders niet gepakt

CDA MPs asked whether the Labour Inspectorate withheld damaging information about asbestos removal firms from certifying bodies, leading to wrongful certification, and what the cause was. The State Secretary denied any refusal, said a 2009 information-sharing protocol could be improved and will be replaced by a new certification system from 1 February 2012, and announced stricter enforcement and a joint chain approach.
No. In March 2009 the Labour Inspectorate concluded a protocol with the certifying bodies to exchange information mutually on how certified firms function.
Nee. De Arbeidsinspectie heeft in maart 2009 een protocol met de certificerende instellingen gesloten om wederzijds informatie uit te wisselen over het functioneren van de gecertificeerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haverkamp over het artikel  “KLM en Transavia in botsing met Schiphol”

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary about reports that Schiphol plans to raise all tariffs by 4% despite earlier pledges, the continued relevance of a 2011 McKinsey/BCG report, the transparency of the regulatory system, the Wet Luchtvaart evaluation timing, and Schiphol's expansion plans and financing. The state secretary answers that the tariff proposal is no longer on the table, the government will report the evaluation and cabinet position in early April, expansion plans are still in development with financing not yet fixed, and investments are mostly planned after 2014.
I will inform you within a few months about the results of the evaluation of the Aviation Act and the cabinet position on it.
Over de resultaten van de evaluatie van de Wet luchtvaart en het kabinetsstandpunt daarover zal ik u binnen enkele maanden informeren.
Vragen van het lid Houwers (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de individuele watermeters (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether the Consumer Authority can rule on whether water utility Evides lawfully installs individual water meters, who decides proportionality if residents dispute it, and for the Evides response to a complaint and whether fixed charges drive meter installation. The government says it is gathering information and will send it to the House before the 15 February 2012 water debate, without answering the questions yet.
Gathering the information needed to answer the questions from MP Houwers (VVD) on individual water meters (2011Z27438) will take some time.
Het inwinnen van informatie voor de beantwoording van de vragen van het lid Houwers (VVD) over individuele watermeters ( 2011Z27438 ) vergt nog enige tijd.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Olietanks slecht beveiligd» (ingezonden 12 december 2011).

MPs De Mos and Elissen asked the state secretary about a report that oil tanks were poorly secured and whether unauthorised people could approach them, and about security at other oil storage sites such as Rotterdam. The state secretary agreed access by unauthorised persons is unacceptable, described the permit, safety report and port security regime and inspection, but said no guarantee can be given that such an incident will never recur.
I share your view that it is unacceptable that unauthorised persons can get close to oil storage tanks.
Ik deel uw mening dat het onaanvaardbaar is, dat niet-bevoegde mensen dicht bij olieopslagtanks kunnen komen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «Te hoge waterschapslasten nog hoger» (ingezonden 13 december 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a newspaper report that water board levies for homeowners would rise despite a Vereniging Eigen Huis claim that they could fall. The state secretary replied that the report misreads the efficiency study: savings of 550 million euro are offset by about 600 million in investment, so tariffs rise only modestly, and he sees no reason to meet individual water boards but will report the final tariffs.

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Thieme (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Soc

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers about illegal heavy fireworks smuggling, the costs of firework injuries, and whether a consumer firework ban was unavoidable. State secretary Atsma listed enforcement measures and cost estimates but declined for now to ban consumer fireworks, citing lack of public support and a planned update of a 2008 survey.
At this moment I therefore am not considering introducing a total ban on consumer fireworks.
Op dit moment overweeg ik daarom niet een totaal verbod op consumentenvuurwerk in te stellen.

Vragen van de leden Samsom en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het voorkomen van het opzuigen van bommen bij zandwinning (ingezonden 23 december 2011

MPs Samsom and Marcouch asked ministers whether explosive munitions dredged during sand extraction at Weesp, transported to a former gravel pit, could be prevented, and who bears the costs, and whether the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid should investigate. The government's answer is only an interim notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all information has yet been received.
because not all required information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de toegankelijkheid van overheidsdata en buienradar (ingezo

An MP asks whether Buienradar's new owner restricted free weather data for app developers and how the government views companies limiting access to public data. The state secretary replies that developers may still use the data with Buienradar's permission, that the underlying KNMI data remains publicly available, and that open-data policy aims at free or low-cost access.
A restriction of access to government data is not at issue because they remain available from the government.
Een beperking van de toegankelijkheid van overheidsdata is niet aan de orde want ze blijven beschikbaar bij de overheid.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de Stort van Troost (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary about the Stort van Troost contaminated landfill in Dordrecht, including support for the municipality against Shell, when contamination spread became unacceptable, access to monitoring reports, and why remediation was delayed. The state secretary replies that soil remediation is fully decentralised to the municipality, which receives a budget and legal support funding, that monitoring reports are public, and that the Polder Stededijk redevelopment has stalled due to lost ecological funding.
Implementation of soil remediation policy is fully decentralised and in this matter the municipality of Dordrecht is the competent authority.
De uitvoering van het bodemsaneringsbeleid is volledig gedecentraliseerd en in deze kwestie is de gemeente Dordrecht bevoegd gezag.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over import van nieuwe auto’s die niet aan de emissienormen voldoen (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

MP Paulus Jansen asked whether Volkswagen importer Pon was importing new T2 camper vans as used vehicles to avoid EU emission standards, and whether this loophole should be closed. State Secretary Atsma denied the importer was involved, said the vehicle appears to meet Euro 4 rather than Euro 5, and explained that EU rules prevent member states from refusing registration of vehicles already approved elsewhere in the EU.
Registration in the Netherlands of a vehicle previously registered in another EU member state cannot be prevented.
Registratie in Nederland van een voertuig dat eerder een registratie heeft verkregen in een andere lidstaat van de EU kan niet worden tegengehouden
Vragen van het lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de verbinding tussen Bergen en Nieuw Bergen (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary why only the first layer of flood protection (dike raising) was addressed around Bergen and Aijen, leaving the access road cut off at high water, and asked about cost estimates for a bridge. The secretary answered that prevention is the responsibility of the ministry and water boards, evacuation planning lies with safety regions, the Maaswerken project lowers river levels, a federal bridge is not an option, and a Rijkswaterstaat review found the municipality's bridge design does not meet permit requirements.
Federal financing of a high-water bridge between Bergen and Nieuw Bergen is currently not an option.
Financiering door het rijk van een hoogwaterverbinding (brug) tussen Bergen en Nieuw Bergen is nu geen optie.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over ernstige vervuiling bij teerput in Vasse (ingezonden 28 oktober 20

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked about serious contamination near a tar pit in Vasse, including who manages it, past works, inspection involvement, health risks and broken monitoring wells. The state secretary answered that the province of Overijssel is the competent authority and client, that health risk is very unlikely, that some wells are broken but the groundwater picture is unchanged, and that the sanitation is to finish around 2015 with a new cover in early 2012.
The province of Overijssel is the competent authority under the Soil Protection Act and also the owner of the tar pit and client for the remediation.
De provincie Overijssel is bevoegd gezag in het kader van de Wet bodembescherming en tevens eigenaar van de teerput en opdrachtgever van de sanering.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de watersnoodramp (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

MP De Mos (PVV) asked the state secretary whether he knows of reports on quicksand as a major cause of the 1953 flood disaster, and whether he agrees that dike policy should address dangers beneath dikes, including a deep study of how Zeeland dikes can collapse. The state secretary answered that all parties aim to prevent such disasters and that design and assessment rules already cover all relevant failure mechanisms, including dangers under dikes, so no new study was announced.
The design and assessment rules we apply in the Netherlands already take into account all relevant failure mechanisms.
In de ontwerp- en toetsregels die wij in Nederland hanteren wordt reeds rekening gehouden met alle relevante faalmechanismen
Vragen van het lid Houwers (VVD) en Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over visvriendelijke technieken (ingezonden 8 november 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary about a court ruling annulling a water permit for the Borgharen hydropower plant over fish mortality, and about fish-friendly turbines and pumps, asking whether owners and water boards could be urged to adopt them. The state secretary confirmed the ruling, said he appealed it, and agreed to ask water boards and implementing bodies to use fish-friendly techniques in replacements and new works, while leaving owners to adopt proven techniques.
As is known, I have lodged an appeal against the court's ruling, because I am of the opinion that the hydropower plant complies with the measures included in the permit.

Zoals bekend heb ik hoger beroep tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank ingediend, omdat ik van mening ben dat de waterkrachtcentrale met het toepassen van de in de vergunning opgenomen maatregelen voldoet.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het vermeende weren van vissers uit de Klaverbank door Greenpeace (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An MP asked whether Greenpeace broke the law by dumping stones on the North Sea seabed (Klaverbank) that blocked fishing, and whether the vessels should be removed and crew prosecuted, and also raised the link between phosphate reduction and declining North Sea cod. The state secretary answered that dumping without a permit violates the Waterwet, but the stones pose little added fishing hazard given natural boulders, so a penalty payment was imposed to prevent repetition; on cod, research points to food mismatch and very high fishing pressure rather than nutrient reduction.
Dumping stones without a permit nevertheless remains in violation of the Water Act.
Het storten van stenen zonder vergunning blijft evenwel in strijd met de Waterwet.

Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het dumpen van zware stenen door Greenpeace op Klaverbank (ingezonden 22 juni

An MP asks the state secretaries whether Greenpeace's dumping of stones on the Klaverbank, a North Sea area, should be condemned as unlawful and undemocratic, and whether direct action and financial liability should follow. The government answers that the stone dumping breaches the Waterwet, that the Wet milieubeheer does not apply outside territorial waters, that the coast guard was deployed, a warning letter and an intended enforcement measure were issued, and that a penalty was imposed, while fishers may sue Greenpeace in civil court.
On 6 July 2011, in accordance with the General Administrative Law Act, the intention to take enforcement action was announced to Greenpeace.
Op 6 juli 2011 is conform de Algemene wet bestuursrecht het voornemen tot handhavend optreden aan Greenpeace bekend gemaakt.

Vragen van het lid Gerbrands (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat Greenpeace «bermbommen» dumpt in de Duitse Noordzee (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary about Greenpeace dumping rocks and concrete blocks in the North Sea, including whether they will be removed and whether the government's marine protection statements encourage such actions. The government answers that the Dutch state cannot remove blocks in German waters, that the marine protection policy is an EU obligation, and that engaging with Greenpeace is a matter for the parties themselves.
It is up to Greenpeace to decide which debate it takes part in or not.
Het is aan Greenpeace te bepalen aan welk debat men deelneemt of niet.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het nakomen van internationale afspraken ten aanzien van milieubelastende subsidies en belastingvoordelen (ingezonden 6 okt

An MP asked whether the government will confirm its international commitment to phase out environmentally harmful subsidies, which subsidies currently have the heaviest environmental impact, and whether it will phase them out and press other countries. The state secretary confirmed the commitment, said further research is needed on environmental pressure, and said the government favours phasing out such subsidies case by case, pursued mainly at EU level.
The cabinet is in principle in favour of abolishing environmentally harmful subsidies.
Het kabinet is in beginsel voor het afschaffen van milieubelastende subsidies.
