Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het onderhouden van de verdiepte vaargeul in de Westerschelde (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether dredging permits for the Westerschelde channel must be renewed periodically, whether lack of nature compensation could lead to annulment, and whether Flanders could claim hundreds of millions if Dutch actions prevented maintenance. The state secretary confirmed permits are needed, said current permits expire in 2015 and no compensation is required, and said no Flemish pre-announcement of a dispute procedure has been made.
The Flemish Region has not given any advance notice of starting a dispute settlement procedure.
Door het Vlaams Gewest is geen vooraankondiging gedaan van de start van een geschillenbeslechtingsprocedure.

Vragen van de leden De Mos, Graus en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «VS laten zich de les niet lezen in de luchtvaart»

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether the EU Emissions Trading System for aviation threatens Schiphol's hub role by pushing non-European airlines to route around Europe, and whether an independent study and joint EU action should follow. The state secretary answered that ETS is a market-based instrument rather than a tax, that a KiM study on Dutch aviation effects is underway, and that the Commission has been asked to assess EU-wide consequences.
The Knowledge Institute for Mobility Policy has currently commissioned a study into the effects of the EU ETS on Dutch aviation.
Bij het Kennisinstituut Mobiliteitsbeleid is op dit moment een onderzoek uitgezet naar de effecten van EU-ETS op de Nederlandse luchtvaart.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «DCMR: Odfjell lekte regelmatig benzeen» (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that Odfjell repeatedly leaked benzene in the Rotterdam port, whether a deep investigation is needed, and whether all Dutch ports should use VentoClean-type vapour recovery. The state secretary says benzene is a minimisation-obliged substance, that the regional authority (DCMR) and inspectorate monitor Odfjell, a criminal investigation is underway, no new deep study is needed, and vapour recovery is required where economically feasible.
Because of this incidental peak emission and earlier emissions in which benzene was released, a criminal investigation has been started against Odfjell.
Wegens deze incidentele piekemissie en eerdere emissies waarbij benzeen vrijgekomen is, is er een strafrechtelijk onderzoek gestart tegen Odfjell.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de uitgegeven Bosatlas van het klimaat (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about the cost of the Bosatlas van het klimaat, whether the KNMI's involvement makes it partisan unsuited to objective public information, and whether the WMO-based ten-yearly climate atlas duty can be dropped. The state secretary answered that no subsidy was given, the KNMI supplied only factual information, and that the ten-yearly assessment is useful for sectors needing to adapt.
The KNMI contributed exclusively factually and objectively established information for the atlas.
Het KNMI heeft voor de atlas uitsluitend feitelijk en objectief vastgestelde informatie aangedragen.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over microplastics in consumentenproducten die het water vervuilen (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about microplastics in cosmetic scrubs and peelings polluting marine ecosystems, their effects on fish, marine mammals and human health, and whether the government would push for an EU ban and raise the issue internationally. The state secretary acknowledged microplastics are in scrubs and that effects are unclear, said the topic will be addressed through the Marine Strategy Directive and international fora, but declined to commit to a ban, noting cosmetics rules are EU-level and contain no environmental criteria, while agreeing to raise the issue with the Commission.

However, I am willing to raise this topic with the European Commission within the framework of the Marine Strategy Framework Directive, with the aim of examining what options exist for reducing the emission of microplastics.

Ik ben evenwel bereid dit onderwerp bij de Europese Commissie aan de orde te stellen in het kader van de Kaderrichtlijn Mariene Strategie met het doel na te gaan welke mogelijkheden er zijn voor het terugdringen van de emissie van microplastics.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het nakomen van internationale afspraken ten aanzien van milieubelastende subsidies en belastingvoordelen (ingezonden 6 okt

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Netherlands committed under the Nagoya and G20 Pittsburgh agreements to phase out environmentally harmful subsidies, which subsidies and tax exemptions currently exist for fossil fuels, groundwater and other resources, which cause the most environmental pressure, and whether the government will phase them out. The government only responded that it needs more time to answer all questions and will reply as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that I need more time to answer all the questions.
Hierbij laat ik u weten dat ik meer tijd nodig heb voor beantwoording van alle vragen.

Vragen van de leden Aptroot en Leegte (beiden VVD) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de mogelijkheden tot het gebruik van Liquid Natural Gas (LNG) in de transportsector (ingezonden

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary why municipalities such as Zwolle refuse permits for LNG fuelling installations, leaving subsidised LNG trucks idle, and asked for quick LNG regulation. The secretary answered that no principled objections exist and a permit is expected within about six weeks, that municipalities hold their own permitting authority, and that a PGS 33 LNG guideline is due in summer 2012, with no speedy timetable and no commitment to rush the reply.
I will look into whether and where the legal frameworks for setting up fuelling points should be made clearer.
Ik zal kijken of en waar de wettelijke kaders voor het inrichten van laad/vulpunten duidelijker moeten worden gemaakt.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over grondstoffen voor de productie van biobrandstof (ingezonden 27 s

MP Paulus Jansen asked the state secretaries about the Task Force Sustainable Palm Oil's initiatives, whether Neste Oil's biofuel refinery uses 400,000 tonnes of palm oil, the RSPO complaint against supplier IOI, whether the refinery receives state financial support enabling conditions, and how the 2015 sustainability target is ensured. The government answered that the Task Force has taken several voluntary steps, that Neste Oil's palm oil share cannot be determined in advance, that IOI's certification is suspended only for new plantations, that no subsidy went to the refinery, and that binding enforcement is limited to statutory criteria for energy use while private parties are held to voluntary commitments.
The share of palm oil at Neste Oil Netherlands therefore cannot be estimated in advance.
Het aandeel palmolie bij Nesté Oil Nederland kan daarom niet op voorhand worden ingeschat.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over kosten van het klimaatbeleid (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary to account for total climate policy costs, including renewable energy subsidies flagged by the Audit Office, and for spending on external consultants and climate foundations. The state secretary says renewable energy costs fall under a different minister and that the requested detail cannot be provided after the fact.
No. The answers given address the requested information as well as possible and provide the information that is directly available.
In de gegeven antwoorden is zo goed als mogelijk ingegaan op de gevraagde informatie en is de informatie verstrekt die direct beschikbaar is.
Vragen van het lid Holtackers (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een botel (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

The MP asks whether the minister will cooperate with a hotel boat (botel) proposed in Woudrichem, arguing its effect on river discharge capacity is minimal and that the Beleidslijn grote rivieren should be read less narrowly. The state secretary says talks with the municipality are ongoing, that local initiatives should be treated positively in principle, but that works in the riverbed need a Waterwet permit and the policy rules only allow such uses under strict river-hydraulic conditions.
I am still in discussion with the municipality about these plans.
Over deze plannen ben ik nog in gesprek met de gemeente.

Vragen van het lid de Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat Al Gore een lezing komt geven aan de Rijksuniversiteit van Groningen (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary of Infrastructure and Environment about Al Gore's lecture at the University of Groningen, alleging that the CBS, tax authority, municipality and university sponsored it, and asking whether taxpayers are funding it and whether the university's climate message is one-sided. The state secretary answers that the tax authority and CBS only ran unrelated workshops, that the organising student association financed the lecture from business contributions, and that the university is responsible for such spending, so no recovery from subsidies is planned.
The University of Groningen is itself responsible for this expenditure.
De Rijksuniversiteit Groningen is zelf verantwoordelijk voor deze uitgaven.
Vragen van het lid Leegte (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over emissietestprogramma’s (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about Volkswagen's cylinder-deactivation technology that lowers test emissions, and whether emission test programmes and labelling mislead given the gap with real-world performance. The state secretary acknowledges the test gap, says Netherlands is pushing UN-ECE reform of the test procedure, and points to driving-behaviour campaigns rather than new binding measures.
The Netherlands is closely involved and is advocating for a measurement procedure for fuel consumption and CO2 emissions that yields figures better matching real-world practice.
Nederland is hier nauw bij betrokken, en maakt zich sterk voor een meetprocedure voor het brandstofverbruik en de CO2-uitstoot die cijfers oplevert die beter overeenstemmen met de praktijk.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over microplastics in consumentenproducten die het water vervuilen (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about microplastics in cosmetic scrubs and peelings, their effects on marine ecosystems and health, and whether the government will push for a ban and raise the issue internationally. The government replies only that data must still be gathered and that the questions will be answered later.
Data still need to be collected to answer the questions, which requires additional time.
Voor het antwoord op de vragen moeten nog gegevens verzameld worden, hetgeen extra tijd vergt.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Veldhoven (D66), Leegte (VVD), Van Tongeren (GL), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (CU), Van der Werf (CDA), Van Vliet (PVV), Samsom (PvdA) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecret

Nine MPs asked why the Hagestein hydropower plant has been out of use since 2005, why a renovation plan and a private 20-year concession offer were not acted upon, and what the government's view is on the case. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat is still studying technical, legal and environmental requirements and will decide in 2012 whether to tender, integrate or shut down the plant, and will inform stakeholders in coming months.
RWS will take the initiative to inform the interested companies and governments about the state of affairs in a few months' time.
RWS zal het initiatief nemen om de belanghebbende bedrijven en overheden over enkele maanden in te lichten over de stand van zaken
Vragen lid Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het project Munnikenland en PKB Ruimte voor de Rivier (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Munnikenland project's nature zoning under the Ruimte voor de Rivier PKB allows agricultural nature management, and whether the Rijk should engage the municipality of Zaltbommel before its July 2011 zoning decision. The state secretary answered that agricultural co-use is possible within the nature designation, that Rijkswaterstaat safeguards flood safety regardless of who manages the land, and that the programme directorate has been in contact with the alderman and project organisation.
Within the nature designation agricultural co-use is possible; a dual designation is not needed for that.
Binnen de bestemming «natuur» is agrarisch medegebruik mogelijk; een dubbelbestemming is daarvoor niet nodig.
Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «Landgoed Hemmen eist «subsidiepercelen» op» (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

An MP asked why Rijkswaterstaat never invited the Lijndensche Fonds to talks about selling the Lexkesveer floodplain plots, and whether the planned transfer to Geldersch Landschap breaches a European Commission state-aid decision and why there was no open tender. The state secretary replied that the plots were promised to the future manager, GLGK, which has managed the land for nearly two years, that the EC decision does not cover this transfer, and that the transfer will be made at market value, with ownership transferred only after the zoning change to nature.
RWS is aware of the complaint to the European Commission (EC) and the Linschoten Declaration.
RWS is op de hoogte van de klacht bij de Europese Commissie (EC) en de Verklaring van Linschoten.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de asbestbesmetting op twee scholen in Purmerend (ingezonden 6 september 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about an asbestos contamination at two Purmerend schools, including whether the removal complied with rules, whether the clearance certificate was rightly issued, and whether the inspectorates would map the whole process. The state secretary confirmed the closures, said the company was certified but declined further comment due to a criminal investigation, noted no authority inspected during removal, and saw no reason for additional inquiry while the criminal probe runs.
I currently see no reason for additional investigation since a criminal investigation is underway.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding tot aanvullend onderzoek aangezien er een strafrechtelijk onderzoek loopt.

Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het afwijken van landelijke stanknormen door een gemeente zodat melkveehouderijen kunnen uit

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary whether they object to Kaag en Braassem municipality deviating from national odour distances so dairy farms can expand, and whether he will urge the municipality to keep national limits. The state secretary replied that the Wet geurhinder en veehouderij lets municipalities set tailored odour policy within set bandwidths, that courts can review such ordinances, and that he sees no reason to intervene.
Whether the ordinance meets the legal requirements can be reviewed by the administrative court in appeal proceedings against the granting of a permit for expanding a livestock farm.

Of de verordening aan de wettelijke vereisten voldoet, kan door de bestuursrechter worden getoetst in het kader van een beroepsprocedure tegen de verlening van een vergunning voor de uitbreiding van een veehouderij.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatsecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de aansprakelijkheid van Eternit voor kosten van asbestsanering (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about the Arnhem appeal court ruling holding Eternit liable for asbestos exposure harm, and whether the state should sue Eternit to recover asbestos removal costs. The secretary confirms the ruling, describes state compensation schemes and recovery efforts, rejects total asbestos removal from buildings as disproportionate, reports failed voluntary talks with Eternit, and says he will further examine legal options in light of the ruling.
In light of this ruling, I will conduct further research.
In het licht van deze uitspraak zal ik nader onderzoek doen.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu, de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de juridische procedure van asbe

An SP MP asks why asbestos victims applying under the two compensation schemes (TAS for employment-related, TNS for non-employment-related exposure) face different appeal routes and double court fees, and asks for a shorter procedure and a longer application deadline. The state secretary explains the routes follow from different legal bases, promises to examine ways to reduce rejections on both applications and to consider legislative change if needed, and declines to extend the application deadline because only the victim can apply.
I share the view that a single legal route for both schemes would be more efficient and cost-saving.
Ik deel de mening dat één rechtsgang voor beide regelingen efficiënter en kostenbesparender zou zijn.

Vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Koopmans en Holtackers (allen CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over begroeiing van de uiterwaarden (ingezonden 23

CDA MPs asked why the cabinet plans to spend 75 million euro on removing vegetation in the river floodplains for flood safety, where the money comes from, whether other financing options were considered, and why a new law rather than existing frameworks is proposed. The state secretary answered that the one-off budget comes from the infrastructure fund, that the Waterwet will be amended to oblige landowners to maintain vegetation so it does not raise water levels, and that the cabinet is following a 2009 parliamentary motion while coordinating with the ministry of Economic Affairs on Natura 2000 aspects.
In my view, owners of land in the floodplains must themselves maintain the vegetation growing on it so that it does not form an unacceptable obstacle to river discharge.
Naar mijn mening dienen rechthebbenden van gronden in de uiterwaarden de daarop groeiende vegetatie zelf zodanig te onderhouden dat deze geen ontoelaatbare belemmering voor de rivierafvoer vormt.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de vraag of klimaatregels überhaupt effect hebben (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP from PVV asked the state secretary whether the light bulb ban and other climate measures actually reduce CO2, and whether they should be reviewed. The state secretary answered that energy saving is important, that the ban was adopted at EU level, and that the emissions trading system will be kept as it is.
The decision for a ban on incandescent light bulbs was taken at European level.
Het besluit voor een verbod op gloeilampen is op Europees niveau genomen.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatsecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de aansprakelijkheid van Eternit voor kosten van asbestsanering (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a court ruling holding Eternit liable for asbestos exposure damages and whether the state should sue Eternit to recover asbestos remediation costs. The answer received was only an interim notice that the reply needs several more weeks of fact-finding.
Because further factual investigation is still needed, answering the questions will take some more weeks.
Omdat nog nader feitenonderzoek nodig is, vergt de beantwoording van de vragen nog enige weken.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat Schiphol in 2007 aan een vliegramp is ontsnapt (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary why the safety board's report on a 2007 near-collision at Schiphol appeared nearly four years later, whether the inspectorate IVW failed in its supervision, why management meetings with LVNL were not recorded in writing, and whether LVNL needs a culture change. The state secretary defended the inspectorate's and LVNL's actions, citing audits, procedures and a prior internal study, and acknowledged one missing meeting report.
Unfortunately there is no report of the meeting on 5 September 2008, the meeting the Safety Board refers to.
Helaas is er geen verslag van het overleg op 5 september 2008, het overleg waar de Onderzoeksraad aan refereert.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Miljarden euro's klimaatgeld onderhevig aan corruptie» (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary about reports that billions in climate finance are vulnerable to corruption, how much goes to highly corrupt countries, whether climate sceptics sit on the climate bank, and about fraud in CO2 trading. The government answered that all funds are accounted for and corruption is investigated and recovered, that the World Bank will act as trustee with fiduciary standards, and that anti-fraud measures for emissions trading are being strengthened.
Afterwards, all organisations that have received the money must always account for the expenditure.
Achteraf dienen alle organisaties die het geld hebben ontvangen zich altijd te verantwoorden voor de uitgaven.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Al Gore start nieuwe klimaatcampagne» (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment for a detailed accounting of climate policy costs per department since 1988, departmental staffing, and the costs for business of meeting the EU 20% CO2 target, and whether the climate spending has made a measurable difference to temperature or sea level. The state secretary gave partial figures for some years, said several datasets are unavailable or will be published later, and said climate costs were not aimed at making the Netherlands climate neutral by 2012 or 2020.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de verwerking van brandbaar afval uit Napels (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

SP MPs asked the state secretary about incineration of combustible waste from Naples in Dutch plants, including whether it displaces Dutch waste, volumes, prices, AVR-Van Gansewinkel's finances and controls on the waste stream. The state secretary replied that no notification had yet been filed, that the flexible import ceiling could block new imports, and that the Inspectorate checks transports by sampling, judging the risk from Naples waste as small.
Setting rates for processing waste from abroad is a matter for the processing companies themselves.
Tariefstelling voor verwerking van afval uit het buitenland is een zaak van de verwerkingsbedrijven zelf.
Vragen van de leden Van Gent en van Tongeren (beiden GroenLinks) aan staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de Europese aanpak om fijnstof terug te dringen (ingezonden 6 juli 2011).

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about the EU approach to fine particulate matter, including whether the Netherlands will meet the 2015 PM2.5 limits, whether standards should target health risks or ultrafine particles, and whether diesel soot filters capture the finest particles. The government answered that PM2.5 compliance is very likely, that new standards are not yet justified and an EU review is pending, and that current filters capture over 95% of fine particles.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Gebruik van roetfilters om fijnstof terug te dringen werk

An MP asked whether Dutch diesel soot filters remove ultrafine particles, whether current fine-dust norms adequately weight ultrafine particles, and what EU and WHO steps exist on PM0.1 standards. The state secretary answered that filters capture over 95% of fine particles, that PM10 and PM2.5 remain the appropriate norm indicators, and that the EU will ask the WHO to evaluate whether soot should be assessed separately, with no new Gezondheidsraad advice planned.
Do you share the view that more research and measurements with new equipment on PM0.1 concentrations are necessary to arrive at a more complete health indicator for fine dust?
Deelt u de mening dat meer onderzoek en metingen met de nieuwe apparatuur naar PM 0,1 concentraties noodzakelijk zijn om te komen tot een volwaardigere gezondheidsindicator voor fijnstof?
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het rapport «Uitbreiding Lelystad Airport» (ingezonden 2 augustus 2011).

The MP asks the state secretary about a business-circle report on expanding Lelystad Airport, including air traffic control, accessibility, Schiphol's willingness to invest, and whether the region's interests are weighed equally. The state secretary answers that an action plan and a pending Alders advisory process govern next steps, that financial and legal instruments will only be considered after an irrevocable designation decision and the Alders advice, and that the government will set a position later.
Before financial and legal instruments can be discussed, it is important that there is 1) an irrevocable designation decision and 2) an Alders advice for the future has been adopted.

Voordat er gesproken kan worden over het inzetten van financiële en juridische instrumenten is het van belang dat er 1) een onherroepelijk aanwijzingsbesluit ligt en 2) een Aldersadvies voor de toekomst is vastgesteld.
Vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van der Werf (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het waterkrachtproject Borgharen (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about the Borgharen hydropower plant, whose permits were partly annulled by the Maastricht court over fish mortality, and whether the government will appeal and apply innovative fish-protection techniques. The state secretary confirmed the permits and the project's benefits, acknowledged the court's concerns on cumulative fish damage, said he is studying a new consultant report, supported innovative techniques, and was positive about an appeal by Rijkswaterstaat.
At this moment experts within my department are studying the report.
Op dit moment bestuderen deskundigen binnen mijn departement het rapport.
Vragen van leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over waterschapslasten (ingezonden 2 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether it is undesirable that farmers pay disproportionate water board levies because of infrastructure value in their water board areas, and whether the Taxatiewijzer for infrastructure should be made optional in 2012. The state secretary said infrastructure value is legally part of the valuation, that Delfland's tariffs rose after the new tax system, that research on tariff relief within the current law has not yet produced a solution, and that the results will be reported to parliament.
I will report the results to the House of Representatives.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer over de resultaten berichten.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over met het artikel «Luchtvaart woest om hulp bij claim» (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether passengers can claim flight compensation without commercial intermediaries, given a Consumentenbond partnership with EUclaim that takes a share of claims and steers consumers toward one paid service. The secretary answers that passengers can always claim directly with IVW, the Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart or the civil court, that the Consumentenbond cannot decide claims, and that the partnership and its role as co-founder of the dispute commission need not conflict.
A passenger can after all take his complaint directly to the IVW, the Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart and the civil court himself.
Een passagier kan met zijn klacht immers zelf rechtstreeks terecht bij de IVW, de Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart en de civiele rechter.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over overlast van de KLM Luchtvaart School op vliegveld Eelde (ingezonden 6 juli 2011).

MPs Dijksma and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about noise nuisance from KLM Luchtvaart School training aircraft at Eelde airport, and whether its economic importance justifies this, plus why older aircraft are used and what will be done. The state secretary answered that the airport operator has operational agreements with flight schools that keep the airport within its permitted noise space, that the government has no competence to review school plans or fleet choices, and that the airport is trying to reduce avoidable noise through pricing incentives.
In doing so, no actual exceedances have been found in recent years.
Daarbij zijn de afgelopen jaren geen feitelijke overschrijdingen geconstateerd.
Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Financiën over de positie van KLM binnen Air France-KLM (ingezonden 14 juli 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary and finance minister about the restructuring of Air France-KLM, including the new top layer, reporting lines of KLM's CEO to the holding, and guarantees that KLM remains the home carrier at Schiphol and the state's shareholding and option rights. The government answered that the structure is still in development, that the Air France-KLM chair will no longer also chair Air France, that existing Schiphol-related commitments were extended indefinitely in 2010, and that the state holds 5.9% of shares with a 50.1% option that lapsed in May 2010.
From KLM I understand that at this stage it is not yet concretely possible to state what will change in the structure.
Van KLM begrijp ik dat in dit stadium nog niet concreet is aan te geven wat er gaat veranderen in de structuur.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat de afvaloven in Harlingen de normen zou overschrijden (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

MPs Jacobi and Samsom asked the state secretary about reports that the Harlingen waste incinerator exceeded emission norms, including health risks and monitoring. The secretary replied that Tauw found no exceedances of emission limits after start-up, that dioxin emissions were negligible, and that the GGD and a Wageningen biomonitoring programme are following local health.
Tauw found no exceedances of the emission limit values.
Tauw heeft geen overschrijdingen van de emissiegrenswaarden geconstateerd.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Jacobi (PvdA) en Samsom (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de emissies van de afvalverbrandingsinstallatie OMRIN te Harlingen (ingezonden 27 mei 2011)

MPs Jansen, Jacobi and Samsom asked whether the OMRIN waste incinerator in Harlingen exceeds its permitted emission levels, what the limits on downtime and enforcement framework are, and what action the government will take. The State Secretary replied that the provincial authority enforces the permit and Besluit verbranden afvalstoffen, that the 60-hour annual downtime cap has reportedly not been exceeded, and that no additional measures are needed.
According to the province, this maximum has not been exceeded since commissioning.
Volgens de provincie is dit maximum sinds de ingebruikname niet overschreden.
Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over aannames anti-verdrogingsbeleid (ingezonden 4 juli 2011).

MP Koppejan asked the state secretary whether flawed assumptions in groundwater-based models of drought (verdroging) undermine the anti-drying policy and related water, manure, pesticide and planning policies, and whether those assumptions should be reviewed. The state secretary answered that the scientific debate is not settled, that the anti-drying policy rests mainly on ecological observations rather than groundwater models, and that no additional review is planned for now.
Given the ongoing scientific discussion and the related research, and because I have received no signals that the assumptions are incorrect, I see no reason at this time to start additional research.

Gelet op de nog gaande wetenschappelijke discussie en het bijbehorende wetenschappelijk onderzoek en het feit dat ik geen signalen heb ontvangen over onjuistheid van de aannames zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor het starten van aanvullend onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Smeets (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de veiligheid van zwembaden (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether accidents involving suction systems in Dutch public pools are known, whether an investigation is needed, and whether every pool should hold the Veilig & Schoon quality mark. The secretary answered that no such accidents are known beyond a 1985 case, that provinces supervise compliance with the pool safety decree, and that no investigation or mandatory certification is planned because the sector itself is motivated.
The provinces supervise compliance with this.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de vormgeving van de Regeling brandstoffen luchtverontreiniging (ingezonden 29 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about possible steps at EU level for implementing the fuel quality directive, whether reporting for fossil fuels in the Regeling brandstoffen luchtverontreiniging is less specific than for biofuels, and whether the regulation should be tightened and pushed in the EU for breakdowns of air-pollution values. The state secretary answers that Commission implementing rules are pending but the Dutch rules follow the Commission's consultation proposals, that existing reporting already requires separate reporting by fuel origin, and that no tightening or EU initiative on air-pollutant reporting is planned.
No. The decree and the regulation are a strict implementation of the Fuel Quality Directive.
Nee. Het besluit en de regeling zijn een strikte implementatie van de richtlijn Brandstofkwaliteit.
Vragen van het lid Holtackers (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «KNMI weersvoorspelling slaat plank mis, recreant blijft weg» (ingezonden 28 juli 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether KNMI weather forecasts that wrongly predicted bad weather, deterring visitors from outdoor events like the Nijmegen Four Days March, should be regionalised and event-specific. The state secretary replies that the KNMI gives a general national forecast by law, that regional and event forecasts are for private weather companies, and that regionalised warnings are issued only for safety or extreme weather.
The KNMI issues a general weather report, as stipulated in the Act on the KNMI.
Het KNMI geeft een algemeen weerbericht, zoals is bepaald in de Wet op het KNMI.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het rapport van de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid over ee

An MP asked the State Secretaries about the Safety Board's findings on a 2009 crash on Bonaire, including inadequate aviation safety oversight and emergency coordination. The government answered that oversight of Bonaire, Saba and St. Eustatius moved to the Dutch state in October 2010, that the Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten authorities are responsible for their own oversight, and that the ICAO action plan is well behind schedule with pressure being applied.
I am of the view that this concern is adequately addressed by the aviation system the Netherlands has set up for this purpose.
Ik ben van mening dat deze zorg afdoende wordt ingevuld door het luchtvaartsysteem dat Nederland daarvoor heeft ingericht.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Minister Cramer investeerde 50 miljoen in zichzelf» (ingezonden 28 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a press report that minister Cramer invested 50 million euro in herself, and whether the funds for the University of Utrecht would go to climate research. The state secretary said no such transaction is known, explaining the figure refers to a 2007 cabinet decision creating a 50 million euro FES-funded climate programme requiring matching contributions from many organisations, with Utrecht's share about 1.2 million euro.
Such a transaction is unknown to me.
Een dergelijke transactie is mij onbekend.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over schade na storing van een luchtwasser (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about a malfunction at an air-scrubber at the DMV plant in Veghel that released white sodium hydroxide deposits, including how it happened, whether it has occurred before, who pays the cleanup costs, and how much subsidy is granted for scrubbers. The state secretary answers that a dosing error caused it, similar incidents have occurred in the past with the province or municipality as competent authority, the company is liable for cleanup costs, and no national overview of scrubber subsidies exists.
In these cases the competent authority is the province or municipality, where overviews of complaints and unusual incidents are also held.
Het bevoegd gezag is in deze gevallen de provincie of de gemeente waar ook overzichten van klachten en ongewone voorvallen aanwezig zijn.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Winsten op vervuilde olie enorm, actie ondernomen» (ingezonden 18 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that profits from mixing waste into marine fuel oil are large, asking about enforcement, legal clarity, sanctions and international standards. The state secretary answered that current rules do not clearly exclude blending, detection is difficult and penalties may not deter, while describing stricter sulphur norms from 2015 and ongoing enforcement and research.
No. Under current laws and regulations it is not easy to determine whether certain substances or material flows may be used as blend components.
Neen. Op grond van de huidige wet- en regelgeving is niet eenvoudig te bepalen of bepaalde stoffen of materiaalstromen gebruikt mogen worden als blendcomponent
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over inkoop van duurzaam hout (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary about a Milieudefensie report finding that 70% of audited central-government projects contained wood not meeting the government's sustainable timber criteria, and about the government's failure to meet its own procurement standards. The State Secretary acknowledges shortcomings in contract compliance and supply-chain verification, commits to exploring improvements with Milieudefensie and market parties, but rejects the advice to require FSC specifically.
Although the 100% target has not yet been reached, I conclude from this that the sustainable timber procurement criteria are widely applied in central-government projects.
Hoewel de 100% nog niet gehaald wordt, concludeer ik hieruit dat de inkoopcriteria voor duurzaam hout breed worden toegepast in rijksprojecten.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het dreigende faillissement van de Nederlandse vissersvloo

PVV MPs asked the state secretaries about the threatened bankruptcy of the Dutch fishing fleet, including whether strict EU environmental rules are to blame, whether climate funds could pay fishers to collect plastic, and for an overview of climate spending. The government answered that the fleet's viability is primarily the fishers' responsibility, that environmental rules are set at EU and international level with no national room to deviate, that climate funds are not earmarked for plastic fishing, and that it will discuss a possible pilot with the Commission.
There are no possibilities to deviate from that nationally.
Er zijn geen mogelijkheden om daar nationaal van af te wijken.
Kamervragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Milieunorm te streng» (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

The PVV MP De Mos asks the state secretary about reports that EU aviation emissions rules could cost jobs, and about the ETS, Chinese non-participation, passenger compensation and reciprocity for foreign airlines. The state secretary rejects the premise, defends free allocation and the polluter-pays principle, promises to press the Commission on third-country issues and passenger-rights revision, and says reciprocity already applies.
I will ask the European Commission to take action on this and seek a solution
zal ik de Europese Commissie verzoeken om hierop actie te ondernemen en te zoeken naar een oplossing

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Van Veldhoven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een VN-onderzoek naar de vliegramp in Tripoli (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

Two MPs asked the ministers whether they would ask ICAO to start an investigation into the 2010 Tripoli air crash, since Libyan authorities had not finished their inquiry after a year. The state secretary replied that ICAO rules put the investigation under Libyan lead, that ICAO can only act with Libya's explicit consent, which seems unlikely given the situation, and that the Netherlands will press for a swift conclusion.
The ICAO Convention provides no possibility to take independent action without consent or a request from the member state responsible for the investigation.
Het ICAO-verdrag kent geen mogelijkheid om zonder toestemming of zonder verzoek van de voor het onderzoek verantwoordelijke lidstaat, eigenstandig acties te ondernemen.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Klimaatdoelen kosten Rotterdam miljarden» (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked whether a reported 11.3 billion euro cost to meet climate targets in the Rotterdam port is accurate, whether it is megalomaniac, and for a cost-benefit analysis and economic consequences. The state secretary replied that the figure concerns the municipality's Duurzaam programme and a direct economic impact estimate by a public-private initiative, not national policy, that no Rotterdam-specific cost-benefit analysis exists, and that the national climate aim is a global warming limit of 2 degrees.
Your question refers to policy formulated in the Rotterdam municipality's Sustainability Programme. This concerns no national government policy.
Uw vraagstelling refereert aan beleid geformuleerd in het Duurzaamheids Programma van de gemeente Rotterdam. Dit betreft geen beleid van het Rijk.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu, de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de juridische procedure van asbe

An SP MP asks the state secretary and ministers about asbestos victims facing two different legal procedures under the TAS and TNS schemes, including separate courts and double court fees, and asks whether the procedure can be harmonised and the claim deadline extended. The government's answer is only an interim notice that the reply will be delayed due to consultation with other departments.

I hereby inform you that the answer to the written questions from MP Paulus Jansen (SP) on the legal procedure for asbestos victims (submitted 16 June 2011) cannot be given within the set deadline because further consultation with other departments is required.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) over de juridische procedure van asbestslachtoffers (ingezonden 16 juni 2011), niet binnen de gestelde termijn zal kunnen plaatsvinden omdat nadere afstemming met andere departementen vereist is.
Vragen van de leden Venrooy-van Ark en Houwers (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het project Hollandsche IJssel (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

VVD MPs asked the state secretary whether plans to dredge a navigation channel at the Hollandsche IJssel near Molen Kortenoord were final, why a promised dredging project was dropped, and whether it will be carried out. The state secretary replied that no clay layer will be applied, the promised access improvement was abandoned because a houseboat without a contract refused to move, and dredging will proceed once the houseboat can be temporarily relocated.
Yes, as soon as the houseboat can be (temporarily) moved.
Ja, zodra de woonboot (tijdelijk) verplaatst kan worden.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over Chinese bezwaren tegen het EU «Emissions Trading Scheme» (ETS) (ingezonden 24 mei 2011).

An MP asked the minister about Chinese government opposition to including Chinese airlines in the EU ETS, possible Chinese retaliatory sanctions, and the government's strategy for global emissions trading and the sector. The state secretary confirmed the Chinese objections and that retaliation is threatened, stated the ETS is lawful under international law, and committed to consulting other member states and the Commission and to informing parliament about sectoral developments.
Within the possibilities I have, I will consult closely with other EU member states and the European Commission on how China is to be met.
Binnen de mogelijkheden die ik hiertoe heb zal ik samen met ander EU-lidstaten en de Europese Commissie nauw overleg voeren over de wijze waarop China tegemoet wordt getreden.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over rioolwater in de Westerschelde (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about millions of litres of sewage entering the Westerschelde after a pipe break, questioning its environmental and economic impact, whether maintenance backlog was involved, and whether the whole sewerage system should be examined and alternative temporary storage promoted. The state secretary answered that the impact was local and temporary, that the water board is investigating the cause, that the national sewerage system is in order per the 2010 benchmark, and that further national research and promotion of alternative storage are not needed.
The Brabantse Delta Water Board is investigating the cause of the pipe break on its territory.
Het Waterschap Brabantse Delta onderzoekt de oorzaak van de breuk in de persleiding op zijn terrein.
Vragen het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Waterschap verkwist zelf veel water in droge tijd» (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that water boards waste considerable fresh water during drought, and whether the reuse of treated wastewater, as suggested by a consultancy, should be pursued. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said reuse of treated wastewater is being studied within the Delta Programme with cost-benefit analysis, and promised to inform the House in the annual Delta Programme update.
Yes, I take the DHV advice seriously.
Ja, ik neem het advies van DHV serieus.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dijsselbloem (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de hoogwatergeul bij Veessen – Wapenveld (gemeente Heerde) (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about the flooding arrangements for the Veessen-Wapenveld flood relief channel and a Rijkswaterstaat letter suggesting changes to how the gates open, and whether this was appropriate given earlier opposition. The state secretary confirmed the chosen flood frequency will not change, said the gate operation protocol is still to be drafted, and described the letter as a routine preliminary review feeding into the pending project decision.
No agreements have yet been made on how the channel will fill and how the inlet will be operated.
Over de wijze waarop de geul gaat volstromen en de inlaat wordt bediend, zijn nog geen afspraken gemaakt.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat de afvaloven in Harlingen de normen zou overschrijden (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about reports that the Harlingen waste incinerator exceeds emission norms, including whether dioxin limits are breached, what health risks and monitoring exist for residents, and what measures will prevent recurrence. The state secretary requested an extension to answer, stating that further consultation with the competent authority, the province of Fryslân, is needed.
The reason for the delay is that additional consultation and coordination is needed with the competent authority, the province of Fryslân.
De reden voor het uitstel is dat aanvullend overleg en afstemming nodig is met het betreffende bevoegd gezag, zijnde de provincie Fryslân.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Jacobi (PvdA) en Samsom (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de emissies van de afvalverbrandingsinstallatie OMRIN te Harlingen (ingezonden 27 mei 2011)

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether emissions from the OMRIN waste incinerator in Harlingen repeatedly exceed permit limits, about permitted breakdown hours, the enforcement framework, and whether the province of Friesland enforces in line with it. The item is a request for an extension, as the answers require consultation with the competent authority, the province of Fryslân.
The reason for the delay is that additional consultation and coordination is needed with the competent authority, namely the province of Fryslân.
De reden voor het uitstel is dat aanvullend overleg en afstemming nodig is met het betreffende bevoegd gezag, zijnde de provincie Fryslân.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het dreigende faillissement van de Nederlandse vissersvloo

Two PVV MPs ask state secretaries whether the Dutch fishing fleet faces bankruptcy due to competition from large vessels and strict EU environmental rules, whether those rules can be relaxed, and how much climate money is spent, plus whether fishers could be paid to collect plastic. The government's reply is only a procedural notice that the answers will be delayed for coordination and sent as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that, due to the required coordination, these questions cannot be answered within the prescribed period.
Hierbij deel ik u mee dat deze vragen in verband met de vereiste afstemming niet binnen de daarvoor gestelde termijn beantwoord kunnen worden.

Vragen van de leden De Mos, Gerbrands en Bontes (allen PVV) aan staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het artikel «Limburgs grondwater nog decennia vuil» (i

Three PVV MPs asked whether the Netherlands should tighten manure rules to meet the 2015 Water Framework Directive nitrate target, and whether further study or postponement to 2027 was wise. The state secretary replied that nitrate concentrations are falling, that policy changes will follow careful study, that no extra research is needed now, and that extending the deadline to 2021 or 2027 may be considered.

That does not necessarily mean that on the basis of this recent research the manure rules will be tightened in the short term merely to meet the 2015 target date of the European Water Framework Directive.

Dat betekent niet per definitie dat op basis van dat recente onderzoek op korte termijn de mestregels zullen worden aangescherpt, om maar de streefdatum van 2015 uit de Europese Kaderrichtlijn Water te halen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de afvaloven Omrin (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

An MP asked whether the Omrin waste incinerator in Harlingen had been idle, whether it sought relaxed environmental norms, whether workers fell ill during a chimney incident, and whether 4.4 million euro of subsidy was paid without checking conditions and should be stopped. The state secretary answered that the plant had a planned five-day maintenance stop, that Omrin made no request to relax norms, that a start-up incident caused brief airway irritation to two workers 300 metres away, that the subsidy payment was made, and that the subsidy falls under another ministry so it cannot be stopped or reclaimed.
The subsidy falls under the responsibility of the Ministry of EL&I and I therefore cannot stop or reclaim that subsidy.
Antwoord 5 De subsidie valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het ministerie van EL&I en ik kan die subsidie dan ook niet stopzetten of terug vorderen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over zwakke veendijken (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is outrageous that no major investment in weak peat dike maintenance followed the 2003 Wilnis breach, and whether the six-year dike testing cycle should be extended to twelve years. The state secretary answered that about 300 km of peat dikes have been improved, that a guideline for drought-sensitive dikes exists, that regional dikes already have a twelve-year testing cycle under provincial rules, and that the change for primary dikes does not affect water safety.
Moreover, the change in testing frequency for primary flood defences has no consequences for the water manager's responsibility to continuously monitor the safety of the flood defences.

Overigens heeft de verandering in de toetsfrequentie voor primaire waterkeringen geen consequenties voor de verantwoordelijkheid van de waterbeheerder om doorlopend de veiligheid van de waterkeringen te bewaken.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Klimaatdoelen kosten Rotterdam miljarden» (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Environment whether a reported 11.3 billion euro cost to meet climate targets in the Rotterdam port is accurate, how it was calculated and what the national government funds, and called the sum excessive and better spent on the Third Maasvlakte. The state secretary's reply is only an interim notice promising answers by 21 June after consultation with the municipality of Rotterdam.
To answer the relevant questions, consultation with the municipality of Rotterdam is necessary.
Voor de beantwoording van de betreffende vragen is overleg met de gemeente Rotterdam noodzakelijk.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het rapport van de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid over ee

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretaries for Infrastructure and Environment and for the Interior about the Dutch Safety Board's findings on a 2009 plane crash on Bonaire, including inadequate aviation safety oversight, the status of a 2009 action programme, and disorganised emergency coordination. The government replied only with a procedural notice that the answers need interdepartmental coordination and will take longer than the three-week deadline, with no substantive answers.
The answering of these questions must be coordinated across departments and for that reason requires more time.
De beantwoording van deze vragen dient interdepartementaal te worden afgestemd en vergt om die reden meer tijd.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over met dioxine vervuilde wateren (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

PVV MPs De Mos and Gerbrands asked the state secretary about dioxin-contaminated waters and polluted river eel, asking whether the waters will be cleaned up quickly, how long they have been contaminated, and whether fines for illegal industrial discharges should be raised by 500%. The state secretary answered that historical sediment contamination cannot feasibly be fully removed, that targeted measures are planned, and that a sharp fine increase is disproportionate and would overshoot its goal.
Raising fines for illegal water discharges significantly is, in that light, not proportionate to me and would moreover overshoot its goal.
Het fors verhogen van de boetes voor illegale waterlozingen acht ik in dat licht niet proportioneel en zal bovendien zijn doel voorbij schieten.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris voor Infrastructuur en Milieu over het eventueel verbieden van emissierechten afkomstig van Clean Development Mechanism (CDM)- en Joint Implementation-projec

MP Van Veldhoven asked whether the government will support banning emission credits from CDM and JI projects based on HCFK-22 or N2O for non-ETS sectors, as several EU member states propose. State Secretary Atsma answered that he is sympathetic, expects these credits will not be used after 2012, and that Dutch non-ETS sectors would not face competitiveness effects under the current arrangement.
I am sympathetic to that proposal.
Ik sta sympathiek tegenover dat voorstel.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over lastenverzwaring via sluiproute (ingezonden 28 ap

D66 MPs asked whether shifting dike and dune investment costs to water boards (reaching EUR 200 million by 2015) would raise local water-board taxes, and whether such cost increases are acceptable. The state secretary answered that the costs will be funded partly through water-board levies, that efficiency savings are intended to keep increases moderate, and that the costs will be monitored and reported under the Bestuursakkoord Water.
The Bestuursakkoord Water further agrees to closely monitor and report on local charges and the savings achieved.
In het Bestuursakkoord Water is verder afgesproken om de lokale lasten en de behaalde besparingen nauwgezet te monitoren en te rapporteren.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over plastic afvalbergen in zee (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about plastic waste accumulating in the sea, its ecosystem impact, and shipping's role, and whether the issue would be placed high on the international agenda. The state secretary answered that Nederland has raised marine litter in EU and UNEP forums, cites EU and IMO measures and national clean-up programmes, and announced a study of microplastics in the North Sea.
In addition, I am currently having an initial study carried out into the scale and possible consequences of microplastics in the North Sea.
Daarnaast laat ik momenteel een eerste onderzoek uitvoeren naar de omvang en mogelijke gevolgen van microplastics in de Noordzee.
Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over termijnen met betrekking tot aanvragen van milieuvergunningen (ingezonden 16 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the deadlines in the Ammonia and Livestock Action Plan for environmental permit applications are realistic given the pending PAS and DPAS, whether a provisional notification route can be offered, and questions on the enforcement strategy, emission-factor methodology, BBT systems and baseline data. The government answered largely by explaining the sequencing of the action plan, promising to examine a provisional route in the guidance and to discuss an enforcement strategy with municipal enforcers in June, while declining to link the deadlines to PAS.

I will examine whether it is possible to advise municipalities in this guidance to have companies expected to fall under the amendment of the Activities Decree submit, for the permit application initially, only the data that must also be provided with a notification.

Ik zal onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om in deze handreiking gemeenten te adviseren om bedrijven die naar verwachting onder de wijziging van het Activiteitenbesluit gaan vallen, voor de vergunningsaanvraag in eerste instantie alleen die gegevens te laten indienen, die ook bij een melding moeten worden overlegd.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «Atsma zet in op minder keuringen van dijken» (ingezonden 19 april 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether reducing dike inspections from every six to every twelve years is wise given rising sea levels and flood risk, and what savings and data justify it. The secretary confirms the change follows a taskforce recommendation to spread assessment and reinforcement work more evenly over time, with a six-yearly overview report and no change to the water manager's ongoing safety duty.
The assessment, design and improvement of water defences can therefore be carried out more evenly over time.
Het toetsen, ontwerpen en verbeteren van waterkeringen kan daardoor gelijkmatiger in de tijd uitgevoerd worden.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over kankerverwekkende stoffen in spaarlampen (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP asked whether energy-saving lamps emitting carcinogenic substances are acceptable on shop shelves and whether the Postbus 51 campaign promoting them should stop. The state secretary replied that the emissions are very small, lower than incandescent and halogen lamps, that German research is ongoing, and that the campaign has ended.
Of course we will keep an eye on the results of this research.
Uiteraard zullen wij de resultaten van dit onderzoek in de gaten houden.
Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatsecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de veiligheid van dijken (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a wave-overtopping test on the Strijenham sea dike in Tholen, whether the results would be released, whether the dike construction met specifications, and what would be done to ensure dikes meet safety norms. The state secretary said results were expected in June 2011, the dike section had passed the recent legal assessment, and remedial projects would finish by 2015.
No, the results of the research are expected to become available in June 2011.
Nee, naar verwachting komen de resultaten van het onderzoek in juni 2011 beschikbaar.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Winsten op vervuilde olie enorm, actie ondernomen» (ingezonden 18 april 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary of Infrastructure and Environment about a newspaper report on illegal blending of waste into fuel oil, asking about preventive measures, legal clarity, enforcement and sanctions, emission rules and international action. The government sent only a procedural notice that the answers would be delayed because additional information takes more time.
I hereby inform you that I cannot provide you with the answers within the set deadline.
Hierbij deel ik u mee dat ik u de antwoorden niet binnen de gestelde termijn kan aanbieden.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over klimaatverandering door menselijk handelen (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about the claimed 97% scientific consensus on human-caused climate change, a sample of 75 scientists, the 'hide the decline' tree-ring affair, a European Commission cost estimate of EU climate policy, and whether environmental policy should be assessed by cost-benefit analysis. The state secretary answered that the IPCC reflects the consensus, that the sample was not representative and the 97% figure rests on a subgroup, that tree-ring data have limited reliability, that climate policy is expected to be effective, and that cost-benefit analysis is already used where meaningful.
For this cabinet, as for the previous one, the IPCC reports reflect the consensus in climate science.
Voor dit kabinet, evenals voor het vorige, geven de rapporten van het IPCC de consensus in de klimaatwetenschap weer.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Defensie en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over explosieven in de Noordzee (ingezonden 6 april 2011).

PVV MPs De Mos and De Jong asked the ministers about unexploded ordnance found during sand dredging for the Zandmotor project, alleged misleading information at a March 2011 information meeting, the lack of open questions there, and changed swimming-ban statements. The government answered that dredgers carry bomb grates, pre-dredging surveys were done, a found explosive was safely neutralised under protocol, and it sees no reason to halt the project.
I see no reason to halt the project, since the construction of the Zandmotor has the same risk profile as other (large) nourishment works that have been carried out along the Dutch coast for decades.
Ik zie geen reden om het project te staken, aangezien de aanleg van de Zandmotor hetzelfde risicoprofiel kent als andere (grote) suppletiewerken.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Defensie en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de Zandmotor (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

An MP asked the ministers of Defence and Infrastructure about explosives, a possibly exploded pipe fitting and gas canisters found or possibly pumped ashore during construction of the Zandmotor, and about safety, reporting and liability. The state secretary answered that no explosion occurred, the damaged fitting was a wear incident, a screening grate removes large objects, and no further ground checks or liability conclusions were given.
No. I was not informed of this. No explosion took place.
Nee. Ik ben hier niet van in kennis gesteld. Er heeft geen explosie plaatsgevonden.

Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de staatssecretaris voor Infrastructuur en Milieu over het eventueel verbieden van emissierechten afkomstig van Clean Development Mechanism (CDM)- en Joint Implementation-projec

An MP asked the state secretary whether the EU should ban use of CDM and Joint Implementation credits from HFC-23 or N2O projects for sectors outside the ETS, and about competitiveness and whether the Netherlands will extend such a ban. The government replied only that it cannot answer within the deadline because not all necessary information is yet available, and promised a later answer.
Not all necessary information is yet available for answering this parliamentary question.
Voor de beantwoording van deze Kamervraag is nog niet alle noodzakelijke informatie beschikbaar.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over inkoop van duurzaam hout (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary about a Milieudefensie report finding that in 2010 most inspected government projects used timber failing the government's sustainable procurement criteria, and whether the government will meet its 100% sustainable purchasing target. The state secretary only announces that the questions cannot be answered within the statutory deadline and promises answers as soon as possible.
I hereby inform you that these questions cannot be answered within the prescribed time limit.
Hierbij deel ik u mee dat deze vragen niet binnen de daarvoor gestelde termijn beantwoord kunnen worden.
Vragen van de leden De Mos, Van Klaveren en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een milieubrochure (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a government-subsidised environmental project for Turkish-origin Dutch citizens, questioning the spelling errors in a brochure, its Turkish-language distribution, and whether the roughly EUR 200,000 was well spent. The state secretary defended the project as reaching a substantial part of the target group, acknowledged the Dutch brochure's spelling errors as regrettable, and stated the SMOM subsidy scheme would no longer be open from 2011.
The SMOM scheme has not been open since 2011, as already announced in this cabinet's coalition agreement.
De SMOM-regeling is met ingang van 2011 niet meer opengesteld, zoals reeds is aangekondigd in het regeerakkoord van dit kabinet.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Graus (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over milieuzones (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether environmental zones (milieuzones) unfairly burden entrepreneurs and fairground/circus vehicles, and whether the fine dust effects justify them. The state secretary rejected the claim of significant economic harm, pointed to hardship exemptions and the 13-year age exception for fairground vehicles, and cited a study showing environmental zones reduce NO2 and PM10 concentrations.
No, I do not share this view.
Nee, deze mening deel ik niet.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitbreiding van het Amerikaanse oliebedrijf NuStar op Sint Eustatius

MP Van Raak (SP) asked ministers whether oil company NuStar's planned expansion on Sint Eustatius from 58 to 25-40 more tanks, its share of island land, tax-zone implications, jobs, tourism, environmental rules, resident involvement, a referendum and business promotion should be a concern. The government answered that no formal expansion request has been filed yet, that the island authority decides development direction and must weigh costs and benefits, that environmental permits (MER, MRA, VR, BBT) will apply, and that residents can consult and use appeal rights, while declining a national referendum.
The island government of Sint Eustatius is free to organise a referendum on this subject.
Het eilandbestuur van Sint Eustatius is vrij om een referendum over dit onderwerp te organiseren.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de bypass bij Kampen (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary to guarantee 117 million euros for the second phase of the Kampen bypass, the cost of a river crossing at Roggebot, and why the project should not be delayed given Rijkswaterstaat's view that it is not urgent for water safety. The state secretary confirms the funding commitment, gives a cost estimate of 19.9 million euros, says a decision on the bypass will follow around summer, and notes the province's role as initiator.
I am awaiting the province's plan and will take a decision on the bypass around the summer.
Ik wacht het plan van de provincie af en zal rond de zomer een beslissing nemen over de bypass.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de terugkeer van de chloortrein (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

An MP asked the minister why chlorine trains will run via the Oldenzaal-Amersfoort route instead of the Betuwe line, and whether route restrictions can be imposed for safety reasons. The state secretary confirmed incidental chlorine transports for maintenance at Akzo Nobel, said the route was chosen under the existing chlorine regime, and stated that the planned Basisnet law will allow a ban on chlorine on main lines except for the incidental transports covered by the convenant.
To respect the agreements with Akzo Nobel in the convenant, this power does not apply to the incidental chlorine transports.
Om de afspraken met Akzo Nobel uit het convenant te eerbiedigen, geldt deze bevoegdheid niet voor de incidentele chloortransporten.

Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Hoogwatergeul Veessen-Wapenveld in het kader van Ruimte voor de Rivier (in

An MP asks the state secretaries whether the Veessen-Wapenveld flood channel, which cuts through farm plots, justifies four times as much nature compensation, why farmers' own nature management offer was rejected in favour of State Forestry, and how the Schaderegeling and the Eigeman motion are being applied. The government announces that it will answer these questions as soon as possible, without answering them yet.
I will answer both parliamentary questions, on behalf of State Secretary Bleker too, as soon as possible.
Beide Kamervragen zal ik, mede namens staatssecretaris Bleker, zo spoedig mogelijk beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Gaat de zon de broeikas stoppen» (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether he would revise climate policy if reduced solar activity cools the Earth, and whether he would investigate that claim further and invite sceptical scientists. The state secretary replied that Dutch climate policy follows current science, that solar variation is already accounted for, that a 2006 report on the sun's influence already covered the topic, and that he is open to talks with climate experts.
I see no reason to adjust the current policy because variations in solar activity are already taken into account.
Ik zie geen reden tot aanpassing van het huidige beleid omdat variaties in zonneactiviteit daarin al worden meegenomen.
Vragen van het lid Jacobi (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het proefjaar waarin de zeeverkeerscentrale en de vuurtorens naast elkaar werken (ingezonden 14 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for details of the planned one-year trial in which the sea traffic control centre and manned lighthouses operate side by side, including staffing, tasks, the radar system and whether the lighthouses would be kept manned. The state secretary answered that detailed plans are not yet finalised pending supplier and camera-system talks, confirmed both lighthouses will be manned, and committed to a decision on lighthouse staffing only after the trial year.
However, I cannot yet give you specific information on the elaboration of the comparison year at this time.
Specifieke informatie over de uitwerking van het vergelijkingsjaar kan ik u echter nog niet geven op dit moment.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over nieuwe maatregelen tegen vogels bij Schiphol (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about extending the bird-attracting activity restriction zone around Schiphol from 6 to at least 10 km, the competent authority, wetland and agricultural land, and the status of the Regiegroep Vogelaanvaringen research. The state secretary confirmed the zone extension is being studied without guaranteeing timing, said the Minister of I&M is responsible, and that agriculture will not be banned though pilots are running.
I am examining the possibilities to extend this zone to at least 10 kilometres.
Ik onderzoek de mogelijkheden om deze zone op te rekken naar minimaal 10 kilometer.
Vragen van de leden Lucas (VVD) en Jacobi (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de Afsluitdijk (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Lucas and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the Afsluitdijk project, including the division of roles between the national government and the provinces and municipalities, and how a motion on a phased masterplan would be implemented. The state secretary replied that the national government is responsible for safety measures, that a structure vision and administrative agreement will set out the plan with regional partners, and that adoption is planned for December 2011.
Adoption of the structure vision is planned for December 2011, after which the structure vision will be sent to the States General.
Vaststelling van de structuurvisie is voorzien in december 2011, waarna de structuurvisie aan de Staten-Generaal zal worden toegezonden.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over met dioxine vervuilde wateren (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about dioxin-polluted waters, the spread of contaminated eel, and whether cleanup is planned, how long the waters have been polluted, and whether fines for illegal industrial discharges should be raised by 500%. The state secretary's reply is only an interim notice stating that answering needs more time because of complex inter-departmental coordination, so none of the questions are answered on substance.
Answering these questions takes more time because they concern complex subjects that require further coordination between the departments and service units involved.

De beantwoording van deze vragen kost meer tijd omdat deze vragen betrekking hebben op enkele complexe onderwerpen die nadere afstemming tussen de betrokken departementen en dienstonderdelen noodzakelijk maakt

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de brand in het havengebied Amst

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and ministers about the handling of the February 2011 fire at the Amsterdam port chemical complex, including emergency response, communication, reporting of hazardous substances, emissions, enforcement history, and liability costs.
