The government answered that the response and coordination went well, that no health risks were measured, that enforcement and inspections are ongoing or completed, and that no major societal costs beyond emergency deployment are known.
Unfortunately it proved impossible to answer the questions before the committee meeting on external safety because relevant information had to be requested from third parties.
Helaas bleek het niet mogelijk vóór het AO externe veiligheid de vragen te beantwoorden omdat relevante informatie bij derden moest worden opgevraagd.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Koopmans (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Zandmotor (ingezonden 27 januari 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked about the Zandmotor pilot coastal nourishment: the timing of the integrated safety plan, how shipping and recreational safety are ensured, long-term management, alternatives if the sand disperses, and whether the site becomes Natura 2000 land. The government answered that the safety plan predates the council presentation, describes marking, notices and fencing measures, assigns management to the province and a foundation, and states the site will not be designated Natura 2000 and is a standalone pilot.
The final designation decision for Solleveld & Kapittelduinen will explicitly state that the Zandmotor is not part of this Natura 2000 area.
In het definitieve aanwijzingsbesluit van Solleveld & Kapittelduinen zal expliciet tot uitdrukking worden gebracht dat de zandmotor geen onderdeel uitmaakt van dit Natura2000 gebied.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over plannen voor een nieuwe afvaloven (ingezonden 21 fe

Two PVV MPs asked whether the €6 million state subsidy for the Omrin waste incineration plant in Harlingen should be withheld while court proceedings and the annulled permit are pending, and whether there is overcapacity in waste incineration. The state secretary answered that the subsidy is tied to commissioning by 1 May 2011 and would be reduced to zero if the plant cannot operate, that the permit is in force after the Council of State rejected the injunction, and that waste supply is currently below forecasts.
If the REC cannot be put into use due to the lack of an environmental permit, the subsidy will be set at zero.
Als de REC niet in gebruik kan worden genomen als gevolg van het ontbreken van een milieuvergunning, zal de subsidie op nihil worden vastgesteld.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Lucas (VVD) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de bypass bij Kampen (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

MPs Jansen, Lucas and Dijkgraaf questioned the state secretary about his remarks on the IJsseldelta-Zuid bypass near Kampen, his commitments to parliament, the status of the water-safety study, the claimed benefits and the flood-safety risks such as the bathtub effect. The state secretary said parliament has the final word, that the provincial plan is expected in April and a decision on the state's share around summer, that the study runs to 2014 and is not a precondition for the bypass, and that the benefits and safety concerns are being addressed through local investigation.
I expect to receive the provincial plan at the end of April, after which I will send it to your House as promised.
Ik verwacht eind april het plan van de provincie te ontvangen waarna ik het zoals toegezegd aan uw Kamer zal toesturen.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Smeets en Timmermans (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de gebiedsontwikkeling Ooijen-Wanssum (ingezonden 7 februari 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about the Ooijen-Wanssum area development in light of plans to reverse flood-protection connecting zones and the high Meuse water levels. The state secretary said a decision depends on completing the MIRT process and budget constraints, that the project cannot be confirmed for the spring 2011 MIRT meetings, and that no short-term certainty can be given.
Around the summer I will inform you about this, in accordance with my commitment in the committee meeting of 13 December 2010.
Rond de zomer zal ik u, conform mijn toezegging in het AO op 13 december 2010, hierover informeren.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het Besluit huisvesting (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

An SGP MP asked whether pig and broiler farmers unable to afford stable upgrades could cut the number of batches to reduce ammonia emissions, and what changes to the housing decree could allow this. The state secretary said the decree requires best available techniques and offers no batch-reduction route, but a working group is examining an exception for farms ceasing operations, subject to sector consultation.
However, I want to consult the sector to examine whether it is desirable to make an exception for businesses that want to stop in the long term.
Wel wil ik in overleg met de sector bezien of het wenselijk is om voor bedrijven die op termijn willen stoppen een uitzondering te maken.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de financiering van het Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether the government would investigate stopping Dutch funding to the IPCC, given that the Dutch House of Representatives had supported halting IPCC funding. The state secretary said IPCC reflects the science well but needs reform, that Dutch funding is modest and better spent influencing reforms than stopping, and disclosed an annual contribution of about 39,000 euro.
Stopping the (modest) contribution is neither opportune nor effective.
Stoppen met de (bescheiden) bijdrage is opportuun noch effectief.

Vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de financiële schade voor waterschap Brabantse Delta vanwege de brand bij Chemie-Pack (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the state secretary whether it is fair that waterschap Brabantse Delta bears the financial costs of the Chemie-Pack fire clean-up, which could raise local water board levies by 40%. The state secretary said investigations are ongoing, that water boards may recover costs from polluters and levy them on the area, and that if recovery fails and levies rise extremely, compensation options would be explored with the relevant ministers.
This must be the aim. If that does not succeed, there is reason for further consultation.
Dit moet de inzet zijn. Als dat niet lukt, is er reden voor nader overleg.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over vliegreizen van Maastricht naar Amsterdam (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

MP Ouwehand asked whether a Limburg company's planned flights from Maastricht to Amsterdam could be prevented, given their CO2 impact compared with car or train travel. The state secretary replied that EU law liberalises intra-community air services so national licensing cannot be imposed, that emissions data for these flights is not available, and that short flights likely emit more CO2 per passenger than rail or car.

Under EU Regulation 1008/2008 the internal market for Community air carriers is liberalised, and member states may not make the operation of air services on intra-Community routes subject to any licence or authorisation.

Op grond van EU Verordening 1008/2008 is de interne markt voor communautaire luchtvaartmaatschappijen geliberaliseerd en mogen lidstaten de exploitatie van luchtdiensten op intracommunautaire routes niet afhankelijk stellen van enige vergunning of toelating.

Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris voor Infrastructuur en Milieu over de voorstellen van het Europees agentschap voor de veiligheid van de luchtvaart (EASA) tot verlening van vliegbrevetten aan vl

Haverkamp (CDA) asked the state secretary about the EASA flight crew licensing rules adopted in December 2010, including whether they weaken recognition of foreign pilot licences and ICAO standards. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands was involved via EASA consultation and comitology, that the rules keep ICAO recognition principles, and that a transitional period to 2014 allows an EU-US agreement to be concluded.
The number of countries that do not properly comply with the ICAO standards therefore cannot be given.
Het aantal landen dat de ICAO-standaarden niet goed naleeft, is dan ook niet te geven.
Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de tarieven die Schiphol berekent aan luchtvaartmaatschappijen (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

MP Dijksma asks the state secretary whether the competition authority NMa asked for extra regulation of Schiphol's tariffs due to its market power, why airline tariff disputes recur, whether the 2010 tariff increase was shelved under government pressure, and whether the government will reconsider the tariff system, reintroduce ministerial consent, or use shareholding to influence tariffs. The state secretary answers that the NMa advised continuing sector-specific regulation and that the Wet luchtvaart evaluation (due end 2011) will assess changes, that Schiphol and KLM commissioned their own study and the government commissioned an independent one, and that shareholder interference in tariffs is legally inappropriate, with a letter on public interests promised before 1 October 2011.
Within the ongoing evaluation of the Aviation Act regarding tariff regulation, it will be examined whether and to what extent adjustment of the current system is desirable.
In het kader van de lopende evaluatie van de Wet luchtvaart ten aanzien van de tariefsregulering zal worden bezien of en in hoeverre aanpassing van het huidige systeem wenselijk is.
Vragen van het lid Jacobi (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de afslag op Terschelling (ingezonden 26 januari 2011).

MP Jacobi asked the state secretary about Terschelling's coastal defence, including whether the dune barrier was tested, who is responsible for water safety, and whether dynamic coastal management keeps residents safe. The state secretary answered that the primary flood defence was tested and found safe, that responsibility is split between Wetterskip Fryslân and Rijkswaterstaat, and that the location of the primary defences will be decided after research due this autumn.
I want to take this wish seriously and will include the option of moving the primary flood defence to the sea dune ridge in the research.
Ik wil deze wens serieus bekijken en zal in het onderzoek de optie om de primaire waterkering naar de zeereep te verleggen meenemen.
Vragen van de leden Mulder en Leegte (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de brand bij Moerdijk. (ingezonden 11 januari 2011).

MPs Mulder and Leegte asked ministers about the smoke and odour spread from the Moerdijk fire, the health and environmental studies under way, and their coordination and timing. The government answered that the plume affected areas up to and beyond 10 km, described the GGD questionnaires and RIVM/MOD environmental measurements, and gave expected report dates, with a health-related decision postponed to eight weeks.
In the debate on 13 January the Minister of VWS committed to decide on follow-up steps after four weeks in light of the health study.
In het debat op 13 januari heeft de minister van VWS toegezegd na vier weken een beslissing over vervolgstappen te nemen naar aanleiding van het gezondheidsonderzoek.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het onderhoud aan dijken (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary why the Netherlands is protected by poorly maintained dikes, which dikes are affected, by when all dikes will meet the norms, and whether dike reinforcement should take priority over new nature creation. The state secretary acknowledged the report, explained that standards are checked every six years and failures have many causes, promised an overview report by mid-year, and said safety is his core priority while nature work may be combined with it but not at the expense of flood-safety budgets.
Yes, I intend to send you a report by mid-year containing an overview of the condition of all primary flood defences.
Ja, ik ben voornemens om u medio dit jaar een rapportage met daarin een overzicht van de toestand van alle primaire waterkeringen toe te sturen.

Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de brand bij Chemie-Pack (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary and interior minister about the Chemie-Pack fire in Moerdijk, covering the scope of the Safety Board investigation, past supervision and sanctions, whether the company fell under the Brzo hazardous substances regime, compliance with PGS 15 storage rules, the delayed public information on chemicals, and firewater containment. The state secretary answered that the Safety Board's focus was still to be set, that the company was supervised annually as required and a joint inspection report would follow by 25 February 2011, and that the remaining questions would be covered by the ongoing investigations.
The investigation by the VI, IVW and AI will address whether adequate facilities for firewater containment were present.
Het onderzoek van de VI, IVW en AI zal ingaan op de vraag of er afdoende voorzieningen aanwezig waren voor bluswateropvang.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD), aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

Six opposition MPs asked the minister to specify measurable, enforceable CO2 targets for 2020, including Mton limits inside and outside the ETS, interim targets, foreign allowance purchases and accountability. The state secretary confirmed the 20% target, explained the EU ETS and non-ETS split, said the exact Dutch non-ETS figure awaits a PBL analysis and a spring 2011 letter, and promised such clarity then.
Due to uncertainties it is too early to draw conclusions, but the Netherlands appears to be on track with current policy to achieve sufficient reduction in the non-ETS sectors.
Door onzekerheden is het te vroeg conclusies te trekken, maar Nederland lijkt met het huidig ingezette beleid goed op weg om voldoende reductie in de niet-ETS sectoren te realiseren.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinetsdoelen

Six opposition MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment for measurable, verifiable government targets on backlog maintenance of flood defences and on how the government will report on progress each year. The state secretary answered that the existing 6-yearly assessment cycle sets the framework, that a new flood-protection programme (HWBP3) and an integral safety programme will be presented before the 2012 budget, and that progress will be reported through the budget cycle and separate programme reports.

As I promised in a Second Chamber debate on 13 December 2010, I will present an integral safety programme before the 2012 budget, giving insight into the flood-safety task in the coming years and the costs involved.

Zoals, tijdens een debat in de Tweede Kamer op 13 december 2010 door mij is toegezegd, zal ik vóór de begroting 2012 een integraal veiligheidsprogramma aanbieden dat inzicht zal bieden wat de waterveiligheidsopgave de komende jaren zal zijn en welke kosten daarmee gepaard zullen gaan.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Timmermans en Smeets (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de dijken in Limburg (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about Limburg dike safety, whether provincial funding requests were justified, and how costs would be split between the state and water boards. The state secretary confirmed the request and the Maaswerken budget use, said the national picture would follow the Inspectorate's validation, and gave no firm timetable or final cost split.
The national picture will be final after the Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management has judged all provincial assessments.
Het landelijk beeld wordt definitief na het oordeel van de Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat op alle provinciale oordelen.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over thermische verwerking van asbest (ingezonden 7 december 2010).

MP Jansen (SP) asked whether thermal treatment of asbestos is preferable to landfilling and what steps the government has taken to stimulate it, and whether the landfill standard tightening is tied to sufficient treatment capacity. State Secretary Atsma answered that landfilling remains the minimum standard, that the government is willing to support denaturation via fiscal schemes and higher landfill tax, but that industry must decide on building plants, and that the LAP conditions for a landfill ban apply.
However, industry itself must weigh the options and actually proceed to build an installation.
Het bedrijfsleven moet echter zelf de afweging maken en daadwerkelijk overgaan tot de bouw van een installatie.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de inzet van Nederlandse CDM projecten gebaseerd op HFC en N20 beperkingen (ingezonden 30 november 2010)

An MP asked the minister whether the European Commission's proposal to ban CDM credits from HFC-23 and N2O projects from the EU ETS from 2013 affects Dutch purchased credits, and whether the CDM Executive Board's review changes Dutch Kyoto compliance. The state secretary said the Commission's reasons are generally valid but credits already bought remain usable for Kyoto, while noting about 2 Mt CO2-eq of HFC credits delivered in 2013 may not be creditable and that the impact will be monitored.
Vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de inzet van Nederlandse CDM projecten gebaseerd op HFC en N20 beperkingen (ingezonden 30 november 2010)

An MP asked the minister about the European Commission's proposal to bar CDM credits from HFC and N2O projects from the EU ETS from 2013, and whether this affects Dutch purchased credits and the Kyoto target. The state secretary answered that the Commission's reasons are generally valid, that the ban applies only from 2013 to the ETS, that about 2 Mt of Dutch HFC purchases cannot be credited for Kyoto, and that credits from already-registered projects remain usable.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het naleven van de Europese reizigersrechten in de luchtvaart (ingezonden 9 december 2010).

MP Bashir asks the state secretary why airlines refuse to pay compensation to delayed passengers even after Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat decisions, whether the inspectorate can assess claims, how many passengers are affected, how the Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart functions, and how KLM's misleading passenger information is enforced. The state secretary answers that the inspectorate enforces through warnings and sanctions, has the expertise to assess claims, keeps no data on delayed flights, and has ordered KLM to correct its folder, while pointing to the commission's independence and self-regulation.
The inspectorate does not keep data on delayed and cancelled flights.
De inspectie houdt geen gegevens bij over vertraagde en geannuleerde vluchten.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een uitspraak van de Nationale Ombudsman over de afhandeling van bezwaren tegen Maastricht Aachen Airport (ingezonden 15 dece

Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) asked why the minister has waited nearly three years to issue a new decision on objections to the Maastricht Aachen Airport designation after the Council of State annulled it, and how this fits with the government's push for faster procedures. The state secretary admits delays, explains that the full reassessment was needed and promises updated studies in January 2011 and a decision in summer 2011, while defending the shift to earlier participation and a possible faster route via the Crisis- en herstelwet.
The National Ombudsman rightly signals that the requirement of timeliness is at stake here.
De Nationale Ombudsman signaleert terecht dat hiermee het vereiste van voortvarendheid in het geding is.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

MP Bashir asks the state secretary whether ArkeFly's refusal to accept an Aviation Dispute Committee ruling undermines the binding nature of its decisions, what measures will be taken, and whether a statutory binding committee should replace self-regulation. The state secretary answers that the rulings are binding, that a bailiff-based enforcement arrangement via BARIN exists, that no further measures are needed, and that consumers can also go to civil court or the Inspectorate.
A ruling of the dispute committee is binding. Both parties must abide by it.
Een uitspraak van de geschillencommissie is bindend. Beide partijen moeten zich eraan houden.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «Nederlanders betalen hoogste milieubelasting ter wereld» (ingezonden 18 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether Dutch environmental taxes, reported as the highest in the world, harm business competitiveness and whether they should be aligned with neighbouring countries. The government corrected an OECD double-counting error, argued that total tax burden and administrative costs matter more than environmental taxes alone, and declined to reduce environmental taxes because revenue funds general spending.
Lowering environmental taxes would have to lead to higher other taxes.
Verlaging van de milieubelastingen zou moeten leiden tot verhoging van andere belastingen.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Defensie over de Zandmotor (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about groundwater risks from the Loswal Noord dump near the Zandmotor, and about ordnance risks, asking that the project be halted pending independent research. The state secretary answered that the dump cannot affect drinking water sources because groundwater flows seaward, that sonar surveys found no ordnance at the sand extraction site, and that the explosives disposal service would be called if ordnance were found; he did not agree to halt the project.
Therefore I do not share your view that the Zandmotor pilot should be abandoned and that independent research should be conducted into possible influences of Loswal Noord.
Daarom deel ik uw mening niet dat moet worden afgezien van de Pilot Zandmotor en er onafhankelijk onderzoek moet worden verricht naar mogelijke invloeden van Loswal Noord.

Vragen van het lid van Veldhoven (D66) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Europese onderhandelingen met betrekking tot aanpassingen in het systeem van emissiehandel (ingezonden 18 oktobe

An MP asked the government about the stage of EU negotiations on ETS phase three, the main disputed points among member states, and the Dutch position on free allocation of allowances for process gases. The State Secretary answered that the Commission proposal was just sent to member states, outlined the contested benchmarks and allocation rules, and stated that the Netherlands favours auctioning and treats free allowances as a transitional measure.
The draft Commission proposal was sent to member states on Friday 22 October.
Het ontwerp Commissievoorstel is vrijdag 22 oktober verzonden aan de lidstaten.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de presentatie van het boek «De staat van het klimaat» (ingezonden 17 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether he shares the claim that favouritism, pressure and deception undermine international climate research, and whether the IPCC should consider sceptical publications. The state secretary rejected the conclusion, said Netherlands supports the IPCC review process, and stated that publications on solar activity, air pollution and land use were included in the Fourth Assessment Report.
I intend to discuss in a follow-up conversation the ideas of Mr Crok regarding the sound and proper functioning of climate science in general and of the IPCC in particular.

Ik ben voornemens in een vervolggesprek door te praten over de ideeën van de heer Crok met betrekking tot het goed en integer functioneren van de klimaatwetenschap in het algemeen en van het IPCC in het bijzonder.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over ontwikkelingen nieuwe zeeverkeerscentrale (Ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

Two MPs asked the minister about preparations for a new sea traffic control centre on Terschelling and the risks of removing human lookouts at lighthouses. The state secretary confirmed that human observation at the Terschelling and Schiermonnikoog lighthouses will be retained after the centre opens and that no decisions on lighthouse staffing will be taken before a promised evaluation is discussed in parliament.
Therefore I hereby undertake that human observation at both lighthouses (Terschelling and Schiermonnikoog) will be retained, even after the Wadden Sea sea traffic control centre is in operation.
Daarom zeg ik u hierbij toe dat het menselijk oog op beide vuurtorens (Terschelling en Schiermonnikoog) behouden blijft, ook nadat de zeeverkeerscentrale Waddenzee in werking is.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over kolenbroei (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about coal heating (kolenbroei) causing odour nuisance near Zaanstad and whether rules prevent it. The state secretary answered that no general rules exist beyond the general duty of care, that permits contain monitoring requirements, and that the inspectorate will ask competent authorities to add emergency procedures where missing.
The VROM Inspectorate will inform the competent authorities and ask them to add requirements where necessary, as is customary with the DCMR.
De VROM-Inspectie zal de bevoegde gezagen informeren en hen verzoeken om zonodig voorschriften toe te voegen zoals bij de DCMR gebruikelijk is.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het effect van elektromagnetische straling van zendinstallaties (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

MP Haverkamp (CDA) asked the state secretary about reported research on effects of wireless internet radiation on plants and trees, and whether the underlying study would be made public. The secretary replied that the study was not available to the government, that it is up to the researcher or the commissioning municipality to publish it, and that preliminary results are unconfirmed.
It is up to the researcher or the commissioning party to make the study public.
Het is aan de onderzoeker of aan de opdrachtgever om het onderzoek openbaar te maken.
Vragen van de leden Jansen (SP) en Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het blenden van stookolie (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

MPs Jansen and Van Tongeren asked the minister whether ships are still mixing hazardous chemical waste into bunker fuel, what law applies, what penalties exist, how reporting duties and enforcement are arranged, and what priority enforcement has been given since the 2008 North Refinery case. The state secretary confirmed the reported practice is suspected but its scale is unknown (research planned for 2011), described the existing legal framework, penalties, reporting duties and inspection capacity (about 1.75 FTE), and declined to say more about the North Refinery criminal investigation while it is ongoing.
Hiernaar zal in 2011 onderzoek worden gedaan.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Juristen: «Overheid loopt aanzienlijke risico’s voor aansprakelijkheid klimaatverandering» (ingezonden 8 november 201

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment whether a book by lawyers warning of state liability for climate change inflames fear, whether the government should create more legal frameworks, whether it disavows the book's conclusions, and whether public money funded it. The state secretary answered that the book reflects the views of lawyers from the Landsadvocaat's firm, that the government was not involved and no public money was spent, that current regulation complies with European and treaty obligations, and that the government anticipates legal problems as they arise.
The Rijk was in no way involved in this, and the conclusions are therefore for the account of the law firm.
Het Rijk is hier op geen enkele manier bij betrokken geweest, en de conclusies komen dan ook voor rekening van het advocatenkantoor.

Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het onttrekken van rechten aan het Europese emissiehandelssysteem met als doel deze te vernietigen (ingezonden 2 novembe

An MP asks the government whether voluntarily cancelling EU ETS allowances, as offered by Stichting Natuur en Milieu's CO2 market, is lawful, how it compares to other offset schemes, and whether it really reduces emissions. The state secretary answers that voluntary cancellation is an inherent part of the system, is additional and verified through the registry, and does reduce emissions.
Voluntary cancellation of emission allowances is part of the regulated emissions trading system.
Het vrijwillig annuleren van emissierechten maakt onderdeel uit van het gereguleerde emissiehandelssysteem.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het onttrekken van rechten aan het Europese emissiehandelssysteem met als doel deze te vernietigen (ingezonden 3 november 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary about a website, co2markt.eu, through which citizens can voluntarily cancel EU ETS emission allowances, and whether the government funds it. The government defends voluntary cancellation as built into the EU ETS, notes the NEa verifies cancellations, and says SNM received a SMOM subsidy of about 236,690 euro for start-up costs.
SNM has received SMOM subsidy from the government for this project.
SNM heeft van de overheid SMOM-subsidie ontvangen voor dit project.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu, de minister Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie o

PVV MPs asked why ministries co-funded a free Bosatlas set for all secondary schools, whether climate sceptics were involved, and whether children are being informed one-sidedly about climate change. The state secretary answered that schools choose their own teaching materials, that the atlas omits future temperature and sea-level scenarios due to uncertainty, and gave no commitment to change anything.
It is up to the schools themselves which teaching materials they use.
Het is aan de scholen zelf van welke leermiddelen zij gebruik maken.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de milieuvergunning voor Sinterfabriek van Thermphos (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about the provincial environmental permit for Thermphos's sinter plant, which allows dioxin emissions of 0.4 ng TEQ/Nm3 until 2015 despite the 0.1 ng national norm, and whether the permit should be referred for annulment by the Crown. The state secretary answered that the NeR norm is not immediately achievable, that RIVM studies show no unacceptable health effects, that the province justified the deviation, and that no reason exists to intervene at present.
There is no acute danger to health. Considering all this, I currently see no reason to intervene.
Er is geen acuut gevaar voor de gezondheid. Dit alles overwegende zie ik vooralsnog geen reden om in te grijpen.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris voor Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de milieuvergunning aan Thermphos (ingezonden 18 novem

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about the environmental permit granted by the Zeeland province to Thermphos for dioxin emissions, and about the central government's oversight role and whether independent health research would be done. The state secretary replied that the province is primarily responsible, that the VROM-Inspectie exercises interbestuurlijk toezicht and will follow the agreements closely, and that no additional independent research is currently planned beyond the province's own health study.
For the time being I see no reason to conduct or commission additional research myself.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen reden om zelf aanvullend onderzoek te (laten) doen.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de inzameling en hergebruik van kunststof afval (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

MP Jansen (SP) asked the state secretary whether he agrees that half of collected plastic waste ends in incinerators, how collected plastic flows through recycling, whether producers can be required to add markers, and whether he will address barriers to post-sorting installations. The state secretary largely referred to earlier answers, said markers would only make sense at EU level and could harm Dutch competitiveness, and promised a review of pre- and post-sorting due early 2011 without committing to new post-sorting plants.
The study will be ready early 2011 and will then be sent to the House.
Het onderzoek is begin 2011 gereed en zal daarna aan de Kamer worden aangeboden.
Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Terug naar de tekentafel» (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

MP Koopmans (CDA) asked the state secretary about a report that 50% of collected plastic packaging is incinerated, its relation to the contractual 70% recyclable output, recycling rates for pre- versus post-sorted plastic, markers and biodegradable plastics. The state secretary said recycling reached 71% in 2009, the VROM-Inspectie is investigating the chain, and a Nedvang evaluation is due early 2011, while declining to commit to specific new measures.
You will receive the VI research report at the end of December.
U zult het onderzoeksrapport van de VI eind december ontvangen.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Gerbrands (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verdubbeling in het aantal legionellagevallen

The MPs asked whether the government will investigate weather effects, water quality and prevention measures after a doubling in Legionnaires' disease cases. The state secretary answered that research points to warm, wet weather, that sources remain unclear, that monitoring duties exist for some installations, and that information campaigns and a separate letter will follow.
You will be informed separately by letter about this issue and the measures to be taken.
Over deze problematiek en de te treffen maatregelen wordt u separaat bij brief geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel waarin een grote gifzaak in de haven van Rotterdam wordt beschreven (ingezonden 19 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether the government considers it a scandal that highly toxic zinc waste has lain for decades in the port of Rotterdam, whether it should be returned to Germany, and whether the ministry failed to protect the environment and help the company. The state secretary replies that the operator EBS is responsible, that a temporary permit allows storage until July 2011, that the EU cannot force Germany to take the waste back, and that the silos pose no danger.
The provincial executive of South Holland decided to cooperate with EBS by issuing a temporary permit for the storage of these waste materials.
Het college van Gedeputeerde Staten van Zuid-Holland heeft besloten mee te werken met EBS door het afgeven van een tijdelijke vergunning voor de opslag van deze afvalstoffen.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de aanleg van een geluidswal met vervuilde g

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers whether a noise barrier built with contaminated soil in the Ecological Main Structure in Heerenveen, by a remediation contractor, complies with rules, with no VROM-Inspectie objection, and whether ecological and health effects were studied. The state secretary answered that the contract is private law and details are unknown, the soil is lightly contaminated and meets the Bbk, ecological studies found no negative effects, and sample results are required per lot through partij keuringen.
The activity concerned involves a private-law contractual arrangement, so I have no insight into its details.
Bij de genoemde activiteit is er sprake van een privaatrechtelijke contractvorming. Ik heb dan ook geen zicht op de details daarvan.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Ophef over gloeilampenafspraken: Cramer in de fout» (ingezonden 19 oktober 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether the incandescent light bulb phase-out, which the MP said had caused darkness for households and businesses and that the alternatives were immature, should be reversed or fought in Brussels. The state secretary rejected these views, pointed to the EU Ecodesign rules, the conversion list and public campaign, and stated support for the phase-out.
I do not share this view. The incandescent bulb is a very inefficient light source and I support the European decision to phase out inefficient lamps.
Deze mening deel ik niet. De gloeilamp is een zeer onzuinige lichtbron en ik sta achter het Europese besluit om onzuinige lampen uit te faseren.
Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over bewindspersonen die naar de klimaattop in Cancún (Mexico) gaan (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

MP De Mos (PVV) asked whether ministers should travel to the Cancún climate summit, given stalled negotiations, doubts about human impact on climate, the expiry of Kyoto, and taxpayer costs. State Secretary Atsma defended attending with a small delegation, reaffirmed the climate science and international agreements' necessity, and offered video links for MPs who do not travel.
I choose a small, effective delegation.
Ik kies voor een kleine, effectieve delegatie.
Vragen van het lid Sharpe (PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «KLM overhoop met Schiphol» (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether Schiphol's planned steep increase in charges for transfer passengers would reduce the airlines using it as a hub, and whether the government would act against it. The state secretary replied that Schiphol will raise charges only modestly from April 2011 and postpone the structural tariff change by six months to study its effects, while the EU-related bill concerns non-discrimination principles rather than tariff levels and the government would take no action beyond referring to that answer.
Reference is made to the answer to question 2.
Verwezen wordt naar het antwoord op vraag 2.

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het bericht dat grondwater een belangrijke rol speelt bij de stijging van de zeespiegel (ingezonden 29 septe

An MP asks the minister about a study finding that groundwater extraction contributes substantially to sea-level rise, and whether measurements should be corrected for it. The state secretary answers that the study adds a reason for sustainable water management and that groundwater extraction would be noted as a third major cause if confirmed, while measured values stay unchanged.
I will of course take the outcomes of this research into account when naming the causes of sea-level rise.
Wel zal ik de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek uiteraard meenemen in het benoemen van de oorzaken van de stijging van de zeespiegel

Vragen van het lid De Mos (PVV) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het falen omtrent asbestverwijdering in woningen in de Nieuwegeinse wijk Jutphaas/Wijkersloot (ingezonden 4

An MP asks the housing minister whether asbestos removal and renovation works in Nieuwegein's Jutphaas/Wijkersloot neighbourhood endangered residents and workers, and whether ministry supervision failed. The state secretary replies that municipal and labour inspection supervision is adequate, that the VROM Inspectorate found permits and asbestos removal compliant after two site visits, and that the Ombudsman found the municipality should have acted faster, which it accepts.
The municipality accepts the ruling and will adjust its working method.
De gemeente accepteert het oordeel en zal haar werkwijze aanpassen.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over ontwikkelingen nieuwe zeeverkeerscentrale (Ingezonden 15 oktober 2010)

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about preparations for a new maritime traffic control centre on Terschelling, including concerns about lighthouse keepers' visual role, restricted radar guidance, a reported confidentiality obligation, and the evaluation of a pilot year. The government's answer is only an interim notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the three-week deadline because further orientation is ongoing.
Further orientation on this subject is currently taking place. Therefore it is not possible to answer the questions within the set three-week period.
Momenteel vindt er een nadere oriëntatie plaats op dit onderwerp. Daarom is het niet mogelijk de vragen binnen de gestelde termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Jansen (SP) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over het verbeterplan van het bedrijf Thermphos in Vlissingen (ingezonden 29 september 2010).

An MP asks whether Thermphos's improvement plan to cut dioxin and cadmium emissions is adequate, whether health, agricultural and nature damage is being assessed, and by when the company will comply with legal requirements and whether the 2015 deadline is acceptable. The state secretary replies that the plan is still being finalised under the province of Zeeland, that RIVM studies are nearly complete, that the Labour Inspectorate has tightened oversight, and that the province expects a timely and effective approach, deferring key timing to the provincial licensing process.
Thermphos is drawing up, under the direction of the province of Zeeland, a plan setting out the measures it will take to improve the environmental and safety situation.
Thermphos maakt, onder regie van de provincie Zeeland, een plan waarin ze vastlegt welke maatregelen ze treft ter verbetering van de situatie op het gebied van milieu en veiligheid.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over het doorrekenen van het regeerakkoord op milieu en natuureffecten (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

Pechtold (D66) asked whether the PBL and ECN could cost the coalition agreement's energy, environment and nature policies as they did for election programmes, and whether this would be sent to the House before the debate on the government statement. The state secretary replied that a first short analysis had been made by the PBL and reported informally, and refused to commission a full analysis for the House, saying the PBL and ECN will assess measures once further elaborated.

No. Of course the Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving, and ECN where necessary, will be asked to calculate the environmental and nature effects of policy that has been further elaborated, as well as concrete measures from the coalition agreement.

Nee. Uiteraard wordt het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving, en ECN wanneer nodig, wel gevraagd om de milieu- en natuureffecten van beleid dat verder is uitgewerkt door te rekenen evenals concrete maatregelen uit het regeerakkoord.

verzoekt de regering in samenwerking met gemeenten, aanbieders van inburgeringsprogramma's en blinden- en slechtziendeninstellingen een inburgerprogramma voor blinden en slechtzienden te ontwikkelen
Motie Dijsselbloem c.s. over informatie over specifieke problemen binnen specifieke bevolkingsgroepen
Asks the government to report annually in the Integration Yearbook on developments among specific population groups such as Iraqis, Afghans, Somalis, Roma and Sinti and Moluccans.
requests the government to also annually provide insight in the Integration Yearbook into relevant developments among specific population groups
verzoekt de regering in het Jaarrapport Integratie ook jaarlijks inzicht te geven in relevante ontwikkelingen onder specifieke bevolkingsgroepen
Motie Van der Burg en Van Toorenburg over herijking van het delictsbestanddeel "in het openbaar"
Asks the government to investigate whether the criminal-law element 'in public' in incitement offences can be redefined to reach closed-circle incitement.
calls on the government to investigate whether and how articles 131 and 132 of the Criminal Code and the element 'in public' could be recalibrated

roept de regering op om te onderzoeken of en, zo ja, op welke wijze de artikelen 131 en 132 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht en het daarin opgenomen delictsbestanddeel «in het openbaar» herijkt zouden kunnen worden
Motie Ortega-Martijn c.s. over een tweejaarlijks onderzoek naar de participatie van inburgeraars
Asks the government to conduct a study every two years into the participation of integration participants after passing the civic integration exam.
requests the government to conduct a study every two years into the participation of integration participants after passing the civic integration exam
verzoekt de regering om de twee jaar een onderzoek te doen naar de participatie van inburgeraars na het behalen van het inburgeringsexamen
Motie Van Toorenburg en Dijsselbloem over een integraal beleid ten aanzien van huwelijksmigratie
Asks the government to develop integrated policy on spouse migration covering education, language, income, abuse and related issues, and a common European approach.
requests the government to develop integrated policy on the theme of spouse migration
verzoekt de regering integraal beleid te ontwikkelen ten aanzien van het thema huwelijksmigratie
Motie Dijsselbloem en Van Toorenburg over een gezamenlijke aanpak met Roma-gemeenten
Asks the government to develop a joint approach with Roma-concentrated municipalities, modelled on the Antillean municipalities approach, and to inform the House.
Motie Van Toorenburg over heroverweging van de remigratieregeling
Asks the government to reconsider the remigration scheme, including its age limit of 45 and its countries and time limits, and inform the House quickly.
calls on the government to reconsider the remigration scheme and to inform the House about this as soon as possible
roept de regering op de Remigratieregeling te heroverwegen en de Kamer hierover zo spoedig mogelijk te informeren
Motie Dijsselbloem c.s. over van taalcursussen op ETV
Motion asks the government to secure continuity of funding for language courses broadcast on the educational channel ETV, which so far had only temporary project subsidy.
requests the government to ensure the continuity of the offer of language courses on the educational channel ETV
verzoekt de regering de continuïteit van het aanbod van taalcursussen op de educatieve zender ETV zeker te stellen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over het niet uitvoeren van de motie over de naturalisatie van circa 10.000 pardonners (Ranov-vergunninghouders

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Van Toorenburg asked why the government has not implemented a motion to speed up naturalisation of about 10,000 Ranov permit holders, given earlier reports, and whether it will implement the motion immediately. The State Secretary answers that she knows the earlier reports but has commissioned additional research into the current group and its obstacles, with results expected in July 2021, which are relevant to how the motion will be implemented.

For this purpose I have commissioned additional research, in which I asked to map the current group of Ranov permit holders and the obstacles they currently experience in submitting a naturalisation application.

Hiervoor heb ik een aanvullend onderzoek ingesteld, waarbij ik gevraagd heb de actuele groep Ranov-vergunninghouders en de knelpunten die zij op dit moment ervaren voor het indienen van een naturalisatieverzoek in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Weigering coronatest kan asielzoeker respijt geven; ’Consequentie is dat de terugkeer geen doorgang vindt’'

An MP asked how many rejected asylum seekers with a departure obligation refused PCR tests, where they ended up, whether detention is possible, and whether refusal should be criminalised. The government said refusal is not registered and cannot be retrieved without individual file research, that refusal to cooperate can be weighed in detention decisions under time limits, and that it will not introduce a general criminal offence of unlawful stay.
How many foreigners at any time refused to cooperate with a PCR test could currently only be determined through extensive individual file research and cannot reasonably be realised.

Hoeveel vreemdelingen op enig moment hebben geweigerd medewerking te verlenen aan de afname van een PCR-test zou op dit moment alleen te achterhalen zijn door een omvangrijk, individueel dossieronderzoek en kan redelijkerwijs niet worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht 'Ondernemers beschermen zaak tegen relschoppers en krijgen boete'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Dam asked the Minister of Justice whether it is unjust that entrepreneurs who defended their shops against rioters received fines for breaching curfew, and what would be done to waive them. The Minister replied that the curfew regulation has an emergency exception assessed case by case by the public prosecution service, that fines can be contested in court, and that it is not for him to intervene in individual cases.
It is not for me as Minister to intervene in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om in individuele zaken te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van de Molen en Van Toorenburg n.a.v. het bericht ‘Slecht Engels sprekende internationale studenten verdwijnen mogelijk in illegaliteit'

CDA MPs asked whether international students who fail to master English disappear into illegality, how the visa system tracks departures, and whether other EU countries face the same problem. The minister replied that no data exist on students who stay on illegally, that there are few signs of deliberate misuse so no extra action is planned, and that the English-language exemption in the code of conduct is optional for institutions, not a tightening of language requirements.
There is no data available if a student chooses not to return to their country of origin but goes into illegality or applies for residence in another country, whether or not within the EU.

Er zijn geen gegevens voorhanden als een student ervoor kiest om niet terug te keren naar zijn land van herkomst maar de illegaliteit ingaat of verblijf aanvraagt in een ander land, al dan niet binnen de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Toorenburg over kinderen die onterecht uit huis worden geplaatst door slecht feitenonderzoek

MPs Peters and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether children are wrongly removed from their homes due to poor fact-finding by youth care workers and the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, and what measures will prevent this. The minister replied that the statutory duty to report facts fully and truthfully applies, that an Action Plan to improve fact-finding is under way through 2021, and that existing checks (RvdK independence, judicial review, appeal) are sufficient, so no new measures are needed.
Based on the above, I am of the view that the current system already contains sufficient safeguards to address the problem you describe.
Op basis van het bovenstaande ben ik van mening dat het huidige systeem reeds voldoende waarborgen bevat om het door u geschetste probleem te ondervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Nispen over de berichtgeving m.b.t. coronabesmettingen binnen het gevangeniswezen: 'Corona in gevangenis: 84 gedetineerden in quarantaine'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about COVID-19 infections in prisons, including 84 detainees quarantined at PI Roermond, prisoners not being allowed to wear masks, a Complaints Commission ruling against the PI Heerhugowaard directorate, and video-call problems. The minister confirmed the infections and said masks are generally not worn by detainees for order and security reasons, while noting that other measures apply and that the matter is under advisory review and pending appeals.
Information on infections among staff cannot be shared with you, as it may not be recorded.
Informatie over besmettingen onder personeel kan ik niet met u delen aangezien dit niet vastgelegd mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Meerdere OMT-leden bedreigd en thuis opgezocht'

MPs Groothuizen and Van Toorenburg asked the government about reports that several OMT members were threatened and visited at home, and about protection, public address data and doxing. Minister Grapperhaus said threats are unacceptable, police are investigating, protective measures are available where needed, and the address-shielding and doxing policy work is ongoing.
As your House knows, I cannot go into further detail on ongoing matters.
Zoals uw Kamer weet kan ik over lopende zaken niet verder in detail treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Van Toorenburg en Voordewind over het beëindigen van de coulance-regeling

MPs Groothuizen, Van Toorenburg and Voordewind asked why the COA coulance (grace) regime for rejected asylum seekers, used in the first lockdown, was not reintroduced, and whether people are being put onto the street during the current lockdown. The State Secretary replied that asylum processes are classed as vital, that accommodation options (vbl, family locations) remain available, that the coulance is not reinstated, and that departures are realistic.
Since there are shelter facilities for rejected asylum seekers and the asylum chain processes remain operational, I have decided not to reintroduce the coulance regime.
Aangezien er onderdakvoorzieningen zijn voor afgewezen asielzoekers en de processen in de asielketen operationeel blijven, heb ik besloten de coulanceregeling niet opnieuw in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Lange rijen bij registratie in Ter Apel'

MPs Groothuizen and Van Toorenburg asked why asylum seekers arriving in Ter Apel still lacked beds despite new pavilions and rising inflow, and what measures will prevent this. The State Secretary explained the new registration process, the four heated pavilions and a waiting room for after-hours arrivals, and said a chain coordinator was appointed to optimise capacity, though there is no firm guarantee of a bed every night.

It is expressly not intended that asylum seekers spend two nights in the waiting room, but in the event of an unexpected peak in registrations, where vulnerable asylum seekers get priority, this cannot always be prevented.

Het is uitdrukkelijk niet de bedoeling dat asielzoekers twee nachten doorbrengen in de «wachtkamer», maar bij een onverwachte piek in het aantal aanmeldingen waarbij kwetsbare asielzoekers voorrang krijgen, is het niet altijd te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van der Graaf en Van Nispen over het blog van de voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur van de Kansspelautoriteit Imago en ‘backlash’

MPs Van Toorenburg, Van der Graaf and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a blog by the Kansspelautoriteit chair warning of a public 'backlash' after opening the online gambling market, and whether the government would protect vulnerable people and the lottery revenue. The minister answered that the Dutch market is regulated rather than liberalised, that strict advertising and care-duty rules apply, that the regulator will monitor and enforce, that the law will be evaluated after three years, and that the sector will revise its advertising code.
Three years after the law takes effect it will be evaluated, with explicit attention to the effects on consumer protection and addiction problems.
Drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van de wet zal deze worden geëvalueerd, waarbij nadrukkelijk zal worden gekeken naar de effecten op consumentenbescherming en verslavingsproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Toorenburg en Kuiken over het bericht 'Geheim telefoonverkeer legt ernstige corruptie bij politie bloot'

MPs Van Dam, Van Toorenburg and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about reports that EncroChat communications revealed serious police corruption, including in the Landelijke Eenheid, and about the scale, staffing, integrity measures, privacy limits and the new MIT team. The minister declined to analyse or disclose details of ongoing investigations, while describing a Team Aanpak Corruptie under the Rijksrecherche, integrity and access-control measures, a pilot for detecting abnormal data use, and the ongoing setup of the MIT.
No, I do not make statements about ongoing investigations.
Nee, ik doe geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Walgelijk, maar ook nuttig?; Justitie zint op maatregelen tegen kindersexpoppen’

The MP Van Toorenburg (CDA) asks the Minister of Justice whether child sex dolls appearing on the Dutch market are a concern, whether they could be a gateway or a deterrent, whether an import ban and confiscation or customer registration are possible, and whether a ban should be included in the planned law against paedophile handbooks. The Minister answers that the issue is serious, that the department is examining legal options and a possible ban by analogy with the ban on virtual child pornography, that confiscation without suspicion of a crime is not currently possible, and that he will inform the House of the results.
I will inform the House of the results of the exploration.
Ik zal de Kamer over de resultaten van de verkenning informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over de trage afhandeling van letselschadezaken door verzekeraars

MPs asked the minister for Legal Protection whether self-regulation by insurers in personal injury claims has failed and whether the government will tighten rules, sanctions and a disciplinary tribunal. The minister acknowledged the problem and attributed delays largely to necessary case complexity, but rejected legislation, sanctions and a disciplinary tribunal, pointing instead to the Letselschade Raad's keurmerk and other industry measures.
Legally anchoring and tightening the Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade, as well as imposing sanctions for non-compliance with that code, do not fit well with this approach.
Het wettelijk verankeren en aanscherpen van de Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade, alsmede het stellen van sancties op het niet-naleven van die gedragscode, verhouden zich daarmee niet goed.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Hoe de UvA in de jacht op de internationale student de grenzen opzoekt'

MPs Van der Molen and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked about reports that the UvA, via the private firm OnCampus, admits non-EEA students with havo-level qualifications through a preparatory year, and whether this breaches the WHW and the Gedragscode. The minister replied that the Landelijke Commissie report is being awaited, that the Inspectie does not supervise these preparatory programmes, that the practice conflicts with the spirit of the law and code, and that further steps and consultations with the sector and Inspectie will follow.
The preparatory education offered to international students does not constitute education as defined in the WHW.
Het voorbereidend onderwijs dat aan internationale studenten wordt aangeboden betreft geen onderwijs zoals gedefinieerd in de WHW.
Antwoord op vagen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Groothuizen over het bericht 'Lange rijen bij registratie in Ter Apel'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Groothuizen asked why asylum registration at Ter Apel stalled, with long queues and people sleeping on chairs or the floor, and why no bed was provided. The Secretary of State attributed the delays to a higher-than-expected August intake combined with COVID-19 procedures, said a temporary pavilion with beds was not yet ready, and promised flexible capacity planning and a 24-hour registration target.
Unfortunately this facility was not yet ready when the intake in early August was higher than expected for several days.
Helaas was deze inrichting nog niet gereed toen de instroom begin augustus een aantal dagen hoger was dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Groothuizen over het bericht 'Achterstand bij de IND wegwerken was het idee; het werd netflixen'

MPs Van Toorenburg (CDA) and Groothuizen (D66) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that new IND decision-makers were advised to watch Netflix documentaries on asylum seekers' countries of origin, and about chaos, quality, and prioritisation problems in the IND backlog taskforce. The State Secretary answered that training uses optional viewing tips alongside written material, that start-up problems were organisational and are being addressed, that quality is safeguarded, and that about 4,000 cases were closed by 1 September with roughly 11,000 remaining.
These programmes are offered optionally outside the mandatory regular training component; staff can therefore choose to watch them when their workload allows.

Deze programma's worden facultatief aangeboden buiten het verplichte reguliere opleidingsdeel; men kan er dus voor kiezen de programma's te bekijken op het moment dat de werkomvang daar ruimte toe biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de berichtgeving dat COA geen informatie meer deelt

An MP asked whether COA stopped sharing asylum-seeker information with police, why, and how crime among asylum seekers will be tackled given the murder of Rik van de Rakt. The government confirmed the suspension pending an external review of the legal basis under art. 107 Vreemdelingenwet, while stating that other data flows continue and promising to inform parliament of the outcome.
Pending the outcome of the external review, COA's board decided on 16 July to immediately suspend sharing personal data with the police.
In afwachting van de uitkomsten van de externe toetsing heeft het bestuur van het COA op 16 juli jl. besloten het delen van persoonsgegevens met de politie per direct op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘'Terrorbuurman' slaat opnieuw toe, Kees D. zorgt dagelijks voor angst en overlast’

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked about a neighbour causing fear and nuisance, reportedly ignoring a court-ordered outpatient care order and a contact ban, and asked what action can be taken. The state secretary declined to comment on the individual case, explained the probation and prosecution route for breaches of conditions, the Wvggz and Wfz coercive-care options, and a new national reporting line, without committing to a specific new action.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Becker over het bericht ‘Moord op Rik van de Rakt: foutengala rond Soedanese verdachte; ’Cruciale informatie vanwege privacy niet gedeeld’’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Becker asked the State Secretary about a report on the murder of Rik van de Rakt by a Sudanese status holder, and whether mental health information was withheld from the receiving municipality because of privacy rules. The State Secretary said privacy law governs sharing medical information, that COA shares what it lawfully may, that the report is the municipality's responsibility, and that partners will review the allocation and information-sharing process.
Strict privacy laws and regulations apply to sharing medical information, and for status holders these are no different than for other citizens in the Netherlands.
Voor het delen van medische informatie geldt strikte wet- en regelgeving op het gebied van privacy, die voor statushouders niet anders is dan voor andere burgers in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over aanleiding van de column ‘Er is een klimaat dat het voor agressieve horken eenvoudig maakt om anderen het leven zuur te maken’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Dam asked whether light community sentences for serious threats are appropriate, and whether digital threats are treated more leniently than physical ones, prompted by a column on online abuse. The Minister answered that threats are unacceptable, that sentencing is for prosecutors and judges, that written threats generally carry higher sanctions than spoken ones, and that threats against journalists can raise the sentence demanded.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: dreiging door extreme afsplitsing van IS’

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report on the Hazimi movement, a jihadist offshoot of IS with an estimated 100 Dutch followers, including its threat level, the number of former IS members involved, local government handling, online activity, and future coverage in the threat assessment. The minister answered that Hazimi followers are more sectarian but not more violent than IS-oriented jihadists, numbers are stable at a few dozen, local care-based approaches apply, online activity is monitored, and the DTN will address the movement if developments warrant.
I cannot make statements about individual persons.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over individuele personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Van Toorenburg over het rapport van het Centrum tegen Kinderhandel en Mensenhandel

MPs Kuik, Rog and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a report on criminal exploitation of Dutch pupils, including the number of awareness programmes run, schools' reluctance to be open about incidents, victim and perpetrator data, and monitoring of progress. The State Secretary answered that schools are being supported, that programme rollout is ongoing, that data-gathering with statistics bodies and the Rapporteur is being explored, and that the Chamber will be informed through progress letters.
Your House will be further informed in the progress letter of the programme Samen tegen mensenhandel about the outcomes of these discussions.
Uw Kamer wordt in de voortgangsbrief van het programma Samen tegen mensenhandel nader geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Toorenburg over het bericht dat in de Haagse wijk Valkenbos-Regentes een dodelijke steekpartij heeft plaatsgevonden

MPs Van Dam and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked about a fatal stabbing in The Hague's Valkenbos-Regentes area, police and prosecution enforcement against drug crime, coffeeshop concentration and school proximity, and whether a new coffeeshop concentration criterion should be added. Minister Grapperhaus answered that enforcement and local measures are in place, that a national concentration criterion is not needed because municipalities can set local rules, and that the municipality is handling the neighbourhood transformation.
I see no added value in adding an extra national criterion for the following reasons.
Ik zie geen meerwaarde in het toevoegen van een extra landelijk criterium om de volgende redenen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Groothuizen, Voordewind en Van Toorenburg over het voorstel om migranten op de Griekse eilanden vanwege corona over te brengen naar stilliggende cruisesc

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Netherlands would press the EU to evacuate migrants from overcrowded Greek island camps, such as Moria, to idle cruise ships to prevent a COVID-19 outbreak, and why Dutch relocation promises were not being kept. The government answered that the Greek authorities are primarily responsible, that transfers to the mainland are already ongoing, that the Netherlands is backing a Greek-Dutch programme for unaccompanied minors, and that cruise-ship accommodation was judged unnecessary and costly by Greece.
In principle it is for the Greek authorities to take adequate measures to address the COVID-19 situation.
Het is in beginsel aan de Griekse autoriteiten om adequate maatregelen te treffen om de COVID-19 situatie het hoofd te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Van Toorenburg over het rapport van het Centrum tegen Kinderhandel en Mensenhandel (CKM) aangaande criminele uitbuiting onder Nederlandse scholieren

MPs Kuik, Rog and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the government about a CKM report on criminal exploitation and drug-related recruitment of Dutch schoolchildren, including school protocols, normalisation of drugs, prosecution statistics, non-punishment protection and the UK approach. The state secretary answered that protocols and prevention programmes exist, that data on drug-related trafficking cases is not registered separately, and that the government will explore closer cooperation and learn from the UK.
The Public Prosecution Service does not register in how many of these cases the exploitation is drug-related, nor whether it occurs among schoolchildren.
Het OM registreert niet in hoeveel van deze gevallen het gaat om drugsgerelateerde uitbuiting, en ook niet of dat gebeurt onder scholieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Becker over terugkeerprogramma’s voor uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers

MPs Van Toorenburg (CDA) and Becker (VVD) asked about subsidised return programmes for rejected asylum seekers, including amounts spent, selection and quality control, effectiveness and whether subsidy depends on actual return. The State Secretary answered that 17 completed projects cost about 3.17 million euro and achieved roughly 45% verified departures, promised an evaluation of the subsidy scheme in autumn, and said it would be reviewed whether subsidy conditions should change.
Because I consider it important to provide insight into how the subsidy funds under the Ondersteuning Zelfstandig Vertrek scheme are spent, I have instructed that this scheme be evaluated.
Omdat ik het belangrijk vind inzage te geven in de besteding van de subsidiegelden die onder de Regeling Ondersteuning Zelfstandig Vertrek vallen, heb ik opdracht gegeven deze regeling te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Toorenburg over de excuses en schadevergoeding voor slachtoffers van Zusters van de Goede Herder

MPs Van Nispen and Van Toorenburg asked whether the proposed EUR 5,000 flat-rate compensation and apology for victims of forced child labour at the Zusters van de Goede Herder is adequate, and why it is aligned with victims of youth-care abuse. The minister defends the single amount as recognition of the government's inadequate supervision, says a separate Goede Herder case would be disproportionate to treat differently, and promises a Ministerial Regulation in autumn with the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven administering it.
In my letter of 19 December to the House I indicated that the government has a responsibility to take for having failed to supervise adequately, allowing the unlawful forced labour to continue.
In mijn brief van 19 december aan uw Kamer heb ik aangegeven dat de overheid een verantwoordelijkheid heeft te nemen voor het feit dat zij onvoldoende toezicht heeft gehouden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Toorenburg over de uitspraak van het Kifid: ‘Softdrug niet illegaal, schade door beroving wel gedekt’

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether preparatory acts for soft-drug dealing are punishable, and how to respond to a Kifid complaints-body ruling that a robbery-related damage claim was covered and soft drugs were not illegal. The minister confirmed that preparatory acts for soft-drug trade are punishable under the Opium Act when commercial or large-quantity, but declined to comment on or engage with Kifid's individual ruling, citing its independence.
I do not intervene in the assessment of Kifid rulings in individual disputes.
Ik treed niet in de beoordeling van uitspraken van Kifid in individuele geschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over de Beleidsregels exploitatievergunning speelautomatenhallen Heerlen 2020

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked why Heerlen allocates speelautomatenhal licences by lottery rather than by merit on player protection and crime prevention. The minister replied that municipalities may choose any allocation method that respects formal equality, that Heerlen's lottery is followed by a substantive assessment of each drawn application, and that it is for the municipality to decide.
Within the limits of laws and regulations, municipalities are free to determine how they shape the granting of licences.
Binnen de grenzen van de wet- en regelgeving zijn gemeenten vrij om te bepalen hoe zij de verlening van vergunningen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over de uitzending ‘WNL op Zaterdag‘ d.d. 7 maart 2020

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert (CDA) asked whether the government is doing enough to collect testimony from Yazidi women and others who suffered under ISIS, so it can be used as evidence in prosecutions. The government answered that it supports NGOs and UN and IIIM mechanisms that collect evidence, stresses victim choice and careful interviewing, and says it is funding Yazda, UNITAD and other programmes, without committing to a new concrete step.
The Netherlands is concretely committed to actively reaching the Yazidi community through, among other things, the support mentioned above for Yazda, UNITAD and the IIIM.
Nederland zet concreet in op het actief benaderen van de Jezidi-gemeenschap door onder meer bovengenoemde steun aan Yazda, UNITAD en het IIIM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Toorenburg over het artikel ‘Verdachte in ‘tattookillers’-zaak knipt enkelband door en vlucht’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a suspect who cut his ankle monitor and fled during a case, and whether conditional release is withheld in such cases. The minister said the prosecution does not hold data on the specific cases, that about 60 requests to revoke conditional release were filed in 2019 with 45 partly granted, and that the specific case is pending appeal and cannot be discussed in substance.
At the time of the assessment, the prosecution saw no serious objections on the basis of which it could be requested to refrain from conditional release.
Ten tijde van de beoordeling zag het OM geen ernstige bezwaren op grond waarvan verzocht kan worden om van een v.i. af te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Becker over het gesprek van de Commissie Justitie en Veiligheid met de nieuwe Eurocommissaris Johansson

MPs Van Toorenburg and Becker asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether she agrees with EU Commissioner Johansson that the Netherlands does not fully use EU rules allowing detention of migrants, and whether she will have this analysed. The State Secretary answered that the government will pursue wider administrative migrant detention within EU law, has asked the Commission for an analysis, and commissioned WODC research with results expected in 2021.
I indicated to the Commissioner that I would like an explanation and/or analysis from the Commission of the possibilities that the current regulations offer regarding detention.
Ik heb de Eurocommissaris aangegeven dat ik graag een toelichting en/of analyse zou krijgen van de Commissie op de mogelijkheden die de huidige regelgeving biedt op het onderdeel van bewaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Verdachte moord Bouwlust ontsnapte aan toezicht enkelband’

MP Van Toorenburg asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the suspect in a Den Haag murder, who had escaped electronic monitoring, had a record of absconding, whether assessment errors were made, and how often lethal offences by electronically monitored offenders occur. The minister answered that the criminal investigation is ongoing, gave only general detention history (a 2013 Turkish sentence transferred to the Netherlands, a penitentiary programme approved in 2019 on positive advice from the OM, reclassering and police, and a first escape on 29 September 2019), and said such cases are not centrally registered.
The criminal investigation led by the public prosecution service is still ongoing.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek onder leiding van het OM is nog bezig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de verstoring van de dodenherdenking door gedetineerden vanuit de P.I. Vught

MP Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether financial compensation to a prisoner for a minor procedural error is appropriate, and whether the minister would discuss this with the Vught prison supervisory committee and the RSJ. The minister said the compensation decision lies with the independent complaints committee under Pbw article 68 and declined to judge that case, but agreed to consult the RSJ, and will ask DJI to appeal such decisions where it disagrees, possibly amending the Pbw if that fails.
