This case gives me reason to ask DJI to appeal in cases where DJI believes a financial compensation should not be awarded.
Deze casus is voor mij aanleiding om DJI te vragen om in gevallen waarin DJI meent dat een financiële tegemoetkoming niet behoort te worden vastgesteld in beroep te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van Toorenburg over legionella in afvalwaterzuiveringsinstallaties

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about legionella at 81 wastewater treatment plants in Noord-Brabant, including who enforces, what has been done, whether the risk locations can be published, and whether companies protect workers. The minister answered that enforcement lies with municipalities and provinces via environmental services, that companies are expected to act, and that publication is the competent authorities' decision, with a model-letter process under way.

Whether enforcement actually takes place when companies do not voluntarily take measures is not known, because Omgevingsdienst NL has no view of the actions each individual environmental service has taken.

Of daadwerkelijk sprake is van handhaving indien bedrijven niet vrijwillig overgaan tot het nemen van maatregelen is niet bekend, omdat Omgevingsdienst NL geen zicht heeft op de acties die elke individuele omgevingsdienst heeft genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht 'Weer hoofdofficier weg bij OM'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Justice about complaints concerning members of the College of Procureurs-Generaal and the procedure for handling them, following a press report on a prosecutor leaving the OM. The Minister answered that two complaints were filed since the Fokkens report, each handled by a separate ad hoc complaints committee, describing the committee's fact-gathering and the general complaints procedure while declining to discuss individual case details.
Since the publication of the Fokkens committee report, two complaints about conduct of members of the College have been filed with my ministry.
Sinds het verschijnen van het rapport van de commissie Fokkens zijn twee klachten tegen gedragingen van leden van het College bij mijn ministerie aanhangig gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat Ikea een proef doet met sollicitatiegesprekken thuis op de bank

An MP asked whether the Minister for Legal Protection would consider reinstating home visits to candidates for prison service posts, as a service and to gain insight into applicants' personal circumstances. The minister answered that home visits are not standard practice since the VOG requirement, that they would burden candidates, and that DJI continuously seeks to improve its recruitment process.

Visiting candidates for a post in a penitentiary institution at home burdens the candidate more, because they would still have to come in later to complete additional selection steps that cannot be organised in a home setting.

Het thuis bezoeken van kandidaten voor een functie in een penitentiaire inrichting belast de kandidaat meer, omdat deze op een later moment alsnog langs zal moeten komen om aanvullende selectiestappen te doorlopen die niet binnen een thuissituatie te organiseren zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht 'Weer hoofdofficier weg bij het OM'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about a complaint over undesirable conduct filed by CVOM staff against a chief prosecutor, shortly after the Fokkens commission report. The minister confirmed the complaint, its handling via two separate advisory-committee procedures, and the appointment process, but declined to discuss its content because of the ongoing complaint procedure.
Regarding the nature and content of this complaint, I will not make any statements, given its confidentiality.
Over de aard en inhoud van deze klacht doe ik, in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid daarvan, geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Toorenburg over misstanden bij adopties en de betrokkenheid en wetenschap van de Nederlandse overheid

MPs Van Nispen and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister for Legal Protection about irregularities in intercountry adoptions, government knowledge of them, and whether the inquiry should be broadened and whether China adoptions remain responsible. The minister mostly pointed to the ongoing COIA inquiry, announced stricter oversight of sending countries, and said adoptions from China remain justified, while declining to give an interim report yet.
I attach importance to awaiting the findings of the COIA before being able to make statements about what is indicated in the question.
Ik hecht eraan de bevindingen van de COIA af te wachten alvorens uitspraken te kunnen doen over hetgeen in de vraagstelling wordt aangegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over de Nederlander die in Roemenië verdacht wordt van het misbruiken en vermoorden van een meisje en mogelijk andere vergelijkbare misdrijven

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked how Dutch authorities assisted Romania's investigation into a Dutch suspect in the abuse and killing of a girl, whether he had other offences, and why Romania lacked official confirmation of his death and was not alerted through European systems. The ministers answered that Dutch legal assistance was provided, that the suspect's death was officially communicated, that he was not registered in SIS II, SIENA or ECRIS, and that he had served his earlier sentences, though they declined to give details of his past convictions and did not answer the questions within three weeks.
I will not go into the exact convictions or sentences that Johannes V. received earlier.
Ik ga niet in op de exacte veroordelingen dan wel straffen die Johannes V. eerder heeft gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Toorenburg en Van der Graaf over de impact van gokelementen in games op jongeren

MPs from the CDA and ChristenUnie asked the state secretaries about rising problematic gaming among young people, the spread of gambling-like loot boxes, the slow enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit against game developers, and age classification. The government answered that the rise may not be confirmed by current data pending a legal basis for LADIS, rejected a national ban as ineffective, said enforcement is complex and partly confidential, and pointed to prevention, industry dialogue and PEGI self-regulation.
Not everything happens in public. It is a careful process that must also be able to withstand scrutiny in court.
Niet alles gebeurt in de openbaarheid. Het is een zorgvuldig proces dat ook bij de rechter moet kunnen standhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over het intrekken van paspoorten Syriëgangers en beleid Buitenlandse Zaken inzake ‘gematigde’ rebellen

Three CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about passport and citizenship revocations for Syria fighters and the government's stance on 'moderate' rebel groups supported under the Dutch Non-Lethal Assistance programme, including why Ahrar al-Sham is not on Dutch terrorism lists. The ministers answered largely by referring to legal frameworks, declining to comment on individual cases, and explaining that the listing criteria for the national-security list and the national sanctions list were not met.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual cases.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Nederlandse hulp aan gevangenen in buitenland berust op willekeur’

Six MPs from CDA, SP, GroenLinks, D66, SGP and ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch assistance to Dutch prisoners abroad (the Singh case), including the five-year binding criterion, a WOTS transfer request and the handling of the case. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that existing criteria apply, that no official US transfer request was ever made, and that it promises no concrete new step.
I cannot make statements about ongoing cases and individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over lopende zaken en individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over het onderzoek naar oorzaken van langlopende letselschadezaken

MPs Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen and Kuiken asked why the University of Utrecht study into causes of long-running personal injury claims is delayed, and whether its independence is compromised given the involvement of the Letselschade Raad, insurers and QCPP. The minister attributes the delay to the broad design, privacy preparation, and insurer response rates, and defends the study's independence and balanced steering committee.
There are no reasons for me to doubt the independence and objectivity of the commissioning party.
Er zijn voor mij geen redenen om te twijfelen aan de onafhankelijkheid en objectiviteit van de opdrachtgever.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Jasper van Dijk, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Bisschop over het bericht dat een medewerker bij de IND door zijn leidinggevende onder druk werd gezet om zijn eigen dossi

MPs asked whether internal IND emails showing a supervisor discussing 'constructions' around asylum decisions contradict the De Leeuw commission's finding of no directed instructions to break rules, and whether further investigation, contact with ministry officials, and a meeting with the whistleblower are warranted. The State Secretary replied that the emails were included in the commission's research, found no reason for further investigation or doubt about the report's reliability or independence, declined to discuss individual personnel matters citing privacy, and saw no reason to meet the whistleblower.
I therefore see no reason for additional investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor een aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kuiken, Laan-Geselschap, Van Toorenburg en Den Boer over terrorismeverdachten die airsoft speelden als mogelijke voorbereiding op een aanslag

MPs from SP, PvdA, VVD, CDA and D66 asked the Justice Minister how airsoft, which RTL reported terrorism suspects played as possible attack training, is controlled, including whether introduced guests need a certificate of conduct (VOG). The minister said current oversight is adequate, that screening looks back eight years, and that he will discuss how to combat misuse with the airsoft association but sees no reason to change the rules now.
I do not comment on individual case matters.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Toorenburg en Van der Molen over de verkoop van paspoorten op Malta en de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

Three CDA MPs asked about Malta's passport-sale programme, its national security risks, and the undisclosed outside roles of a Groningen professor in the investment-migration industry. The minister said the programme is a security concern, that the university must investigate the professor's disclosure and conflicts of interest, and that the Inspectorate will advise on the findings.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to subsequently assess the findings of the investigation regarding the secondary activities and possible conflicts of interest and to advise me on them.

Ik heb de Inspectie van het onderwijs gevraagd om vervolgens de bevindingen van het onderzoek ten aanzien van de nevenwerkzaamheden en eventuele belangenverstrengeling te beoordelen en mij daarover te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de Coöperatie Laatste Wil een handleiding online heeft gezet waarmee het mogelijk is om een leven te beëindigen

MPs Van der Molen and Van Toorenburg asked whether the government would act against the Coöperatie Laatste Wil after it posted online a manual naming chemicals usable for ending life, and whether a criminal investigation should be reopened. The government called the manual undesirable and said it was in talks with the CLW, but stated that the Public Prosecution Service independently decides whether to investigate and will inform parliament only once it has decided.
The OM makes an independent, autonomous assessment of whether or not to start a criminal investigation.
Het OM maakt een eigenstandige, onafhankelijke afweging over het al dan niet starten van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Haarendael restaureren? Technisch kán alles...maar er moet  ook geld  zijn’

The MPs asked the minister about the fire at the historic Haarendael complex, its consequences for the municipality's enforcement against neglect, measures to secure the surviving structure, and willingness to consult stakeholders. The minister confirmed the monument's historical value, said the enforcement order will be revised, described ongoing safety and conservation measures led by the municipality, and committed to involving the heritage agency in talks on the site's future.
From the municipality, the competent authority in this matter, I have learned that measures are currently being investigated to determine what is possible.
Van de gemeente, het bevoegd gezag in dezen, heb ik vernomen dat er op dit moment onderzocht wordt welke maatregelen mogelijk zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het werkbezoek School en Veiligheid (Oost-Brabant)

An MP asked whether minor juvenile offences, including soft-drug possession, can be referred to Halt quickly without a full official report, and whether the restriction lies in law, policy or local agreements. The Minister explains that Halt referrals for offences via a mutation or simple report are locally arranged, that soft-drug possession is a misdemeanour requiring a report and prosecutor consent, and that a nationally uniform ZSM referral process is being decided in autumn 2019.
In the autumn a decision will be taken on a nationally uniform ZSM process for Halt.
In het najaar vindt besluitvorming plaats over een landelijk uniform ZSM-proces Halt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Politievrijwilliger in ruil voor een weekje aan zee’

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police capacity shortages in holiday areas, including reports that municipalities rent holiday accommodation for volunteer police officers. The minister answered that seasonal peaks are common across holiday regions, that police units support each other and mayors can request assistance, and that the municipal arrangements are an innovative solution he praised, while promising to explore further cooperation with partners such as DJI for prisoner transport.
If local cooperation partners see options for more intensive cooperation, I will investigate what is legally possible.
Indien lokale samenwerkingspartners opties voor intensievere samenwerking zien, dan zal ik onderzoek doen naar wat er wettelijk mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Ronnes over het bericht 'Overloon vraagt om actie tegen ‘foute vluchtelingen’'

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about residents of Overloon reporting an asylum centre with disproportionate nuisance from a small group of asylum seekers, and feelings of powerlessness, including advice to residents to get a dog, install a fence and report incidents. The State Secretary denied advising residents to get dogs or fences, acknowledged the nuisance, described stepped-up measures (including faster transfers to the EBTL facility) and stated that the Overloon-specific details and wider measures would be reported before summer recess.
On the progress of the measures I will inform your House extensively by letter before the summer recess.
Over de vorderingen van de maatregelen zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces uitgebreid per brief informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘De behandeldirecteur van de PI Vught die zwaar blunderde bij de overplaatsing van Michael P. is nu bestuurder van Fivoor’

Two CDA MPs asked whether it is acceptable that the prison treatment director criticised for errors in the transfer of Michael P. now leads the clinic Fivoor, and whether the government will act given local residents' distrust of the clinic in Den Dolder. The minister replied that the government does not steer individual appointments at private institutions but on quality and performance, that a broader culture change is being pursued, and that interim measures were agreed with residents, with the inspectorate monitoring the clinic.
Where these performances fall below standard, intervention is possible.
Daar waar deze prestaties onder de maat zijn kan worden ingegrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het doorbreken van het medisch beroepsgeheim bij verdenking van een misdaad

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked whether staff at the Mondriaan clinic should have breached medical confidentiality when they suspected a patient was involved in a double murder, and for examples of when a breach is permitted. Staatssecretaris Blokhuis answered that breaching confidentiality requires a careful case-by-case weighing under the conflict-of-duties rules, declined to judge the case while the investigation is ongoing, and gave general examples.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Buitenweg, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht Boek over politieonderzoek Nicole van den Hurk moet worden aangepast

MPs asked about a court ruling that a book on the police investigation into Nicole van den Hurk must be amended to protect relatives' privacy, and about how the police and prosecution service handle media contracts and embedded journalists. The minister admits errors were made, says the relatives were informed late, outlines a revised media guideline and standard contract, and says a Slachtofferhulp study will report by end 2019.
Errors were made. In weighing the public interest in openness against the protection of the relatives' privacy, insufficient attention was paid to the latter.

Er zijn fouten gemaakt. Bij de afweging tussen het maatschappelijk belang van openheid aan de ene kant en de bescherming van de privacy van de nabestaanden aan de andere kant is onvoldoende oog geweest voor het laatste.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Haatlectuur voor het grijpen in bajes Vught’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why radical jihadist and anti-Jewish/Christian literature is available to detainees in PI Vught, including those on the Terrorist Wing, and what criteria exist for refusing books. The Minister answered that the TA screening has removed several titles, that criteria for the director's decision are not yet formulated but will be drafted with experts, and that removal of extreme titles will be checked further.
I am of the view that such criteria are indeed desirable.
Ik ben van oordeel dat dergelijke criteria wel wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de dodenherdenking in Vught is verstoord door gejoel en geroep van de PI Vught

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that a Dutch national remembrance ceremony in Vught was disrupted by shouting and noise from the PI Vught prison's terrorism wing, and how this could happen. The Minister confirmed that five detainees deliberately made noise, that they received disciplinary punishment of about a week in isolation, and that the prison is reviewing how to prevent such disruptions.
Internal investigation showed that five detainees placed on the TA at PI Vught deliberately made noise in their cells during the two-minute silence.
Uit intern onderzoek is gebleken dat vijf gedetineerden, die op de TA van de PI Vught zijn geplaatst, tijdens de twee minuten stilte opzettelijk lawaai in hun cel zijn gaan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Wetenschappelijke studie laat zien: hoe sterker de wiet, des te groter de kans op psychose'

An MP asked the ministers how a study linking cannabis potency to psychosis risk affects care, prevention policy, THC limits for the cannabis experiment and the definition of softdrugs. The minister answered that the causal link is contested, that care aims to stop cannabis use, that labelling and information requirements are being set for coffeeshops, and that no upper THC limit is set for now pending more research.
Partly on the basis of the Knottnerus committee's advice, we for now set no upper limit on the THC content of Dutch cannabis and hashish to be produced within the closed coffeeshop experiment.

Mede op basis van het advies van de commissie Knottnerus in deze, stellen wij vooralsnog geen bovengrens aan het THC-gehalte van Nederwiet en Nederhasj die in het kader van het experiment gesloten coffeeshopketen zal worden geproduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Onverbeterlijke criminele asielzoeker heeft vrij spel’

CDA MPs asked whether criminal asylum seekers move between reception centres without follow-up or shared records, and whether a national database should be created, citing police criticism. The State Secretary said existing registration and information-sharing have been improved and that a new database would take long, so existing structures will be used in the short term, and he denied that transfers merely shift the problem.
At the JBZ committee meeting on 6 March I indicated that I am willing to examine whether an additional database would add value.
Tijdens het AO JBZ op 6 maart jl. heb ik aangegeven dat ik bereid ben te kijken of een additionele databank meerwaarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Vrouwelijke IS’er wil naar Nederland’

An MP from the CDA asked how a female IS member married to a Dutch citizen could obtain Dutch nationality, whether marriages in IS-controlled areas are recognised, whether her children could secure residence, and whether Dutch nationality can be blocked or withdrawn in national security cases. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, set out the general naturalisation conditions and the national security grounds for refusal, and said information from other countries will be considered where possible.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Vrouwen zoeken vaker én eerder hulp na verkrachting’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Bergkamp asked whether forensic evidence collection at Centres for Sexual Violence costs victims their own-risk payment, and how to exempt such care from it. The government answered that forensic costs are borne by the justice chain, medical care falls under the deductible, and it is piloting a one-year temporary scheme to reimburse the deductible for acute-phase victims while pointing victims to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven.

We are working towards a temporary one-year arrangement under which victims of sexual violence seeking help at the CSG in the acute phase receive reimbursement of the costs incurred for the deductible.

Zo zetten wij erop in om een tijdelijke voorziening voor één jaar in te richten waarbij slachtoffers van seksueel geweld die in de acute fase hulp zoeken bij het CSG, een vergoeding krijgen van de gemaakte kosten voor het eigen risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de rol van instanties rond het langdurig misbruikschandaal in de atletiekwereld

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked why police and the OM only started an investigation after publication, whether a Rotterdam athletics coach is in the sports misconduct register, and how registers, information-sharing agreements and public disclosure of disciplinary rulings are being developed. The minister answered that ongoing criminal investigations cannot be discussed, that the coach is listed in the register, that a separate sex-offence register is undesirable under the GDPR, and that a joint register and a cooperation document with police and the OM are in preparation.
I do not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Van Ojik over het rapport ‘Extra beschermd of extra beschadigd?’

MPs asked the State Secretary about a report finding that disabled and seriously ill children in asylum procedures and reception centres are not protected under UN child and disability treaties, and how the IND's medical assessments differ from treating doctors' views. The State Secretary responded that COA adapts housing and care case by case, that medical permits follow a separate IND/BMA assessment with discretionary power, and that individual cases are not addressed.
From that standpoint I cannot answer your question.
Ik kan uw vraag vanuit dat oogpunt dus niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Kuik over het bericht 'Criminele asielzoekers van de straat houden'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kuik asked whether nuisance-causing and criminal asylum seekers, including those from safe countries, should be placed in extra supervised locations where they cannot leave the grounds, and how police response times at the Ter Apel centre are handled. Secretary Harbers answered that nuisance is unacceptable and that transfer to such locations is used case by case, that residents may leave during the day under a reporting duty and that stricter detention rules are constrained by EU law, while police response data were provided, with statistics only partly available.
As I have written to your House several times, the starting point is that nuisance behaviour, as caused by a limited group of asylum seekers, is completely unacceptable.
Zoals ik meermaals aan uw Kamer heb geschreven staat voorop dat overlastgevend gedrag, zoals wordt veroorzaakt door een beperkte groep asielzoekers, volstrekt onacceptabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Meisjes bedreigd door asielzoekers'

Christian Democrat MP Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports of threats and nuisance by asylum seekers toward girls and local residents, including on public transport, and what powers reception centre management has. The State Secretary acknowledges the nuisance as unacceptable, describes a broad palette of criminal, administrative and immigration measures, the COA's sanction policy, and a local casus-based approach that led to extra cameras at the Leersum centre and a camera at a bus stop, without giving statistics on frequency.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Den Boer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat een Rus waarschijnlijk de nieuwe baas van Interpol wordt

MPs Sjoerdsma, Den Boer and Van Toorenburg asked whether Russian candidate Alexander Prokopchuk would become Interpol president, whether the Netherlands would vote against him, and whether he was linked to politically motivated Red Notices against Kremlin critics. The Minister answered that Mr Kim was elected president on 21 November 2018, that Red Notice procedures are bound by Interpol's constitution, and that the questions arrived after the vote.
These questions reached me after the election of Mr KIM as the new president of the INTERPOL Executive Committee.
Deze vragen hebben mij bereikt na afloop van de verkiezing van de heer KIM als nieuwe president van het INTERPOL Executief Comité.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de berichten 'Criminelen achter drugsafvaldumpingen wanen zich onaantastbaar' en 'Spoor van negen kilometer drugsafval leidt naar gedumpt busje in Nijmegen'

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice Minister about reports of escalating drug-waste dumping near homes, including the rise in incidents, prosecutions, the penalty for criminal organisations, public awareness campaigns, and who pays for clean-up. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, cited court sentences, said data cannot be fully generated, rejected raising the penalty for dumping itself, and noted that a sustainable clean-up funding solution is still being explored by an interadministrative working group.
A complete overview of cases in which suspects were convicted for dumping drug waste cannot be generated from the Public Prosecution Service's registration systems.
Uit de registratiesystemen van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) is geen volledig overzicht te genereren van zaken waarin verdachten zijn veroordeeld voor het dumpen van drugsafval.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Toorenburg over onnodig confronterende vragen op evaluatieformulieren voor ouders van kinderen met zeer ernstige verstandelijke en meervoudige beperkingen (ZEVMB)

Two MPs asked whether evaluation forms that ask parents who are curators of children with severe multiple disabilities (ZEVMB) about their children's self-reliance are unnecessarily confronting, and whether the forms can be changed. The minister acknowledges the questions can be painful, reports that the form has been revised so parents can skip questions with a medical statement, and says the issue will be discussed with stakeholders and the Werkgroep Wij zien je Wel.
At the second periodic evaluation, answering the questions can be much shorter via a specific ZEVMB-targeted route.
Bij de tweede periodieke evaluatie kan de beantwoording van de vragen veel korter zijn via een «afslag», die specifiek is gericht op ZEVMB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Buitenweg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over seksueel misbruik binnen de gemeenschap van Jehova’s Getuigen

Four MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether at least five victims had filed reports of sexual abuse within the Jehovah's Witnesses, whether these reports warrant further investigation, how police and prosecutors handle them, whether Jehovah's Witnesses can invoke the clergy testimony privilege, and whether internal instructions to store abuse allegations in sealed envelopes comply with the GDPR. The minister confirmed the reports, said an ongoing criminal investigation prevents further comment, stated the prosecution has nationwide oversight, said the testimony privilege belongs to individuals not organisations and will be considered in the review of extending the reporting duty, and referred the GDPR question to the independent Data Protection Authority.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation, which may result in prosecution and trial.
Er is sprake van lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat kan resulteren in vervolging en berechting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van den Berg over de steekpartij in Den Haag

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister why a Den Haag stabbing was quickly attributed to confused behaviour, what the asylum status of the suspect was, what support exists for asylum seekers with confused behaviour, and what the state of policy on such persons is. The minister answered that the suspect has a residence permit with no prior IND warning signs, described existing care and reception facilities, and promised a letter on the policy this autumn.
The foreign-national legal aspects of this individual case will not be discussed further.
Er wordt niet verder ingegaan op de vreemdelingrechtelijke aspecten van deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Oosten en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de vader van een ontvoerd kind alimentatie moet betalen

MPs Van Nispen, Van Oosten and Van Toorenburg asked whether the Dutch collection agency LBIO may enforce foreign alimony orders against a parent whose child was abducted abroad. The minister acknowledged the harshness, said the treaties offer limited grounds to refuse, and announced practical improvements such as LBIO summarising the left-behind parent's objections and checking for abduction cases in court requests.

As also promised during the General Consultation on Personal and Family Law on 16 May, I have engaged with the LBIO to examine how current practice can be improved, within the limited possibilities the treaties allow.

Zoals ook toegezegd tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Personen- en familierecht van 16 mei jongstleden ben ik met het LBIO in gesprek gegaan om te bekijken op welke wijze de huidige praktijk verbeterd kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het voorkomen van wangiri-fraude

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked how wangiri phone fraud via Dutch and foreign numbers can be prevented and whether operators can block high-tariff numbers. The government answered that no reliable figures exist, that operators and the ACM have some blocking and anti-fraud options, and that enforcement is difficult because it is international, while promising to inform the House if relevant developments arise.
I am willing to inform the House further if relevant developments occur in the consultations with the telecom sector.
Ik ben bereid de Kamer nader te informeren als zich relevante ontwikkelingen voordoen in het overleg met de telecomsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Van Toorenburg over de uitzending ‘Donny pleegde zelfmoord door gokschulden’

MPs Van der Graaf and Van Toorenburg asked why Unibet can operate illegally in the Netherlands, why payments to it remain possible despite the payment-provider convenant, and why unlicensed operators are not listed unless sanctioned. The minister answered that enforcement is difficult given the scale of illegal gambling, that the Remote Gambling Bill would add powers such as binding instructions to block payments, and that the Council of State ruled facilitation via payments was not clearly prohibited, while pointing payment providers to their own responsibility.
The Remote Gambling Bill clearly states that facilitating illegal games of chance, including offering payment services, is also prohibited.
Het wetsvoorstel Kansspelen op afstand bepaalt duidelijk dat ook het faciliteren van illegale kansspelen (waaronder het aanbieden van betaaldiensten) verboden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Buitenweg en Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Gevaarlijk 'pedohandboek' al jaren op internet te vinden’

MPs from CDA, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked whether a 'paedophile handbook' circulating online can be prosecuted, and whether Dutch law should be changed, including what other countries do. The Minister of Justice answered that possessing or distributing texts from such a handbook can already be prosecuted under existing provisions, so no new legislation is needed, and promised a progress letter on online child sexual abuse in September.

Since it has not so far been shown that the aforementioned criminal provisions would be inadequate to act criminally against the making, possession and distribution of such handbooks, I see no reason to introduce new legislation.

Nu vooralsnog niet is gebleken dat de voormelde strafbepalingen ontoereikend zouden zijn om strafrechtelijk te kunnen optreden tegen het vervaardigen, voorhanden hebben en de verspreiding van dergelijke handboeken, zie ik voor de introductie van nieuwe wetgeving geen reden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Drie mishandelaars Praag veroordeeld en Tsjechië uitgezet’

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that three Dutch men were convicted in Prague for assault and expelled, including questions on reputational harm, prosecution in the Netherlands, police-officer involvement and compensation for the victim. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the case is individual, the Czech authorities handle it, the Netherlands will not investigate under Article 68 Sr, a Dutch police investigation has started, and compensation is not for the Dutch government.
I do not make statements about the individuals involved.
Over de betrokken individuen doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pieter Heerma en Van Toorenburg over de As Soennah moskee die onder de Nederlandse wet aangemerkt is als goed doel

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the As Soennah mosque holding ANBI charity status despite reportedly preaching against women's rights and advocating stoning, its missing mandatory publications, and whether foreign public bodies automatically qualify as ANBIs. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority cannot disclose individual cases, that foreign public bodies qualify automatically under current law and that the ANBI definition is under review together with other ministers, and that transparency proposals on funding from unfree countries are being explored.
The Tax Authority is bound by the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act and therefore does not provide information on individual cases.
De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) en verstrekt derhalve geen informatie over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Hoornse Zedenzaak: Somalische verkrachter nog in Nederland’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why a convicted Somali rapist from the Hoorn case had not yet been deported, whether he would be deported as the previous minister intended, and whether the victim was kept informed. The State Secretary answered that the man was placed in immigration detention after serving his sentence, could not be deported at once due to a follow-up asylum application that was rejected, and was deported to Mogadishu on 25 May 2018, and described the standard victim-information procedures.
After serving his criminal detention, the person concerned was immediately placed in immigration detention with a view to deportation.
Na het uitzitten van zijn strafdetentie is betrokkene aansluitend in vreemdelingenbewaring gesteld ter fine van uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Toorenburg over trillingsoverlast door het spoor bij Rosmalen

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about vibration nuisance from the raised railway line at Rosmalen, which residents say was caused by the 2010-2012 Zuid-Willemsvaart realignment works. The government answered that a postdiction study found it unlikely that vibrations rose by more than 30% overall, but that three homes may be affected, so mitigation options are being examined, and that the ministry remains in talks with residents.

Based on the postdiction study, I want to examine for three homes whether effective measures can be taken, because it cannot be ruled out that a noticeable increase in vibrations occurred due to the adjustment of the railway.

Op basis van het postdictie-onderzoek wil ik bij drie woningen onderzoeken of er doelmatige maatregelen te treffen zijn omdat niet is uit te sluiten dat hier een voelbare toename van trillingen is opgetreden door de aanpassing van het spoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘crimineel hoeft niet te betalen voor opruimen eigen drugsafval’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the costs of clearing drug waste left by criminals can be recovered from them, and whether the planned undermining fund could help, after police failed to recover cleanup costs in court. The minister says the offender should bear the damage, points to victim-claim routes in criminal and civil law and to the victim policy agenda, and says the police are considering a new claim on appeal and that details of the fund will follow around summer 2018.
I am of the view that the damage resulting from leaving behind drug raw materials and drug waste should be borne by the perpetrator.
Ik ben van oordeel dat de schade als gevolg van het achterlaten van grondstoffen voor drugs en drugsafval ten laste dient te komen van de dader
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Experts: overheid moet ingrijpen bij internetapparaten’

Two MPs asked the ministers whether insecure internet-connected devices should be regulated, including a ban on proven insecure devices and a European certification mark, and what awareness campaigns and producer liability rules exist. The government acknowledged the threat, said a roadmap on secure hardware and software is being prepared with certification, awareness and liability as instruments, pointed to existing campaigns and to an EU review of product liability, and made no firm commitment to bans or a specific certification scheme.

To promote better security for IoT devices, the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, in consultation with the Ministry of Justice and Security, other departments and private parties, is currently drawing up a roadmap for secure hardware and software.

Om te bevorderen dat IoT-apparaten beter worden beveiligd, stelt het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat in samenspraak met het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, andere departementen en private partijen thans een roadmap veilige hard- en software op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Pedofielen delen massaal Nederlandse kinderfoto’s op openbare Russische site’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked whether the government would investigate a Russian website hosting child photos, including Dutch children, and whether Dutch police cooperate with Belgian investigators. The government answered that no joint investigation or Dutch-specific investigation is underway because no punishable images of Dutch children have been found, that the OM would open an investigation if such material is found, and that it will ask Russian authorities about action against the site.
At this moment there is no joint investigation with the Belgian authorities underway regarding the named Russian website, nor any investigation into images of Dutch children.
Op dit moment is er ten aanzien van de genoemde Russische website geen gezamenlijk onderzoek met de Belgische autoriteiten gaande of onderzoek gedaan naar afbeeldingen van Nederlandse kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Henk Kuipers begint een eigen videorubriek’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kuiken asked whether a detained suspect starting his own video column, 'Vraag het Henk', was acceptable under the Penitentiary Principles Act and whether he had permission to contact the media. The Minister replied that contact with media requires the prison director's permission, that a request for an own video column is not likely to be granted, and that no such request had been received, so unauthorised contact could lead to restrictions.
For all contacts with the media, detainees must request permission from the director of the institution.
Voor alle contacten met de media geldt dat gedetineerden toestemming aan de directeur van de inrichting dienen te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Advocaten ronselen in de bajes’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about lawyers advertising to prisoners via eMates-printed correspondence and about recruitment practices. The Minister replied that DJI has no formal agreement with eMates, that advertising is not prohibited but targeted recruitment breaches professional conduct rules handled by the bar deans, and that DJI will pass complaints to eMates.
DJI has no formal agreements with eMates or other parties regarding advertising on private correspondence of detainees.
DJI heeft geen formele afspraken met eMates of andere partijen ten aanzien van het adverteren op (privé)correspondentie van gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Geurts over het bericht ‘NVWA gebruikt satellietdata bij controles vanggewas’

The CDA MPs asked whether satellite data used by the NVWA to check cover crops could also detect illegal cannabis plantations hidden among farmers' crops, and whether research or cooperation with the police is possible. The minister answered that a police experiment in 2016 found under 10% of satellite-flagged cases were actually cannabis, so the approach is not yet effective, though it may be reconsidered, and the ministry is examining how satellite technology can help police.
The experiment showed that fewer than 10% of the cases flagged by satellite images actually involved cannabis.
Uit het experiment is gebleken dat minder dan 10% van de door satellietbeelden aangeduide gevallen daadwerkelijk cannabis betroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Aboutaleb laat ‘kindercasino’ ongemoeid’

MP Van Toorenburg asked the Justice Minister about reports that Rotterdam's mayor was leaving so-called 'kindercasino' arcade halls with permanent fairground-style gambling machines unregulated, and whether the Gaming Authority had advised on them. The minister replied that the Authority found no deliberate or structural circumvention of the gambling-machine regime, that it had asked venues to carry out risk analyses, and that its supervision was still ongoing with no advice issued yet.
These supervisory activities are still ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen, Visser, Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over paspoortcontroles door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

MPs from VVD and CDA asked whether airlines must check passengers' identity on intra-Schengen flights, how responsibilities are divided, and how the EU PNR directive would help detect terrorists. The minister explained that border checks are a KMar task only at external borders, that airlines may but need not perform conformity checks, and that PNR implementation (deadline 25 May 2018) and a feasibility study on mandatory conformity checks are the planned responses.
Figures on how many airlines check the identity of their passengers are not kept.
Cijfers over hoeveel luchtvaartmaatschappijen de identiteit van hun passagiers controleren worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat het project met de slimme camera’s in de haven van Rotterdam stil ligt

MPs Van Raak and Van Toorenburg asked about reports that the smart camera project in the Rotterdam port had stalled, including whether cameras are being read, a funding deadlock, and a claimed one-fifth interception rate for cocaine. The government replied that a convenant is about to be signed, operational rollout is planned for 2018–2021, it has no basis for the one-fifth figure, and the Haventafel held its first meeting on 5 September.
I am not aware of the basis for the estimate of one fifth.
Het is mij niet bekend waarop de schatting van een vijfde is gebaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Keijzer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht “Albanese maffia slaat hier zijn tentakels uit”

MPs Omtzigt, Keijzer and Van Toorenburg asked about reports of Albanian organised crime in the Netherlands, including whether a visa requirement should be reintroduced under EU rules and whether Albania should keep candidate status. The minister answered that Albanian-national suspects rose to about 700 in 2016, that the government will await the Commission's Western Balkans monitor before considering the EU emergency brake, and that the answers were delayed beyond the two-week target.
I will make this report available for confidential inspection by your House until the end of the year.
Deze rapportage leg ik tot het einde van het jaar ter vertrouwelijke inzage in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het inspectieonderzoek naar de stroomstoring van Amsterdam en omstreken van 17 januari 2017

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked why the 1-1-2 emergency line's intake arrangements date from when mobile phone use was limited, why about 19% of callers got no contact during the January 2017 Amsterdam power outage, and what is being done about mobile reachability, waiting times and standards. The Minister answered that a national intake structure and a renewed technical infrastructure are being introduced, that a cost-benefit analysis on a standard for outage-resilient 1-1-2 access will be sent to parliament in early 2018, and that the Agentschap Telecom has advised several municipalities.
As indicated in the policy response, a thorough cost-benefit analysis will first be carried out to determine what a reasonable standard is.
Zoals aangegeven is in de beleidsreactie, wordt eerst een gedegen kosten en baten analyse uitgevoerd om te kijken wat een redelijke norm is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Toorenburg over de werking van de Wet Damocles

MPs Kuiken and Van Toorenburg asked whether a Raad van State ruling of 30 August 2017 deviates from case law on closing homes under the Damocles law (Opiumwet art. 13b), and whether finding drugs in a home remains sufficient grounds for closure. The minister answered that the ruling confirms existing case law: a trade-sized quantity suffices for a presumption of sale, the burden shifts to the resident, and closure powers are unaffected.
This ruling does not deviate from existing case law.
Deze uitspraak wijkt niet af van de bestaande jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Bevel rechter leidt niet tot snellere hulp jongere’

MPs Peters and Van Toorenburg asked why juveniles ordered by the juvenile judge to undergo therapy face long waiting lists, and whether this reflects judges imposing specific trajectories unaware of municipal contracts. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for youth care availability, that coordination between the Child Protection Board, probation and municipalities should be improved, and that the Midden-Nederland region will hold talks, with the Board reporting back on follow-up.
The Child Protection Board has informed me that in upcoming talks with municipalities where this is a problem, it will discuss the availability of forensic youth care and will keep me informed.
De RvdK heeft mij gemeld in de komende gesprekken met gemeenten waar dit een probleem vormt, de beschikbaarheid van forensische jeugdhulp te bespreken en houdt mij daarvan op de hoogte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over terugkerende jihadisten naar Zweden die een nieuwe identiteit krijgen

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked whether Sweden gives returning jihadists new identities without local authorities knowing where they live, and what risks this poses for the EU. The ministers answered that the reports are inaccurate according to Swedish authorities, that no EU state is known to pursue such a policy, and they described existing EU information-sharing and PNR arrangements.
Enquiries with the Swedish authorities show that this report is incorrect.
Uit navraag bij de Zweedse autoriteiten blijkt dat deze berichtgeving onjuist is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'COA informeert Nijmegen over aso-asielzoeker'

MPs Keijzer and Van Toorenburg asked whether the mayor of Nijmegen was not informed in advance about the placement of nuisance-causing asylum seekers, and whether all mayors should be notified beforehand. The Secretary of State said there is no direct prior notification, but local cooperation structures exist, and Nijmegen agreed with the police and the asylum chain on intensified information sharing, with two extra supervised locations opening in autumn.
Therefore the municipality of Nijmegen, the police and the asylum chain have made agreements on intensifying the integrated approach and the necessary information exchange.
Daarom hebben de gemeente Nijmegen, de politie en de vreemdelingenketen afspraken gemaakt over de intensivering van de geïntegreerde aanpak en de noodzakelijke informatieuitwisseling hierbij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van Toorenburg over drugsdumpingen en waterkwaliteit

MPs Geurts and Van Toorenburg asked the ministers about rising illegal drug waste dumping and its effects on water quality, enforcement in rural areas and registration. The state secretary confirmed rising recorded dumpings, said they affect wastewater treatment and surface water only occasionally, and described existing cooperation, saying further enforcement measures are sufficient and registration is being improved.
I acknowledge the importance of good registration, both for obtaining a complete picture and for tracing the perpetrators.
Ik erken het belang van goede registratie, zowel ten behoeve van het verkrijgen van een volledig beeld als ten behoeve van het opsporen van de daders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Hoe criminelen Kluivert in de val lokten’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a Volkskrant report on a betting syndicate that lured footballer Kluivert, asking about the syndicate's identity, licensing and enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit. The government declined to give details citing an ongoing criminal investigation, stated that only reliable operators will be licensed, and said that rules restrict sponsorship and advertising targeting young people.
The syndicate you refer to is the subject of a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service (investigation Feniks, see also answer 6).
Het syndicaat waar u in uw vraag naar verwijst is onderwerp van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie (onderzoek Feniks, zie ook antwoord 6).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Wapenhandelaar vrijuit na bedreiging burgemeester Gilze en Rijen’

MP Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the prosecution of a suspect who threatened a mayor, civil servants and a police officer was dropped, why the victims were not informed in time, and whether the minister will consult the prosecution service. The minister answered that the prosecution service had asked the court to end the case because of the suspect's convictions in other cases, that the court declared the request inadmissible so prosecution will proceed, that the victims were not informed in time and the prosecution service apologised, and that no policy change is needed.
The prosecution service regrets this course of events and has offered its apologies for it.
Het OM betreurt deze gang van zaken en heeft hiervoor zijn excuses aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het artikel ‘Een ongeluk 112 aan de lijn, waar zit je precies?’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why mobile 112 calls do not transmit location data and what changes are needed, and whether an app or SMS-based tool could help. The minister answered that location data is already shown to the 112 centre, that wider location sharing requires infrastructure changes planned for spring 2018, that 14 of 22 regional centres use the VIL location tool, and that no legal obstacle exists.
No data is kept on this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Gevangene heeft wapen met munitie in zijn cel’

MP Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether a prisoner on leave under electronic monitoring could commit armed robberies, and how a firearm and ammunition were found in his cell and a Kalashnikov in his car. The State Secretary declined to confirm the arrest or comment on the ongoing investigation, said he regretted the events, pointed to an ongoing DJI security investigation at Ter Peel, and rejected tightening conditional release rules because the prisoner was not on conditional release.
DJI is currently conducting a security investigation at ZBBI Ter Peel. Depending on the outcome of the investigation, it will be considered whether procedures need to be revised or tightened.
Momenteel voert DJI een veiligheidsonderzoek uit in de ZBBI Ter Peel. Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek wordt bezien of er procedures herzien of aangescherpt moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht 'Veiligheid is in het geding, waarschuwt Schiphol'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Knops (CDA) asked ministers whether KMar border-guard capacity at Schiphol would be expanded given rising passenger numbers and terror threat, and about funding and timing of extra staff. The government answered that 135 temporary FTE are funded from incidental resources and available by summer 2017, that structural capacity will be considered in the 2018 budget and formation options, and that it declines to bear the 190 million euro automation cost at Schiphol.
In the current situation, with Schiphol's healthy financial position and a competitive cost level for airlines, the cabinet sees no reason to also contribute financially to the investment programme.

Het kabinet ziet in de huidige situatie, met een gezonde financiële positie van Schiphol en een concurrerend kostenniveau voor luchtvaartmaatschappijen, geen aanleiding om ook financieel bij te dragen aan het investeringsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Pieter Heerma over het bericht 'Omstreden imam terug in Gouda'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Heerma asked why a controversial imam, whose visa had reportedly been revoked earlier, was able to speak in Gouda, and whether investigation, visa denial and withdrawal of the host association's ANBI status were pursued. The minister answered that the imam holds a Belgian (EU) passport so entry can only be refused on strict grounds, that police were present at the event without finding incitement, and that ANBI status can be withdrawn only after an investigation by the Tax Authority.
For preachers holding EU nationality, on the basis of statements made on Dutch soil that conflict with Dutch law, prosecution by the Public Prosecution Service may be possible.

Voor predikers die over een EU-nationaliteit beschikken geldt dat zij op basis van hun uitspraken die zij op Nederlandse bodem doen die in strijd zijn met Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving mogelijk vervolgd kunnen worden door het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Jihadonderzoeker UvA uitte zelf steun voor strijders van IS’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about reports that a junior UvA researcher on a jihad study had posted online statements praising jihadist fighters, and whether this warrants prosecution and a response from the university. The government condemned the statements, said the UvA disavowed them, declined to comment on individual prosecutions, and treated the methodological debate as a matter of academic freedom outside ministerial involvement.
As your House knows, the Minister of Security and Justice does not make statements about individual (criminal) cases.
Zoals uw Kamer weet doet de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie geen mededelingen over individuele (straf)zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Onschuldig en toch voor het leven gestraft'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about a report of a person wrongly treated as a suspect for about a year, with only a dismissal letter afterwards and little aftercare. The government acknowledges the harm, gives figures on wrongly-suspected cases and describes existing compensation routes and a re-integration convenant with municipalities, but offers no new aftercare for wrongly suspected persons beyond ongoing study.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it is currently considering whether it is possible in such cases (sepot 01 cases) to send a non-automated message to the person concerned.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij laten weten dat zij momenteel bezien of het tot de mogelijkheden behoort om in dit soort gevallen (sepot 01-zaken) een niet-geautomatiseerd bericht te doen uitgaan naar de betrokken persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Toorenburg over intolerantie jegens religieuze instellingen

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether arson at a planned mosque in Culemborg and vandalism at a church in Utrecht reflect intolerance toward religious institutions, how many such incidents occurred in 2016, and whether online racist reactions are pursued. The minister declined to judge the open cases, said incidents are not registered by religion, noted no reports were filed about online discrimination, and committed to pursuing perpetrators.
I have received the report that an investigation has been started in both cases.
Ik heb het bericht ontvangen dat er in beide gevallen een onderzoek is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over Privacygevoelige informatie van 1-1-2-meldingen

An MP asked whether privacy-sensitive details from 112 emergency calls should be published and what measures will stop that, including the timing of encrypted P2000 messaging. The minister agrees such information should not be published, and says the renewed P2000 network will allow encrypted sensitive messages from early 2018, with emergency services preparing new equipment and procedures.
Yes, I share the view that privacy-sensitive information from 1-1-2 reports should not be published publicly.
Ja, ik deel de mening dat privacy gevoelige informatie van 1-1-2 meldingen niet openbaar gepubliceerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg  en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Nabestaanden twijfelen aan zelfmoord gevangene Nieuwegein’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kooiman asked whether relatives doubting a prisoner's suicide in Nieuwegein prison should be able to halt the cremation, and whether the Rijksrecherche should investigate. The State Secretary replied that the cremation was not scheduled for 5 December and needed no postponement, and that the Public Prosecution Service is already investigating, with relatives to be informed of the outcome.
The Public Prosecution Service, the police and also DJI take the signals from relatives who doubt the cause of death of a family member very seriously.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM), de politie en ook DJI nemen de signalen van nabestaanden die twijfelen over de doodsoorzaak van een familielid zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het niet voorwaardelijk kunnen opleggen van een strafbeschikking door het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked why the Wet OM-afdoening does not allow conditional fines in prosecutorial penal orders, and whether the Public Prosecution Service sees a need for conditional sanctions and what a law change would require. The Minister explained the design choice (penal orders use instructions rather than conditions, with a court fallback), said prosecutors weigh cases individually, and noted the Public Prosecution Service wants conditional sentences, which would need legislation; the question has been passed to the ongoing WODC evaluation.
This would require a legislative amendment, which would have to provide, among other things, for additional procedural safeguards.
Dit zou wetswijziging vergen, waarbij onder meer zou moeten worden voorzien in extra procedurele voorzieningen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Swinkels, Van Toorenburg en Van Raak over het bericht dat een terreurverdachte op het vliegtuig naar Turkije kon stappen

MPs asked why a terror suspect could board a flight to Turkey after a German SIRENE alert was not passed on urgently due to a telephone outage and an unmonitored email inbox. The minister explained the outage, the procedures for passing on alerts, and measures taken, but declined to share the outage report in full, citing security concerns.
Because of the detailed information about the internal systems of the National Police and their vulnerability to possible misuse, I will share the outage evaluation confidentially with your House.

Vanwege de gedetailleerde informatie over de interne systemen van de Nationale Politie en de kwetsbaarheid daarvan ten aanzien van mogelijk misbruik, zal ik de storingsevaluatie vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Bruins Slot en Amhaouch over het bericht dat een verwarde man in de boeien is geslagen

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a report of a confused man being hit while handcuffed, whether the police apology was appropriate, and the state of municipal care for confused persons. The minister answered that the matter is covered in a separate letter, that the Aanjaagteam found in September 2016 that no municipality had a well-implemented integrated approach, and that the Schakelteam will monitor progress and share results with parliament.
The Schakelteam has been tasked with promoting and monitoring progress towards an integrated approach.
Het Schakelteam heeft als opdracht meegekregen de voortgang van de sluitende aanpak te bevorderen en te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Kooiman over de reactie van de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie op de plannen van de Woenselse Poort naar aanleiding van misstanden aldaar

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kooiman asked why the minister did not mention the Inspectorate's critical letter on the Woenselse Poort action plan during a November 2016 debate on TBS, and asked for the Inspectorate's concerns on drug use, vacancies and staffing. The Secretary of State confirmed receipt, said the letter was published and that the plan now addresses the Inspectorate's points, and promised to await the final report and a return visit in early 2017.
The inspectorate informed me that the action plan presented by the clinic De Woenselse Poort broadly addresses the identified shortcomings.
De inspectie heeft mij geïnformeerd dat het actieplan dat de kliniek De Woenselse Poort heeft gepresenteerd, op hoofdlijnen ingaat op de geconstateerde tekortkomingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Apple haalt tientallen gokapps uit Nederlandse App Store’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about Apple removing dozens of gambling apps from the Dutch App Store at the request of the Gambling Authority, including how long removal took and whether Unibet, a persistent illegal offeror, can still obtain a licence. The State Secretary declined to name the 55 companies, said the requested removals were completed in time, and stated that persistent illegal offerors may be excluded from a licence and could face a financial sanction, leaving those decisions to the Gambling Authority.

The Gambling Authority informed me, when asked, that it does not wish to publish this information; in principle it does not make the names of individual companies public unless an administrative sanction underlies them.

De kansspelautoriteit heeft mij desgevraagd aangegeven deze informatie niet te publiceren; zij maakt in beginsel geen namen van (individuele) bedrijven openbaar tenzij daar een bestuurlijke sanctie aan ten grondslag ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘OM wraakt rechtbank’

The MP asks the Justice Minister about the public prosecution service (OM) seeking to recuse three Almelo judges in a drugs case, and whether scheduling ignored the prosecutor's availability. The minister answers that the recusal was rejected, that the OM rarely uses this power, that scheduling is a judge's call, and that a planning improvement taskforce is underway.
I cannot give insight into aspects related to the OM's procedural position in an ongoing criminal case.
Ik kan geen inzage geven in aspecten samenhangende met de procespositie van het OM in een lopende (straf)zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Bruins Slot over de ziekte van Huntington

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a TV item claiming a medical breakthrough for Huntington's disease was possible with four million euros, about the scope of Health Deals investment, past ZonMw funding, and how expertise centres are financed. The Minister called the breakthrough claim doubtful, said the 130 million euros are existing programme budgets rather than new Huntington investment, and said the Huntington-specific research funding figures are not known to her.
I am not aware of which amounts are available within these centres for research into Huntington's disease.
Het is mij niet bekend welke bedragen binnen deze centra beschikbaar zijn voor onderzoek naar de ziekte van Huntington.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Rotterdam omtrent het niet toepassen van jeugdstrafrecht

An MP asked the Minister about a Rotterdam court ruling that declined to apply juvenile criminal law because suitable housing and help for the suspect might not be arranged in time, and asked how treatment delays for young offenders would be addressed. The government acknowledges the concern, says municipalities are responsible for youth care, and points to a monitoring study, knowledge-sharing efforts, a VNG tool, and a commitment to inform parliament in spring 2017.
I am aware of the signals about cases where too much time passes between the ruling and the start of treatment/youth care
Ik ken de signalen over zaken waarin te veel tijd zit tussen de uitspraak en de start van de behandeling/jeugdhulp
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de implementatie van de Wet Precursoren voor Explosieven

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Security and Justice why explosive precursors such as acetone and hydrogen peroxide could be bought easily in shops after a TV investigation, and how implementation of the new precursor law is being supervised. The Minister replies that the products are legitimately sold, that reporting duties apply to suspicious transactions, that an awareness campaign and advisory materials exist, and that the ILT has not yet received signals on effectiveness or used its audit powers.
These instruments were handed over on 18 November 2015 and made available to all other EU member states to strengthen implementation of the EU Regulation at European level as well.
Deze instrumenten zijn op 18 november 2015 overgedragen en beschikbaar gesteld aan alle overige EU lidstaten om de uitvoering van de EU Verordening ook op Europees niveau te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de uitspraak dat een lid van een criminele motorbende in dienst mag blijven van Justitie

MP Van Toorenburg asked the Justice Minister about a Central Appeals Tribunal ruling that a civil servant who is a member of the criminal motorcycle gang Satudarah cannot be dismissed on that basis, and what the government will do about such memberships. The minister agreed that such memberships are undesirable, said he is still considering how to execute the ruling and aims to decide the objection within statutory deadlines, and noted the Public Prosecution Service is assessing whether a civil ban on outlaw motorcycle gangs is feasible.
I am still deliberating on how I can implement the ruling.
Ik beraad mij nog over de wijze waarop ik de uitspraak kan uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht ‘Geen gedeeltelijke herbouw van het Genneperhuis’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether partial physical rebuilding of the Genneperhuis ruin in Gennep should be ruled out, and about its heritage status, the Keverberg precedent and RCE cooperation. The Minister answered that the RCE advised that rebuilding would overly damage the monument's archaeological and historical value, so it is not an option, but alternatives such as limited visualisation or a virtual presentation could be discussed.
Over the implementation of these alternatives, one can certainly talk.
Over de uitvoering van deze alternatieven valt zeker te praten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht “Nederlandse pro-Erdogan-agent lekt informatie aangifte bedreiging”

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police leaked information about a woman who filed a threat complaint against a pro-Erdogan supporter, whether she is protected, and what consequences the officer faces. The minister condemns any breach of trust, says an investigation is ongoing, and will inform parliament of any measures after its outcome.
I do not want to anticipate possible outcomes of the currently ongoing investigation.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op eventuele uitkomsten van het thans lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de voorgenomen wijziging van de Regeling verkeersregelaars

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the planned amendment of the traffic controllers regulation, including whether separate appointment decisions can be abolished, whether permits and no-objection declarations can be linked, whether the one-year validity of the instruction declaration was reviewed, and practical problems for motorcycle escorts. The Minister answered that the separate appointment decisions will be abolished and embedded in event permits, that permits and declarations cannot be coupled to traffic controller appointments, that the annual e-learning is retained for quality, and that talks with stakeholders are ongoing on the motorcycle escort issue.
The appointment of the event traffic controller will be arranged in the event permit.
De aanstelling van de evenementenverkeersregelaar wordt in de evenementenvergunning geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Big-data experiment legt onzichtbare criminaliteit bloot’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the FinPro big-data programme in Rotterdam-Zuid, including whether the data were destroyed and why the Tax Administration did not take part. The minister answered that the project aimed to explore fraud patterns, that the data were destroyed under data-protection rules, and that participants were promised confidentiality, so the findings cannot be shared; a legal basis via a framework data-sharing law is under study.
Against that background, I cannot provide this information.
Tegen die achtergrond kan ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het illegaal aanbieden van kansspelen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Gambling Authority knows that illegal online gambling operators redirect Dutch visitors from .nl sites to .eu or .com sites, whether this continues, and how a motion to refuse licences to persistent illegal operators will be implemented. The State Secretary confirmed the Authority is aware, acknowledged such redirection exists, and said the Authority will assess this among other factors when judging licence applicants' reliability and suitability.
The assessment of the reliability and suitability of individual licence applicants is for the Gambling Authority.
Het oordeel over de betrouwbaarheid en geschiktheid van individuele vergunningaanvragers is aan de kansspelautoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Eerste hulp bij vermissingen’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police use of mobile phone tracing in missing-person cases should be legally permitted, and about the status of follow-up legislation after the report on search tools for urgent missing-person cases. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, said separate legislation is being prepared and will go to consultation after the summer.
I intend to put this into consultation after the summer.
Ik ben voornemens deze na de zomer in consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Van Toorenburg en Swinkels over het in weerwil van een Kamermotie sluiten van gevangenissen

MPs Kooiman, Van Toorenburg and Swinkels asked whether preparations to close prisons after the March 2017 elections, and the concentration of vacant cells, conflict with a Chamber motion stating that closing prisons is not on the agenda. The Secretary of State replied that he is implementing the motion, closes no prisons, and that concentrating vacancies is internal operational management, with DJI mapping consequences in consultation with staff and promising to inform the Chamber later.
I am implementing this motion accordingly.
Ik voer deze motie dienovereenkomstig uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Dader Zelhem moest naar psychiatrische kliniek’

An MP asked the Justice Minister six questions about court and prosecution decisions preceding the release of the suspect in the fatal Zelhem accident, including whether a forced psychiatric admission could have been arranged. The minister declined to answer on substance, citing the ongoing investigation and the victims' families' information position, and promised a letter to parliament later.

In this General Consultation I indicated, in response to questions on this subject, that the investigation is ongoing and that it is therefore not appropriate for me to answer questions on this subject in detail.

In dit Algemeen Overleg heb ik in reactie op vragen over dit onderwerp aangegeven dat het onderzoek op dit moment loopt en dat het mij daarom nu niet past op detailniveau op vragen op dit onderwerp in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van Toorenburg over de 24/7 opening van Holland Casino in Rotterdam

MPs Segers and Van Toorenburg asked whether Holland Casino's 24/7 opening in Rotterdam is acceptable given gambling-addiction risks, whether mayors have say over opening hours, and whether a trial could be stopped or monitored. The State Secretary answered that opening hours are a local matter, the operator's duty of care applies at all hours, the Gaming Authority was not informed of the trial, and existing monitoring suffices.
When asked, the Gaming Authority indicated to me that it was not informed in advance.
Desgevraagd heeft de Kansspelautoriteit aan mij aangegeven niet tevoren geïnformeerd te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Geen straf coffeeshop Meetpoint Den Bosch’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about court rulings that let coffeeshop suppliers go unpunished for holding stocks above the 500-gram limit, and whether the government still enforces drug crime policy consistently. The minister answered that appeals are pending in several cases, that the ministry does not register such rulings so no full overview can be given, and that courts are independent while the government continues its fight against drug crime.

The Ministry of Security and Justice does not register rulings in which Opium Act offenders were found guilty but received no punishment because the drug stock was deemed necessary for supplying a coffeeshop.
Er wordt door het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie niet geregistreerd op uitspraken waarin overtreders van de Opiumwet wel schuldig zijn bevonden, maar geen straf hebben kregen opgelegd
