Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Pak criminelen hun geld af, dan tref je ze het hardst’

MP Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the ZSM out-of-court settlement approach to drug cases in Brabant, its revenue, legal and evaluation issues, and whether drug-offence sentencing and penalties should change. The Minister denied any broader rollout, reported about 150,000 euros collected and 23 objections in one district, stated that the business case evaluation is still pending for June, and said no change to drug penalties is needed.
The Public Prosecution Service is still busy with the practical elaboration of its plan of action for the investment of 3 million euros.
Het OM is nog druk doende met de praktische uitwerking van haar plan van aanpak voor de investering van de € 3 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Toorenburg, Knops en Keijzer over de zaak Saban B. in Turkije

CDA MPs asked about the case of Saban B., convicted in the Netherlands to 7 years 9 months for trafficking and assault but still free in Turkey, and about Turkey's cooperation on enforcing Dutch sentences. The minister answered that Turkish proceedings are still pending, that Dutch requests since 2010 cover 23 persons with at least 6 granted, and that a memorandum of understanding is being negotiated, but did not provide a complete list or the requested one-week timeline.

In the context of protecting the privacy of the persons concerned, I can only inform you that since 2010 the Netherlands has, under the Wots, expressed to Turkey the wish to transfer enforcement of a Dutch sentence for 23 persons.

In het kader van bescherming van de privacy van de betrokken personen, kan ik u slechts mededelen dat Nederland vanaf 2010 op grond van de Wots ten aanzien van 23 personen aan Turkije de wens kenbaar heeft gemaakt de tenuitvoerlegging van een Nederlands vonnis aan Turkije over te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Smaling en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat er door een drugs-lab giftige stoffen zijn vrij gekomen in een woonwijk in Tilburg

MPs asked the government how harmful the toxic release from a Tilburg drug lab was, how residents are being informed and trained to spot drug labs, and how many labs are dismantled and what resources are assigned. The minister answered that methanol and sulphuric acid were present, residents were informed by letter, training and a smell map are being rolled out in the south, and labour conditions at the dismantling unit were investigated and improved.
In any case it is an undesirable situation when a drug laboratory is found in a residential area.
Het is hoe dan ook een onwenselijke situatie als een drugslaboratorium in een woonwijk wordt aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Gevangenisoproer in België’

The MP asked whether the state secretary was aware of the Belgian prison riot and whether the Netherlands would again discuss keeping the Tilburg prison open for Belgian inmates before its planned closure. The state secretary confirmed awareness and said the Netherlands remains willing to keep Tilburg available, but Belgium has not changed its decision to phase out use of the facility.
I have informed Minister Geens that the willingness on the Dutch side remains.
Ik heb Minister Geens laten weten dat de bereidheid aan Nederlandse zijde blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van Toorenburg over de gesubsidieerde milieurechtsbijstand

Two CDA MPs asked why legal-aid policy charges legal persons in environmental cases only 25% of the highest contribution, whether this rule was evaluated, and whether members' private wealth is considered. The minister explained the 2008 rule was meant to prevent exclusion of environmental groups, said no evaluation occurred and that the Raad voor rechtsbijstand will review it, provided usage figures, and held that members' private means are not relevant to the legal person's means test.
I will ask the Legal Aid Board to examine whether this measure, given its original objective, should be maintained.
Ik zal de raad voor rechtsbijstand verzoeken te onderzoeken of deze maatregel, gelet op de oorspronkelijke doelstelling daarvan, moet worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over een uitspraak van de Raad voor Strafrechtstoepassing en Jeugdbescherming (RSJ) op 25 februari 2016

An MP asks the State Secretary about an RSJ ruling that a prison director's order to segregate a prisoner, based on GRIP intelligence, was not reasonable beyond one day because no verification was shown, and whether directors should better argue their case before the RSJ. The State Secretary answers that the ruling was based on an administrative error where no defence was filed, that procedures have been adjusted, and that attending hearings is up to the director, with no new awareness campaign planned.
Procedures in appeal cases have since been adjusted by the institution concerned, so that repetition is prevented.
Inmiddels zijn de procedures in beroepszaken door de betreffende penitentiaire inrichting aangepast, zodat herhaling wordt voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over onderhoud van de A59

Two CDA MPs asked why a stretch of the A59 near Rosmalen will receive single-layer ZOAB in 2017 while other roads get double-layer, and whether the maintenance contract is deficient. The minister says single-layer is in line with the contract and the applicable rules, that no noise ceiling breach is foreseen, and that double-layer would be beyond legal requirements, so it will not be applied there.
In those consultations Rijkswaterstaat indicated that laying double-layer ZOAB goes beyond legal requirements and that it adheres to the applicable laws and regulations.
In die overleggen heeft Rijkswaterstaat aangegeven dat het aanleggen van tweelaags ZOAB bovenwettelijk is en zich te houden aan de geldende wet-en-regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Nieuwe drug vervangt de zware XTC-pil'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about health risks of the new drug 4-FA (XTC-light), its long-term effects, prevention, and whether it will be banned under the Opium Act. The State Secretary answered that long-term risks are unknown, the drug is monitored, prevention runs through regular channels, and no ban is planned for now based on the 2015 CAM quick scan and WHO advice.
The CAM will examine this year whether there is reason to update the quick scan.
Het CAM zal dit jaar bekijken of er aanleiding is de quick scan te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over de aanpak van verkeershufters

MPs Van Helvert and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked why fines for road offences such as overtaking on the right and tailgating have fallen and how this fits the 2020 road-casualty target. The minister attributes the drop mainly to police CAO actions in 2015, vacancies and shifting priorities, announces a 2016-2018 enforcement plan, and declines to reinstate the alcohol-lock programme as not opportune.
An important reason for the decline in the number of fines imposed is the police CAO actions in 2015.
Een belangrijke reden voor de daling van het aantal opgelegde boetes zijn de CAO-acties van de politie in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Veldslag van motorclubs bij Van der Valkhotel Rotterdam’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a clash between Hells Angels and Mongols motorcycle club members at a Rotterdam hotel, including arrests, fugitives, aftercare, the Mongols' emergence, and the status of a civil ban on clubs. The minister declined to give details on ongoing investigations and prosecutions for reasons of investigation and privacy, but described aftercare for victims and staff, and said he would report on the civil-ban study in early June.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Geurts over de Nationale Reddingvloot

MPs Van Toorenburg and Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Reddingsbrigade Nederland's rescue fleet may be dismantled over unresolved funding after 2016. The minister answered that safety regions are responsible for water rescue capacity, that a one-off 2016 contribution was given, and that he urged the Veiligheidsberaad to reach structural arrangements before end of May.
It is the responsibility of the safety regions to provide sufficient rescue capacity during crises and disasters on and around water.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de veiligheidsregio’s om te voorzien in voldoende hulpverleningscapaciteit bij crises en rampen op en rond het water.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Keijzer over het bericht ‘Lastpak naar aso-azc’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Keijzer asked whether the state secretary had examined using the former PI Tilburg or the Zeist detention centre as a stricter facility for rule-breaking asylum seekers, and about the regime, timing, and pros and cons. The state secretary answered that the Tilburg option was not linked to the planned separate facility, that COA is exploring suitable locations (requiring local consent) and a stricter regime not based on immigration detention, and that a criminal investigation follows any offence as usual.
This exploration is currently ongoing, and I will inform your House about it at a later moment.
Momenteel is deze verkenning gaande waarover ik uw Kamer op een later moment zalinformeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Kosten opruimen drugsafval Brabant in kaart gebracht’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Interior about rising drug waste dumping in Brabant and Limburg, the costs for municipalities, and how national funds are allocated. The Minister confirmed rising dumpings, said municipalities' costs are several million euros per province, committed €1 million a year for cofinancing cleanup in 2015–2017, and explained the provincial allocation convenant.
To ease the cost problem, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment makes available €1 million annually in 2015–2017 for cofinancing the cleanup of drug waste dumpings (maximum 50% of costs).

Om het probleem van de kosten te verzachten stelt het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu in de periode 2015–2017 jaarlijks € 1 miljoen beschikbaar voor cofinanciering van de opruiming van drugsafvaldumpingen (maximaal 50% van de kosten).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Toorenburg, Leijten en Dik-Faber over de tariefverhoging van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag en de gevolgen hiervan voor vrijwilligerswerk

MPs from CDA, SP and ChristenUnie asked the government to explain the 38% fee increase for the Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) and its impact on volunteer organisations, and to reconcile it with earlier statements. The state secretary attributed the increase mainly to cost-recovery of Justis integrity products, said 7.5% covers the free VOG scheme, declined to commission an impact study on volunteer organisations, and said no consultation with VWS took place.
I am not willing to conduct research into the consequences of the fee increase for volunteers and their organisations.
Ik ben niet bereid onderzoek te verrichten naar de gevolgen van de tariefverhoging op het effect voor vrijwilligers en hun organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Toorenburg over binaire opties

MPs Ronnes and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether binary options should be treated as games of chance rather than financial products, given their prize-like payout, the broker's opposite interest, and possible refusal of successful traders. The Minister of Finance replied that binary options are classed as financial instruments under MiFID and the AFM supervises them, that a court case on the gambling question is pending, and that no new measures are planned for now.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Ziekteverzuim onder politieagenten explodeert’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that sick leave among police officers was surging, including the figures, a split between operational and support staff, progress on sick-leave files, the reasons for absence, and whether an in-depth study of causes would be commissioned. The minister gave the figures, said the Wet verbetering Poortwachter compliance target is 80% by end 2017 with some older files no longer fixable, and declined a separate study, pointing to a letter on causes instead.
In connection with privacy legislation, medical data are only queried and documented in the medical file by those authorised to do so, namely the company doctor and the psychologist.

In verband met de privacywetgeving worden medische gegevens uitsluitend bevraagd en gedocumenteerd in het medisch dossier door degene die daartoe bevoegd zijn, zijnde de bedrijfsarts en de psycholoog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Werkdruk leidt tot ontsporen van crimefighter’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reported work pressure leading to misconduct by a prosecutor, the NVvR's call to invest in the Public Prosecution Service, support available to prosecutors, threats against local officials, and the status of a criminal investigation into the prosecutor. The minister replied that work pressure is not directly linked to budget cuts, pointed to existing support and new structural funding, said the criminal investigation is ongoing and declined to give details of its status, and committed to a careful assessment of prosecution.
I cannot give you any information about the status of the criminal investigation.
Over de stand van zaken van het opsporingsonderzoek kan ik u geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Drugs- en wapensmokkel Woenselse Poort kinderlijk eenvoudig’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretaries of Security and Justice and of Health about a broadcast showing easy drug and weapon smuggling into the Woenselse Poort forensic psychiatric clinic, including the effectiveness of security measures after a firearm-related suicide and whether inspection oversight is ongoing. The State Secretary answered in detail: no firearm was found in five years, security measures were described, internal and Inspectorate investigations are underway, and the outcome is expected within weeks.
The police are currently investigating the origin of the weapon.
Door de politie wordt momenteel onderzoek gedaan naar de herkomst van het wapen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Opstand Vught neergeslagen’

Mr Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary about reports of a riot in the Vught prison terrorism wing and the IBT intervention, including injuries to staff, incident frequency, staff safety and radicalisation. The State Secretary answered that the IBT was deployed on 19 December 2015 (not January 2016), one officer was lightly injured, two incidents occurred in 2015, staffing is adequate, and a new risk assessment tool and differentiated placement policy are being studied.
One member of the IBT was lightly injured on 19 December 2015.
Er is één lid van het IBT lichtgewond geraakt op 19 december 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de brandstichting in een cel in de penitentiaire inrichting (PI) Vught

MP Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the death of a detainee after a cell fire at PI Vught, the prevention measures for suicide, the number of unnatural deaths there, and the timing of an inspection report on a 2015 suicide. The State Secretary answered that internal DJI investigations are not published, that suicide prevention measures are described generally, that personal information about the deceased's care cannot be shared, and that the Inspectorate did not investigate the 2015 death, with an IGZ review finding the care structure in order.
As usual, these are not made public because these reports contain personal data and information about procedures within the institution.
Zoals gebruikelijk worden deze niet openbaar gemaakt omdat deze rapporten persoonsgegevens én informatie over handelwijzen binnen de inrichting bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht m.b.t. strafexpedities op VenJ tegen ambtenaren die misstand melden

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the position of the former integrity confidential adviser was repeatedly undermined, whether whistleblower reports were rerouted and annual reports removed, and whether staff can report confidentially to the Oosting commission. The minister denies any systematic undermining, says the reporting lines remain confidential, and refers to earlier letters on the whistleblower scheme.
The position of the former integrity and undesirable conduct confidential adviser was not repeatedly undermined in recent years.
De positie van de voormalig Vertrouwenspersoon integriteit en ongewenste omgangsvormen (VPI) is niet herhaaldelijk in het geding geweest de afgelopen jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Twee keer per dag vergeet justitie verdachte op te halen’

MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that suspects are often not transported to court hearings, with hundreds of cases where transport was never requested. The Minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service, not DV&O, requests transport, that court-data figures cannot establish causes, that adjournment costs about 87,000 euro per year, and that DJI is exploring earlier notice of the right to waive attendance.
The figures show the number of cases the Council for the Judiciary reports as adjourned because a suspect did not appear on time for the hearing.
De cijfers geven het aantal zaken weer dat volgens uitvraag van de RvdR wordt aangehouden wegens het niet tijdig verschijnen van een verdachte op de zitting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over een onderzoek naar een anti IS-strijder

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Defence ministers about the investigation of a Dutch citizen fighting ISIS in Syria, the handling of returning jihadist fighters, and the legal limits on private citizens fighting in armed conflict. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, described the existing criminal and administrative approach to returnees, and gave limited figures on ongoing investigations.
I cannot therefore provide any information on the state of the investigation or the powers deployed.
Over de stand van zaken van het onderzoek en de ingezette bevoegdheden kan ik daarom geen mededeling doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Boeven de baas in bajes’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about press reports that prison staff at PI Alphen a/d Rijn and PI Ter Peel had lost control over the regime, including weapons, contraband, integrity breaches and staff cuts. The State Secretary said staff did not recognise the criticism, brought forward an Inspectorate investigation into contraband and integrity, reported two staff access bans and ongoing integrity investigations, and answered the staffing and death-in-custody questions without new structural commitments.

Nevertheless, given these different voices and the great importance of integrity in an organisation like DJI, I have asked the Inspectorate of Security and Justice to bring forward its announced investigation into contraband and integrity issues in the prison system.

Toch heb ik gelet op deze verschillende geluiden en het grote belang van integriteit in een organisatie als DJI, de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) verzocht haar reeds in haar werkprogramma 2016 aangekondigde onderzoek in het gevangeniswezen naar contrabande en integriteitskwesties, naar voren te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Toorenburg en Pieter Heerma over de Al Fitrah-moskee in Utrecht

CDA MPs asked whether the Al Fitrah mosque in Utrecht received funding from Kuwaiti organisations linked to Al-Qaida, whether tax and intelligence services checked its income, whether it publishes accounts, and what the mayor has done about it. The government largely declined to comment on specific cases citing confidentiality and procedural secrecy, while describing a three-track approach of dialogue, confrontation and enforcement and promising a forthcoming salafism letter.
In general I do not make statements about concrete cases.
In zijn algemeenheid doe ik geen uitspraken over concrete casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Amhaouch over privacybelemmeringen bij de uitwisseling van bijzondere persoonsgegevens van prostituees ten behoeve van een intakegesprek

MPs Van Toorenburg and Amhaouch asked why resolving privacy rules that hinder Amsterdam's intake interviews with sex workers is taking so long, and about evaluation outcomes and other municipalities. The minister replied that existing privacy rules remain the starting point, that Amsterdam should seek a workable method within them, that the Amsterdam evaluation is the municipality's responsibility, and that no other municipalities have reported the same problem.
The ministry has indicated that the applicable privacy rules are and remain the starting point.
Vanuit het ministerie is daarbij aangegeven dat de geldende privacyregels het uitgangspunt zijn en blijven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over uitlevering van een levenslange gedetineerde in Nederland naar Engeland

An MP asked the Justice Minister why a transfer of a life-sentenced prisoner (Daniel S.) to England was initiated, whether such transfers had occurred before, what happens to his life sentence, and why the victim's relatives were not informed and why extradition was not sought for the suspected commissioner. The minister answered that the transfer proposal was withdrawn after the prosecution service, having belatedly consulted the relatives, advised negatively, that no transfer has yet occurred for a life prisoner, and that the Secretary of State is exploring how life sentences are enforced, with a letter promised in Q1 2016.
The prosecution service saw insufficient concrete and direct evidence of Robert D.'s involvement and also did not expect to be able to obtain it.
Het OM zag onvoldoende concreet en direct bewijs voor betrokkenheid van Robert D. en verwachtte ook niet dat te kunnen verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de WK-kandidatuur van Nederland en België

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked whether the minister pressed the KNVB for an independent investigation into the Netherlands-Belgium 2018 World Cup bid, who commissions and conducts it, whether the Public Prosecution Service will investigate, what the 2009 departure of Alain Courtois and ministry knowledge of alleged Belgian misconduct involved, and whether the minister has contacted Belgian counterparts. The minister answers that the KNVB independently commissioned an independent accountant's investigation expected in Q1 2016, that the ministry has contact with the KNVB and will be informed of results, that the Public Prosecution Service cannot comment on its investigations, that the 2011 evaluation was limited in scope, that the ministry had no subsidy relationship with Beltomundial, and that the ministry has contacted Belgian colleagues who await their own internal investigation.
Once the results are known, the KNVB will inform me of the findings and conclusions and I will inform the House of Representatives.
Zodra de resultaten bekend zijn, zal de KNVB mij op de hoogte brengen van de bevindingen en conclusies en zal ik Uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het bericht ‘Boete tijdens vervoer doodziek kind’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a speeding fine issued to a driver transporting his critically ill daughter escorted by ambulance and police vehicles, and how the OM and CJIB weigh such circumstances. The Minister answered that the OM erred, reduced the fine to zero, apologised, and that the CJIB cannot fully reconsider cases beyond narrow correction grounds, with €15 million committed to OM service improvement.
The OM has indicated that the decision of the public prosecutor, as well as the reasoning behind it, was incorrect in this case.
Het OM heeft aangegeven dat de beslissing van de officier van justitie, alsmede de motivering van deze beslissing, in deze zaak onjuist is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de prijsverhoging van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) in 2016

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked why the VOG fee would rise in 2016 and whether volunteer organisations had been consulted, and asked the government to reconsider eligibility rules and make VOGs free for all volunteers working with minors. The Secretary of State confirmed the fee rise, said the cost of the free VOG scheme was built in, refused to change eligibility conditions, and declined to extend free VOGs beyond the existing 100,000-per-year scheme citing budget limits.
No, I am not willing to change the existing conditions.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid om bestaande voorwaarden te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de brief van de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie d.d. 3 november 2015 betreffende het ontbreken van een acceptatieplicht bij autoverzekeringen

Mr Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether insurers refer ex-detainees to Rialto Verzekeringen with higher premiums and extra financial demands for car insurance. The minister answered that insurers have no database of detention, that prior detention is not decisive for premiums, that Rialto's surcharges reflect its higher risk and deposit requirements, and that no signals of misconduct justify a new investigation.
I have received no signals that this is the case, nor that it causes abuses.
Mij hebben geen signalen bereikt, dat hiervan sprake is, en evenmin dat hierdoor misstanden zouden ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over de subsidieregeling van OP Zuid

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister why the OP Zuid subsidy scheme's conditions were changed after the application deadline to exclude projects already started, and how many applications were affected. The Minister replied that the change followed EU state-aid rules on incentive effect, that the managing authority had earlier interpreted the rules too loosely, and that he sees no way to reverse the change.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht “Pleidooi voor instellen speciaal tuchtrecht voor politie-agenten”

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a special disciplinary law for police officers, similar to that for soldiers, should be studied given calls from police unions and experts. The Minister acknowledged the proposal and said it is being considered within the broader reform of how police use of force is handled, promising to inform parliament before the 2016 budget debate.
In the short term, and in any case before the budget debate of my ministry for 2016, I will inform your House of my intentions on this matter.
Op korte termijn – en in ieder geval voor de behandeling van de begroting van mijn ministerie voor het jaar 2016 – zal ik uw Kamer informeren over mijn voornemens hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over een uitspraak van de RSJ d.d. 29 april 2015

MPs Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a Council for Criminal Justice and Youth Protection ruling that the Van der Hoeven clinic breached privacy by publishing factual information about a TBS patient in its internal newsletter. The State Secretary confirms the ruling, explains the Article 8 ECHR test and says the clinic is looking for less far-reaching alternatives, consulting relevant parties if needed.
I agree with the RSJ that disseminating such privacy-sensitive information is only permissible when it is sufficiently justified.
Met de RSJ ben ik van mening dat het verspreiden van dergelijke privacy-gevoelige informatie alleen toelaatbaar is wanneer dit voldoende gemotiveerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Van Toorenburg over de onttrekking van een TBS-er tijdens zijn verlofperiode in de Rooyse Wissel

MPs Knops and Van Toorenburg asked why no full signalement or dangerousness information was shared after a TBS patient absconded during escorted leave from the Rooyse Wissel clinic, and why the Kamer was informed only via media. The Staatssecretaris answered that a signalement was in fact issued via Burgernet, described the standard notification procedures and the leave-approval process, and declined to change the policy of not informing parliament about individual absconding incidents.
Measured against roughly 70,000 leave movements, the 38 unauthorised absences and no escapes from clinics in 2014 give no reason to change its position (on informing parliament about such incidents).

Naar aanleiding van de motie van de heer Oskam. Afgezet tegen het totale aantal van circa 70.000 gepraktiseerde verlofbewegingen, vormen de 38 ongeoorloofde afwezigheden en de afwezigheid van ontvluchtingen uit klinieken in 2014, geen aanleiding om een ander standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Toorenburg over de uitzending van Rambam met de ‘portemonneetest’

A CDA MP asked the Interior Minister whether a TV test showing lost wallets mishandled by municipalities and police undermines trust in local government, whether the lost-and-found registration is adequate, and whether the rules should be changed. The minister acknowledged registration is not always well run, pointed to disciplinary action taken in Ede and by the police, but said the Civil Code rules are adequate and no legal amendment is needed, while raising the issue with the police and the VNG.
Where it becomes clear that this does not happen, action should be taken.
Daar waar duidelijk wordt dat dit niet gebeurt, dient dan ook actie te worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Limburgse gemeenten in de fout met bewaren agenda’s

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked the minister about reports that most Limburg municipalities delete wethouders' digital agendas when they leave office, contrary to the seven-year Archiefwet term. The minister did not dispute the findings, said there is no systematic oversight of municipal compliance, and pointed to digital archiving programmes and a letter sent to the VNG.
The ministry keeps no systematic records of how sub-national governments carry out their tasks, and therefore also not of how municipalities comply with the Archives Act requirements.
Het ministerie houdt geen systematische administratie bij van de naleving van taken door medeoverheden en derhalve ook niet van de wijze waarop gemeenten de voorschriften van de Archiefwet naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over het bericht “Doorgegeven parkeerkaartje ongeldig”

Two CDA MPs asked whether it is acceptable that a motorist who took over a transferred parking ticket that was still valid was fined, and whether the rules should allow such tickets to be passed on. The minister answered that these are two separately taxable facts, that there is no refund or transfer of remaining parking time, and that changing the regulation is not necessary based on this single case.
Changing the substantive basis of the relevant regulations as a foundation is not necessary in my view based on this single case.
Wijziging van de inhoudelijke grondslag als fundament voor de terzake doende regelgeving acht ik niet noodzakelijk op basis van deze ene casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over hoge servicekosten voor toegangskaarten

MPs Van Dijk and Van Toorenburg asked the ministers whether excessive service fees added to concert and event tickets, including a claim of 56,000 euro per week for website maintenance and fees for printing one's own ticket, are acceptable, and whether a cap or all-in ticket should be introduced. The minister replied that pricing and fees are for market parties, that existing consumer-information and unfair-practice rules and the ACM's oversight are sufficient, and that a cap is undesirable.
Determining the height of the service fees is up to market parties.
Het bepalen van de hoogte van de servicekosten is aan marktpartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Toorenburg over de voortgang van de ondergrondse opslag van kernafval in Mol

MPs Mulder and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Belgian experiment at Mol on heat effects of high-level nuclear waste storage and whether Belgian authorities had contacted Brabant authorities as agreed in 2011. The minister confirmed awareness, said Belgium had made an informal 2011 commitment to inform Brabant authorities of new developments, and said no contact was missing because stakeholders were invited to an information meeting in February.
I visited Mol in May 2013 and had NIRAS inform me about this dossier.
Ik ben in mei 2013 naar Mol geweest en heb me daar laten informeren door NIRAS over dit dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de afschaffing van de opbrengsten van de proces verbaal-vergoeding voor gemeenten

CDA MPs asked whether the WODC study on abolishing the proces-verbaal fee for municipalities will examine effects on neighbourhood liveability, police workload, BOA dismissals, municipal budgets and use of administrative fines. The minister answered that the study focuses on registration and spending of the fees rather than direct effects, that no signals of BOA dismissals or budget cuts have been found, and that no VNG inventory is needed for now.
The short time elapsed since the abolition of the fee scheme, as well as the period made available for the study, currently make it impossible to map the effects of the abolition.

De korte tijd die is verstreken sinds de afschaffing van de vergoedingsregeling, alsmede de voor het onderzoek beschikbaar gestelde periode, maken het op dit moment niet mogelijk de effecten van de afschaffing in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van Toorenburg over hogere rentepercentages bij gemeentelijke samenwerkingsverbanden ten opzichte van rentepercentages bij individuele gemeenten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the reported finding that municipal joint arrangements pay higher interest rates than individual municipalities warrants measures. The minister saw no reason for measures, noting the difference is small (4%), and said he would raise the matter in updated treasury guidance.
I see no reason to take measures now.
Ik zie geen reden om nu maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over het bericht over valse inschrijvingen in de Basisregistratie Personen

MPs Van Toorenburg and Omtzigt asked whether false registrations in the Basisregistratie Personen were used to obtain a citizen service number or Dutch driving licences, how many cases and municipalities were involved, and what measures would block this. Minister Plasterk answered that six municipalities suspect about 125 improper registrations, that no benefits were claimed in those cases, and that municipalities will now run address checks when foreign licences are exchanged for Dutch ones.

I will ask all municipalities to always carry out an address investigation if someone applies, within four weeks of registration in the BRP, to exchange a still-valid foreign driving licence for a Dutch one.

In aanvulling hierop zal ik alle gemeenten vragen om altijd alsnog een adresonderzoek in te stellen als iemand binnen vier weken na inschrijving in de BRP een aanvraag doet voor de omwisseling van een nog geldig buitenlands rijbewijs naar een Nederlands rijbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat een gedetineerde een drone heeft binnengesmokkeld en laat vliegen binnen de penitentiaire inrichting

An MP asked whether a video showing a drone flown inside a prison was filmed by a detainee in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting Vught, and how a detainee could order and fly a drone inside. The minister answered that the footage was not from Vught or any operational prison but from the former Blokhuispoort in Leeuwarden, now a business centre, so filming there is for its owner to decide.
These images were not recorded in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting in Vught.
Deze beelden zijn niet opgenomen in de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting te Vught.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van Toorenburg over het maken van pasfoto’s op gemeentehuizen

MPs Bisschop and Van Toorenburg asked whether municipalities offering passport photos at town halls, such as Amsterdam, conflicts with earlier assurances and the Knops motion, and whether this is a municipal task and unfair competition with the photo trade. Minister Plasterk answered that it is not prohibited, that municipalities are not making passport photos themselves but are responsible for photo quality via the fotomatrix, and that he sees no reason to discuss it with municipalities, though his ministry is examining how to improve photo quality.
I therefore see no reason to enter into discussion with municipalities about this.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden hierover in gesprek met gemeenten te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Hulp stelt DNA-bank enigszins teleur’

An MP asks whether about half of Dutch municipalities failed to respond to the Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen's requests to identify where unknown dead are buried, and why, and what will be done. The minister confirms the non-response, attributes it largely to unfamiliarity and incomplete records, and says he will consider with the VNG how to improve municipal cooperation.
Yes, given the great importance of identifying missing persons, I want to examine together with the VNG how municipal cooperation can be further encouraged.
Ja, gelet op het grote belang van identificatie van vermiste personen wil ik samen met de VNG bezien hoe de medewerking door gemeenten nog verder bevorderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het Nedersaksisch

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about recognition of Low Saxon under Part III of the European Charter for Regional Languages, the timing of the Council of Europe visit, and state support for regional languages. The minister said the fifth periodic report will be finalised this spring, that the Council of Europe visit may offer a chance to review Low Saxon's position but he will not pre-judge it, and that talks with SONT on a concrete national contribution will continue.
I do not consider it opportune to make any statements on this in advance of the Council of Europe visit.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om hier vooruitlopend op het bezoek van de Raad van Europa al uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Meisje gebeten door pitbull, baasje loopt door'

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police declined to pursue the owner of a pitbull that bit a girl, and whether the police and prosecutors give priority to Article 425 of the Criminal Code on dangerous animals. The minister answered that an investigation is underway, the dog and owner are being sought, and prosecution and municipal measures will be considered once identified; 100 to 200 such cases per year are handled.

Once the dog and its owner are found and the breed is established, the Public Prosecution Service, in consultation with the mayor of Tilburg, will consider whether criminal and/or administrative measures (such as a muzzle order) apply in this case.

Zodra deze gevonden zijn en is vastgesteld wat voor hond het betreft, zal het Openbaar Ministerie in overleg met de burgemeester van Tilburg bezien of strafrechtelijke en/of bestuurlijke maatregelen (zoals een muilkorfgebod) voor dit geval aan de orde zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de dood van de 17-jarige Juliette uit Geldrop

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the death of a 17-year-old girl who had filed a threat report shortly before her death, and about police capacity and handling of threat reports. The minister confirmed a suspect was arrested and given a conduct order, but declined further details citing the criminal investigation, and pointed to ongoing police and prosecution improvements and a local pilot.
Because of the interests of investigation and prosecution, no further details can be given about this investigation.
Vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging kunnen geen nadere mededelingen over dit onderzoek worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Kweekschool voor criminelen’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a newspaper report calling youth detention centres a breeding ground for crime, and about sick-leave levels, staffing and reorganisations in the Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen. The State Secretary rejected the report as one-sided, gave sick-leave figures by institution, and said that staffing problems at De Hartelborgt were structurally resolved and that the closures had not reduced quality.
I find the article paints an unbalanced picture of what happens in the Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen (JJI's).
Ik vind het artikel een onevenwichtig beeld schetsen van hetgeen in de Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen (JJI's) gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het burgerservicenummer

An MP asked whether the citizen service number (BSN) appears on the data page of the new passport, despite a promise to move it to the reverse, and how this squares with identity-fraud prevention. The Minister confirmed the BSN is on the reverse and in the machine-readable zone and chip, arguing removal from the zone is infeasible, while acknowledging the need for careful handling and that the information page could not be updated.
I therefore stated that I consider it unfeasible to no longer include the BSN in the machine-readable zone.
Ik heb daarom gesteld dat ik het onhaalbaar acht om het BSN niet meer in de machine leesbare zone op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Nu al even veel drugsafval gedumpt als in heel 2013’

MPs Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked the Justice Minister about the rise in synthetic drug waste dumping in Noord-Brabant, its cleanup costs, enforcement capacity, and why prosecutors did not appeal an acquittal in a cannabis-grow case. The minister gave figures on dumpings and costs, described intensified enforcement and funding decisions, and declined to provide some registration data citing administrative burden.
The College of Procurators-General has informed me that it does not have an overview of cases in which suspects were convicted for dumping drug waste.
Het College van procureurs-generaal heeft mij gemeld dat het niet beschikt over een overzicht van zaken waarin verdachten zijn veroordeeld ter zake van het dumpen van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Nu al even veel drugsafval gedumpt als in heel 2014’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice how many Brabant and Limburg mayors had requested extra capacity against drug crime, whether organised drug crime is shifting to the south, and what he learned on a recent visit to Brabant. The minister acknowledged serious concern in the south, said police capacity will be redirected within existing strength from 1 October 2014 (detailed in a separate letter), and reported that mayors raised worries about smaller municipalities; he did not give a count of mayors' requests.

The competent authority in the south of the Netherlands has therefore decided that from 1 October 2014, within existing strength, more police capacity will be deployed against undermining and organised crime.

Het bevoegd gezag in Zuid-Nederland heeft dan ook besloten om per 1 oktober 2014, binnen de bestaande sterkte, meer politiecapaciteit in te gaan zetten op de aanpak van ondermijnende en georganiseerde criminaliteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de nog steeds niet uitgevoerde motie over het uitwisselen van informatie over in het buitenland veroordeelde zedendelinquenten, zodat ze niet in Neder

CDA MPs asked why a motion to exchange information on foreign-convicted sex offenders, so they cannot obtain a VOG and work in childcare, remains unimplemented, and whether Dutch children are adequately protected. The Minister confirmed the motion, said information exchange with non-EU countries happens only case by case, and promised an Interpol-related study and a progress report before the end of 2014, while acknowledging the VOG cannot fully exclude misuse.
in contrast to the arrangements within the EU, criminal information is not exchanged structurally with countries outside the EU
wordt in tegenstelling tot de afspraken die gelden binnen EU-verband, niet op structurele wijze strafrechtelijke informatie uitgewisseld met landen buiten de EU
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Van Toorenburg over het mogelijk op straat zetten van 250 militairen

Two CDA MPs asked whether reinstating cleaning staff into government employment would force Defence to dismiss 250 military and civilian personnel, and whether this would cut the defence budget. The government denied a forced choice, said Defence is only connected from 2018 for office premises with a near budget-neutral business case, and gave a partial answer on compensation.
As stated in Minister Blok's letter of 23 June, the cabinet's choices for the departments lead to an almost budget-neutral business case for performing the cleaning work in-house.

Zoals in de brief van Minister Blok van 23 juni jl. is vermeld, leiden de keuzes van het kabinet voor de departementen tot een vrijwel budgettair neutrale business case voor het in eigen beheer uitvoeren van de schoonmaakwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het onderzoek ‘Spookjongeren: quickscan naar uitgeschreven jongeren in Amsterdam Nieuw-West’

Van Toorenburg asked about a quickscan on 'ghost youths' who deregister from the municipal population register in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, including whether this is a deliberate way to evade bailiffs and justice and whether benefit rules contribute. Minister Plasterk answered that the study is only a quickscan needing further research, that the number of ghost citizens nationally is estimated at 100,000 (over 10,000 aged 18–26), that municipalities have tools to question registrations, and that the childcare-cost rule may raise but is not expected to greatly increase the phenomenon.
This report concerns a quickscan. The researchers indicate that further investigation is necessary.
Dit rapport betreft een quickscan. De onderzoekers geven aan dat nader onderzoek noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Hachchi over het bericht: ‘Aruba boos over trage benoeming Raad van State’

Two MPs asked why Aruba's seat on the Council of State remains unfilled, whether a nomination was pulled from the Council of Ministers agenda, and when Aruba will be represented. The minister confirmed the report, cited confidentiality of Council of Ministers deliberations on nominations, and explained that the nomination requires agreement with the Aruban government but not automatic approval, promising only to announce any appointment.
Under Article 26 of the Council of Ministers' Rules of Procedure, there is a duty of confidentiality regarding what is discussed or takes place at the meeting.
Krachtens artikel 26 van het Reglement van orde voor de Ministerraad bestaat ten aanzien van hetgeen ter vergadering wordt besproken of geschiedt, een geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi, Van Haersma Buma en Van Toorenburg over de onduidelijke antwoorden van de regering inzake de hongerstaking van minister-president van Aruba

MPs from D66 and CDA asked the government how it prevented escalation with Aruba over the budget dispute, whether the College Financieel Toezicht was explicitly assigned the investigation, what solution it intends, whether a mediator should be appointed, and whether the Raad van State should rule on the lawfulness of the Rijksministerraad decision. The minister answered that the joint press statement clearly pointed to Cft staff, that a quick interim report and a final report within six weeks are expected, and that the royal decree was adopted lawfully, so no Raad van State ruling is sought.
With a view to the process of finding an acute solution, I do not consider it useful to make that communication public now.
Met het oog op het proces van het vinden van een acute oplossing, acht ik het niet dienstig die communicatie nu publiek te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi, Van Haersma Buma en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de Arubaanse premier Mike Eman in hongerstaking gaat

MPs from D66 and CDA asked whether Aruba's prime minister's hunger strike was caused by a Council of Ministers decision instructing the Governor not to sign Aruba's 2014 budget, and whether that decision was lawful. The minister replied that the Council acted lawfully, that the budget right remains with Aruba, and that the Governor's instruction is a temporary suspension pending an independent review.
The decisions of the Council of Ministers are taken carefully and lawfully.
De beslissingen van de Rijksministerraad komen zorgvuldig en rechtmatig tot stand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het bericht dat ontbreken GSM dekking levens kan kosten

MPs from the CDA asked the government about a reported death in Lattrop where AED alerts did not arrive, whether mobile coverage gaps endanger lives, and whether providers meet licence coverage obligations. The Minister replied that the network functioned properly, that 100% coverage is not achievable, that alternative emergency routes are advised, and that no coverage requirements exist in current frequency licences, with a ministry study on mobile coverage and 112 announced.
I do not have such information available.
Dergelijke informatie heb ik niet beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de aangenomen motie Omtzigt (Kamerstuk 33 750 V, nr. 30) over informatie over veroordelingen van Nederlanders voor zedendelicten in het buitenland

MPs Omtzigt, Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked about information exchange on Dutch nationals convicted of sex offences abroad, which can allow them to obtain a VOG and work with children. The government explains that EU exchange works under treaties and ECRIS, while information exchange with non-EU countries occurs only case by case, with Thailand approached and an Interpol-based approach being explored.
It is not separately recorded in how many cases a VOG was refused to a person with a Dutch passport for a sex offence conviction abroad.
Er wordt niet apart geregistreerd in hoeveel gevallen de VOG is geweigerd aan iemand met een Nederlands paspoort voor een veroordeling voor een zedendelict in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de EO-reportage 'De nachtmerrie na het misbruik'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about an EO report on parents of sexually abused children lacking a strong victim position, the court ruling that parents cannot join criminal proceedings for their damages, and the limited compensation from the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven. The State Secretary acknowledged parents' limited victim rights, announced a bill allowing parents to join as injured parties for costs incurred for their child (aiming for early 2015), explained the Schadefonds' limits, and declined a personal meeting while using the letters as input for policy.
I intend to regulate by law that parents can join the criminal proceedings as an injured party for costs they have incurred on behalf of their child.
Ik ben voornemens wettelijk te regelen, dat ouders zich in het strafproces kunnen voegen als benadeelde partij voor kosten die zij ten behoeve van hun kind hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Toorenburg over de onrust onder het gevangenispersoneel

MPs Kooiman and Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary about unrest among prison staff, including staffing shortages, intimidation, budget cuts and the pension gap for staff in substantially burdensome posts. The State Secretary disputed the staffing-shortage and intimidation claims, cited falling violent incidents, and deferred detailed answers on cuts and the Masterplan to a later letter.

In line with my earlier commitments during the General Consultation on the DJI Masterplan of 29 January and the General Consultation on prisons of 27 March, I will inform the House before the summer recess about progress on implementing the DJI Masterplan and the additional financial problems.

Conform mijn eerdere toezeggingen tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over het Masterplan DJI van 29 januari jl. en het Algemeen Overleg over het gevangeniswezen op 27 maart jl. zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces informeren over de voortgang van de implementatie van het Masterplan DJI en de aanvullende financiële problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt Justitie over gsm-ontvangst in Nederland

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about poor mobile coverage in border municipalities and whether 112 emergency calls could fail, including how many complaints and cases occurred and what action was taken. The minister answered that 100% mobile coverage is not achievable, that no registration of failed emergency calls exists, that EZ is studying coverage reach, and that citizens are advised to use a landline in emergencies.
It is not registered in how many cases an acute emergency call was not possible because no mobile coverage was available.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd in hoeveel gevallen een acute noodoproep niet mogelijk was, omdat er geen mobiele dekking voorhanden was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Rijk koopt XPocalypse af via extra support van Microsoft’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the central government signed a multi-million contract with Microsoft for custom support on Windows XP, why municipalities are excluded, and what measures prevent dependence on one software vendor. The minister confirmed a 2.48 million euro custom support agreement until April 2015, denied that Microsoft required migration to Windows 7 or 8, and said municipalities are responsible for their own ICT contracts while dependence is managed through open tendering.
The total amount for this custom contract is 2,480,000 euros, excluding VAT.
Het totaal bedrag voor dit maatwerk contract is 2.480.000 Euro, exclusief BTW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Overheveling van taken treft vooral zwakste gemeenten’

Two CDA MPs asked the government whether the decentralisation of youth care, elderly care and Wajong to municipalities hits the financially weakest municipalities hardest and whether municipalities can carry these tasks. The minister answered that the claim is not supported by the comparison made, that a historical distribution model applies for 2015, and that municipalities will get budget clarity in the May circular, while largely restating existing policy.
There is no question of a trial calculation.
Van een proefberekening is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Hoeder privacy: gemeente laks met veiligheid data’

MP Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Interior about reports that many municipalities still run Windows XP after Microsoft ends support, and about privacy risks as municipalities take on more sensitive social-domain data. The Minister says migration away from Windows XP is under way and responsibility lies with municipalities, points to the Taskforce BID, a planned Privacy Impact Assessment and a forthcoming policy vision, and states that municipalities are actively working on information security.
Citizens must be able to trust at all times that personal data is handled carefully.
Burgers moeten er te allen tijde op kunnen vertrouwen dat er zorgvuldig wordt omgegaan met persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en van Toorenburg over de GSM-ontvangst enquête van het CDA Zaltbommel

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Economic Affairs about poor mobile reception in the municipality of Zaltbommel, including whether residents can miss emergency alerts, whether 112 and AED access are endangered, whether emergency services are hindered, and whether the minister will meet the parties involved. The minister answered that alerts can be received through other channels, that 112 calls are adequately handled, that AED alternatives exist, and that a meeting is unnecessary because 4G rollout is expected to improve coverage, with an update promised later in the year.
I do not consider a meeting necessary.
Ik acht een gesprek niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Afvalboete blijft bij gemeenten’

MP Van Toorenburg asked whether Brabant municipalities face fines from waste processor Attero for under-delivering residual waste because residents separate their waste, and why Attero has not fined them. The minister answered that the contracts are private-law matters between municipalities and Attero outside his remit, that the province has no direct role, and that the clause causing the perverse incentive will be dropped in a new contract from 2017.
As Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, I cannot intervene in the underlying agreements.
Ik kan als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties niet treden in onderliggende overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het bericht dat een gevangene is beschoten met een spijkerpistool

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked the State Secretary about a reported shooting of a prisoner with a nail gun at the Alphen aan den Rijn detention facility, the status of the investigation, occupancy, and whether security was under pressure after G4S guards left. The State Secretary answered that a police investigation is ongoing so the circumstances cannot yet be disclosed, occupancy was above 95%, the security concerns are not shared, and that the department monitors security and incidents internally.
The police investigation is ongoing. As long as the police investigation has not been concluded, no conclusive statement can yet be given about the circumstances of the incident.
Het politieonderzoek is gaande. Over de toedracht van het incident kan, zolang het politieonderzoek nog niet is afgerond, vooralsnog geen uitsluitsel worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over een 77-jarige vrouw uit Valkenswaard die tienduizenden euro’s moet betalen omdat vaten gif op haar terrein zijn gestort door criminelen

An MP asked the government about a 77-year-old woman in Valkenswaard who must pay tens of thousands of euros to clear barrels of toxic drug waste dumped on her land by criminals, questioning the municipality's assessment of her conduct and whether the law should include a hardship clause or fund. The State Secretary replied that the municipality is responsible for the case and the legal framework is sufficient, declined to judge the municipal assessment, and pointed to a provincial working group and a possible guarantee fund instead of legislative change.
I therefore cannot give an opinion on assessments the municipal official made regarding the specific case in Valkenswaard.
Ik kan daarom geen mening geven omtrent inschattingen die de betreffende gemeenteambtenaar heeft gemaakt met betrekking tot de specifieke casus in Valkenswaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht «Overheid doet zaken met pornoboer»

An MP asked whether a social-media monitoring firm contracted by nine ministries and the police was linked to adult internet services, and how it was vetted given sensitive data. The minister confirmed the link was via a former stake of WiseGuys in an adult search service, which was divested after a security assessment, and pointed to integrity screening rules under the 2012 Aanbestedingswet.
In tenders, under the Aanbestedingswet 2012, the integrity and suitability of the entrepreneur to be awarded the contract are checked on the basis of mandatory official evidence.

Bij aanbestedingen wordt op grond van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 de integriteit en de geschiktheid van de ondernemer die de opdracht zal worden gegund, gecontroleerd aan de hand van de verplicht te overleggen officiële bewijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Doodgestoken Zweedse deed aangifte van bedreiging’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Den Bosch failed to handle with due priority a report of threats filed in August 2013 by a Swedish student later killed, and whether police lacked capacity. The minister answered that the report was assessed and marked for pickup, that police in Den Bosch can handle such reports with priority, and that case screening and intervention improvements are being implemented.
Reports of threats must be taken up with priority and adequately.
Aangiftes van bedreiging dienen met prioriteit en adequaat opgepakt te worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat gemeenten de volle mep betalen voor het onderzoek naar de decentralisaties

MPs Schouw and Van Toorenburg asked whether municipalities in practice fully pay for the CPB multi-year research agenda on decentralisation, via the Gemeentefonds. The minister answers that the Rijk pays its half from the Rijksbudget (administratively placed in the Gemeentefonds), so the cost is shared equally, and that the €2 million also funds the Schouw motion research.
Given the distribution of costs, there is no question of the research agenda being fully financed by the municipalities.
Gelet op de verdeling van de kosten geldt dat er geen sprake is van een volledige financiering van de onderzoeksagenda door de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het Droomboek

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the Droomboek was printed in Germany, on what criteria the printing contract was awarded, how many copies and what cost, and whether it is a dream or nightmare that such a book is printed abroad. The minister confirmed printing in Germany, said the Postcode Lottery funded it without taxpayer money, and explained that a German printer won the offer process on cost, climate-neutral printing and capacity.
Because the Committee was not granted any budget by the central government when it was established, it depends on sponsorship to fund its initiatives.
Omdat aan het Comité bij de instelling ervan geen budget vanuit het Rijk is toegekend, is het Comité voor de bekostiging van initiatieven afhankelijk van sponsoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Oppositie Oegstgeest: Wob-verzoek om integriteitsrapporten’

An MP asks whether the Oegstgeest council was refused access to two reports on integrity violations, and how the 'public interest' exception in the Gemeentewet should be read. The minister replies that the council did receive a summary memo, that the public-interest exception must be read narrowly and is for the council itself to assess, and that the Wob grounds are not the test.
The right to information belongs to individual council members.
Het inlichtingenrecht komt toe aan de raadsleden individueel.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het bericht “13 duizend euro voor cursus ‘Digitaal leiderschap’”

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked whether a 13,000-euro social media course for civil servants, taught partly by a member of the 'Project X Haren' commission, is a fitting follow-up to that commission's recommendations and how the government will build social media skills without relying on this course. The minister answered that the commission has finished and its knowledge may be spread further, that civil servants are not obliged to take such a course, and that social media training is part of the regular education offer.
It is up to the government and the civil servants concerned themselves to decide which courses should be followed and by whom.
Het is aan de overheid en betrokken ambtenaren zelf om de afweging te maken welke cursussen gevolgd (dienen) te worden en door wie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur, Van der Burg en Van Toorenburg van uw Kamer over verboden voorwerpen in de cel van de veroordeelde voor het doodschoppen van Richard Nieuwenhuizen

MPs Van der Steur, Van der Burg and Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary about a PowNews broadcast showing contraband (a phone or camera, soft drugs, a key-fob and possible sexual contact) in the cell of a convicted youth at the Teylingereind youth institution. The State Secretary acknowledged the phone was unacceptable, described existing controls and a sector-wide review, said no sexual contact was found, and saw no reason for further action or concern about the institution's management.
I have instructed the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen to survey across the sector how the illegal import and use of mobile phones can be further curbed.
Ik heb de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen de opdracht gegeven om sectorbreed te inventariseren hoe de illegale invoer en het gebruik van mobiele telefoons nog verder kan worden teruggedrongen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Steekincident hing in de lucht'

Two MPs from the CDA asked the state secretary about a press report on a fatal stabbing in the Nieuwegein prison, including whether the deceased inmate had complained about overcrowding, the occupancy rate, staffing, transfers after the incident, and whether discrimination played a role. The minister answered that no complaint about overcrowding is known, the occupancy was 82%, staffing was sufficient, five inmates were transferred to restore order, and details of the incident cannot be disclosed because of an ongoing criminal investigation.
The circumstances of this stabbing incident are the subject of an ongoing criminal investigation into the suspect and therefore I cannot make any statements about it.
De toedracht van dit steekincident is onderwerp van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de verdachte en derhalve kan ik geen mededelingen hierover doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Raad Hoogezand zet Maagd voet dwars'

The MP Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the Minister of Interior whether the Hoogezand-Sappemeer council blocked a party's nominee as faction representative despite a committee finding that he met the ordinance criteria, and whether the Minister would act on it. The Minister confirmed the facts, said appointment of faction representatives is a purely municipal matter outside the Municipalities Act, and declined to intervene or consult the municipality or VNG.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het artikel 'Gemeenten mikpunt van Russische spionage'

The MP asks the Minister of the Interior about a newspaper report that Dutch municipalities are targets of Russian espionage, including whether civil servants and local officials are sufficiently aware of information security risks. The Minister confirms that municipal data such as GBA records interest foreign intelligence services, describes safeguards in the design of the BRP and an information-security taskforce, and lists AIVD awareness publications and presentations.
Antwoord vragen Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het rapport inzake de luchtkwaliteit in celruimten in huizen van bewaring en gevangenissen

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked the State Secretary about a report on air quality in prison cells, whether cell ventilation will meet standards quickly, the impact on the Masterplan DJI, the costs, and whether multi-person cell use is possible. The State Secretary answered that only ventilation capacity was measured, that the report has no consequences for the Masterplan, that ventilation cleaning protocols will be tested at selected locations with further measures if needed, that costs are unknown, and that multi-person cell use will only occur in suitable cells.
If the test with cleaning protocols does not achieve the desired results and other measures prove necessary, measures will be taken depending on the planned closure date.

Mocht de test met reinigingsprotocollen niet tot de gewenste resultaten leiden en mochten daardoor andere maatregelen noodzakelijk blijken, dan zullen afhankelijk van het tijdstip van voorgenomen sluiting maatregelen genomen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het artikel ‘Den Bosch wil snel duidelijkheid verkiezingen’

Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the Minister of Interior whether the Den Bosch/Maasdonk merger is voluntary and broadly supported, whether Den Bosch council elections will move to November 2014, which other municipalities face merger procedures, and whether a bill will extend council terms. The minister said he cannot yet judge support without the merger advice and provincial view, listed the other municipalities in merger procedures, and said a postponement bill is with the Council of State and will be submitted soon, covering municipalities with a proposal filed by end 2013.
At this stage of the merger procedure I cannot answer that, as I have not yet received the merger advice and the provincial view.
In deze fase van de herindelingsprocedure kan ik daar geen antwoord op geven, aangezien ik het herindelingsadvies en provinciale zienswijze nog niet heb ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat Eindhoven Airport een belangrijke schakel zou zijn in de internationale mensenhandel

MPs Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Eindhoven Airport is a key hub for international human trafficking and what steps are being taken there. The minister confirmed awareness, described a Public Prosecution Service project and Marechaussee information-building at the airport, and answered that no other small border-region airports hold a comparable position.
The Public Prosecution Service has started a project aimed at further improving the approach to criminal networks involved in human trafficking.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is met een project gestart dat zich richt op het verder verbeteren van de aanpak van criminele samenwerkingsverbanden inzake mensenhandel.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht verstandelijk beperkt echtpaar in de vrieskou

MPs Van Toorenburg and Knops asked about a couple with intellectual disabilities evicted from a Dordrecht senior flat over rent arrears, and about cooperation to prevent evictions. The minister answered that the eviction followed a court ruling, that prevention is mainly the landlord's responsibility, that a new prevention covenant with Dordrecht was signed, and that the government will underline the importance of prevention in consultations.
Preventing evictions is a responsibility of landlords.
Het voorkomen van huisuitzettingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van verhuurders.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de brief van de Caribisch Nederlandse Vereniging van fysiotherapeuten met daarin de wijziging van de ziektekostenverzekering op Caribisch Nederland per 1

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about the late announcement and cut-back of physiotherapy and dental care in the Caribbean Netherlands' basic insurance from 1 January 2013, questioning consultation and the 5-working-day notice. The minister conceded five working days was too short, extended the transition to 1 July 2013, promised to announce future package decisions by 1 July of the prior year, but refused to postpone or revise the decision.
For that reason it was decided to introduce a transition period of half a year, in line with common practice in European Netherlands.
Daarom is besloten tot een overgangsperiode van een half jaar conform de gangbare praktijk in Europees Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over het wetsvoorstel dat de pensioenen voor politieke ambtsdragers moderniseert

MPs Van Toorenburg and Omtzigt asked why the bill modernising pensions for political office holders, announced for 1 January 2013, had not yet been submitted, and when it went to the Council of State. The minister explains that adjusting the Appa pension to a flexible retirement age is complex and that the bill will be sent to Parliament around 1 March 2013.
Yes, the bill will be sent to you around 1 March 2013.
Ja, het wetsvoorstel ontvangt u omstreeks 1 maart 2013.
Antwoord vragen Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over de tegenstrijdige berichtgeving over het schrappen van de buitenlandtak van de AIVD

MPs Van Toorenburg and Omtzigt asked the Interior Minister about conflicting reports on scrapping the AIVD's foreign intelligence branch, what the government would do to prevent its abolition, and whether the cut would be fully reversed. The minister replied that the coalition agreement footnote was read as a suggestion, the full AIVD task set was kept intact including foreign intelligence, but the budget cut still requires reprioritisation, with a concrete proposal promised in the first half of 2013.

The constituent meeting then decided, on the proposal of the Minister of the Interior, to keep the AIVD's full set of tasks, A through E, intact as the service's field of work, thus including the foreign intelligence task.

Vervolgens heeft het constituerend beraad op voorstel van de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties besloten het volledige takenpakket van de AIVD, van taken A tot en met E, intact te laten als het werkterrein van de dienst, dus inclusief de buitenlandtaak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, Van Toorenburg en Van der Staaij over de schadelijke gevolgen door blowen

MPs asked the government about harms of heavy cannabis use among young people, including effects on brain development and psychosis risk, and whether schools should act more strictly and the minimum age for softdrugs be raised to 21. The minister replied that existing drug policy already reflects these risks, that schools are tightening enforcement and drug use is declining, that the research shows no case for raising the age to 21 on current evidence, and that the 350-metre coffeeshop distance rule takes effect in 2014 after a transition period.
This report does not give cause for this at present.
Daartoe geeft dit bericht vooralsnog geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over problemen bij het zuiver aanvaarden van een nalatenschap

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked about heirs who unknowingly accepted an inheritance purely (zuiver) and so became liable for debts, including whether bank forms, emptying the estate and court fees trap heirs, and why minors are protected but not uninformed adults. The state secretary answered that heirs can get free public information and notary advice, that certain acts count as pure acceptance, that protecting minors reflects their inability to judge, and that beneficiary acceptance mostly causes unnecessary burdens, while promising only to consult the profession if a law change is considered.
I maintain my position that beneficiary acceptance will in most cases lead to unnecessary administrative burdens for citizens.
Ik blijf bij mijn standpunt dat beneficiaire aanvaarding in de meeste gevallen zal leiden tot onnodige administratieve lasten voor de burger.

Vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat uit onderzoek van de Politieacademie blijkt dat de politie in de regio Midden- en West-Brabant na telefonische meldi

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Midden- and West-Brabant often fail to follow up on phone reports, and how this would be prevented in future, including whether the approach would be rolled out nationally. The minister acknowledged that many reports go unanswered due to limited capacity, called this unacceptable, and pointed to the National Police service concept and a planned nationwide multichannel approach conditional on adequate follow-up.
This is of course unacceptable. In the service concept of the National Police a method is being developed to prevent this.
Dit is uiteraard onacceptabel. In het dienstverleningsconcept van de Nationale Politie wordt een werkwijze ontwikkeld om dit te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over een tv-uitzending waarin kinderen hun toekomstige pleegouders kunnen kiezen

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary whether a Talpa/Spirit TV format letting children choose their foster parents exploits vulnerable children and whether she would intervene. The state secretary said Jeugdzorg Nederland judged the format unsuitable, that the plans might be dropped, and that she trusts the body to protect the children's privacy, while committing to foster-care recruitment campaigns and legislation on foster parents' legal position.
I have had myself informed by the responsible parties.
Ik heb mij laten informeren door de verantwoordelijke partijen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg Gesthuizen en Bouwmeester inzake de opsplitsting cq. verplaatsing van het Pieter Baan Centrum

MPs Van Toorenburg, Gesthuizen and Bouwmeester asked whether the government would fully inform parliament about plans to split up or relocate the Pieter Baan Centrum, a forensic psychiatric observation institute, after press reports and without debate on the matter. Minister Opstelten answered that the building is outdated and the funds for renovation are lacking, so a relocation to Almere is planned for 2013 with decentralised observation places, and that the move was not discussed in the June debate because there were no new developments beyond earlier letters to parliament.
As I also indicated in answering questions from MP Van der Steur (VVD), the Netherlands Institute for Forensic Psychiatry and Psychology (NIFP) is continuously working to improve quality.

Zoals ik ook heb aangegeven in de beantwoording van de vragen ( 2012Z14241 ) van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) werkt het Nederlands Instituut voor Forensische Psychiatrie en Psychologie (NIFP) voortdurend aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit.
Antwoord vragen Van Toorenburg over de uitzending van De Vijfde Dag over het huldigen van een tbs'er
