An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a broadcast on a tbs detainee's escape and early release, including the handling of the 1997 escape, the role of the Advisory Committee on Leave Assessment, drug use under supervision, and the status of the case. The State Secretary answered that the 1997 investigations gave no reason for prosecution, that the minister may depart from positive AVT advice, that controlled soft drug use was permitted by the probation service with prosecutorial consent, and that the tbs measure remains in force pending appeal.
To ensure the tbs measure is never ended without any form of preparation for return to society, I have submitted a legislative amendment.
Om te zorgen dat de tbs-maatregel nooit zonder enige vorm van voorbereiding op de terugkeer in de samenleving wordt beëindigd heb ik een wetswijziging ingediend

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het feit dat de vader van de ontvoerde minderjarige I.A. hoogstwaar

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked why the father of abducted child I.A., convicted in absentia of murdering the mother and likely still in Libya, cannot be extradited, whether the government will press the new Libyan government, and why he was not put on the national wanted list. The Minister replied that the government will raise the case with the new Libyan authorities when an opportunity arises, that Libyan law bars extradition of nationals, that the Public Prosecution Service sees no reason to revisit the decision, and that only national and international alerts have been issued.
The Public Prosecution Service has hardly any means of tracing the person in Libya, because it has no investigative powers there.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft nauwelijks mogelijkheden betrokkene in Libië op te sporen, omdat het aldaar geen opsporingsbevoegdheden heeft.

Vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een wedstrijd forellen doodslaan (ingezonden 11

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about a contest in which fish were beaten to death with hammers, and whether the Dierenbescherming inspectorate was investigating and whether this constitutes animal cruelty. The minister said the inspectorate is examining whether a criminal report is warranted, that the courts would decide whether cruelty occurred, and that the outcome would be reported to Parliament only in exceptional cases.
In principle, the House will only be informed further about an individual case in special circumstances.
In beginsel wordt uw Kamer alleen in bijzondere gevallen nader geïnformeerd over een individuele zaak.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Van Toorenburg (CDA) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het SBF-verlof voor gev

MPs Gesthuizen, Van Toorenburg and Bouwmeester asked why the SBF leave scheme for prison staff left DJI personnel inadequately and late informed about lower net income, why P-Direkt information was deficient, and whether the scheme should be changed or allow continued working. State Secretary Teeven answered that the lower net leave benefit was known from the start, that information was slow but not incorrect, that continued working is decided case by case on service interests, and that the scheme is a safety net not meant to encourage longer working.

Vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de vereniging Martijn (ingezonden 8 juli 2011).

Christian Democrat MPs Van Toorenburg and Omtzigt asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands complies with the Lanzarote Convention on child sexual exploitation, given the Martijn association's aims and its board members' sex-offence convictions, and whether prosecution or dissolution of the association should be pursued. The minister answered that the Netherlands complies with the Convention, that no concrete offence justifies prosecution, that further examination of dissolution under existing law is ongoing, and that the Convention committee is procedural rather than a forum for case review.
At present there is no suspicion of a concrete criminal offence that could justify criminal prosecution.
Op dit moment is geen sprake van een verdenking van een concreet strafbaar feit die een strafrechtelijke vervolging kan rechtvaardigen.

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a deputy chief prosecutor in Rotterdam had urged complainant Drost to quickly file an Article 12 Sv complaint against the prosecution's decision not to prosecute the association Martijn. The state secretary answered that Drost himself announced the complaint, the deputy chief prosecutor only discussed it with him and said a quick filing would be good given public debate, and that the College of Procurators-General was informed.

The deputy chief prosecutor then stated that the public prosecution service maintains its earlier conclusion that prosecution, dissolution and/or banning of the association Martijn is not possible on the basis of what is currently known.

The state secretary answered that the Public Prosecution Service judged listing ineffective because he is unlikely to return to the Netherlands, though he is signalled nationally and internationally, and that the case would be revisited if Libya's situation changes.

The minister answered that reinstatement is for the police forces to decide, that the investigation was lawfully handled by the Maastricht prosecutor, and that no national overview of affected cases exists.
The Public Prosecution Service does not have a national overview of all criminal cases in which the lack of authority of the hulpofficieren did or did not have consequences.

Two CDA MPs asked the health and justice ministers about illegal betting on sports matches, including whether the minister attended the IOC Lausanne meeting and what steps will be taken toward an international definition and coordinated approach. The minister confirmed illegal betting threatens match-fixing and fair play, said she did not attend but provided the joint declaration, and pointed to a new working group, EU Council work and the planned Kansspelautoriteit.

The state secretary answered that a district investigation team and extra night patrols were set up in Vught, that contact was made with other forces, that nationwide information exchange on offender profiles already occurs, and that current measures are considered sufficient.
For now, I consider these measures sufficient.

CDA MPs Ferrier and Van Toorenburg asked the education minister whether privacy rules stopped the prosecutor's office from informing a primary school that its deputy head was a suspect in a child pornography case, and whether privacy should yield to children's interests. The state secretary replied that the Wjsg framework requires weighing a serious public interest against the parties' interests, that the existing framework already allows early information sharing with employers, and that the prosecution service will train prosecutors on how to inform third parties, without committing to a change in law.

Asks the government to submit the amendment note on the advisory committee and its assessment framework to the Council of State for advice.
requests the government to submit the amendment note on the advisory committee and its assessment framework to the Council of State for advice
verzoekt de regering, de nota van wijziging aangaande de commissie van advies en het bijbehorende toetsingskader, dat nog te ontvangen is, alsnog aan de Raad van State ter advies voor te leggen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het declaratiegedrag van de voorzitter van het College van Bestuur van de Universiteit Utrecht

An MP asked the minister about the UU board chair's 2018 domestic travel claims of EUR 124,343, the redacted trip destinations, and whether ceilings and a efficiency test should apply to board travel claims. The minister explained the chauffeur-car arrangement in his contract, said the inspectorate found no irregularities, and said current VSNU rules apply while the inspectorate will review claims in late 2019.
The inspectorate found in its investigation that the company cars and taxi rides were not used for private purposes.
De inspectie heeft in haar onderzoek geconstateerd dat de dienstauto’s en de taxiritten niet voor privédoeleinden zijn ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Özdil over het bericht ‘RIVM en CBS: psychische gezondheid jongeren achteruit in afgelopen tien jaar’

MPs Bruins and Özdil asked the ministers about a RIVM/CBS report showing declining mental health among young people, and about student stress, the leenstelsel link, waiting times for student psychologists and prevention. The minister acknowledged the concern, announced a large-scale RIVM follow-up study expected by late 2020, and said the ministries will coordinate, while several questions on causes, waiting times and the leenstelsel link were answered only in outline.
I am aware of the results of the research.
Ik ben bekend met de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht 'Scriptie onvoldoende? Dan ook geen beloning voor docent'

An MP asks whether history lecturers at the RUG received no teaching hours for supervising theses that were graded insufficient or not completed, and whether such schemes exist elsewhere, and calls for compensation and investigation. The minister confirms the RUG allocates hours on expected supervision rather than outcomes, reports no signals of outcome-linked allocation at other institutions, says she sees no reason to investigate further, and states the funding review response will be sent by 21 June 2019.
I see no reason to investigate this further.
Ik zie geen aanleiding dit verder te onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Özdil over het bericht ‘Cafédeur blijft dicht voor expat in Eindhoven: 'Ik ben hier nu vijf maanden en dat is lang genoeg om te weten dat ik nooit hier ga wonen'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a report of a bar in Eindhoven refusing entry to an expat, and about discriminatory door policy in hospitality generally, including the existing legal framework, enforcement and sanctions. The minister answered that discrimination is unacceptable, cited 2017 and 2018 complaint and police incident figures, and described the legal framework, municipal tools, complaint bodies and sanctions while leaving enforcement largely to municipalities.

It is not compatible with the prohibition of discrimination and the principle of equality as enshrined in our Constitution and as further elaborated in the Criminal Code and the General Equal Treatment Act (Awgb).

Het is niet verenigbaar met het discriminatieverbod en gelijkheidsbeginsel zoals neergelegd in onze Grondwet en zoals onder meer nader uitgewerkt in het wetboek van Strafrecht en de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling (Awgb).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het rapport ‘Mogelijkheden stopzetten studentenreisproduct’ (2017) en het niet automatisch stopzetten van de OV-studentenkaart

An MP asked the education minister why the student OV travel product was not stopped automatically via account based ticketing despite a 2017 report, and why operators earlier claimed this was technically impossible. The minister answered that ABT was rejected mainly because at the time it was technically impossible to stop all student products that way, that blacklist capacity was expanded and new communication measures introduced, and gave boete totals for 2017 and 2018.
The main reason for not choosing ABT as the solution for stopping the student travel product was that at that time it was technically not possible to stop all student travel products via ABT.

De belangrijkste reden om niet voor ABT te kiezen als oplossingsrichting voor het stopzetten van het studentenreisproduct was dat het op dat moment technisch niet mogelijk was om via ABT alle studentenreisproducten stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de wetenschapsvisie van de minister ‘Nieuwsgierig en betrokken - de waarde van wetenschap’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the science vision gave only two sentences to the adopted Özdil motion on safeguarding researchers' academic freedom under the embedding guarantee, whether the motion would be implemented, and whether embedding guarantees should be independently reviewed. The minister answered that NWO is evaluating the embedding guarantee within the ongoing VIDI round, will monitor independence and take measures if needed, and that universities decide who receives a guarantee without mandating independent review.
The scientific freedom and independence of researchers in the VI must remain guaranteed, including with an embedding guarantee.
De wetenschappelijke vrijheid en onafhankelijkheid van onderzoekers in de VI moet gewaarborgd blijven, ook met een inbeddingsgarantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Özdil over de berichtgeving over de Qatarese vestiging van NHL Stenden

MPs Tielen and Özdil asked the Minister of Education about press reports on NHL Stenden's Qatar campus, including an Inspectorate investigation running since October 2018, and whether foreign branch quality and diploma integrity are adequately safeguarded. The Minister said the Inspectorate's report is expected around June and will be sent to parliament, that existing quality safeguards (NVAO accreditation, examination board decisions) apply, and that she will review rules if the investigation warrants it.
I undertake to send this investigation to your House, including my response.
Ik zeg u toe dit onderzoek naar uw Kamer te zullen sturen inclusief mijn reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil inzake het bericht ‘Overhaaste studiekeuze in het mbo door numerus fixus’

An MP (Özdil, GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Education whether it is undesirable that numerus fixus rules at vocational colleges (mbo) force rushed study choices, whether a national overview and complaint facilities for students are needed, and what is done about unclear enrolment dates. The minister answered that first-come-first-served allocation is lawful under the 2017 mbo admission law, that the first evaluation of the law is due in 2019 and may lead to a national overview, and that schools must communicate enrolment dates better, while pointing to existing complaint committees and an upcoming letter on student legal protection.
Before summer 2019 the first report of the evaluation monitor of the mbo early enrolment date and admission right law will become available.
Voor de zomer van 2019 komt de eerste rapportage beschikbaar van de evaluatiemonitor van de Wet Vroegtijdige aanmelddatum voor en toelatingsrecht tot het mbo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het EenVandaag-onderzoek: ‘Mbo-studenten willen graag een titel’

An MP asked the education minister why she dismissed an EenVandaag poll showing 63% of MBO students want a title for graduates, and whether she had consulted students. The minister said she had aligned her reaction with the JOB student organisation, acknowledged the new signal, and promised further talks with JOB while cautioning that a title needs recognition by employers.
I will discuss this further with the JOB.
Ik zal hierover met de JOB nader overleg voeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Özdil over de antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving dat de studie Nederlands dreigt te verdwijnen en alleen in het buitenland populair

MPs Van der Molen (CDA) and Özdil (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science to clarify earlier answers on the declining Dutch-language degree programmes, including whether the VU plans to close its programme and what actions are planned. The minister denies any contradiction, says no concrete closure plans are known, points to a Deltaplan for the languages due in 2019, a KNAW problem analysis, and a Taalunie study on Dutch abroad, and says further steps will follow in 2019.
However, as far as I am aware, there are no concrete plans by the VU or other higher education institutions to close Dutch programmes.
Echter, voor zover mij bekend is, zijn er geen concrete plannen van de VU of van andere hoger onderwijsinstellingen om opleidingen Nederlands te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de brief inzake Flexibilisering uitbetaling collegegeldkrediet voor studies in het buitenland

An MP (Özdil, GroenLinks) asks the Minister of Education why she blocks flexible payment of the tuition credit for study abroad, questioning the fraud risk estimates as assumptions and her distrust of Dutch students. The Minister answers that costs and fraud risks outweigh benefits given budget and DUO capacity limits, that she is not opposed in principle, and points to existing options such as meeneembare studiefinanciering and scholarships.

As I concluded in the letter, I believe the costs – both the structural implementation costs and the one-off costs for process and system adjustments – and the risks of flexible payment of the tuition credit do not outweigh the benefits.

Zoals ik in de brief concludeerde, vind ik dat de kosten – zowel de structurele uitvoeringskosten als de eenmalige kosten voor de proces- en systeemaanpassingen – en de risico’s van de mogelijkheid tot flexibele uitbetaling van het collegegeldkrediet niet opwegen tegen de voordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de berichten ‘Studie Nederlands dreigt te verdwijnen door studententekort’ en ‘Studie Nederlands is alleen in het buitenland populair’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Education about reports that enrolment in Dutch-language studies has fallen sharply and that the subject may disappear at some universities. The Minister acknowledges the decline, says the causes are not fully known, notes that teacher-training intake is more stable, and points to existing sector initiatives and a planned analysis without committing to new measures.
I want to work with the relevant programmes to determine what may be causing the lagging intake.
Ik wil met de betreffende opleidingen nagaan wat de oorzaak kan zijn van de achterblijvende instroom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de inventarisatie 'Hypotheek en Studieschuld' van het Interstedelijk Studenten Overleg (ISO)

An MP asked the government why mortgage lenders still use original rather than current student debt when calculating maximum mortgages, despite a motion, and asked about DUO's information duties and the weighting factors. The government defended annuity-based weighting factors (0.45% and 0.75%) as reflecting the social character of student loans, committed to improved DUO information and a Nibud study, and found no signs of misuse of explain options.
Following the Koerhuis motion, Nibud is currently examining whether it is desirable to lower the weighting factors.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Koerhuis onderzoekt Nibud momenteel of het wenselijk is om de wegingsfactoren te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de berichten ‘Promoveren op een studentenbeurs’ en ‘Universiteit Groningen kleedt het promoveren verder uit’

An MP asked the education minister about the RUG and EUR experiment with promotiestudenten who receive a stipend instead of employment, raising concerns about lower pay, missing benefits, savings for universities, and whether the experiment should be capped or stopped. The minister answered that the positions differ legally, that a minimum stipend is not set but universities aim for a netto starting salary level, that an independent interim evaluation is underway, and that no new applications will be honoured.
I refer to the answer to question 9.
Ik verwijs naar het antwoord op vraag 9.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Özdil over het bericht ‘Gemiddelde prijs studentenkamer voor het eerst boven de 400 euro’

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about rising student rents, the causes of the housing shortage, and whether the woningwaarderingsstelsel should be mandatory for student housing. The government said it lacks exact shortage figures per city, pointed to the Landelijke monitor and a new action plan, and considered existing rent-control and Huurcommissie routes sufficient consumer protection.

As I indicated earlier in answers to parliamentary questions from MPs Van Meenen and Van Eijs (D66) and MPs Voortman and Özdil (GroenLinks), no exact figures per city can be given on student housing demand and supply.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven in antwoorden de Kamervragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Eijs (D66) (kenmerk 2017Z12177 ) en de leden Voortman en Özdil (GroenLinks) (kenmerk 2017Z15653 ) zijn er geen exacte standen per stad te geven als het gaat om de vraag naar en het aanbod van studentenhuisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht dat één op de acht universitaire opleidingen hbo-studenten weert

An MP asked whether bridging programmes (schakelprogramma's) for HBO students entering university masters should be publicly funded, given reports that one in eight university programmes excludes HBO students. The minister agreed bridging is important, said these pathways are funded from institutions' lumpsum and will be considered in the funding review, and rejected the claim that this creates a wrong incentive.
As agreed in the sector agreement with the VSNU, I am including bridging programmes in my consideration of the funding review for higher education.
Zoals ik in het sectorakkoord met de VSNU heb afgesproken neem ik de schakeltrajecten mee in het nadenken over de bekostigingsherziening in het hoger onderwijs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Voordewind en Özdil over de hogeschool Saxion, die een stuk over de Aramese genocide niet plaatst omdat er ophef en discussie over is in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Voordewind and Özdil asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Saxion's decision not to publish a student interview on the Aramean genocide due to public controversy, questioning whether such concerns justify withholding publication and whether the institution should be told so. The Minister replied that controversy alone should not be a reason to withhold publication, that the editorial decision was made independently for safety reasons, that the article was later published internally and on Saxion's website, and that she sees no need for further action or a joint statement.
I am of the view that controversy and debate should not be reasons to avoid speaking or writing about a subject.
Ik ben van mening dat ophef en discussie geen redenen mogen zijn om over een onderwerp niet te spreken of te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özdil over het bericht ‘Vicieuze cirkel: groot tekort aan verpleegkundigen, maar de opleidingen hanteren studentenstops omdat er geen stageplaatsen zijn’

GroenLinks MPs asked the health and education ministers why the nursing shortage persists despite student admission stops caused by insufficient internship places, and about internship funding, student deployment as staff, and the numerus fixus. The minister answered that regional action plans, the SectorplanPlus and the Stagefonds address the shortage, that most universities of applied sciences are dropping the numerus fixus from 2019/2020, and that the admission budget for the current year cannot be increased.
Compensating staff shortages with the full deployment of interns is not desirable.
Het compenseren van personeelstekorten met de volwaardige inzet van stagiairs is niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het rapport 'Vluchtelingen en Werk. Een nieuwe tussenbalans' van de Sociaal Economische Raad

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an SER report showing that few adult asylum seekers granted status in 2014 had paid work two and a half years later, and about follow-up actions. The Minister shares concern, points to the Taskforce Werk & Integratie, an evaluation framework, and a promised update in Q4 2018, but declines to inform parliament earlier.
No. It is easy to start experiments, but it requires careful preparation to set them up so that after evaluation they can actually say something about effectiveness.

Nee. Het is gemakkelijk om experimenten te starten maar het vergt een gedegen voorbereiding om experimenten zo in te richten dat ze daadwerkelijk na evaluatie iets over de effectiviteit kunnen zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Van der Lee over het SER-advies Energietransitie en werkgelegenheid

MPs Özdil and Van der Lee asked ministers about an SER advisory report on the energy transition and employment, including shortages of qualified staff, language barriers for status holders, and VCA certification requirements. The ministers acknowledged the labour-market challenge, pointed to retraining, a Klimaatakkoord task group, and talks with industry on certification differentiation, without committing to specific new government investment.
Where this does not lead to the desired results, there must be a good social plan.
Daar waar dit niet tot de gewenste resultaten leidt moet er een goed sociaal plan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Özdil en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat flexwerk verder oprukt, vooral onder jongeren

MPs Van Kent, Özdil and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that insecure contracts are spreading, especially among young people, and about the Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans. Minister Koolmees acknowledged the trend, said he shares concerns about its consequences for housing and family formation, and said the government will send the Wab bill to parliament in Q3 2018.
To tackle the growing divide on the labour market, I want to make it more attractive and less risky for employers to offer people a permanent contract.
Om de groeiende tweedeling op de arbeidsmarkt aan te pakken, wil ik het voor werkgevers aantrekkelijker en minder risicovol maken om mensen een vast contract aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Özdil over Jihadpreken in Nederlandse moskeeën

MPs Van Dijk and Özdil asked the minister about a reported jihad-themed sermon in a Diyanet mosque in Hoorn, its compatibility with integration, the role of Diyanet, and what the government would do about it. The minister said freedom of religion applies, no criminal offences were suspected, the local triangle had reviewed the sermon, the government does not decide sermon content absent criminal limits, and it wants ISN to operate independently of Turkey.
From the information I have received about the case in Hoorn, it appears there is no suspicion of criminal offences.
Uit de informatie die ik heb ontvangen over de zaak in Hoorn blijkt dat er géén sprake is van een verdenking van strafbare feiten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Özdil over het bericht ‘Callgirl voor Albert Heijn’

MPs Özütok and Özdil asked the minister whether reported practices at Albert Heijn distribution centres, including intimidation, unpaid on-call work and unworkable rosters, amount to labour exploitation, whether working conditions are safe and the Inspectorate monitors them, and whether OTTO's wage deductions and the WAADI are breached. The minister answered that the article does not show labour exploitation, that the Inspectorate handles complaints and no recent relevant complaints are known, that deductions are unclear but housing deductions are capped by law, and that no enforcement action or new commitment is announced.
There are no known recent reports relating to the situation described in the article.
Er zijn geen recente meldingen bekend die betrekking hebben op de in het artikel genoemde situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht ‘Kingdom of the Netherlands: Concluding Statement of the 2018 Article IV Consultation’ van het IMF

An MP asked the Social Affairs minister about IMF recommendations on wage growth, self-employed social insurance and tax treatment, and the tension with the coalition's spending plans. The minister replies that wages are rising, that wage policy is for social partners, that the government is acting against false self-employment and reducing tax deductions for the self-employed, and that additional spending is not needed given the economic upswing.
The cabinet will therefore enter into discussions with insurers to promote a better insurance offer.
Het kabinet gaat daarom in gesprek met de verzekeraars om een beter verzekeringsaanbod te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Özdil over het onderzoek 'Mind the gap: barrières en mogelijkheden voor de arbeidsparticipatie van vluchtelingenvrouwen'

MPs Özütok and Özdil asked the minister about a research report showing a large employment gap between male and female refugees and barriers for refugee women's labour participation. The minister acknowledged the gap, said the report's recommendations will feed into the integration-to-work programme and the new civic integration system, and committed to working with municipalities and Divosa on sharing effective practices.
The recommendations from this report will be taken into account in efforts to bring status holders into the labour market and in developing the new civic integration system.
De aanbevelingen uit dit rapport zullen worden meegenomen bij de inzet op toeleiding naar de arbeidsmarkt van statushouders en bij de uitwerking van het nieuwe inburgeringsstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht 'Buurtbus in de problemen door tekort aan vrijwilligers'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that a neighbourhood bus service struggles to find volunteer drivers because UWV bars unemployed people receiving WW benefits from volunteering there, and whether such volunteering should be allowed without displacing paid work. The Minister says volunteering is allowed under the WW volunteering scheme when there is no economic gain or displacement, that the scheme is being evaluated and adjusted to meet a motion, and that an amended scheme is expected in spring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het rapport inzake Voorinvesteringen en medezeggenschap in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asks the Minister of Education about the Court of Audit report on pre-investments and works council involvement in higher education, including whether only 280 of 600 million euros was demonstrably spent on stated goals and whether students should be compensated. The Minister answers that the report shows unclear definitions rather than wrongdoing, promises clearer agreements in the quality agreements, and commits to sending a letter to parliament after talks with sector bodies.
As I also indicated in my written response to the Court of Audit report, we can learn from the report for future policy.
Zoals ik ook in mijn schriftelijke reactie 2 op het Algemene Rekenkamer rapport heb aangegeven, kunnen we van het rapport leren voor toekomstig beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bindend studieadvies

MP Özdil asks the Minister of Education about the binding study advice (bindend studieadvies), citing a dissertation on student success, alternatives such as mentoring and grants, and the legal basis allowing a rejection to end enrolment. The Minister acknowledges the research, promises further study of the binding advice including input from student bodies and the CBHO ruling, but declines to make the advice non-binding or to widen the aanvullende beurs.
Therefore I will have further research conducted into the current functioning of the binding study advice.
Daarom zal ik verder onderzoek laten doen naar de huidige werking van het bindend studieadvies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht “Meer jonge moslims leven naar strikte islamitische regels. Dreigt segregatie?”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report on young Muslims living by strict Islamic rules and possible segregation, including gender segregation at a university event and pressure on moderate young Muslims. The minister answered that the government does not track such numbers, rejects segregation-promoting messages as problematic for integration, notes the university bans sex segregation in rented rooms, and points to strengthening youth resilience as part of follow-up on Salafist influence.
Based on the freedom of religion in the Netherlands, the government does not keep track of how many young Dutch Muslims live (or want to live) by strict Islamic rules.
Vanuit de in Nederland geldende vrijheid van geloof houdt de overheid niet bij hoeveel jonge Nederlandse moslims naar strikt islamitische regels (willen) leven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de lange wachttijden voor uitslagen van de inburgeringsexamens bij DUO

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs about waiting times of up to 18 weeks for civic integration exam results at DUO, and whether these delays could cause candidates to exceed their integration deadline and lose loan-to-grant conversion. The minister acknowledged the delays, said DUO extends deadlines so candidates are not penalised, and described capacity measures while admitting waiting times may rise further in the short term.
Therefore, in the coming period it will be examined which additional measures must be taken to shorten the waiting times.
Daarom zal de komende tijd worden bezien welke extra maatregelen genomen moeten worden om de wachttijden in te korten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Özdil over het bericht ‘Studentensteden sturen brandbrief over huisjesmelkers’

MPs Voortman and Özdil asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that student cities want more powers against landlords exploiting the student housing shortage, including whether students can resist excessive rents and what municipalities can do. The minister answered that tenants can use rent regulation and the Huurcommissie, launched a targeted student campaign, gave an overview of housing supply figures without per-city data, and said she is willing to discuss additional municipal powers with the aldermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Özütok over de afhandeling van de zaak Artez

Two MPs asked the ministers about the costs and lessons of the ArtEZ top-salary (WNT) case, the first enforcement of its kind, which involved a penalty order by the Education Inspectorate. The government estimates about €350,000 in public costs, says lessons are shared among WNT supervisors, promises evaluation of supervision and enforcement in 2019, and points to the annual WNT report for other cases.
In the next evaluation of the WNT, planned for 2019, supervision and enforcement will be specifically evaluated, among other things.
In de volgende evaluatie van de WNT, voorzien in 2019, zullen onder meer het toezicht en de handhaving gericht worden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil inzake het bericht ‘Student met handicap voelt zich verloren in het hoger onderwijs’ (nieuwe versie)

MP Özdil asked the Minister of Education about support for students with disabilities in higher education, including variation between institutions and municipalities and a call for an action plan on information and guidance. The minister said the 2016 student survey shows improved satisfaction, pointed to institutional autonomy and municipal discretion over study allowances, and committed to talks with stakeholders and an update on the action plan in spring 2018.
I am willing to enter into discussions with VNG, VH, VSNU, Handicap + Studie, ISO and LSVB about support for students with a disability.
Ik ben bereid in gesprek te gaan met VNG, VH, VSNU, Handicap + Studie, ISO en LSVB over de ondersteuning voor studenten met een functiebeperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Özdil over het bericht dat werknemers met een tijdelijk contract er fors op achteruit gaan bij ziekte

MPs Van Kent and Özdil asked whether the planned removal of the labour tax credit and income-dependent combination credit for sick temporary workers, who lose their jobs and move to the Sickness Benefit Act, which can cost up to 3,000 euro net per year, was a deliberate choice that punishes illness. The minister replied that the measure aligns tax treatment with unemployed people on WW, applies from 1 January 2020 only to new cases, will be elaborated with the State Secretary of Finance, and will involve social partners.
The cabinet intends to abolish the labour tax credit and the IACK from 1 January 2020 for ZW beneficiaries who no longer have an employer.
Het kabinet is voornemens om de arbeidskorting en IACK per 1 januari 2020 af te schaffen voor ZW-gerechtigden die geen werkgever (meer) hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Ellemeet over de numerus fixus in (tand)artsenopleidingen

MPs Özdil and Ellemeet asked whether the numerus fixus in dentist and doctor training causes the dentist shortage, raises specialist salaries and collective care costs, and whether more training places should be funded. The minister answered that the latest capacity study is under way with results expected end 2017 or early 2018, that the numerus fixus is considered sufficiently generous, and that integrated tariffs were introduced in 2015 to address costs, without committing to a new estimate of places.
I would prefer to await the results of this study before making statements about the number of training places needed.
Graag wacht ik de resultaten van dit onderzoek af alvorens uitspraken te doen over het aantal benodigde opleidingsplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özdil over stigmatiserende lesmethodes

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary of Education whether a primary-school reading method that describes the 'ng' sound with a Chinese-stereotype gesture is stigmatising, whether similar methods exist, and whether the government will investigate or raise awareness. The minister agrees the gesture is stigmatising, says no similar methods are known, declines to start an investigation because schools and publishers are responsible for teaching materials, and says raising awareness is up to schools and publishers, not the government.
I do not intend to start an investigation into this.
Ik ben niet van plan hier een onderzoek naar te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over 'Het nut van onderwijsovereenkomsten in het mbo'

An MP asked the Minister of Education why vocational colleges (mbo) alone must use written education agreements with students, whether this adds value, and whether student rights could instead be secured in the WEB. The minister acknowledged signals that the written form adds little, promised a study into alternatives that protects student rights while limiting administrative burden, and said the study would be sent before year end.

I will examine whether this conclusion is correct and if so, how else the legal relationship between institution and student can be shaped so that on the one hand legal protection and the student's position relative to the institution are maintained

Ik zal onderzoeken of deze conclusie juist is en zo ja, op welke andere wijze de rechtsbetrekking tussen instelling en student kan worden vormgegeven zodat enerzijds de rechtsbescherming en de positie van de student ten opzichte van de instelling in stand blijven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil inzake de verslechterde positie van promovendi

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the PNN monitor showing worsening terms for PhD candidates, including a rise in short or part-time contracts, and whether the government will act on its recommendations. The Minister disputes that working conditions have worsened, argues the data covers only contract form and duration, and says promotion work should fit within the contract period while committing only to continued dialogue and to cao-based measures.
I am always willing to exchange views with those involved about the career prospects of PhD candidates.
Ik ben altijd bereid om met betrokkenen van gedachten te wisselen over de loopbaanperspectieven van promovendi.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özdil over het bericht 'FNV: doorgeslagen flex in kinderopvang'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about union FNV's claim of excessive flexible employment in childcare, and whether public provision could bring more permanent contracts. The minister defended market functioning, attributed flexibility to cyclical demand, and declined to study conversion to a public system, leaving that to a successor.
At this moment I am not willing to examine its effects further, partly because such an assessment is for my successor.
Op dit moment ben ik niet bereid de effecten ervan verder te onderzoeken, mede omdat een dergelijke afweging aan mijn opvolger is.

The government attributes the problem to rising international and Dutch student numbers and tight housing markets, says institutions and municipalities are responsible, and promises ongoing consultations and monitoring without concrete new measures.
We are already in discussion with various knowledge institutions, Kences, the VH and the VSNU to gain more insight into the specific task regarding housing for international students

Wij zijn reeds in gesprek met verschillende kennisinstellingen, Kences, de VH en de VSNU om meer inzicht te krijgen in de specifieke opgave die er ligt voor de huisvesting van internationale studenten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht in de Volkskrant van 22 augustus jl. “Fraudejagers ministerie neuzen honderden keren in ov-chipkaarten”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how DUO checks and selects students for home visits and OV-card data use for fraud detection, given privacy law and a court ruling that the data use lacked legal basis. The minister answered that DUO acts within the Wet studiefinanciering, data protection law and ECHR Article 8, that home visits follow a protocol, and that the ruling is under appeal so no further comment is given.
An appeal has been lodged against this ruling with the Central Appeals Tribunal. Since this case is before the court, I cannot make further statements on it at this time.
Tegen deze uitspraak is hoger beroep aangetekend bij de Centrale Raad van Beroep. Aangezien deze zaak onder de rechter is, kan ik hierover op dit moment geen nadere uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özdil over het bericht 'Een groeiend aantal basisartsen moet wachten op een vervolgopleiding'

GroenLinks MPs Ellemeet and Özdil asked the ministers of Health and Education about reports that a growing number of newly graduated basic doctors cannot obtain a specialist training place, and whether government was steering this gap. The minister answered that there is no entitlement to a vervolgopleiding, that current intake is judged sufficient for most specialties, that a Capacity Council scenario analysis is pending, and that no measures are currently planned.
In assessing what is sufficient, the projections of the Capacity Council play an important role.
Bij de beoordeling van de vraag wat voldoende is, spelen de ramingen van het Capaciteitsorgaan 3 een belangrijke rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht ‘Arbeidsinspectie komt controleurs tekort’

An MP asked the minister whether inadequate labour inspection capacity (per the Inspectie Control Framework report) would cause accidents and why the shortfall was not anticipated in the budget. The minister answered that accident effects cannot be quantified, acknowledged rising workload pressure, said a new cabinet should decide on capacity, and committed only to providing information rather than immediately expanding capacity.
This cabinet has decided that the government may in principle not grow.
Dit kabinet heeft besloten dat de overheid in principe niet mag groeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Voortman over het bericht dat veel studenten een te hoge huur betalen

The minister replied that rent above the points-based level is not a violation, that contractual freedom and the Huurcommissie route apply, and that a differentiated legal fee for repeatedly losing landlords and more publicity about tenant review are planned.
When a tenant and a landlord conclude a rental agreement, the principle of freedom of contract applies.
Als een huurder en een verhuurder een huurovereenkomst sluiten, geldt het principe van contractsvrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht ‘Torenhoge boetes door niet stopzetten van studentenreisproduct’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Nationale ombudsman's report on fines imposed on former students who failed to cancel their public transport card, and whether DUO should stop reminders, referrals to bailiffs and CJIB, and how it will handle outdated email addresses and minors. The Minister rejected the claim that operators profit at students' expense, declined to halt referrals while the automatic-cancellation study runs, and deferred the remaining questions to a reply to the ombudsman's report before summer.
No, I see no reason to do so.
Nee, ik zie daartoe geen aanleiding.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tseggai en Piri over de toenemende spanningen tussen de Verenigde Staten en Venezuela

MPs Tseggai and Piri asked the government about Caribbean concerns over US strikes on alleged drug boats near Venezuela, whether the Kingdom would curb intelligence sharing or the Curaçao CSL cooperation, and how local authorities and residents are informed. The government answered that there is no acute threat to the Kingdom, that the US operation is national and outside Kingdom waters, that the Kingdom is not involved, that CSL flights are limited to unarmed surveillance under treaty, and that Aruba, Curaçao and Bonaire communicate with their own populations while the Foreign Minister keeps them informed.
The Kingdom is not involved in the current military operation of the United States.
Het Koninkrijk is niet betrokken bij de huidige militaire operatie van de Verenigde Staten.

An MP asked the State Secretary how malicious language schools could receive millions in public funds for years without oversight, and what is being done about inspections, affected learners and prevention. The State Secretary acknowledged the fraud under the old loan system, described intensified inspections and new controls, and stated that the new system and existing oversight bodies are sufficient, though no figures on affected learners are available.
I have no insight into the numbers. Those affected have mostly not reported themselves.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de aantallen. Gedupeerden hebben zich veelal niet gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over de subsidieregeling voor geadopteerden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why a subsidy scheme for intercountry adoptees' origin searches reaches only a few adoptees, how many can use it, and whether it will be revised. The State Secretary answered that searches depend on country context, that INEA is building search infrastructure, that the subsidy is not for individual trips, and that a revision is not warranted now, with the scheme evaluated before any extension after October 2027.
So far in 2025, subsidies totalling € 280,932 have been paid out.
Tot op heden is in 2025 aan subsidies uitgekeerd een bedrag van € 280.932,=.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over het bericht dat de burgemeester van Eindhoven alarm slaat over het antisemitisch geweld in Eindhoven

The MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security how the Eindhoven mayor's alarm about antisemitic violence should be addressed, what the current state of the antisemitism strategy is, how antisemitic offences are followed up, and what measures will help mayors. The Minister says the government stays engaged, points to prosecution policy and statistics, lists existing measures and offers to consult municipalities, while stressing local authorities decide on local measures.
Concrete local measures are the responsibility of local authorities, but I am always willing to engage with municipalities on tackling antisemitism.
Concrete lokale maatregelen liggen bij het lokaal gezag, maar ik ben altijd bereid in gesprek te gaan met gemeenten over de aanpak van antisemitisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over de inzage in transactiegegevens van kansspelaanbieders.

MP Tseggai asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether an illegal online gambling operator refusing transaction records to a gambling-addicted former client, and related Maltese data-protection claims, were acceptable, and whether the government would act against operators that frustrate such claims. The State Secretary answered that these are civil disputes reserved for courts, that a Overijssel court ruled the records must be provided under the GDPR, and that the government will not inform parliament about individual court cases, though conduct of licence holders may matter for integrity screening.
Given the above, I do not consider it appropriate to inform your House about all these cases, and I am also not in a position to do so.
Ik vind het gezien voorgaande niet passend om uw Kamer over al deze zaken te informeren en ben daarnaast niet in de positie om dat te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over het bericht 'School voor asielzoekers en statushouders sluit: ‘Terug naar de eenzaamheid’

An MP asked the State Secretary about the closure of a Deventer school for asylum seekers and status holders, the Iedereen aan Boord initiative, and whether language lessons should start from day one for asylum seekers. The government answered that it supports early language and labour-market integration, cites existing programmes (VrIP, Meedoenbalies, basic Dutch training), and states that municipalities decide which initiatives to partner with.
The possibilities for services aimed at guiding asylum seekers from reception towards work are being investigated.
De mogelijkheden voor dienstverlening met het oog op toeleiding naar werk voor asielzoekers vanuit de opvang, worden onderzocht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Tseggai over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie over het feit dat het Nederlands sanctiebeleid bij niet tijdig halen van het inburgeringsexamen in strijd is met het Eur

MPs Piri and Tseggai asked about the CJEU ruling that Dutch sanctions for failing the civic integration exam in time conflict with EU law, and how many statushouders were fined or had loans reclaimed. The government answered that it awaits the Council of State ruling, has paused fines and loan recovery since March 2023, and reported about 4,025 fined and about 2,100 required to repay loans under the Wi2013.
Pending the Division's ruling, my predecessor felt compelled not to take irreversible decisions in implementation.
In afwachting van de uitspraak van de Afdeling zag mijn ambtsvoorganger zich genoodzaakt in de uitvoering geen onomkeerbare besluiten te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Baarle en Tseggai over ‘de conclusies van de lokale ombudsman dat de gemeente Almere nalatig was bij het beschermen van de grondrechten van moslimgemeenschap’

MPs Van Baarle and Tseggai asked about the local ombudsman's finding that Almere municipality seriously failed to protect Muslim community fundamental rights through security analyses (krachtenveldanalyses) funded by central government. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own compliance, that the Rijk lacks a complete overview of analyses, and that the government acknowledges the unrest but has not offered formal apologies.
Municipalities are the commissioners of the analyses and the research bureau is the author. It is up to these parties involved to grant access.
Gemeenten zijn de opdrachtgever van de analyses en het onderzoeksbureau is de opsteller. Het is aan deze betrokken partijen om inzage te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over het bericht "Aantal mbo’ers loopt komende jaren verder terug ‘Niet meer alles verwachten van de zorg’'

An MP asks the Minister of Education about reports that the number of mbo students will keep falling, and about measures on dropout, late entrants, internship allowances, and funding after the shrinkage grants end in 2027. The minister acknowledges demographic decline, outlines existing action plans and a planned overhaul of the funding system, and answers each question without addressing parliamentary oversight of the executive.
That is why work is under way on changing the funding system.
Daarom wordt er gewerkt aan een wijziging van de bekostigingssystematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Tseggai over de gevolgen van een langdurig ernstig verstoorde verhouding tussen studenten en hun ouders voor de hoogte van de aanvullende studiebeurs

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education whether the Centrale Raad van Beroep interprets too strictly the exemption letting students with unreachable or refusing parents obtain the full supplementary grant, and what support exists for minors. The Minister says he is studying the article and jurisprudence, will inform parliament before summer 2025, notes that about half of loskoppeling requests are granted, and refers to courts' independence.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai  over arbeidscontracten voor sekswerkers

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a Belgian-style law giving sex workers employment contracts and social security would suit the Netherlands, and whether he would consult stakeholders on it. The minister answered that a Dutch law on the Belgian model is not currently warranted, that the opting-in scheme is the preferred route, and that he will discuss the matter with stakeholders and inform parliament in the autumn.
A Dutch law modelled on the Belgian law is therefore not currently a realistic option.
Een Nederlandse wet naar het voorbeeld van de Belgische wet ligt momenteel dan ook niet in de rede.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Tseggai en Lahlah over het bericht 'Kamermotie over onderzoek naar Nederlanders met migratieachtergrond maakt veel los', en het verzoek van het lid Timmermans om een brief te o

MPs Timmermans, Tseggai and Lahlah asked the cabinet whether it still stands by its statement that no opinions of people with a migration background would be recorded, given the Becker motion requiring research into people with a migration background, and how this fits with the non-discrimination principle. The cabinet answered that the SCP research will cover the whole population without distinguishing by migration background, that it sees no break in cabinet policy, and that it will consider how to provide the requested information within legal frameworks.
The cabinet observes no break in the unity of cabinet policy.
Het kabinet constateert geen breuk in de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over vergunningverlening aan escortbureaus

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security why a Tilburg escort agency received a licence despite its founder's prior conviction for human trafficking, and whether foreign convictions can be weighed in Bibob screening. The minister agrees such convictions are in principle relevant, explains the Bibob framework and information-sharing options, says the municipality found nothing warranting refusal, and declines to comment on the specific case as licensing is local.
Granting licences to sex businesses is a local matter.
Het verlenen van vergunningen aan seksbedrijven betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over de toenemende discriminatie tegen moslims

An MP asked ministers about rising discrimination against Muslims, citing an EU survey showing 55% of Dutch Muslims report discrimination, and about school discrimination, national anti-discrimination policy, and training measures. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to a forthcoming national study on Muslim discrimination, outlined the division of responsibilities across ministries, and referred to existing programmes and a future action plan without committing to new binding measures.
On the basis of the findings of the study, it will be considered which specific additional measures can be taken to prevent discrimination against Muslims.
Op grond van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek wordt bezien welke specifieke maatregelen aanvullend getroffen kunnen worden om moslimdiscriminatie te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Boomsma, Tseggai en Diederik van Dijk over de aanpak van klanten die betaalde seks hebben met minderjarige slachtoffers van seksuele uitbuiting

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police and prosecution capacity for pursuing clients who buy sex from minors, after the OM Limburg reportedly declined to target them, and about sentencing, online age verification on sex-advertisement sites, and effective enforcement. The Minister denied any national policy of not pursuing clients, cited the higher statutory maxima and capacity investments, and committed to talks with police, the OM and advertising platforms, plus a policy response to the CKM report before the Christmas recess.
There is no decision that no capacity will be deployed in any case for the investigation of customers of human trafficking.
Er is geen besluit dat er sowieso geen capaciteit wordt ingezet voor de opsporing van klanten van mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over de jaarcijfers Mensenhandel 2023

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the 2023 human trafficking figures, including the rise in victims in home prostitution, falling suspect numbers, rising dismissals of cases, and low prosecution for labour exploitation. The minister answered that reporting bodies and investigative capacity are being strengthened, a sex-work bill and an amended trafficking offence are in progress, and the Action Plan will be monitored, but gave no new binding commitments beyond existing plans.
National policy is therefore aimed at increasing victims' willingness to report.
Het landelijk beleid is er dan ook op gericht om de meldingsbereidheid onder slachtoffers te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over het bericht 'Stage, studie, bijbaan en thuis: mbo-student ervaart stress door opeenstapeling'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a report on vocational students (mbo) experiencing stress from accumulating obligations such as internships, studies, part-time jobs and family, including questions on unpaid internships, discrimination, guidance and assessment. The minister answered that the issues are concerning, pointed to the Stagepact, the planned study on a statutory minimum internship allowance due December 2024, anti-discrimination measures, and a forthcoming policy response and progress letters.
I find it a worrying finding that vocational students experience performance pressure and stress because they have many different responsibilities.
Ik vind het een zorgelijke constatering dat mbo-studenten prestatiedruk en stress ervaren doordat zij veel verschillende verantwoordelijkheden hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Tseggai over ‘Opnieuw meer jongeren van middelbare school of mbo af zonder diploma’

MPs Pijpelink and Tseggai asked the Minister of Education about a report that early school leaving without diploma rose again, including causes such as mental health and the need for income, and what the government will do to reduce it. The Minister acknowledges the rise, states the government keeps the action plan and 18,000 target for 2026 (calling it ambitious), points to planned legislation on support toward sustainable work, mental health measures, and an ongoing study into a statutory minimum internship allowance.
The cabinet adheres to the early school leaving action plan and the target agreed in the Werkagenda mbo of 18,000 new early school leavers in 2026.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan het actieplan vsv en de in de Werkagenda mbo afgesproken doelstelling van 18.000 nieuwe voortijdig schoolverlaters in 2026.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Tseggai over het Advies van het college voor de Rechten van de Mens om de discriminatiegrond ‘opleiding’ op te nemen in de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling

MPs Stultiens and Tseggai asked the ministers about the Human Rights Institute's advice to add education level as a protected ground under the equal treatment act, and about government support for vocational education. The minister acknowledged the advice, said the government will respond in a cabinet reaction, will study the advice together with the Interior Minister, and will examine socio-economic status as a ground separately.
I will study this advice carefully, together with my colleague the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal dit advies, samen met mijn collega-minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, goed bestuderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai inzake de bescherming van sekswerkers

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Justice Minister about violence against sex workers, the Ugly Mugs report, and the government's position on six recommendations including decriminalisation. The minister acknowledged the signals, said police lack reliable data on victims who are sex workers, agreed that strict rules can create vulnerability, and said most recommendations match the existing 'Aanpak' and that progress will be reported in autumn.
In the autumn I will inform the House by letter about the progress of this.
In het najaar informeer ik uw Kamer middels een brief over de voortgang hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over het bericht dat opvallend veel scholieren online gokken, gesteld op 5 juli jl.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that many schoolchildren gamble online, whether minors use others' accounts or illegal foreign sites, how age checks can be circumvented, and how to curb illegal operators and protect minors. The State Secretary says the government takes the signal seriously but cannot verify the picture, reports strict age verification at licensed operators, describes Ksa enforcement against illegal offers, and outlines prevention and awareness programmes while promising to examine how minors reach illegal operators.
I therefore cannot verify the picture sketched on the basis of the available data, but I take this signal extremely seriously.
Ik kan het geschetste beeld dus niet verifiëren op basis van de beschikbare data, maar ik neem dit signaal uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Tseggai en Kathmann  over opleidingsniveau als risico-indicator voor fraude

MPs asked whether education level (mbo, hbo, wo) was used as a fraud risk indicator, including by DUO, and whether it is ethically justified given government goals to value all forms of education equally. The government acknowledged the former DUO risk profile, said no fraud-related algorithm in the register uses education type, stated that education type is generally an unjustified criterion and that DUO has stopped using it, and referred the broader question to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Ouwehand, Teunissen en Tseggai over het bericht ' Yeşilgöz haalt uit naar Tim Hofman na X-bericht over ME'

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether her social media post questioning journalist Tim Hofman about police treatment of ME (riot police) demonstrators harmed press freedom and journalist safety, and whether she would retract it. The minister answered that press freedom is a great good, that her post was a counter-question about possible police incidents and did not limit press freedom, and that any alleged improper police conduct is investigated.

I also indicated in my post that if there were questions about, or if there were improper conduct by the police, an investigation is always conducted and appropriate measures are taken where necessary.

Ik heb in mijn bericht ook aangegeven dat wanneer er vragen zouden zijn over, of sprake zou zijn van onjuist handelen van de politie, daar altijd onderzoek naar wordt gedaan en waar nodig passende maatregelen worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over uitbuiting van sekswerkers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports of agencies recruiting Eastern European sex workers through misleading advertisements, and about trafficking, controls, cross-border measures, a national police trafficking team and the criminal law revision. The government answered that trafficking is punishable, that municipalities oversee the sex industry with police involvement, that tackling intermediaries is hard, that a national coordination point and EU cooperation exist, and that the revised trafficking article is pending with a bill expected this spring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Klaver, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over Russische desinformatiecampagnes

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about Russian disinformation campaigns, including Czech intelligence reports that Voice of Europe served as a conduit for Russian payments to Dutch politicians, and whether the Czech government was asked to share that information and whether further investigation and capacity investment are planned. The answer declines to answer in writing and asks that the questions be put orally in the plenary debate instead.
I request that you put the questions orally during the debate on the report that, according to the Czech secret service, Russia paid cash to Dutch and European politicians
Ik verzoek u de vragen mondeling te stellen tijdens het debat over het bericht dat volgens de Tsjechische geheime dienst Rusland cash betaalde aan Nederlandse en Europese politici
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Tseggai over restitutie les- en cursusgeld mbo-studenten

MPs Westerveld and Tseggai asked why mbo students, unlike hbo and wo students, generally do not receive automatic refunds of tuition fees when they leave their studies early, and about related follow-up on a promised exploration, the use of unrefunded fees, and support needs. The minister answered that mbo refunds are available only under specific conditions such as serious illness, that the difference reflects the aim of encouraging a starting qualification, and that changing the policy is not feasible for 2024–2025 and is left to the next cabinet.
It is not feasible to realise this for the 2024–2025 study year.
Het is niet haalbaar om dit te realiseren voor het studiejaar 2024–2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over de Russische desinformatiecampagne via sociale media in Duitsland

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about a reported Russian disinformation campaign on X in Germany and whether similar campaigns target the Netherlands, including the adequacy of Dutch law, the EU Digital Services Act and platform responsibility. The minister acknowledged foreign interference risks, said no concrete Dutch cases were identified in the election, pointed to EU and NATO information sharing, announced a review of whole-of-government disinformation policy, and noted the European Commission opened a formal DSA procedure against X.

In its letter of 9 November 2023 the cabinet already announced it would examine whether, and if so how, the whole-of-government approach to disinformation about the core democratic processes should be strengthened.

In de brief 9 november 2023 heeft het kabinet daarom al aangekondigd te onderzoeken of, en zo ja hoe, de Rijksbrede aanpak van desinformatie over de kernprocessen van de democratie versterkt moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tseggai en Maatoug over het bericht ‘Hoe Netflix zijn recordwinst laat belasten: in vele ‘winstjes’ hier en daar’

MPs Tseggai and Maatoug asked whether Netflix's Dutch-based profits are shifted abroad, whether this undermines the investment obligation for streaming services, and about openness over Netflix's tax rulings. The State Secretary answered that profit allocation follows the arm's-length principle and BEPS rules, that the investment obligation is tied to Dutch revenue rather than profit, that he has no insight into Netflix's investments, and that individual tax files cannot be discussed under tax secrecy.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tseggai en De Hoop over het bericht 'Woondiscriminatie: Studentenhuis vaak niet beschikbaar voor mbo’ers'

MPs Tseggai and De Hoop asked how the government responds to reports that student housing is often unavailable to MBO students, and whether education level should become a protected discrimination ground. The minister answered that most social student housing corporations admit MBO students, pledged to urge the remaining ones to do so, and will request advice from the College voor de Rechten van de Mens on banning distinction by education level.
All partners in student housing, by signing the LAS, have endorsed the accessibility of education for MBO, HBO and WO alike and stand for equal opportunity in education.

Alle samenwerkingspartners bij studentenhuisvesting hebben met het ondertekenen van het LAS de toegankelijkheid van onderwijs, voor zowel mbo, hbo als wo, onderschreven en staan voor kansengelijkheid in het onderwijs.

requests the government to carry out as soon as possible the study into the financial consequences of postponing and/or abolishing the CO2 levy

SGP MPs Stoffer and Flach asked whether Ahold Delhaize closed 25 stores in Serbia due to a retail margin cap, whether the measure breaches the internal market and the Stabilisation and Association Agreement, and what the government will do. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Netherlands has raised concerns repeatedly with Serbian ministers, judges the measure market-distorting and at odds with EU accession criteria, and has asked the Commission to raise it, but did not commit to any formal sanction.
The cabinet considers the measure market-distorting and believes it is at odds with the economic criteria for EU accession.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de brandbrief van burgemeesters inzake de wolf

MP Flach (SGP) asks the state secretary about a letter from Gelderland mayors on increasing wolf encounters with humans and dogs, and whether mayors have enough emergency powers and whether provinces and the EU wolf population framework justify earlier intervention. The state secretary acknowledges the concerns, points to pending national rules defining problem wolves and a planned additional study on Dutch habitat suitability, but says the powers of mayors are considered sufficient for now and no extension is planned.

In consultations with the relevant ministries and the Association of Dutch Municipalities and the Dutch Association of Mayors on possible additional emergency powers, it emerged that the powers of provincial executives and mayors in principle suffice, and that extending mayoral powers in cases no longer acute would cut across the statutory responsibilities of provincial executives.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de recente update van AERIUS

An SGP MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether the RIVM's recent AERIUS update wrongly failed to correct for likely overestimation of dry nitrogen deposition in dune areas (Solleveld measurements), and what this means for local ammonia concentrations and permitting, such as housing projects in western Netherlands. The Minister answers that RIVM is independent and decides on model methods, that the 2014 Solleveld measurements are not suitable for calibration but a new measurement campaign runs to end-2026, that halving deposition velocity would raise concentrations 15-20% but there is no scientific basis yet for that, and that the DEPAC model will be adjusted only once sufficient consistent evidence exists.

Er is op dit moment echter geen inhoudelijke (wetenschappelijke) onderbouwing om de depositiesnelheid te halveren.

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Rotterdam wrongly barred a marriage registrar from any reference to God or faith during ceremonies, and raised equal treatment, freedom of expression and language questions. The minister answered that the registrar's discretion is bounded by the anti-discrimination rules and the Civil Code, that supervision of the speech is a municipal matter, and that the courts or the Equal Treatment Commission must judge specific cases.

It is not for me to test the conditions set in a specific case at a marriage ceremony against the prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion; that is for the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights or the judge.

Het is niet aan mij om de voorwaarden die in een concreet geval bij een huwelijksvoltrekking zijn gesteld te toetsen aan het verbod van onderscheid op grond van godsdienst; dat is aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens of de rechter.
