MPs Flach and Grinwis asked the government about the impact of ETS-2 and the green gas blending obligation on greenhouse growers, whether the sector agreed to an opt-in, why an exemption for glasshouse horticulture is not feasible, and how compensation and the CO2 levy will be set. The minister answered that an opt-in with full cost compensation is unavoidable for enforceability reasons, that the blending obligation is reduced and delayed, that a new tariff study is pending, and that a compensation scheme and SDE++ adjustments are still being worked out.

The cabinet remains in discussion with the covenant partners, trusting that the sector's concerns about reasonable and timely compensation can be resolved on the basis of the compensation scheme being worked out.

Het kabinet blijft hierover in gesprek met de convenantspartijen in het vertrouwen dat de zorgen vanuit de sector over de redelijke en tijdige compensatie weg te nemen zijn op basis van de uitgewerkte compensatieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de beoordeling van verslechtering in Natura 2000 gebieden

MP Flach (SGP) asks how the Habitats Directive's deterioration test should be applied in nature goal analyses, including whether critical deposition values are treated as targets and how soil monitoring should be improved. The Secretary of State answers at length, largely by reference to existing guidance, the Ecological Authority's advice and planned improvements, while stating that the court's reasoning on critical deposition values is accepted as it stands.
The Ecological Authority checks whether the nature goal analyses draw correct conclusions about developments in the protected nature values.
De Ecologische Autoriteit toetst of in de natuurdoelanalyses op de juiste wijze conclusies worden getrokken over de ontwikkelingen in de beschermde natuurwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de aanval van een wolf op een hardloopster

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister about a wolf attack on a jogger in the Hoge Veluwe park, the slow DNA testing, and the roles and liability of mayors and provinces in dealing with problem wolves. The government confirmed the wolf identification, explained the legal powers of mayors and provinces, said it is working to strengthen the mayor's role and to codify the problem-wolf definition by general administrative order, and declined to answer liability questions beyond general principles.
I am currently looking into what is possible to strengthen the role of the mayor.
Ik bezie op dit moment wat er mogelijk is, om de rol van de burgemeester te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Grinwis en Flach over de voortgang van het besluitvormingstraject rondom de natuurcompensatie Voordelta

MPs Vedder, Grinwis and Flach asked the State Secretary about the progress of the alternative nature compensation process for the Voordelta, including conditions for a proposal, EC approval, compensation funds, and impacts on the sand eel fishery. The State Secretary answered that stakeholders are working toward a broadly supported proposal, that the European Commission will test it against the 2003 compensation plan, that some correspondence with Brussels is confidential, and that about 27 million euro is available for flanking measures, though no impact estimate is yet possible.
Communication with member states from the institutions of the European Union is confidential.
Communicatie met lidstaten vanuit de instellingen van de Europese Unie is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Stoffer en Flach over het bericht Cryptomijnen in een land onder hoogspanning

MPs Van Dijk, Stoffer and Flach asked the ministers whether Dutch and EU rules apply to Dutch firms mining crypto in Ethiopia, and about its benefits, its effect on the local population's electricity, and the government's moral view. The minister answered that OECD and UN business standards apply, that crypto mining brings foreign currency but little direct benefit to the population, and that no additional legislation is needed.
The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally to apply the OECD Guidelines on responsible business conduct and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal opereren dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen inzake maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het RIVM-advies om geen particuliere eieren meer te eten

MP Flach (SGP) asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Agriculture about the RIVM advice to stop eating eggs from backyard hens, why locational factors and the English-only report were not examined or published in Dutch, and what keepers can do to reduce PFAS uptake. The government answered that the wider investigation into PFAS sources is ongoing, that findings on bio-accumulation via worms and housing options are expected by year end, and that a Dutch public summary will follow later this year.
The RIVM report is part of a longer-running investigation aimed at identifying the sources of elevated PFAS levels in eggs.
Het RIVM-rapport is onderdeel van een langer lopend onderzoekstraject met als doel de bronnen van verhoogde PFAS-gehaltes in eieren te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de relatie tussen pachtnormen en teeltopbrengsten

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary whether regional lease norms, based on farm accounting data (BIN), reflect crop yields and whether the sample, selection and treatment of side income are representative. The State Secretary largely rejected the concerns, defended the sample's representativeness and the Pachtprijzenbesluit 2007, and promised a broader review of the lease regulation without committing to concrete changes now.
I therefore have no reason to doubt the representativeness.
Ik heb daarom geen reden om te twijfelen aan de representativiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over het bericht dat de Nationale Politie en het ministerie van SZW en VWS iftars organiseren

Two SGP MPs asked whether police and ministries hold iftar gatherings during Ramadan, questioning their neutrality given a reported in-uniform prayer, their costs, and why Islamic holidays dominate. The government answered that police and ministries organise gatherings for diversity and inclusion, that costs are absorbed in existing budgets, that in-uniform prayer is undesirable while attending iftars is acceptable, and that no nationwide policy governs which days are marked.
A call to prayer in uniform does not seem to me to fit with a police force that projects neutrality.
Een oproep tot gebed in uniform vind ik niet passen bij een politie die neutraliteit uitstraalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het eindrapport 'Ammoniak van Zee'

An SGP MP asked the minister about the RIVM final report 'Ammoniak van Zee', which found sea ammonia cannot explain much of the coastal measurement gap, and about whether deposition models in coastal areas will be corrected, the Solleveld measurements, and speeding up model adjustments for permitting. The minister answered that the measurement correction has fallen by 20%, that the model adjustments will reduce the gap by 20% without wholesale changes, that new Solleveld measurements will yield results no earlier than end-2026, and that a dry-deposition correction is not realistic in the short term.
The cabinet wants to limit the use of models in this dossier as much as possible and rely more on measurements.
Het kabinet wil het gebruik van modellen in dit dossier zoveel mogelijk beperken en meer uitgaan van metingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor, Van Nispen en Flach over het bericht 'Ambtenaren verwachten ontevreden VNG na Kamerbrief'

MPs Chakor, Van Nispen and Flach asked why the government did not implement a motion requiring consultation with municipalities and provinces (VNG and IPO) on the new GDP-based normering system and its effects on the municipal and provincial funds. The State Secretary answered that consultations took place in 2024-2025, that government and local authorities hold different views on 2026 finances, that the matter was discussed in the BOFv of 6 March, and that the Minister will inform parliament before the 26 March debate.

Between November 2024 and February 2025 there were both administrative and civil-service consultations with the subnational governments on the financial effects and the pros and cons of the new calculation method for task changes.

Er is in de periode november 2024 tot februari 2025 zowel bestuurlijk als ambtelijk gesproken met de medeoverheden over de financiële effecten en de voor- en nadelen van de nieuwe berekeningswijze van taakmutaties.

Antwoord op vragen die leden Aartsen, Inge van Dijk, Vijlbrief, Rikkers en Flach over het bericht “Hoge Raad: bij beoordeling of sprake is van arbeidsovereenkomst geldt geen rangorde tussen de mee te wegen omstandigheden

Five MPs asked the minister how the Supreme Court ruling that no hierarchy exists among factors in classifying employment, including entrepreneurship, affects the online tool hetjuistecontract.nl, Belastingdienst practice, government hiring of freelancers and the VBAR bill. The minister answered that the tool already covers external entrepreneurship, that no change or takedown is needed, that the Belastingdienst weighs all factors, and that the VBAR follow-up will be communicated soon.
Because, in line with the Supreme Court ruling, all factors are weighed in the web module, there is no reason to take the web module offline.
Omdat, in lijn met de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad, alle gezichtspunten worden meegewogen in de webmodule, is er geen reden om de webmodule offline te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het bericht '1,4 miljard pakketjes van buitenlandse webshops naar Nederland: 'Onhoudbaar''

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government will respond to supervisors' warnings that the flood of small parcels from Chinese webshops is uncontrollable and that most such goods fail EU rules. The minister answered that the government takes the problem seriously, cited EU product rules, the DSA and a Commission e-commerce communication, and committed to lobbying Brussels for an in-depth study and to continued consultation with supervisors.
Given the scale and social importance of this problem, I will continue to actively press for it in Brussels to keep it on the Commission's agenda and develop effective policy.

Gezien de omvang en het maatschappelijke belang van deze problematiek, zal ik mij actief blijven inzetten in Brussel om het probleem op de agenda van de Commissie te behouden en effectief beleid te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de berichten ‘Driekwart gemeenten krijgt begroting niet rond, keuzes uitgesteld’ en ‘Zuid-Holland stemt in met begroting met groot gat’

MPs Flach (SGP) asked the Minister of Interior about press reports that only a quarter of municipalities can present a balanced budget and that Zuid-Holland approved a budget with a large gap. The minister said municipalities' finances are under pressure, that provincial supervisors check structural balance but multi-year deficits are not yet decisive, that the reserve rules were loosened and that she is exploring additional supervisory criteria to report in Q2 2025.
I expect to be able to inform the House further on this in the second quarter of 2025.
Naar verwachting kan ik uw Kamer hierover nader informeren in het tweede kwartaal van 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach, Van Campen, Graus en Pierik over de dure importcontroles bij groente en fruit

MPs from SGP, VVD, PVV and BBB asked why residue controls on imported fruit and vegetables at the national reference lab WFSR are so expensive compared with private labs in Belgium, and whether private labs could be allowed to do them. The government answered that the NVWA cost-recovery tariffs cover sampling, transport and lab analysis, that WFSR is non-profit and independence rules rule out private labs for now, and that a study and consultation with industry are underway with results promised before summer.
I will also commission a research bureau to look into this further. Your House will be informed about this before the summer.
Ook zal ik een onderzoeksbureau opdracht geven om dit nader uit te zoeken. Uw Kamer zal hier voor de zomer over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de uitspraken over het aanmerken van het spuiwater uit de stikstofkraker als dierlijke meststof

An MP asked whether ammonia-stripper effluent should be treated as animal manure under the Nitrates Directive, questioning the EC's position on it. The minister answers that the stripper effluent remains animal manure because it results from active processing of manure, that the EC has interpreted it as subject to the 170 kg N/ha limit, and that no relevant EU Court case law exists.
This therefore makes it a product of animal manure and it falls under the definition of animal manure in the Nitrates Directive.
Daarmee is het een product van dierlijke mest en valt het onder de begripsbepaling van dierlijke mest in de Nitraatrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de grondgebondenheidseis voor melkveestallen in de Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij

MP Flach asked whether the full grondgebondenheid requirement for dairy barns in the Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij, which gates MIA/Vamil tax benefits, blocks barn renewal for welfare, emissions and fire safety, and whether it should be relaxed. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the Milieulijst 2025 now judges grondgebondenheid only on phosphate, and committed to consult colleagues on changing the condition in the Milieulijst 2026.
I will consult with my colleagues of Infrastructure and Water Management and Finance to see whether this can be given a different form in the Milieulijst 2026.
Ik ga in overleg met mijn collega's van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en Financiën om te bezien of deze in de Milieulijst 2026 op een andere wijze invulling kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het intrekken van vergunningen bij onderbezetting van stallen

An MP asked the ministers whether they were aware of Council of State rulings requiring municipalities to justify not withdrawing unused livestock-housing permits, and whether this creates legal uncertainty for farmers. The minister said the duty to give reasons was not tightened, that good reasoning is possible, and that he will talk with the VNG and Omgevingsdienst NL about ensuring legal certainty within the existing framework.

Therefore I will, possibly together with my colleagues of Housing and Spatial Planning and of Public Transport and Environment, enter into discussion about permits with the VNG and Omgevingsdienst NL to see what is needed to secure the desired legal certainty in practice.

Daarom ga ik, eventueel samen met mijn collega van Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening (VRO) en mijn collega van Openbaar Vervoer en Milieu (OVM), in gesprek over vergunningen met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) en met de Omgevingsdienst NL om te bezien wat er nodig is om in de praktijk de gewenste rechtszekerheid daarvan te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Flach over de versterkte gebedsoproepen door moskeeën

MPs Eerdmans and Flach asked the Minister of Interior about enhanced call-to-prayer broadcasts from mosques, including their frequency, number of complaints and legal basis. The minister answered that no data on mosques, frequency or complaints is yet available, that a fact-finding trajectory is underway to inform future rules, and that the practice is a constitutionally protected connex right subject to necessity and proportionality.
No, we do not yet have this information at this time.
Nee, wij beschikken op dit moment nog niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de dramatische terugval in mossel- en kreeftenvangsten in de Oosterschelde

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Agriculture, Fisheries and Nature about the sharp drop in sellable lobster and mussel catches in the Oosterschelde, including whether rent on mussel plots could be reduced. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, outlined a four-year research programme starting January 2025, and said the possibility of financial support for the sector is still being examined with a promise to inform parliament.
This investigation is still ongoing. I will inform your House about this as soon as possible.
Dit onderzoek is nog gaande. Ik zal uw Kamer hierover zo spoedig mogelijk nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over groeiend aantal boeren dat wordt benaderd door onder meer drugscriminelen

Two MPs asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about a reported rise in farmers approached by drug criminals offering use of barns, and what is being done. The minister acknowledged the problem, said the data does not show a rising trend, and described existing measures (advisors, Veilig Buitengebied, reporting lines) while declining to give police-level detail on how cases are handled.
This specific theme is also not registered as a separate category by the police.
Dit specifieke thema wordt ook niet als aparte categorie geregistreerd door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het bericht ‘Gemeenten dreigen miljarden mis te lopen’

An MP asked the minister whether municipalities and provinces lose hundreds of millions yearly because the fund normering underestimates inflation, and whether the compensation should be set earlier. The minister replied that the bbp-based system is stable and transparent, that it gives no direct inflation compensation, that the government sees no reason to change it, and that it will keep discussing financing with the local government bodies.
In view of the above, the cabinet sees no reason to change the system.
Het kabinet ziet gezien het bovenstaande geen reden om de systematiek te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Flach over blauwtong

MP Flach asks the agriculture minister about the current spread and severity of bluetongue (BTV-3), the effectiveness of vaccines and whether vaccination limits transmission, alternative management measures, and support for the sheep sector. The minister reports 6,352 BTV-3 infections, partial protection from vaccines with no effectiveness estimate yet, limited evidence on vaccination reducing spread, identified protective factors (early shearing, ventilation), and a commissioned study into the sheep sector's finances to be completed by end December.
I cannot give an estimate of the effectiveness now, but the experts' impression is that there is indeed protection against symptoms.
Ik kan nu geen inschatting geven van de effectiviteit, maar de indruk van de deskundigen is dat er wel degelijk sprake is van bescherming tegen verschijnselen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het intrekken van vergunningen bij onderbezetting van stallen

An MP asked the ministers whether the Omgevingswet's one-year period for partially withdrawing permits for underoccupied barns (versus three years under the Wabo) puts farms in Beter Leven programmes at risk of losing permit capacity, and whether rules should change. The minister answered that withdrawal is discretionary for the competent authority after a weighing of interests, that the shorter period is not meant to increase withdrawals, and that no rule change is planned while monitoring continues.
It is up to the competent authority to weigh the interests.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om een belangenafweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het bericht ‘Astronomische rentes, nul toezicht: kasvoorschotten nekken kleine ondernemers’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of very high effective interest rates on business cash advances and the lack of supervision by the AFM or DNB, and whether these should be regulated or banned. The minister acknowledges the high rates but argues cash advances meet a real need, relies on a voluntary industry code of conduct and a planned financing hub, and rejects a total ban or rate cap while committing to urge providers to join the code.
It is indeed correct that specific rules and financial supervision are lacking in this business lending market.
Het klopt inderdaad dat specifieke regels en financieel toezicht op deze zakelijke financieringsmarkt ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de regeling Samenwerking in veenweidegebieden en Natura 2000 overgangsgebieden

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the first application round of the scheme for cooperation in peat meadow areas and Natura 2000 transition zones, including oversubsidy risks for already-extensive (e.g. organic) farms, state aid compliance, and design choices. The minister gave figures on applications, budgets requested versus available, and said the conditions will be reviewed before the next round, while defending the calculation method and rejecting some concerns.
That is why I intend to tighten the requirements for reducing livestock nitrogen excretion in the next opening.
Daarom ben ik voornemens bij de volgende openstelling de eisen voor de reductie van stikstofdierexcretie aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Flach over de toepassing van de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling (BOR) in de agrarische sector

Two MPs from the SGP asked the Minister of Agriculture about how the business succession scheme (BOR) applies to crop-lease arrangements in agriculture, including whether the Grondkamer's rules on necessary crop rotation and the exclusion of grass and maize are fair to landowners. The Minister confirmed the rules, explained the rationale for excluding grass and maize, and declined to extend BOR treatment to one-sided crop leases before a planned revision of the Pachtwet.
When the crop lease regime was created, the legislature determined that it was not intended for maize and grass.
Bij de totstandkoming van de teeltpacht is door de wetgever bepaald dat het regime niet bedoeld is voor mais en gras
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach, Vedder, Postma, Grinwis en Pierik over de visserij en ETS-2

Five MPs asked whether fisheries should be brought under the EU ETS-2 carbon market and what the consequences would be for the sector. The minister answers that the cabinet has decided not to opt fisheries in, citing lack of a viable path for the sector, EU state-aid limits and unequal competition, and that a WECR impact study will be sent to Parliament.
The cabinet has now decided not to bring fisheries under ETS2 through the opt-in.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om visserij niet onder het ETS2 te brengen middels de opt-in
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over het bericht 'Halsema wilde Extinction Rebellion bij blokkade A10 'zoveel mogelijk tegemoet komen''

MPs Diederik van Dijk and Flach asked whether the Amsterdam mayor's tolerance of a banned Extinction Rebellion motorway blockade on the A10, and the prosecution policy of not pursuing single Wom offences, weakens enforcement of the law. The ministers answered that the mayor has primary responsibility for demonstration rules, that the public prosecutor decides on prosecution case by case, that six demonstrators received 200 euro penalties, and that the ministry will address the legal framework in a letter on the right to demonstrate.
We take this responsibility seriously and have therefore reported to your House extensively on it in the letter on the right to demonstrate that you recently received.
Wij nemen deze verantwoordelijkheid serieus en hebben uw Kamer hier dan ook uitgebreid over bericht in de Kamerbrief over het demonstratierecht die u onlangs heeft ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Flach over de brief ‘Looptijd EHF project’

Two MPs asked the agriculture minister about a letter from a Zeeland water storage partnership requesting an extension because a 20-month wait between application and grant cut the project's runtime by about half, partly linked to ELFPO funding. The minister acknowledged the delay, attributed it to an overspent crisis-era EHF scheme and budget reshuffling, said the funding is not from ELFPO, pointed to the 2025 deadlines and the new CAP period, and declined to comment on the pending objection procedure.
The project in question is the subject of an objection procedure, so no statement can be made on it now.
Het voorliggende project is onderwerp van een bezwaarprocedure, daarom kan daar nu geen uitspraak over gedaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Milieuorganisatie stapt naar de rechter om renovatie Binnenhof te stoppen’

MPs Flach and Van Dijk asked about an environmental group's court appeal to halt the Binnenhof renovation over nitrogen permits, its standing as a cooperative, and possible delays. The minister answered that the appeal is pending before the court, that a nature permit was granted in January 2024, that delay effects will be reported in the next progress report, and that the court decides on standing.
I cannot go into the substance of this appeal procedure or the arguments to be made, because this case is before the court.
Op de inhoud van deze beroepsprocedure en de te voeren argumenten kan ik nu niet ingaan, omdat deze zaak voorligt bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het bericht ‘Kinderdagverblijven en bso's gebruiken vaker trucs om omzet te verhogen’

An MP asked the minister whether childcare centres and after-school care use tricks such as billing extra hours and pressuring parents into contract changes, and what the government will do about it. The minister says such practices are undesirable, points parents to complaint routes and a planned transparency and monitoring approach, and defers the new financing system's safeguards to the next cabinet.
I intend to clarify the regulations on this point.
Daarom ben ik voornemens de regelgeving op dit punt te verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de gevolgen van de korting op het tongquotum

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the socio-economic impact of a 60% cut to the North Sea sole quota, the reach of fishing vessel decommissioning, financial support options, sole stock assessment uncertainties, and the cumulative ecological effects of offshore wind farms on fish. The minister answered that the Netherlands raised the sole cut repeatedly but is not at the negotiating table, that impact assessments are pending from Wageningen Economic Research, that some decommissioned quotas will be made available to active fishers via producer organisations, that a new financial support scheme is largely legally blocked for now, and that research on wind farm impacts continues, though commercial species are not yet covered.
It is not possible to make the consequences of the high cut visible for individual fishers.
Het is niet mogelijk om de gevolgen van de hoge korting inzichtelijk te maken voor individuele vissers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het wetenschappelijke vangstadvies voor tong

Pieter Flach (SGP) asked the minister why she warned of a possible zero sole catch advice for 2025 citing Wageningen Marine Research, and whether that claim was justified. The minister answered that she nuanced her earlier statement, that ICES's advice implies a 34-60% cut and a possible further decline, and promised to keep communicating carefully.
I have nuanced my earlier explanation in the debate of 7 December.
heb ik mijn eerdere toelichting in het debat van 7 december jongstleden genuanceerd

m: Motie van het lid Laçin c.s. over lagere en beweegbare varianten bij vervanging van de Paddepoelsterbrug en de Gerrit Krolburg
Asks the government to include lower and movable bridge variants in the further design of the Paddepoelsterbrug and Gerrit Krolbrug replacements.
Include the variants for lower and movable bridges as an option for further development.
de varianten voor lagere en beweegbare bruggen op te nemen als mogelijkheid voor verdere uitwerking
Motie van de leden Postma en Schonis over in kaart brengen van toekomstige geluidsbelasting bij uitbreidingsplannen rond Den Haag
Asks the government to map future noise levels from expansion plans around The Hague and report options for noise-reducing measures to the House.
requests the government to map the future noise burden and indicate which noise-reducing measures could be taken
verzoekt de regering, de toekomstige geluidsbelasting in kaart te brengen en aan te geven welke geluidwerende maatregelen genomen kunnen worden
Motie van het lid Postma c.s. over veiligere N-wegen en de rol van vergevingsgezinde infrastructuur
Asks the government to investigate how N-roads can be made safer, including forgiving infrastructure, and to inform the Chamber in spring.
requests the government to map out how the N-roads can be made safer
verzoekt de regering, de mogelijkheid in kaart te brengen op welke wijze de N-wegen veiliger kunnen worden gemaakt
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over een Deltaplan voor het Noorden
Motion asking the government to draw up a northern Netherlands delta plan including the Lelylijn railway and to share its outlines with the House by 1 May 2021.
requests the government, in cooperation with the four northern provinces, to draw up a delta plan for and of the North
verzoekt de regering, in samenwerking met de vier noordelijke provincies een deltaplan van en voor het Noorden op te stellen
Motie van het lid Postma c.s. over concrete afspraken over slimmer en flexibeler thuiswerken
Asks the government to make concrete agreements with employers to promote smarter and more flexible (home) working to reduce traffic congestion, and to inform the House before the Christmas recess.
requests the government to make concrete agreements with employers to promote smarter and more flexible (home) working
verzoekt de regering, om concrete afspraken te maken met werkgevers om slimmer en flexibeler (thuis)werken te stimuleren
Motie van de leden Schonis en Postma over niet-vrijblijvende verkeersbegeleiding door de Kustwacht bij stormcondities op de Waddenzee
Asks the government to give the Kustwacht power to impose binding traffic guidance on container ships in Wadden Sea storm conditions and to consult Germany and Denmark on similar rules.
requests the government to give the Kustwacht the power to proceed to non-voluntary traffic guidance in storm conditions in the Wadden Sea
verzoekt de regering, om de Kustwacht de bevoegdheid te geven om tot een niet-vrijblijvende verkeersbegeleiding over te gaan bij stormcondities in de Waddenzee
Motie van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over een bestuursakkoord over de toegankelijkheid sluiten
Asks the government to conclude a governance agreement on public transport accessibility by 1 March 2021 and start the legislative process quickly.
requests the government to conclude a governance agreement by 1 March 2021
verzoekt de regering, uiterlijk 1 maart 2021 een bestuursakkoord te sluiten
Motie van het lid Schonis c.s. over onderzoek naar de financiële mogelijkheden om de Westerscheldetunnel tolvrij te maken
Asks the government to research the social and economic effects of a toll-free Westerscheldetunnel and the financing options for making it toll-free.
to carry out research into the financial possibilities of making the Westerscheldetunnel toll-free
onderzoek te doen naar de financiële mogelijkheden om de Westerscheldetunnel tolvrij te maken
Motie van de leden Schonis en Ziengs over een visie op het spoorgoederenvervoer
Asks the government to produce a vision for rail freight transport, analogous to the OV 2040 vision, covering the Basisnet and noise and vibration nuisance.
requests the government to come up with a vision on rail freight transport
verzoekt de regering, met een visie te komen op het spoorgoederenvervoer
Motie van het lid Van Raan c.s. over inzetten van burgerpanels bij het overleg over de toekomst van luchthavens
Asks the government to study using citizen panels or citizen tables to strengthen consultation with residents on the future of airports.
requests the government to investigate how citizen panels or citizen tables can be used as an instrument to strengthen consultation on the future of airports
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe burgerpanels of burgertafels kunnen worden ingezet als instrument om het overleg over de toekomst van luchthavens te versterken
Motie van de leden Schonis en Kröger over meer treinen naar Londen

MPs asked whether land speculation rules changed since 2019, whether notaries adequately protect private investors, and how buyers are protected against speculators. The minister replied that no relevant legislative changes occurred, that fragmentation is limited (about 0.13% of farmland), that notaries' independence rules and disciplinary oversight apply, and that consumer protection and AFM oversight exist, promising a further answer.
Since May 2019 there have been no legislative amendments aimed at bringing land positions under AFM supervision or at countering land speculation.
Sinds mei 2019 zijn geen wetswijzigingen geweest die erop gericht waren grondposities onder het AFM-toezicht te brengen of gericht waren op het tegengaan van grondspeculatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Duitsland: elk uur een trein Amsterdam – Berlijn (en één uur sneller)

An MP asked the state secretary about German plans to shorten the Amsterdam-Berlin train journey, the Dutch acceleration plans, possible route options and an Amsterdam-Hamburg connection. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the German plans, described a joint acceleration step by 2024 and open long-term route options, and said the Hamburg connection will be considered in a market study due before summer 2021.
I will inform you of the first results of the market study before the summer of 2021.
Ik informeer u over de eerste resultaten van de marktverkenning voor de zomer van 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het gebruik van vervuilde grond voor de aanleg van de Perkpolder

An MP asks the minister about contaminated thermally cleaned soil used in the Perkpolder dike, including its origin, whether the cleaning was complete, and why the Westdijk was remediated but Perkpolder was not. The minister confirms that Deltares found substances above standards, says the origin cannot be traced to a specific batch, and states RIVM finds no unacceptable risk for now, with a final decision on measures still pending.
Tracing a specific exceedance in the Perkpolder dike back to a batch of material offered for cleaning is therefore, in my expectation, not possible.
Het herleiden van een specifieke overschrijding in de Perkpolderdijk naar een partij materiaal die voor reiniging is aangeboden, is daardoor naar mijn verwachting niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over de kap van essen in het Markiezenbos langs de A27

An MP asked the minister whether felling ash trees in the Markiezenbos along the A27 is linked to the Utrecht ring road route decision, which is still subject to an appeal and was declared controversial by parliament. The minister answered that the felling concerns dead and diseased trees for traffic safety and is separate from the route decision and the appeal procedure.
These works are separate from the route decision and the appeal procedure.
Deze werkzaamheden staan los van het tracébesluit en de beroepsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en De Groot over het bericht 'Vattenfall mag in de Maas doorgaan met massaal vermalen van vissen'

D66 MPs Schonis and De Groot asked about fish mortality at Vattenfall's Maas hydropower plants (Lith, Linne), eel survival, the legal footing of the 10% mortality norm after a Council of State ruling, and Rijkswaterstaat's remedies. The minister acknowledged substantial eel and smolt mortality, said the 10% norm can no longer be applied without legal anchoring after the Council of State ruling, and committed to restoring the permit framework and reporting to parliament by June 2021.
Unlike before, however, the Council of State has in a recent ruling held that the 10% norm can no longer be applied without further legal anchoring.
Anders dan voorheen heeft de Raad van State in een recente uitspraak echter geoordeeld dat die 10%-norm niet meer zonder nadere juridische verankering gehanteerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het op omvallen staan van de snelle trein Eurostar van Rotterdam naar Londen

A D66 MP asked the state secretary about reports that Eurostar, facing collapsing passenger numbers during COVID-19, may be unable to meet payment obligations, and about support and cross-border cooperation to keep the Amsterdam-London rail link. The government confirmed the precarious financial situation, said talks with Belgium, France and the UK on support were ongoing and promised to inform parliament of effects on Dutch rail services, while noting the NOW wage subsidy and the TVL support scheme are available.
I will of course follow these talks and will inform your House should this have consequences for rail transport to and from the Netherlands.
Ik zal deze gesprekken uiteraard volgen, en uw Kamer informeren mocht dit gevolgen hebben voor het treinvervoer van en naar Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Schonis over de kosten die Transavia in rekening brengt aan consumenten die hun vlucht willen omboeken

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Transavia's rebooking fees (up to €35 per flight) penalise passengers who follow travel advice, and whether the Flex package and the 2020 advice changes justify this. The minister answered that fees reflect Transavia's business decision, that many destinations were orange rather than yellow, that the government urged people not to travel, and that the minister has no plans to push Transavia for flexibility.
Transavia makes a business-economic assessment to charge passengers who want to rebook their flight.
Transavia maakt een bedrijfseconomische afweging om kosten in rekening te brengen aan passagiers die hun vlucht willen omboeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis de hinder op HSL ondanks de windschermen en de introductie van de ICNG

An MP asked why wind warnings still disrupted high-speed rail despite the new windscreens, whether the PPS structure makes Infraspeed accountable, and when the ICNG trains and higher speeds would arrive. The state secretary acknowledged the wind-warning norms are being recalibrated with ProRail and the ILT, that ProRail is responsible for the system, and that NS will raise speeds only after full ICNG deployment and trial operation, likely from 2023.
ProRail has been working with the ILT since October on adjusting the norms.
ProRail werkt sinds oktober in overleg met de ILT aan de aanpassing van de normen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, Paternotte en Veldman over de handhaving van de negatieve PCR-testuitslag en verklaring voor inreizen of transit in Nederland

MPs Schonis, Paternotte and Veldman asked how compliance with the mandatory negative PCR test requirement for travellers entering the Netherlands is enforced, including spot checks, bus and train stations, testing on arrival, and exemptions for vaccinated travellers. The minister answered that carriers must check 100% of passengers with sanctions available, veiligheidsregio's perform spot checks, arrival testing and vaccination exemptions were not adopted, and enforcement is via fines and orders under administrative coercion.
The safety regions carry out spot checks among arriving passengers to see whether the airline and ferry companies comply sufficiently.
De veiligheidsregio's doen steekproeven onder aankomende passagiers om te zien of de naleving door de luchtvaart- en ferrymaatschappijen voldoende is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Paternotte over het bericht 'Belgen krabbelen terug: eis negatieve test alleen voor wie langer dan 48 uur in België blijft'

MPs Schonis and Paternotte (D66) asked ministers about Belgium's COVID-19 negative-test requirement for travellers staying over 48 hours, its consultation with the Netherlands and border municipalities, and whether the Netherlands could impose a similar test requirement. The minister answered that consultation with Belgian and Dutch authorities took place, that the 48-hour rule benefits cross-border workers, that the Netherlands extended negative-test requirements to certain high-risk arrivals from 29 December, and that extending it to car traffic would require legislative change.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Stel je voor dat je op kantoor werkt, eet én slaapt: dat is wat een chauffeur door corona elke dag moet doen'

MPs Schonis and Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that truck drivers, due to COVID restrictions, cannot get a warm meal or proper sanitary facilities and must live in their cabs. The minister said extended cab stays are undesirable, rejected reopening roadside restaurants for drivers as unwise now, and pointed to ongoing dialogue with the petition initiators and unions and to campaigns on sanitation.
As I indicated above, relaxing the rules by opening roadside restaurants to professional drivers is currently not sensible.
Zoals ik hierboven aangeef, is een versoepeling in de vorm van het openstellen van wegrestaurants voor beroepschauffeurs momenteel niet verstandig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over berichten dat opnieuw een containerramp heeft plaatsgevonden bij de Waddenzee

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of a possible container loss near the Wadden Sea, including whether reporting duties, route restrictions, contingency plans and insurance were being addressed. The minister answered that no containers were found, the shipowner denied any loss, and that IMO, EU and contingency-plan actions will follow, with several answers deferring to later reports.
Subsequently no containers were found, and the shipowner of the Munich Maersk indicated that it had not lost any containers.
Er zijn vervolgens geen containers aangetroffen en de reder van de Munich Maersk heeft aangegeven geen containers te zijn verloren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Renovatie van de Afsluitdijk loopt flinke vertraging op door problemen met spuisluizen

An MP asked the Infrastructure minister about delays in the Afsluitdijk renovation caused by sluice problems, including completion timing, the bike path, extra costs and road traffic impact. The minister said completion is expected in 2025 but planning is not yet fixed, bike bridges cannot be widened, extra costs are still under negotiation with the contractor, and traffic will face longer hindrance.
Unfortunately that is not yet possible at this moment, because we are still in discussion with the contractor about it.
Helaas is dat op dit moment nog niet mogelijk, omdat we hier nog over in gesprek zijn met de aannemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht 'Nieuwe studie: elektrische auto gaat langer mee dan gedacht'

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked the ministers how the TU Eindhoven study showing longer EV lifespans and lower battery CO2 emissions affects climate policy and the cost-effectiveness calculations of the Klimaatakkoord. The Staatssecretaris largely endorsed the study, defended the cost-effectiveness estimates with sensitivity analyses, said the models are kept up to date, and promised to improve consumer information on used EVs.
The ministry will continue to monitor these developments.
Het ministerie blijft deze ontwikkelingen monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Onmenselijke situatie voor bemanningen op zeeschepen, levering van vitale goederen loopt gevaar’.

MPs Schonis and Van der Graaf asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that about 300,000 seafarers worldwide were stranded by COVID-19 crew-change restrictions, how many were Dutch, why crew changes still failed after a motion and a July letter, and which steps were taken since. The minister acknowledged the problem, said about 75% of overdue Dutch-flag crew changes had occurred, attributed the obstacles mainly to other countries' national measures, and listed expanded visa processing and diplomatic efforts, without committing to new binding measures.
Not being able to change crews on time potentially has a major impact on the well-being and physical health of seafarers.
Het niet – tijdig – kunnen aflossen heeft potentieel een grote impact op het welbevinden en de fysieke gezondheid van zeevarenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Van der Graaf over het artikel ‘verbreden snelwegen kan ondanks stikstofcrisis doorgaan dankzij ‘rekentruc’ kabinet’

MPs Schonis and Van der Graaf asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report that road widening could continue despite the nitrogen crisis because of a calculation method that cuts off dispersion at 5 km, and about differences between the SRM2 and OPS models. The minister acknowledged the model differences, defended the 5 km cut-off as technically justified and consistent with past practice, said lawyers are closely involved in preparing decisions on the seven remaining MIRT road projects, and did not commit to new external legal advice.
In preparing the decisions on the MIRT road projects, lawyers are and will be closely involved.
Bij de voorbereiding van de besluiten over de MIRT-wegenprojecten zijn en worden juristen nauw betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Archief deltapionier verkwanseld’

An MP asked whether most of deltapioneer Johan van Veen's Delta Works reports had gone missing and whether they could be found and made available. The minister answered that about two-thirds of the collection was preserved, transferred to the National Archives in 2005 and catalogued in 2020, that many reports were digitised, and that the ministry stays in contact with private parties holding the rest.
Besides the National Archives, the Zeeland Archives and the library of Delft University of Technology also hold material by Johan van Veen.
Naast het Nationaal Archief bevatten bijvoorbeeld ook het Zeeuws archief en de bibliotheek van de Technische Universiteit Delft materiaal van Johan van Veen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Restanten Paddepoelsterbrug zijn definitief verwijderd’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why no temporary replacement for the collided Paddepoelsterbrug bridge has been provided, why the removal was communicated without a solution for residents, why shipping is prioritised, what contact exists with residents, and when a definitive plan will be presented. The minister answered that a modular temporary bridge is unsafe, that the removal was needed for navigation safety, that contact with residents has been regular though slow at first, and that a structural decision will be taken at the MIRT consultation on 26 November.
I consider it important to first discuss these with the administrative partners.
Ik vind het belangrijk om deze eerst met de bestuurlijke partners te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het artikel ‘Subsidie op elektrische auto loopt als een trein’

An MP asked the state secretaries about the rapid exhaustion of the EV purchase subsidy, its expected effects on emissions and future applications, and how it will be evaluated and promoted. The government explained the fast uptake (manufacturer discounts, postponed sales), estimated CO2 and NOx benefits, said it plans to stop carrying unused budget forward, and committed to monitoring in early 2021 and results by mid-2021.
As I recently reported to your House, the cabinet intends to stop this carry-over provision in the scheme (for both new and used EVs) in the short term.
Zoals ik uw Kamer recent heb gemeld, is het kabinet voornemens deze doorschuifbepaling in de regeling (zowel voor nieuwe als gebruikte EV's) op korte termijn stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, Belhaj en De Groot over munitiedumps in de Deltawateren en Noordzeekust

Three D66 MPs asked the government about the munitions dump in the Oosterschelde and North Sea sites, including the risks, monitoring, clean-up or capping costs, and whether a dedicated management fund exists. The government answered that research results will be sent to parliament in 2021, that monitoring shows no danger, that no clean-up or capping is planned under current assessments, and that only existing monitoring budgets are available.
The results will then be submitted to your House in 2021.
De resultaten worden dan in 2021 aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht op Spoorpro.nl getiteld ‘Trafikverket publiceert tender nachttrein Zweden-Brussel/Hamburg’

An MP asked the state secretary about a Swedish tender for a night train linking Sweden with Brussels/Hamburg and whether Dutch connections could be explored. The government said it has contacted Sweden, that the route is commercial and open access, and that international connections will be examined in an upcoming market study.
As promised, your House will receive a broad progress letter before the NO MIRT on developments in international passenger rail transport.
Zoals toegezegd ontvangt uw Kamer voor het NO MIRT een brede voortgangsbrief over de ontwikkelingen rondom internationaal spoorvervoer voor reizigers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht 'Coronacrisis helpt Minister van Nieuwenhuizen van rekeningrijden af'

MP Schonis (D66) asked the minister whether he was aware of a report that the Covid crisis was helping him avoid road pricing, and how this squared with the Klimaatakkoord commitment to study pay-per-use variants. The minister confirmed the commitment, said telework agreements with employers could reduce congestion, and said the study of three pay-per-use variants is ongoing with an interim report due in autumn 2020.
The State Secretary for Finance will inform the House of Representatives about this in autumn 2020.
De Staatsecretaris van Financiën zal de Tweede Kamer hierover in het najaar van 2020 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht ‘Sloop dreigt voor onafgebouwd testcentrum getijde-energie bij de Grevelingendam’

Two D66 MPs asked whether the unfinished tidal energy test centre at the Grevelingendam should be revived given its innovation potential, and whether the permit withdrawal could be postponed. The minister answered that the sector offers limited innovation potential, a market scan will show by 31 December 2020 whether a new party will complete the centre, and otherwise Rijkswaterstaat will demolish it so sluicing can resume.
By 31 December 2020 it will be known whether there is interest and under what conditions parties want to participate.
Uiterlijk 31 december 2020 zal bekend zijn of er belangstelling is en onder welke voorwaarden partijen willen instappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, De Groot en Verhoeven over verlengen certificaten voor de bruine vloot

D66 MPs asked the ministers whether the brown fleet of historic sailing ships, facing low revenue and costs from extended safety certificates during COVID-19, deserves more help and further postponement of certificate inspections. The government answered that EUR 15 million has been made available to secure the fleet, that existing schemes also apply, and that inspections need not be postponed further, while leaving room to reconsider extensions case by case.
With the additional EUR 15 million now made available, it is moreover not expected that entrepreneurs will still choose to postpone inspections.
Met de aanvullende € 15 miljoen die nu beschikbaar is gesteld, is het bovendien niet te verwachten dat ondernemers er nog voor zullen kiezen om keuringen uit te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht in de NRC getiteld ‘Plan sneltrein staat al jaren stil’

An MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that the Groningen-Bremen 'Wunderline' rail project had stalled, including the status of the Friesenbrücke bridge, obstacles, and next steps. The state secretary replied that the project is on schedule, the bridge repair is planned for end 2024, and the 2024 timetable launch remains achievable, without new commitments beyond existing planning.
The Wunderline project is on schedule.
Het project Wunderline ligt op schema.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over de reactie van de kinderopvangsector om het besluit tot aanwijzing van de Stint als bijzondere bromfiets aan te houden totdat een risico-inventarisatie door de Stichting Wetens

A D66 MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why approval of the Stint after-school bus is delayed while SWOV finalises its safety risk assessment, and whether alternatives for childcare transport are equally assessed. The minister answered that the SWOV assessment is binding and proceeds on the agreed policy framework, that the methodology is nearly ready, that alternatives are the existing transport options, and that a decision is aimed for in autumn rather than before the new school year.
This assessment by SWOV is binding for a decision on the application.
Deze beoordeling door de SWOV is bindend voor een besluit over de aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schonis over het bericht: ‘Corona jaagt ov-reizigers de deelauto in’

MPs Schonis and Dik-Faber asked the state secretary about reports that COVID-19 pushed public transport users into car sharing, and about how to encourage safe and electric car sharing, its effect on congestion and CO2, and subsidy eligibility for cooperatives. The state secretary answered that car sharing is promoted via the Green Deal Autodelen II and a sector hygiene protocol, that the shift is small and its traffic and CO2 effects limited, and that the electric car subsidy is restricted to individuals for administrative reasons.
I am willing to enter into discussion with the sector about this.
Ik ben bereid om met de sector het gesprek hierover aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Bruins over veilige evenementen

MPs Schonis and Bruins asked why event organisers cannot obtain permits for safe events such as drive-in venues under the general ban, and why Dutch rules differ from Germany and Denmark. The minister replied that the ban was lifted from 1 July, that local authorities now decide case by case, and that economic support schemes exist, but declined to give a detailed rationale for why safe events were not permitted earlier.
It is up to the local authorities to determine whether organisers can adequately arrange their activity at 1.5 metres and meet the other applicable measures.

Het is aan de lokale autoriteiten om te bepalen of organisatoren hun activiteit voldoende op anderhalve meter in kunnen richten en tevens aan andere van toepassing zijnde maatregelen kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Schonis over het besluit om de ILT te verzoeken tot handhaving Verordening (EG) 261/2004 passagiersrechten luchtvaart

MPs Paternotte and Schonis asked whether the government's instruction to the ILT not to enforce EU passenger refund rules for COVID-era flight vouchers, and the planned withdrawal of that instruction, leaves consumers exposed to delayed refunds and airline insolvency. The minister answered that the instruction is withdrawn so the ILT resumes enforcing Regulation 261/2004, that the ILT can act against systematic non-compliance but not individual refund delays, and that the government has lobbied the European Commission for an EU guarantee on vouchers.
With this, the ILT will again enforce Regulation (EC) 261/2004.
Daarmee gaat de ILT de Verordening (EG) 261/2004 weer handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Bergkamp over de toegankelijkheid voor mensen met een handicap in het openbaar vervoer in het licht van de coronacrisis

MPs Schonis and Bergkamp asked how people with disabilities can keep access to public transport during the COVID-19 measures, including wheelchair space loss and assistance. The State Secretary answered that the OV protocol applies to all travellers, NS assistance is fully restored from 1 June, and the working group will report later, committing to a letter and involving disability organisations.
How this will be elaborated, I will let your House know in the letter I promised at the committee debate.
Hoe dit uitgewerkt wordt, zal ik aan uw Kamer laten weten in de brief die ik heb toegezegd bij het notaoverleg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Van der Graaf over de bevindingen van de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) dat containerschepen vaak nog steeds de veiligheidsregels niet naleven

MPs Schonis and Van der Graaf asked why ILT inspection reports on container ships' non-compliance with safety rules were not shared with parliament and whether protective measures for the Wadden Sea would follow. The minister explained the report was delayed, promised to incorporate the findings into policy responses to the MSC Zoe investigations, and said closing the southern shipping route requires IMO proposal and consultation with Germany and Denmark.
I will incorporate the findings from the ILT report into my policy response to the outcomes of the relevant investigations into the MSC Zoe accident.
Ik zal de bevindingen uit het ILT-rapport betrekken in mijn beleidsreactie op de uitkomsten van de relevante onderzoeken naar aanleiding van het ongeval met de MSC Zoe
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Postma over het artikel 'Binnenring A10 Oost weer vrijgegeven na beschadiging spoorviaduct'

MPs Schonis and Postma asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the damage to a rail viaduct on the A10 Oost inner ring, its maintenance history, the cause investigation, and the wider maintenance backlog. The minister said the failed wall panels were a fitting error with no structural problem, that a similar case will be repaired later this year, and that the growing backlog of deferred maintenance will be considered in a wider review.
What we learn from this is that the construction of these wall panels should have been inspected in recent years.
Wat we hier van leren is dat de constructie van deze wandplaten in de afgelopen jaren wel geïnspecteerd had moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Schonis over het uitreiken van 'coronavouchers' door reisorganisaties en het bericht 'Europese Commissie handhaaft recht op geld terug bij annulering'

MPs Paternotte and Schonis asked whether consumers must still pay travel-operator deposits and accept vouchers instead of refunds for cancelled trips, and whether the minister's instruction to the ILT not to enforce refund rules for airline vouchers conflicts with EU law. The minister answered that consumers keep a legal refund right enforceable in court, that the ILT's instruction was withdrawn so Regulation 261/2004 is enforced again, and that the government supports voucher attractiveness and a possible EU voucher guarantee while promising further letters.
A passenger has a statutory right to a refund and can enforce it through the court, possibly with help from a claims bureau.
Een passagier heeft een wettelijk recht op terugbetaling en kan dat afdwingen via de rechtbank, eventueel met hulp van een claimbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Schonis en De Groot over het bericht 'Vergeten diesels blijken ernstige vervuilers'

MPs Schonis and De Groot asked whether a news report that diesel machines on construction sites emit far more nitrogen oxides than assumed is correct, and whether models like AERIUS underestimate deposition. The government confirms measured emissions of four machine types exceeded type-approval norms by 25% to 350%, has raised the emission factor and promised further measurements, but says full model impacts are not yet known.
I find it undesirable that emissions from mobile machinery in practice are higher than the official norm.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat de emissies van mobiele werktuigen in de praktijk hoger zijn dan de officiële norm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Schonis over het toetsingsadvies van de commissie voor de milieueffectrapportage over A27/A12 ring Utrecht

MPs Kröger and Schonis asked the minister about the environmental assessment committee's critical review of the A27/A12 Utrecht ring road project, including delays, corona-related traffic changes, construction method risks, nitrogen permits and housing priority. The minister answered that the tracébesluit will be adopted after summer 2020 with a renewed committee review, that nitrogen effects will be handled via a project-specific assessment and the speed reduction, and that further studies on noise and construction are underway.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, De Groot, Van Eijs, Paternotte en Schonis over het bericht ‘Dutch spell out green ideas for EU recovery fund’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Agriculture about a Dutch non-paper proposing a green EU recovery, including conditioning state aid on the national climate plan, early energy and circular investments, and an exclusion list for the Just Transition Fund. The government said the non-paper was an informal civil-servant document, declined to share such papers routinely, and gave largely non-committal answers, deferring concrete national plans until after the Commission's proposals and an August decision.
However, the cabinet considers sharing all such informal civil-servant lobbying documents at all times neither opportune nor desirable for effective Dutch advocacy in Brussels.
Echter, het kabinet acht het te allen tijde delen van al deze ambtelijke beïnvloedingsdocumenten niet opportuun noch wenselijk voor effectieve Nederlandse belangenbehartiging in Brussel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht 'Onderzoek: Met hyperloop binnen half uur van Amsterdam naar Brussel'

MP Schonis asked whether the government sees prospects for a hyperloop link between Amsterdam and Brussels and about the status of a hyperloop test track in Groningen. The minister answered that such a link is not realistic in the short or medium term, that private investment should lead, and that a new round of talks on a Groningen test track will be held in the coming months.

The aim is, after a new round of talks on the possibilities and scale of private investment in an ecosystem around a test track in Groningen, to review in the coming months whether this changes the situation.

Insteek is om na een nieuwe ronde van gesprekken over mogelijkheden en omvang van private investeringen in een ecosysteem rond een testtraject in Groningen in de komende maanden te bezien of dit die situatie verandert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Paternotte over de uitgifte van vouchers door luchtvaartmaatschappijen bij vluchtannuleringen vanwege Covid-19

MPs Schonis and Paternotte asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about airline vouchers issued instead of refunds for Covid-19 cancellations, including validity periods, credit card chargebacks, insolvency protection and whether non-enforcement by the ILT deviates from EU rules. The minister answered that vouchers are valid at least twelve months with refund available after six months on request, that enforcement is waived by directive, that she is pursuing an EU guarantee scheme and a fund, and that she has informed the Commission and transport ministers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht ‘Dik half jaar wachten voor plaatsen snellader geen uitzondering’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked about reported waits of up to half a year to connect fast-charging points to the grid, and how businesses can be supported. The Staatssecretaris answers that the National Agenda for Charging Infrastructure, regional partnerships, grid operator planning and guidance documents are being used to speed up rollout, without committing to a new concrete measure beyond existing plans.

Specifically for speeding up fast chargers at motorway service areas, I have asked Rijkswaterstaat to explore how many fast chargers could be added at service areas (up to 2030) and how the government can facilitate this.

Specifiek voor het versneld plaatsen van snelladers op verzorgingsplaatsen langs de snelweg heb ik Rijkswaterstaat gevraagd om te verkennen hoeveel snelladers er op de verzorgingsplaatsen bijgeplaatst zouden kunnen worden (tot 2030) en op welke wijze de overheid dit mogelijk kan faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Schonis over het meenemen van schadevrije jaren voor autoverzekeringen binnen de Europese Unie

MPs Sneller and Schonis asked the Finance Minister whether no-claims years (schadevrije jaren) for car insurance can be carried across EU member states and whether they should be harmonised, given that people moving to another EU state may pay higher premiums. The minister answered that insurers set their own risk weighting, that cross-border no-claims statements are mandatory but applied differently per country, and that EU-wide harmonisation is not desirable, while the related claims-history form is being negotiated in the MID revision.
I will continue the consultation jointly with the parties involved to examine further whether they can reach a solution and how.
Ik zal met de betrokken partijen gezamenlijk het overleg verder voeren om nader te onderzoeken of de partijen tot een oplossing kunnen komen en op welke wijze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over onduidelijke tarieven bij laadpalen voor elektrische auto’s

MPs Sienot and Schonis asked the government about unclear and non-transparent charging tariffs at public EV charge points, and whether the price-transparency agreements with the sector would be met in 2020. The minister acknowledged the need for transparency, described the existing pricing structure and agreements with the sector and ACM, and declined to impose a standard tariff, while committing to further steps such as a legislative change and a sector-wide data exchange by 1 June 2020.
I have made further agreements on price transparency with the industry associations of operators and service providers within the National Agenda for Charging Infrastructure (NAL).
Ik heb met de brancheverenigingen van exploitanten en serviceproviders in het kader van de Nationale Agenda Laadinfrastructuur (NAL) nadere afspraken gemaakt over prijstransparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Verhoeven  over het artikel ‘Autosector voldoet niet aan strenge privacynorm’

MPs Schonis and Verhoeven asked the minister whether the car sector complies with the GDPR, including whether it processes special personal data, opt-out data sharing and dealer bonuses for data sharing. The minister answered that compliance varies by manufacturer, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is taking targeted steps and that most responsibility lies with manufacturers and dealers, while promising further consumer information work and an exploration with the sector.
Towards the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP), the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the sector, efforts are therefore being directed on this issue.
Richting de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP), Autoriteit Consument & Markt (ACM) en de sector wordt hier dan ook op ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schonis over het bericht ‘Kosten verlaging maximumsnelheid twee keer hoger dan verwacht’

MPs Dik-Faber and Schonis asked whether the costs of lowering the motorway speed limit were twice the expected amount and why Rijkswaterstaat would place extra 130 km/h signs and why EV charging-point signs were not added. The minister confirmed the extra signs, said budget and time were allocated for the urgent nitrogen-driven speed reduction, and committed to combining charging-point signage with the work where cost-efficient.
Rijkswaterstaat has indicated that it will prepare a schedule including a cost estimate for this after completing the placement of the current signs.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft aangegeven hiervoor een planning inclusief een kostenraming te maken na afronding van het plaatsen van de huidige borden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het artikel ‘85.000 senioren mogen niet meer met de auto naar het buitenland: ‘Dit is leeftijds- én regio-discriminatie’

An MP from D66 asked the minister about reports that around 85,000 seniors aged 75 and over cannot drive abroad due to backlogs at the CBR driving licence agency, and whether these people are being adequately helped. The minister confirmed the figures (over 100,000 covered by administrative extension by January), said exceptions exist for individual hardship with specified criteria, and refused to commit to faster processing for border-region seniors, deferring to a forthcoming appraisal of a motion.
As promised during this debate, I will send your House an appraisal of this motion before the votes on 3 March.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens dit VAO zal ik voor de stemmingen op 3 maart een appreciatie van deze motie naar uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘ProRail: spoor niet berekend op hevige regenbuien en extreme hitte’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Dutch rail network is prepared for extreme weather linked to climate change and what the risks and costs are. The minister acknowledged new risks, pointed to ProRail's commissioned stress tests and advice expected in late 2020 and end 2021, and listed vulnerable components with some incidental measures.
Pending this advice, I cannot yet make a statement about possible effects, risks and costs.
In afwachting van dit advies kan ik nog geen uitspraak doen over mogelijke effecten, risico's en kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het Nieuwsuur-bericht van 22 december 2019  "Tuchtrechter tikt artsen die rijbewijskeuringen doen ‘opvallend vaak’ op de vingers"

An MP asked whether the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management recognises concerns about driving-licence medical assessors, including psychiatrists whose reports were revised at the CBR's request, nine disciplinary sanctions in two years, and links to a commercial bureau. The minister replied that CBR asks for revisions only for substantive clarity, that the sanctions are a small share of about 5,000 procedures, that no structural problem is seen, and that no separate investigation into revisions will be carried out.
I see no reason to ask the CBR to conduct further research into this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om CBR te vragen hiernaar verder onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Schonis over de inzet van crashtestdummy’s

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether crash test dummies, which vary in stiffness and flexibility, reflect differences between men and women, and whether EU rules test cars on dummies representative of women. The minister confirmed the dummy differences and said EU type approval uses average 50th-percentile male-sized dummies, that Euro NCAP adds small-adult and child dummies, that the EU will broaden testing and introduce a 5th-percentile dummy from 2022, and that the Netherlands will keep pushing for representative and diverse dummies.

The Netherlands is already actively working within the European Union and Euro NCAP for the highest possible safety level, including through the use of as representative and diverse crash test dummies as possible.
Nederland zet zich binnen de Europese Unie en Euro NCAP al actief in voor een zo hoog mogelijk veiligheidsniveau, ook door het gebruik van zo representatief en divers mogelijke crashtestdummy's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: een op de drie vluchten vanaf Schiphol zou ook per trein kunnen’

Two D66 MPs asked about a report suggesting a third of flights from Schiphol could be replaced by train, about the role of tourism in flights, its economic value, and how to make rail more attractive. The minister says the report draws no conclusions, outlines an action plan with rail partners, cites tourism data and welfare estimates, and commits to talks with the travel industry and NS International.
I am aware of the study.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht 'Onderzoek: omrijden taxi en te veel rekenen is schering en inslag'

An MP asked the minister about a Taximonitor 2018 study of Amsterdam taxis showing frequent detours and overcharging, and about quality on the national taxi market. The minister replied that the Amsterdam findings are not representative nationally, that quality is primarily the industry's responsibility with local measures and enforcement improvements in preparation, and that approved taxi organisations are not given priority.
No comparable figures on the quality of taxi transport are available at national level.
Er zijn op landelijk niveau geen vergelijkbare cijfers beschikbaar over de kwaliteit van het taxivervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over de uitspraak van minister-president na afloop van de ministerraad op 29 november 2019 ‘de treinen rijden op steenkool, en ik ga dan vliegen’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked about the Prime Minister's remark that trains run on coal while he flies, and whether the claim is accurate, plus the energy mix on the Den Haag–Madrid route and European high-speed rail coordination. The minister answered with 2017 Eurostat energy-mix figures for Belgium, France and Spain, said Dutch trains run on wind power, admitted other countries' electricity may partly be coal-based, and pledged to push international rail on the EU agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Schonis over het bericht 'Veel meer ongevallen, veel minder politie op snelweg'

MPs Den Boer and Schonis asked ministers about a report linking reduced police presence on motorways to rising accidents, including the effectiveness of radar enforcement, the choice of enforcement locations, speed-trap apps, and seatbelt enforcement. The ministers acknowledged the rise in accidents and the importance of enforcement, but defended current enforcement practice, said no separate policy plan was needed, and promised modest follow-up such as the Analysetool Handhaving and trajectory controls.
The SWOV study 'Traffic enforcement on Dutch motorways' focuses on traffic enforcement.
Het onderzoek van SWOV «Verkeershandhaving op Nederlandse autosnelwegen» is gericht op de verkeershandhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Schonis over het kunnen meenemen van schadevrije jaren

MPs Sneller and Schonis asked the Finance Minister whether foreign no-claims years can be transferred to Dutch insurance, whether partners and regular drivers can build no-claims years, and whether no-claims years can be split on divorce. The minister answered that transfer depends on each insurer's rules, that children and partners build no-claims years only if registered, and that no change is planned because some insurers already offer splitting.
I do not intervene in the acceptance conditions of individual insurers.
Ik treed niet in de acceptatievoorwaarden van individuele verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Van Eijs en Schonis over het artikel ‘Duurzaamheid blijft ondergeschoven kind bij aanbestedingen in de bouw’

D66 MPs asked whether sustainability plays too small a role in public construction tenders and whether this jeopardises the 2050 climate goals. The government answers that sustainability can be included in many tender criteria, outlines Rijksoverheid purchasing strategy, Klimaatakkoord measures, CO2-Prestatieladder and MKI/MPG instruments, and the status of motion Schonis on smart maintenance pilots.
For central government this has led to drafting a new procurement strategy for Rijk purchasing, aimed at sustainable, social and innovative purchasing.
Voor de rijksoverheid is dit aanleiding geweest voor het opstellen van een nieuwe inkoopstrategie voor de inkoop van het Rijk, gericht op duurzaam, sociaal en innovatief inkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over het artikel ‘Groene Wende op Duitse Wegen: Wat betekent dat voor Nederland?’

MPs Sienot and Schonis asked the minister whether a large German shift to electric cars would hurt the Dutch economy and auto sector, and whether the Dutch market and supply of EVs are at risk. The minister answered that the transition offers opportunities for Dutch firms, that the government's Klimaatakkoord measures and annual monitoring aim for 100% zero-emission new sales by 2030, and that suppliers will need to adapt.
That is why the market and sales of electric cars are monitored annually and the incentive package will be adjusted if necessary.
Daarom wordt de markt en verkoop van elektrische auto’s jaarlijks gemonitord en zal het stimuleringspakket zo nodig worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het artikel ‘De e-truck komt, maar het duurt wel even voor hij zijn dieselneef inhaalt’

An MP from D66 asked the minister about an article and ING report saying electric trucks will only be cost-competitive with diesel around 2028, and asked about subsidies, the truck toll, hydrogen and biofuels. The government answered that the market is hard to predict, pointed to existing subsidies (DKTI), a EUR 94 million scheme to 2025, the planned truck toll with possible lower rates later, and a future hydrogen covenant, but made no binding commitments beyond ongoing work.
Of course I am willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht “Supersnelle elektrische fietsen winnen snel aan populariteit”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising speed-pedelec popularity, accident numbers, expected growth, safety of mixed speeds on cycle paths and roads, and the rules applying to them. The minister answered with 2017-2018 accident counts, a commissioned SWOV deep-dive due in 2020, statistics on registrations, and that existing rules and consultations with stakeholders are being maintained, while no separate vehicle category is planned.
To gain more insight into the road safety of speed-pedelecs, I am having SWOV carry out an in-depth study of accidents involving speed-pedelecs.
Om meer inzicht in de verkeersveiligheid van speed-pedelecs te krijgen, laat ik SWOV een diepteonderzoek doen naar ongevallen met speed-pedelecs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Schonis over het bericht 'Mogelijk 14 miljard minder aan woningbouw en wegen door stikstofuitspraak'
