MPs Van Eijs and Schonis asked about reports that the Council of State's PAS ruling could cost the construction sector billions, including whether provinces paused nature permits, how many homes are affected, and how the ADC test applies to housing. The minister answers that permitting has resumed step by step, that roughly 25,000 homes are affected though projects are not halted, and that an overview of affected infrastructure projects will follow.
The Minister of IenW will inform the House before the MIRT consultation about the consequences of the PAS ruling for national infrastructure projects.
De Minister van IenW zal de Kamer voorafgaand aan het Nota-overleg MIRT informeren over de gevolgen van de PAS-uitspraak voor de nationale infrastructuur projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Schonis en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Italy holds Netherlands, EU ‘responsible’ for migrant boat’

MPs asked the government about Italy holding the Netherlands and the EU responsible for migrants aboard the Sea-Watch 3, about Dutch obligations under the SAR convention, and about progress on a structural EU solution for disembarkation. The minister answered that Netherlands requested a port and asked the Commission to coordinate, that primary SAR responsibility lies with the state of the rescue zone, that no structural solution has yet been found, and that the government keeps pressing for one.
The cabinet will continue to press for a mechanism in which as large a group as possible, if not all member states, takes its responsibility.
Het kabinet zal blijven aandringen op een mechanisme waarin een zo groot mogelijke groep, zo niet alle lidstaten, haar verantwoordelijkheid neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en De Pater-Postma over de video 'CBR belt  politie voor vechtpartij en nu gaan we de mail van de directeur platleggen'

MPs Schonis and De Pater-Postma asked the minister about a video alleging CBR delays in medical fitness checks for young drivers, the one-year validity of theory certificates, and compensation. The minister said CBR assessments are legally required, the Gezondheidsraad is reviewing the list of conditions, compensation options are under study, and the theory certificate validity will not be extended.
I do not have exact figures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Tijdens vakantie gekochte e-step kan duur uitpakken, waarschuwen verzekeraars’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about electric scooters bought abroad that insurers say cannot be insured, and about their regulation and harmonisation with other countries. The minister acknowledged the insurance problem, pointed to the 2019 interim approval framework and a pending definitive one, and said Netherlands advocates EU-level harmonisation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Omwonenden niet blij met gang van zaken rondom Paddepoelsterbrug’

An MP asked why a temporary replacement bridge for the Paddepoelsterbrug is taking so long, whether a temporary ferry or nearby bridge is considered, the safety assessment, and timing of a permanent bridge and public participation. The minister answered that agreement on a temporary high bridge was reached in June 2019 with €1.5 million, location is still being determined with residents, a ferry option is under review, and the MIRT process for a permanent solution will start with a preferred alternative expected in Q2 2021.
I am committed to running this process as quickly as possible.
Ik zet mij in om dit proces zo snel mogelijk te doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Schonis over het artikel ‘CO2-uitstoot stijgt door populariteit van SUV’s’

An MP asked the state secretary about a report showing rising CO2 emissions per kilometre from larger vehicles such as SUVs in Europe, and about the Netherlands' role, EU fines, incentives and the Climate Agreement. The secretary acknowledged the trend, said Dutch average emissions are low due to fiscal policy on electric cars, and described existing and planned measures without committing to new action.
I do not share this view.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schonis over het bericht ‘Anonieme OV-chipkaart is niet anoniem, betoogt Michiel Jonker’

MPs Verhoeven and Schonis asked the State Secretary about claims that the anonymous OV-chipkaart is not really anonymous, and about what data NS and Translink store and share. The State Secretary answered that the data processing is lawful under the AVG, that anonymous card data is limited, that travellers are informed via privacy statements, and that a voordeeluren subscription is personal and cannot be placed on an anonymous card.
Translink has informed me that it cannot in any way trace the traveller's personal details, even when paying by card to top up the balance on the anonymous OV-chipkaart.
Translink heeft mij laten weten op geen enkele manier achter de NAW-gegevens van de reiziger te kunnen komen, ook niet als er gepind wordt om het saldo op de anonieme OV-chipkaart aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Roep om afschaffing CBR-keuring voor autisten: ‘Het is gewoon een verdienmodel’’

An MP asked the minister to respond to reports calling for abolishing the CBR medical fitness test for drivers with autism, which critics see as a revenue model. The minister explained that the test for first-time applicants with ASS stays under the Gezondheidsraad-based rules, that a broader review of the medical fitness system is underway with results expected mid-2020, and that she will engage with the Dutch autism association.
It is unknown how many people with ASS hold a driving licence.
Het is onbekend hoeveel mensen met ASS een rijbewijs hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ’Volkerak-Zoommeer op de grens van Zeeland en Brabant wordt al vóór 2030 zout’

An MP asked the minister whether the Volkerak-Zoommeer will become saline before 2030, whether it is ecologically thriving, and what consultation and safeguards exist. The minister replied that no decision has been taken, that the lake is part of a PAGW long list still under discussion, and that a decision would only follow an environmental impact assessment and cost-benefit analysis with stakeholder involvement.

The decision on possibly making the Volkerak-Zoommeer saline again will not be taken by me until the costs and effects have been determined on the basis of an environmental impact assessment and a (social) cost-benefit analysis.

Het besluit over het eventueel weer zout maken van het Volkerak-Zoommeer zal ik niet eerder nemen dan nadat op basis van een milieueffectrapportage en een (maatschappelijke) kosten-batenanalyse de kosten en effecten hiervan zijn bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Schonis en Remco Dijkstra over de grote problemen bij het CBR

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about data leaks at the CBR, where medical documents of one client were viewable in another's file, including how many cases there were, when they were reported, and whether affected people were informed. The minister reported 71 cases in January to June 2019 and 5 in 2018, said procedures and GDPR obligations were followed, and agreed to share monthly progress reports with the Chamber.
Yes, I am willing to share with the Chamber the monthly report that the CBR sends me within the framework of enhanced oversight.
Ja, ik ben bereid om de rapportage die het CBR maandelijks aan mij doet toekomen in het kader van het aangescherpt toezicht te delen met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over de Youtube film ‘CBR haat zieke mensen en Marije krijgt een boete’

An MP asked the minister about a video on CBR driving-licence assessments, including the medical condition list, long phone waits and lost documents, and whether a leniency scheme would be introduced. The minister said the health council advises on the condition list, the CBR has clarified forms and prioritises expiry dates, and an extension study and plan of action are underway, with more information promised before the summer recess.
Before the summer recess, your House will receive more information on the findings of the research I am now conducting and the actions that follow from it.
Voor het zomerreces ontvangt uw Kamer meer informatie over de bevindingen van het onderzoek dat ik nu uitvoer en de acties die daaruit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het artikel ‘Energie voor elektrische auto superduur, rijden toch het goedkoopst’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked whether electric car charging, though costlier per kWh than fuel, is cheaper per kilometre than diesel, and what the government will do about fiscal incentives for business drivers and charging prices. The state secretary answered that efficiency offsets the higher per-kWh price, rejected the claim that diesel is generally cheaper, and pointed to Klimaatakkoord measures such as lowering the energy tax on electricity and raising the diesel excise.
No, I do not share that conclusion.
Nee, ik deel die conclusie niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Von Martels over de openstelling van de Afsluitdijk voor fietsers

MPs Schonis (D66) and Von Martels (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why bicycle access to the Afsluitdijk is limited in 2020-2021 and whether alternatives such as closing the road or separating lanes were considered. The minister answered that construction makes safe openings very limited, that closing the A7 or splitting lanes is not feasible given its regional importance, and that only a bicycle bus and a possible incidental opening will be considered.
For 2020 and 2021 the opportunities for opening appear very limited, but in due course I will examine whether opportunities arise to let cyclists and walkers use the dike incidentally and safely.

Voor 2020 en 2021 lijken de mogelijkheden voor openstelling zeer beperkt, maar ik zal te zijner tijd bezien of zich dan ook kansen voordoen om fietsers en wandelaars incidenteel veilig van de dijk gebruik te laten maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het artikel 'Paddepoelsterbrug: nog even geduld voor fietsforenzen richting Stad'

An MP asked about the closed Paddepoelster bridge and the cycling route into Groningen, and whether the ministry values inland shipping above slow traffic. The minister says Rijkswaterstaat is working with the municipalities on a joint solution, weighing navigation safety on a high-risk waterway against alternative routes, with a decision expected in summer 2019.
I expect to have the outcome of this in summer 2019.
Ik verwacht in de zomer 2019 hiervan de uitkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Verhoeven over het artikel ‘Wie temt het datamonster in de auto-industrie?’

MPs Schonis and Verhoeven asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about in-car data collection, privacy, independent oversight and consumer choice over shared data. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports EU data-driven road safety, pointed to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and RDW as oversight bodies, said privacy is protected under the GDPR, and promised further study and a response to a related motion, while declining to give a full overview of all vehicle data.
A complete overview of all data that all types of cars generate and store I cannot give.
Een volledig overzicht van alle gegevens die alle typen auto’s genereren en opslaan kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Reddingsschip Sea-Watch mag voorlopig weer uitvaren na winst rechtszaak’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government will handle the Sea-Watch 3 rescue ship dispute after a court ruling, and whether it will negotiate a transition period and clarify the requirements. The minister answered that the court upheld the regulation, set a suspension until 15 August 2019 for this vessel, and that talks on clarifying the requirements are ongoing, with the government committing to provide clarity itself if talks fail.
The court ruled that the regulation for vessels that systematically take drowning people on board is lawful and remains in force.
De rechter heeft geoordeeld dat de regeling voor schepen die stelselmatig drenkelingen aan boord nemen rechtmatig is en in stand blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Schonis en Gijs van Dijk over het rondetafelgesprek inzake MSC Zoe

MPs Kröger, Schonis and Gijs van Dijk asked the minister about inspection of container ships, cargo securing, confidentiality of cargo manifests, shipping routes and container tracing after the MSC Zoe incident. The minister answered that inspections led to few detentions, that extra cargo-securing checks shift inspection effort from other topics, that certain cargo data is confidential under the Wob, and that international rule changes depend on investigation outcomes.
There has been contact between the Dutch police and Port of Sines in Portugal. This was the last port the MSC Zoe called at before the accident occurred.
Er is contact geweest tussen de Nederlandse politie en Port of Sines in Portugal. Dit was de laatste haven die de MSC Zoe aandeed voor het ongeval plaatsvond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Von Martels over de coulanceregeling Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

Two MPs asked the minister whether drivers harmed by CBR delays can expect a temporary coulance (goodwill) arrangement, and why medically flagged drivers cannot get faster renewals and police cannot verify doctors' letters. The minister confirmed no short-term coulance will be granted, citing road safety and that the arrangement cannot be verified, while saying the situation is regrettable.
That is correct. I understand the wish of your House.
Dat klopt. Ik begrijp de wens van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sneller over het verkrijgen van inzicht in de gevolgen van maximumsnelheden

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government gains insight into the effects of speed limits, including the 130 km/h motorway limit, on road safety, air quality, costs, liveability and congestion, and whether evaluation and cost-benefit analyses are adequate. The minister answered that effects are tracked in annual monitors, that road safety is a priority but the speed limits will be kept, that the Court of Audit has a study pending, and that a French-style study in the Netherlands is not needed.
If not, do you agree that it would be desirable to have these insights?
Zo nee, deelt u de mening dat het wenselijk zou zijn om wel over deze inzichten te beschikken?

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over de berichten ‘Gewonden bij botsing cruiseschepen op de Nieuwe Maas’, ‘Cruiseschip geëvacueerd na botsing op de Waal’ en ‘Cruiseschip met 171 passagiers botst met tanker op West

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about three collisions involving river cruise ships in March and April 2019 and whether safety rules and emergency preparedness are adequate. The minister answered that the incidents appear coincidental without structural causes, referred the Westerschelde collision to the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid, and described existing regulations and regional emergency planning.
For the incident on the Westerschelde, the OVV is launching an investigation. The report that appears on this will of course be shared with the House.
Naar het incident op de Westerschelde stelt de OVV een onderzoek in. Het rapport dat daarover verschijnt wordt natuurlijk met de Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Bergkamp over het artikel 'Vrouwen kunnen niet autorijden en dit is waarom'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a newspaper column claiming cars are designed for men and that women face higher injury risk, and whether test dummies and data gaps should be addressed. The minister disputed the figures, argued the data show a lower mortality risk for women largely due to driving less, said representative dummies are already used, and saw no reason for new measures.
I see no reason at this time to take measures.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Van Meenen over het bericht 'VO-raad: middelbare scholen verdwijnen in krimpregio's’

MPs Schonis and Van Meenen asked about reports that secondary schools are disappearing in shrinking regions and what the government will do to keep access reasonable. The minister acknowledges concern, says school boards are primarily responsible, points to accountmanagers and a process facilitator, and commits to working with the Interior Ministry and provinces on an integrated regional approach.
The problem of pupil decline in such regions is much broader than education alone and also concerns the liveability of the region.
Het probleem van leerlingendaling in zulke regio's is veel breder dan alleen het onderwijs, en gaat ook over de leefbaarheid van de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht dat er afgelopen weekend zeecontainers in de Schelde terecht zijn gekomen

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether shipping containers blown into the Scheldt by storm winds threatened nature and environment in the Westerschelde, who is responsible and liable, and what steps would prevent pollution. The minister answered that the one container entered the Churchill dock on Flemish territory and was recovered, no pollution report was filed, and therefore no environmental harm occurred in the Westerschelde.
The container did not end up in the Scheldt.
De container is niet in de Schelde terecht gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Provinciaal ontgasverbod is een wassen neus’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that tankers illegally vent carcinogenic gas on the Waal and that provincial venting bans are ineffective, asking what powers the government has and what steps it will take with Rijkswaterstaat. The minister answered that the ADN convention does not ban venting outright, that the Scheepsafvalstoffenbesluit will be amended to ban venting in densely populated areas and near locks and bridges from late 2019, that a thematic enforcement action is being prepared, and that a nationwide ban is targeted for 2020 once legal basis exists.
However, based on the ADN the regulations in the Dangerous Substances Transport Act will be tightened.
Wel zal op basis van het ADN de regelgeving in de Wet vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Locomotief ontspoord op Sloelijn bij Nieuwdorp’

MP Schonis (D66) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether a locomotive derailment on the Sloelijn near Nieuwdorp could have been prevented given earlier incidents on the same line, and whether the incidents will be evaluated together and whether measures are needed. The State Secretary answered that each incident is investigated individually, that ProRail's preliminary view points to a human factor differing from the December 2018 incident, that the track was found in good condition after December 2018, that results are expected in spring, and that no structural cause is currently apparent.
Each incident is investigated individually. The outcomes of these investigations will be compared with each other and with other incident investigations.
Ieder incident wordt individueel onderzocht. De uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken zullen met elkaar en met andere incidentenonderzoeken worden vergeleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht 'Rechter: Biro moet van het fietspad'

An MP asked the minister about a court ruling that the Biro vehicle must leave bicycle paths, including whether the verdict was in writing, whether municipalities are involved, and whether disabled users are disproportionately affected. The minister said the verdict was oral only and cannot be obtained in writing, that municipalities need not implement it, that the ruling does not cover adapted vehicles for disabled users, and that she will work with the consumer authority and other partners to clarify rules for such vehicles.
No, the verdict of the police judge was given orally only and has therefore not been put in writing.
Nee, het vonnis van de politierechter is alleen mondeling gedaan en is dus niet op schrift gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over de radiouitzending 'Overheid is rem op vergroening'

The MP asks the Minister whether the Green Deal implements the Sienot motion on measuring emissions at the exhaust, whether old ship engines will force vessels out of service, how bankruptcy of inland shipping firms will be avoided, and how hydrogen engines are stimulated. The Minister says the motion is being implemented, the COBALD evaluation found on-board monitoring insufficient as an alternative to test-bench measurement, no old-engine norm is intended, financing options are being studied, and innovation is stimulated through a subsidy scheme.
I still see opportunities for measuring at the exhaust for the purposes of monitoring and signalling emissions.
Ik zie nog wel kansen voor meten aan de pijp ten behoeve van monitoring en signalering van emissies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Schonis over het bericht dat de risicoplafonds voor vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen per spoor wordt verruimd

MPs Amhaouch and Schonis asked the State Secretary about reports that risk ceilings for rail transport of hazardous substances would be loosened, how this fits with legal norms, and the effects on residents along the Twente line. The State Secretary largely referred to a separate letter on the ceiling exceedances and gave substantive answers on Dutch-EU alignment, the legal basis for adjusting ceilings, quick-scan follow-up, noise and pilot timelines.
For the answer to these questions I refer to my letter 'Explanation of exceedances of risk ceilings on the railways and my approach', which is being sent to your House parallel to these answers.

Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief «Toelichting op overschrijdingen risicoplafonds op het spoor en mijn aanpak» die parallel aan de beantwoording van deze vragen aan uw Kamer is aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Merwedebrug was bijna ingestort, Nederland aan ramp ontsnapt’

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether a remaining service life of six days for the Merwedebrug is safe, and what the threshold is for reinforcement, whether other bridges need review, and whether a long-term maintenance plan is needed. The minister answered that end-of-life still leaves the bridge structurally safe under wide margins, that a heightened inspection regime applies after that point, that strategic bridges were reviewed earlier, and that the existing Vervanging en Renovatie programme and inspection programme already cover maintenance.
This means that at the end of its service life the bridge is still structurally safe enough, but may over time no longer meet the safety standards.
Dit betekent dat de brug op het moment van einde levensduur constructief nog veilig genoeg is, maar dat de brug mogelijk op termijn niet meer aan de veiligheidsnormen voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Schonis, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat er 277 containers overboord zijn geslagen bij de Waddeneilanden, waarvan drie met benzoylperoxide

MPs asked how the government will protect nature and environment in the Wadden Sea after 277 containers, three holding benzoylperoxide, were lost overboard, and about responsibility, liability, tracing, monitoring, cleanup coordination and a future Wadden authority. The minister replied that retrieval is the priority, that Rijkswaterstaat and the Wadden Academy are studying the effects, that the shipping company is liable and has accepted cleanup costs, that the Veiligheidsregio Fryslân coordinates cleanup, and that the role of a future Wadden authority is still being decided.
The shipping company has been held directly liable on behalf of the State and obliged by Rijkswaterstaat to clean up under the Maritime Accidents Combating Act.
De reder is namens de Staat direct aansprakelijk gesteld en door Rijkswaterstaat tot opruiming verplicht op basis van de Wet bestrijding maritieme ongevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Remco Dijkstra, Van der Graaf, Von Martels, Gijs van Dijk, Van Aalst, Schonis en Laçin over de nieuwe prijsverhoging voor tachograafkaarten

MPs asked whether the government would accept a proposed 5% price rise for tachograph cards by Kiwa, how the Dutch price compares with neighbouring countries, and why the new fee system has not yet taken effect. The minister said the current card price stays at 95 euro while a new generation card is priced at 100 euro due to new EU requirements, promised a benchmark study and a letter later in the year, and refused to suspend the price increase despite a motion.
No, the tariffs for tachograph cards remain at the established price.
Nee, de tarieven voor de tachograafkaarten blijven op de vastgestelde prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Goederenlocomotief blokkeert weg na ontsporing’

An MP asked the state secretary about a freight locomotive derailment at a Vlissingen port track on 24 December 2018 and whether it could have been prevented given a 2017 derailment there. The answer attributes the incident to the remote operator braking too late without using the available distance-signalling aid, says the 2017 causes (rotten sleepers) were absent, and states an ongoing investigation will review the incident.
After thorough investigation it was established that a combination of factors, including rotten wooden sleepers, played a role in this incident.
Na grondig onderzoek is vastgesteld dat een combinatie van factoren, waaronder verweerde houten dwarsliggers, een rol speelde bij dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht dat ProRail miljoenen betaalde voor grond aan ‘handige jongens'

An MP from D66 asked whether ProRail overpaid about 18.1 million euros in 2017 for land it could have obtained from NS earlier, and whether a stricter pre-approval test for ProRail land purchases is needed. The State Secretary explained that ProRail followed its own strategic-interest test then in force, that the 2017 full purchase ended costly legal disputes, and that the parties will review the framework and the minister's approval threshold, though no legislative change is committed.
With ProRail I have moreover agreed that the land ProRail does not need now or does not expect to need in the future will be sold again by ProRail.
Met ProRail heb ik bovendien afgesproken dat de gronden die ProRail nu niet nodig heeft of niet in de toekomst verwacht nodig te hebben, door ProRail weer zullen worden verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over het bericht ‘Roep om geluidsschermen langs snelwegen in 't Gooi: ‘Elke nacht wakker’’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about noise from the A1 motorway near Naarderbos in Gooi, a local news report on residents' complaints, and possible solar noise barriers. The minister answered that the site is in a sanitation backlog but not in the first phase of the noise programme, that a noise barrier is still under study, that solar panels can be considered, and that Rijkswaterstaat would meet residents and the municipality.
I therefore gladly want to consult with the residents about this.
Ik ga daarom graag met de bewoners hierover in overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over het bericht ‘TenneT zegt miljoenencontract 380kv-lijn met Heijmans op, project loopt vertraging op’

Two D66 MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that TenneT terminated a multi-million euro contract with Heijmans for 380kV pylons, causing delays, and what this means for offshore wind connections. The minister replied that TenneT, not the state, is the contracting party, that only the Zuid-West 380kV West project faces at least a one-year delay with no effect on wind farm connections, and that he has asked TenneT for clarification and urged it to resume construction quickly.
Of course I have asked TenneT for clarification and I urge that the realisation of the relevant connections be resumed as quickly as possible.
Uiteraard heb ik TenneT om opheldering gevraagd en dring ik erop aan dat de realisatie van de betreffende verbindingen zo snel mogelijk wordt hervat.

qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over de slechte toegankelijkheid voor het publiek van het tv-programma Kiespijn

An MP asked whether the NPO's TV studios, including for the programme Kiespijn, are physically accessible to wheelchair users and whether this undermines representation of people with disabilities. The State Secretary answered that the studio is accessible, that an earlier report was a miscommunication, that the College van Omroepen found studios accessible, and that no further action is needed beyond continued dialogue on representation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht 'Cursor op zwart'

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the dismissal of the Cursor editor-in-chief at TU Eindhoven and alleged pressure on the independence of university newspapers. The Minister says journalistic independence is a great good, finds the situation undesirable, notes an integrity-commission investigation into alleged censorship at TU/e, and declines to start a broader investigation for now.

I consider it up to the Executive Board, as publisher of Cursor, the editorial board and the Cursor editorial staff to discuss with each other the editorial statute, especially in light of what has happened.

Ik vind het aan het College van Bestuur, als uitgever van Cursor, de redactieraad en de redactie van Cursor om, te meer naar aanleiding van hetgeen is voorgevallen, met elkaar het gesprek te voeren over het redactiestatuut
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Stoffer over de afwezigheid van de NOS bij vertoning beelden van de aanval op 7 oktober 2023 op de Israëlische ambassade

MPs Pouw-Verweij and Stoffer asked why the NOS did not attend an Israeli embassy screening of footage of the 7 October 2023 attack and whether the NOS should play a key role in neutral news coverage. The Staatssecretaris replied that the NOS is editorially independent, that he does not know the reason for its absence, and that it is not his place to assess or steer the NOS's working methods, so he will not discuss the matter with the NOS.
It is not appropriate for me to assess the NOS's working methods or to direct the NOS.
Het past mij niet om de werkwijze van de NOS te beoordelen of om de NOS aan te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over deWob/Woo-documentatie over de gang van zaken rondom ‘Het GrootsteCoronaspreekuur’

An MP asks the Health and Education ministers about Wob/Woo documents on the financing and government role in the SBS programme 'Het Grootste Coronaspreekuur', including possible breach of media rules and the independence of CBG and advisory bodies. The minister says the documents describe events accurately, the CBG funded the production without content interference from ministries, and the financing (144,980 euro) is itemised, though the ministry gives partial answers on the Denktank membership and some individual details.
The production was initiated by the CBG without any substantive involvement from the CBG and/or the core ministry.
De betreffende productie is op initiatief van het CBG tot stand gekomen zonder enige vorm van inhoudelijke bemoeienis vanuit het CBG en/of het kerndepartement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over hetzelfde bericht 'Toegankelijkheid musea onder druk door achterblijvendeoverheidssubsidies'

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about reports that museum accessibility is under pressure from lagging government subsidies, including whether subsidies rose only 1 percent against roughly 10 percent inflation and whether the government will inform parliament on museums' financial position. The State Secretary acknowledged financial pressure varying across museums, explained the indexation of subsidies, pointed to statistics published by the CBS, and listed existing support measures without committing to new action.
The Ministry of Education, Culture and Science commissions the museum statistics requested by the CBS and published annually in December.
Het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap is opdrachtgever van de museumstatistiek die wordt uitgevraagd door het CBS en jaarlijks in december wordt gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over het bericht 'Toegankelijkheid musea onder druk door achterblijvendeoverheidssubsidies'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about reports that museums face financial pressure from rising costs and lagging government subsidies, risking admission prices and accessibility. The State Secretary acknowledged uneven financial strain, said admission pricing is up to the museums, and pointed to existing support measures while stating that funding responsibility is shared with local and provincial governments.
As independent institutions, it is up to the museums themselves to set the admission price for entrance tickets.
Als zelfstandige instellingen is het aan de musea zelf om de toegangsprijs te bepalen voor entreetickets.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Strien over Het televisieprogramma ‘The Biohack Project’

MPs Tielen and Van Strien asked whether the NPO programme 'The Biohack Project' spreads misleading, unscientific health claims, whether the presenter's commercial interests matter, and whether the NPO ombudsman or the Commissariaat should act. The State Secretary replied that the broadcaster KRO-NCRV is responsible for content, added a disclaimer and re-edited parts, said the NPO journalistic code does not formally apply to entertainment, and that the Commissariaat does not comment on specific signals or possible investigations.
The Commissariaat does not make statements about how signals are handled or about possible investigations into specific programmes.
Over de afhandeling van signalen en over (mogelijke) onderzoeken naar specifieke programma's doet het Commissariaat geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Strien over Nederlandse speelfilms met amper internationaal succes

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the Olsberg SPI report showing Dutch feature films have little international success despite high output, and about Filmfonds budgets, multiple concurrent subsidy applications, governance, DAFF's role, and entrepreneurship. The State Secretary largely agreed with the report's direction, pointed to existing measures such as larger budgets and co-production support, noted domestic popularity and the narrow scope of the study, and said the Filmfonds is not rudderless.
The Olsberg SPI report offers no ready-made solutions, but that was also not the assignment of the Filmfonds.
Het rapport van Olsberg SPI biedt geen kant en klare oplossingen, maar dat was ook niet de opdracht van het Filmfonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de rapportagemaatregelen van de NPO voor Ongehoord Nederland

An MP asks the Secretary of State whether the NPO has a legal basis for requiring bimonthly reporting from Ongehoord Nederland and whether the NPO may impose such demands and sanctions before a licence decision. The Secretary of State answers that the NPO is an independent administrative body, that the matter is for the courts through objection and appeal, and that the minister cannot impose obligations on the NPO.
It is not for me to hold a political opinion on administrative decisions of an independent administrative body such as the Board of Directors of the NPO.
Het is niet aan mij om een politiek oordeel te hebben over bestuurlijke besluiten van een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan zoals de Raad van Bestuur van de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over Misstanden in realityprogramma's

An MP asked the Secretary of State for Culture about abuses in reality dating shows such as Temptation Island and De Villa, and whether oversight, complaint mechanisms, contract clauses and regulator roles should change. The Secretary of State answered that the cases are individual, that RTL has stopped the programmes and adopted a protocol, that the media sector has a conduct pact and Mores complaints body, and that the Commissariaat has no pre-broadcast or commercial oversight role, while committing to monitor and ask media organisations to improve.
I see no reason at this time to examine whether the Commissariaat should play a larger role in overseeing cross-border misconduct at commercial media parties.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om te onderzoeken of het Commissariaat een grotere rol dient te spelen in het toezicht op grensoverschrijdend gedrag bij commerciële mediapartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over Eenmalige specifieke uitkeringen lokale bibliotheekvoorzieningen 2023 – 2024 (SPUK Bieb)

An MP asked the state secretary about the SPUK Bieb library grants for 2023-2024, including how many applications were made and funded, how the budget was split, and whether the statutory library duty for municipalities will still come by mid-2024. The state secretary answered that 210 applications from 148 municipalities led to 79 grants, that the budget was oversubscribed by 21.7 million euros with a ranking published in annexes, and that the bill is now planned for late 2024 because of the caretaker cabinet.
The aim is to submit the bill to parliament by the end of 2024.
Het streven is om het wetsvoorstel voor eind 2024 in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over verduurzaming van de cultuursector

MP Mohandis asked the state secretary whether the cultural sector can decarbonise voluntarily, what a decarbonised sector means, how it will be supported, and whether a reduced cultural offer is a risk. The state secretary answered that initiatives are fragmented, that an inventory questionnaire and monitoring will precede any decision on further regulation, and that the Raad voor Cultuur's advice will be answered in 2024.
I am convinced that intrinsic motivation is very powerful.
Ik ben ervan overtuigd dat intrinsieke motivatie heel krachtig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Strien over het vertraagd openbaar maken van kijkcijfers

MP Van Strien asks the State Secretary whether he approves of the decision to publish TV viewing figures six days late instead of daily, and whether he will ask the NPO to resume daily publication. The State Secretary replies that the decision was taken by the NMO board, that no legal rules or NPO performance agreements govern figure publication, and that he sees no reason to ask the NPO to change course.
This decision was taken by the board of the NMO.
Dit besluit is genomen door het bestuur van het NMO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerseboom en Van Houwelingen over het vrijgeven van alle documentatie met betrekking tot de omroep Ongehoord Nederland

Two FvD MPs asked the Minister for all government documents mentioning broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland since August 2022, including NPO correspondence, and asked for them before any debate on withdrawing its recognition. The Secretary of State confirmed the documents exist and will be released in one batch only after a final decision on the NPO's request to withdraw the provisional recognition.

I will release the requested documentation regarding Ongehoord Nederland at the moment I have taken a final decision on the NPO's request to withdraw the provisional recognition of Ongehoord Nederland.

Ik zal de gevraagde documentatie met betrekking tot Ongehoord Nederland vrijgeven op het moment dat ik een definitief besluit op het verzoek van de NPO tot intrekking van de voorlopige erkenning van Ongehoord Nederland heb genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Draft EU plans to allow spying on journalists are dangerous, warn critics'

MP Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether the Council's draft European Media Freedom Act, which would allow member states to deploy spyware against journalists, is acceptable, and why the Netherlands sought carve-outs for law enforcement and intelligence services. The government answered that the draft introduces the first EU-level safeguards against unlawful spyware use against journalists, that the Netherlands opposes unlawful use and does not support surveillance of journalists or their sources, and that it had supported the compromise text and will not change its position.

The current version of the proposal contains, for the first time at Union level, safeguards on the use of intrusion software by governments in relation to journalists to protect media freedom in all member states.

De huidige versie van het voorstel bevat, voor het eerst op Unieniveau, waarborgen omtrent het gebruik van binnendringingssoftware door overheden in verhouding tot journalisten ten behoeve van het beschermen van mediavrijheid in alle lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het cancellen van politici door Op1

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that BNNVara ended Op1 after a conflict with a WNL director, and about allegations that politicians are being dropped from broadcasts for not fitting the broadcaster's outlook, and whether public broadcasting spends taxpayers' money responsibly. The state secretary answered that the NPO, not the minister, is responsible for programme content and quality, that broadcasters decide form and content and treat guests properly under the Mediawet, and that the NPO and the Commissariaat voor de Media oversee efficient use of funds.
It is not appropriate for me as State Secretary for media to interfere with the content of and requirements for programmes.
Het past niet dat ik mij als Staatssecretaris van media bemoei met de inhoud van en eisen aan programma's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over Bedreigd maritiem erfgoed

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the illegally salvaged Palmhout shipwreck, the state of Dutch maritime heritage research, the budget for in situ protection, and a proposed maritime archaeology institute under NIOZ. The State Secretary condemned the unlicensed salvage, reported agreements with divers and increased enforcement capacity, and said the €1.5 million annual budget suffices for monitoring but not for excavation, while committing to a further exploration of the wreck by the RCE.
I have indeed followed this case.
Ik heb deze casus inderdaad gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘En weer is een muziekschool failliet gegaan. Wie kan er nog naar muziekles?’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the bankruptcy of music schools, shrinking cultural education for young people, the stopped CBS research on cultural education, and the withdrawal of cultural ANBI status from choir schools. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns but largely pointed to municipalities' responsibility, a planned knowledge synthesis by LKCA, ongoing talks with the Ministry of Finance, and no commitment to restore choir schools' status.
I cannot make a commitment about (re)granting the status to choir schools.
Ik kan geen toezegging doen over het (opnieuw) toekennen van de status aan koorscholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de grote archeologische ontdekkingen bij Tiel

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the Tiel archaeological finds, the construction of warehouses on the site, public display of finds, funding for analysis, and the quality and capacity of archaeological research and municipal archaeology. The State Secretary answers that the municipality weighed interests, that existing legal frameworks and funding (Mondriaanfonds, a research platform, €3 million for municipal heritage care) address these concerns, and commits to several follow-up steps.
I therefore make €3 million per year available to strengthen heritage care at municipalities.
Ik stel daarom € 3 miljoen per jaar beschikbaar voor het versterken van de erfgoedzorg bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over een regionale zender

An MP asked the state secretary about a regional broadcast channel, including the costs of a regional window on NPO3, how TV channel positions are set, and what a fixed channel-10 position would require. The government answered that a pilot and validation study estimated costs of about EUR 10.8 million per year for regional windows, that channel positions are set in commercial distribution contracts outside its role, and that only the Telecommunicatiewet and Mediawet 2008 apply.
These are market negotiations in which I, as State Secretary for media, play no role.
Dit zijn marktonderhandelingen waar ik als Staatssecretaris voor media geen rol in speel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien en De Kort over het artikel ‘Ondertiteling voor slechthorenden ontbreekt vaak: Vorm van uitsluiting’

MPs Van Strien and De Kort asked whether the minimum subtitling norms for deaf and hard-of-hearing viewers, set fifteen years ago, are still adequate and why streaming services and commercial broadcasters do not disclose their share of subtitled content. The State Secretary replied that existing quotas and a new progress-reporting duty from July 2022 should suffice, that the Commissariaat oversees compliance, and that talks with streamers and the sector will follow.
For media services not under Dutch jurisdiction there is no legal basis to provide access to this information.
Voor mediadiensten die niet onder de Nederlandse jurisdictie vallen is er geen wettelijke grondslag om inzage in deze informatie te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het nieuws dat de NPO een pornofilm maakt

An MP asked the state secretary how the NPO/BNNVARA making a pornographic film fits the public broadcasting values in the Mediawet, whether it is the broadcaster's task, what it costs, and how children will be protected. The answer says there is no prior content supervision under Article 7 of the Constitution, that broadcasters are responsible for content within legal and NICAM limits with the Commissariaat voor de Media enforcing, and that the film will only appear online at night with age restrictions.
At the outset, under Article 7(2) of the Constitution there is no prior supervision of the content of programmes of the Dutch public broadcaster.
Voorop staat dat er in Nederland conform artikel 7 lid 2 van de Grondwet geen voorafgaand toezicht op de inhoud van programma’s van de Nederlandse publieke omroep is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht 'Minder theatervoorstellingen door hoge kosten en personeelstekorten'

An MP asked the state secretary about theatres cutting programming by 10-15% due to high costs and staff shortages, and whether extra cultural funding and fair pay measures are adequate. The state secretary acknowledged the pressure, pointed to coronavirus support and reserves, reduced the required number of large-stage productions, and announced structural fair pay funding from 2025 and collective tariff agreements.
To reduce performance pressure, in the coming bis period I will reduce the number of large-stage productions required by the regulation for the large theatre companies from three to two.
Om de prestatiedruk te verminderen, breng ik de komende bis-periode voor de grote theatergezelschappen het in de regeling opgenomen aantal grotezaalproducties terug van drie naar twee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Strien over het artikel 'Hoe beoordeel je of een kunstinstelling voldoende divers is'

MP Van Strien asks the state secretary about an NRC article and the Raad voor Cultuur advice on conditioning arts subsidies on the Governance, Fair Practice and Diversity & Inclusion codes, sustainability requirements, and cultural entrepreneurship. The secretary says the codes come from the sector itself, defends them as conditions for public funding while stressing artistic freedom, and defers details on sustainability, entrepreneurship and simplified procedures to a forthcoming policy letter.
In my policy principles letter I will go into this subject further.
In mijn uitgangspuntenbrief ga ik nader op dit onderwerp in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over geweldsfantasieën op de NPO

An MP asked the state secretary whether a 9 May 2023 NPO programme in which climate activists voiced violent fantasies crossed a line, why the presenter did not condemn this, and how it fits the Mediawet. The state secretary declined to judge programme content citing public broadcaster editorial independence, and referred the matter to the Commissariaat voor de Media, the Public Prosecution Service and the NPO Ombudsman.
As state secretary for media, it is not appropriate for me to pass judgement on the content of the programming.
Als Staatssecretaris voor media past het mij niet om een oordeel uit te spreken over inhoud van de programmering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht 'En weer is een muziekschool failliet gegaan. Wie kan er nog naar muziekles?'

An MP asks the state secretary about the bankruptcy of a Drenthe arts centre (Scala) and the threat to arts education access, and about funding, self-employment of teachers and inclusion. The state secretary acknowledges the vulnerability of local arts infrastructure but states that financing arts centres and music schools is a municipal responsibility, pointing to a planned national amateur arts accord and an evaluation of cultural education policy without committing to legislation.
Financing arts centres and music schools, such as Scala, is a municipal responsibility.
Het financieren van de kunstencentra en muziekscholen, zoals Scala, betreft een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de Audiovisuele Media Richtlijn

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the EU Audiovisual Media Services Directive ban on advertising inciting behaviour harmful to the environment is implemented, and why the environmental advertising provision was removed from the new sustainability advertising code. The State Secretary answered that self-regulation via the Advertising Code Foundation and the Commissariaat covers this, and that the provision will be re-inserted in the code around 1 July 2023.
The Advertising Code Foundation intends to re-add this prohibition to the revised code.
De Stichting Reclame Code is voornemens om deze verbodsbepaling weer toe te voegen aan de herziene code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over het bericht ‘Journalist Ana van Es werd opgeroepen om te getuigen. ‘Dit schrikt bronnen af’, zegt haar advocaat'

D66 MPs asked whether summoning journalist Ana van Es as a witness, and the resulting risk to source protection, is acceptable under the Wet bronbescherming in strafzaken. The ministers said they cannot comment on individual criminal cases, pointed to the law's safeguards and its evaluation, and stated that journalists may refuse to answer questions about sources even when summoned.
It is not for me to comment on individual criminal cases.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘‘Schrikbarende’ conclusies in zeer kritisch advies: Den Haag heeft ‘de regio’ stelselmatig verwaarloosd’

An MP asked the state secretary for Culture about a critical advisory report finding that central government has neglected the regions, including whether regional cultural access gaps will be addressed. The state secretary deferred the broader conclusions to a forthcoming cabinet response, but listed existing and planned regional cultural funding measures and said cultural spreading criteria will be revisited in the BIS 2025-2028 policy letter.
Because this advice touches many policy areas, a cabinet response will follow that addresses the conclusions of the advice.
Omdat dit advies vele beleidsterreinen raakt, volgt er nog een kabinetsreactie waarin zal worden ingegaan op de conclusies van het advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Ben je vrouw, van kleur of kom je van buiten, dan krijg je het lastig bij NOS Sport'

An MP asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science how a culture of silence and inaction over sexual misconduct at NOS Sport and the broader media sector could be broken, and about the independence of the reporting point Mores.online. The state secretary answered that an independent investigation by the Onderzoekscommissie Gedrag en Cultuur Omroepen is under way, that Mores.online's board has resigned, and that the government commissioner Mariëtte Hamer was asked to advise on its governance, with a follow-up meeting planned.

Because the safety of victims must be guaranteed at all times, on 15 March I asked the government commissioner, Mariëtte Hamer, to investigate what is needed to guarantee that safety for victims and which governance structure fits.

Omdat de veiligheid van slachtoffers te allen tijde gewaarborgd dient te zijn heb ik 15 maart jongstleden de regeringscommissaris, Mariëtte Hamer, verzocht om te onderzoeken wat nodig is om die veiligheid voor slachtoffers te waarborgen en welke governancestructuur daarbij past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de voortgang van de toekomstgerichte bibliotheekvoorziening in elke gemeente

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about progress on a statutory duty for municipalities to provide library facilities by 2025, including new branches, funding accountability, school library coverage in vocational schools, and Caribbean Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that a bill is expected mid-2024, a specific grant scheme is open to municipalities, and a separate budget applies to the Caribbean public bodies.
One of those changes is a statutory duty for municipalities and provinces, which will be introduced in 2025.
Eén van die wijzigingen is een zorgplicht voor gemeenten en provincies, die in 2025 zal worden ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Palland over het bericht 'Wie redt de grootste kerk van de vier noordelijke provincies? Zelfs de klokken mogen nu niet luiden'

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the structural decay of the Bovenkerk in Kampen and whether the Rijk should fund a restoration including re-foundation. The secretary acknowledged the problems, said the RCE is involved, and said funding depends on pending structural research; she committed to a broader policy review letter in June.
I expect to send the cabinet's response to the heritage policy review to the House in June.
Ik verwacht de kabinetsreactie op de beleidsdoorlichting erfgoed in juni naar de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over wederom desinformatie verspreidt bij uitzending Ongehoord Nieuws

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the government considers disinformation about COVID-19 vaccines and excess mortality broadcast by Ongehoord Nieuws a public health risk and whether the public broadcaster should tolerate it after prior NPO sanctions. The State Secretary answered that assessing content is not his task, that the government does not generally label disinformation, that the NPO sanctioned the broadcaster for insufficient cooperation, and referred to a Rijksbrede strategy letter for steps.
It is not for me to assess whether the statements made in the Ongehoord Nieuws broadcast qualify as disinformation.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of de uitingen die zijn gedaan in de uitzending van Ongehoord Nieuws kwalificeren als desinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over dreigende onbereikbaarheid van Omrop Fryslân

An MP asked about DAB+ coverage gaps for Omrop Fryslân and whether FM should stay available, citing Frisian language rights. The government says coverage is a licensing matter for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and the RDI, that FM and online remain available, and that no FM switch-off is planned before 2035.
Yes, I am aware of these statements.
Ja, ik ben bekend met deze uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chris Simons en Van Strien over het artikel 'Bevrijdingsfestival Utrecht gaat voor het eerst in 30 jaar niet door'

MPs Chris Simons and Van Strien asked the State Secretaries about the cancellation of the Utrecht Liberation Festival, the value of commemorating liberation, and financial support for liberation festivals. The government answered that the festivals are decentrally organised, that it sees no central role, that it advised talks with provinces and municipalities, and that talks with the National Committee and the VFonds on solutions are still ongoing.
Since the liberation festivals are organised decentrally, I see no role for central government in finding a solution.
Aangezien de bevrijdingsfestivals decentraal georganiseerd worden, zie ik geen rol vanuit het Rijk weggelegd om tot een oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat meer bevrijdingsfestivals niet door dreigen te gaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries whether the government would guarantee funding so that liberation festivals stay free and nationwide, and whether it would reconvene with the National Committee 4 and 5 May. The government answered that all festivals go ahead this year, that the festivals are decentralised and funded mainly by provinces and municipalities, that it sees no federal role, and that it will keep monitoring talks between the festivals and the National Committee.
Since the Liberation Festivals are organised at decentralised level, I see no role for central government in finding a solution.
Aangezien de Bevrijdingsfestivals decentraal worden georganiseerd, zie ik geen rol vanuit het Rijk weggelegd om tot een oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het tijdelijk blokkeren van het Twitteraccount van De Telegraaf-columnist Leon de Winter

An MP asked the state secretary whether she considers Twitter's temporary blocking of columnist Leon de Winter's account acceptable and whether she will raise it with Twitter given the value of free speech. The state secretary replied that platforms may enforce their own terms of service as private contracting parties, that it is not for the government to judge those terms, and that she will not intervene with Twitter.
It is not for me to judge the terms of use of social media such as Twitter.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de gebruikersvoorwaarden van sociale media als Twitter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Van Strien over het bericht ‘Zeeland wil dat geschenkwoningen rijksmonument worden: “Ze maken het verhaal van de Watersnoodramp zichtbaar”’

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether the Watersnood gift houses, donated after the 1953 flood, meet the criteria for national monument status and whether the government would act on a request from the provinces. The state secretary agreed the houses are valuable heritage, said a request from Noord-Brabant, Zeeland and Zuid-Holland has been received, and intends to start an investigation soon and decide on a designation programme this year.
I have now received a request from the provinces of Noord-Brabant, Zeeland and Zuid-Holland to examine the designation.
Ik heb inmiddels een verzoek van de provincies Noord-Brabant, Zeeland en Zuid-Holland ontvangen om de aanwijzing te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over de bedreiging van schrijver Pim Lammers

An MP asked the Justice and Culture ministers about threats against writer Pim Lammers and whether artistic freedom needs better protection, including a PersVeilig-style reporting platform for artists. The minister condemned the threats, pointed to existing criminal law and PersVeilig, and committed to talks with the sector and PersVeilig to explore further protection.
The Ministry of Education, Culture and Science will in the coming period talk with the sector and PersVeilig, among other things to explore how this issue plays out within these professional groups.
Het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap zal de komende tijd in gesprek gaan met de sector en PersVeilig, onder andere om te verkennen hoe dit onderwerp speelt binnen deze beroepsgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het schrappen van jazz en wereldmuziek bij de NPO

An MP asked the state secretary whether the renaming of Radio 4 to NPO Klassiek, and the removal of jazz and world music from its programming, was known, whether the government accepts that the NPO influences broadcaster programming, and what role ratings played. The state secretary answered that programming decisions belong to the NPO's programmatic autonomy, that jazz and world music remain available on NPO Soul & Jazz, that the renaming was based on audience research, and that the ministry will address the issue with the NPO and jazz sector representatives.
It is for the NPO and the broadcasters to shape the programming in good mutual consultation and cooperation.
Het is aan de NPO en de omroepen om in goed onderling overleg en samenspel invulling te geven aan de programmering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het intrekken van de vergunning van de omroep Ongehoord Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary about the NPO imposing a third sanction on Ongehoord Nederland and whether the minister should revoke its broadcasting recognition under the Mediawet. The State Secretary replied that revocation requires a request from the NPO that has not yet been made, that the minister cannot prejudge it, and that the law gives no direct ground for action now.
Only at the moment the NPO makes a request for revocation of recognition can I make that assessment.
Pas op het moment dat de NPO een verzoek tot intrekking van de erkenning doet, kan ik die afweging maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Westerveld en Kwint over Wob documenten aangaande de aanschaf van De vaandeldrager en de informatiepositie van de Staten-Generaal

MPs Teunissen, Westerveld and Kwint asked why the 2018 Call Option Agreement for De Vaandeldrager, the expired 165 million euro option, was not shared with parliament, why parts of documents were redacted, and whether parliament was fully informed before approving the purchase. The State Secretary answered that the option had already expired, the agreement was confidential and not a state contract, the redactions protected the state's negotiating position, and parliament was informed as fully as possible.
Therefore the Sale and Purchase Agreement will be placed confidentially for inspection shortly so committee members can still take note of it.
Daarom zal de Sale and Purchase Agreement op korte termijn vertrouwelijk ter inzage worden gelegd zodat de commissieleden hier alsnog kennis van kunnen nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien en Peter de Groot over de serie 'Kraken doe je zo' van NPO 3

MPs Van Strien and Peter de Groot asked whether the NPO 3 series 'Kraken doe je zo', which explains how to squat, should be removed and investigated under the Mediawet, and asked about squatting enforcement and evictions. The government answered that it does not judge individual programme content, that the Commissariaat voor de Media supervises the Mediawet, that the courts decide on criminal matters, and that existing criminal and municipal tools suffice, while promising a later data update on squatter numbers.
It is not for the cabinet to judge the content of individual programmes or statements made in them.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van afzonderlijke programma's of uitlatingen die daarin worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over bedreiging van cultureel erfgoed uit de periode 1965-1985

An MP asked the State Secretary for Culture whether post-1965 heritage such as buildings from 1965-1985 is under threat, and whether the Rijk will protect 100 or 200 such objects as it did for the postwar Reconstruction period. The State Secretary acknowledged the threat, said a limited designation programme (Post 65) is being prepared by the RCE with selection criteria, while leaving the number of objects open and noting municipalities also have protection duties.
Given the major spatial challenges facing the Netherlands in 2023 and their impact on heritage, I have now decided that a (limited) designation programme is nevertheless needed.
Vanwege de grote ruimtelijke opgaven waar Nederland anno 2023 voor staat en de impact daarvan op het erfgoed, heb ik inmiddels besloten dat een (beperkt) aanwijzingsprogramma nu toch nodig is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Verliest De Mearmin haar status?’

MPs Werner and Van der Molen (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether the government intends to remove windmill De Mearmin from the national monuments register after it was moved to an open-air museum, and about the grounds, subsidies, and consequences. The State Secretary confirmed the plan, citing heritage policy that relocation to a museum ends monument status, while acknowledging the RCE advised against the move and stating that monument policy does not support museum operations.
It has long been customary that where buildings are moved to a museum, they lose their monumental status or are not designated.
Het is reeds lange tijd gebruikelijk dat daar waar panden worden verplaatst naar een museum deze hun monumentale status verliezen of niet worden aangewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Boekenprogramma 'Brommer op zee' mocht toch doorgaan, maar dat hoorden de makers te laat'

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that the NPO influenced a VPRO book programme, its short-notice cancellation, and staff contracts, and whether programme success should be judged by ratings. The state secretary says the NPO and broadcasters jointly shape programmes within the Mediawet, that the government operates independently of broadcasters, that the NPO and VPRO communication is not reconstructable, and that she will discuss contracts and success measures with the NPO.
It is not for me to judge the considerations made in that interplay regarding programmes, in this case 'Brommer op zee'.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de afwegingen die in het genoemde samenspel ten aanzien van programma's, in dit geval «Brommer op zee», gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Sjoerdsma over een kadaster voor journalisten

Two D66 MPs asked why journalists cannot shield their home addresses in the Kadaster as threatened persons can, and why the Verhoeven motion on withholding private addresses has not been implemented. The minister answered that the Kadaster must keep object addresses public for a transparent property market, that searching by name is now limited to professional users, and that doxing should be criminalised instead, so no change to the Kadasterbesluit is planned.
I am aware that with this I depart from the line being taken for the Trade Register.
Ik ben mij bewust van het feit dat ik daarmee afwijk van de lijn die wordt ingezet bij het Handelsregister.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Ephraim over het bericht 'Shula Rijxman zit aan de paddenstoelen’

An MP asked the state secretary about a hiking route named after the former NPO chair Shula Rijxman, its cost, the procedure used, and whether honouring her is controversial. The state secretary answered that the action was a temporary farewell gift by NPO and the municipality of Hilversum, that the municipality is responsible for such decisions, that the costs were about 120 euro from the regular maintenance budget, and that the stickers have been removed.
It is up to the municipality of Hilversum to weigh how it wishes to honour executives such as Ms Rijxman.
Het is aan de gemeente Hilversum om een afweging te maken in de manier waarop het bestuurders als mevrouw Rijxman wil eren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over het voorafgaand toezicht op televisie-uitzendingen van Ongehoord Nederland

MP Van Meijeren asked whether the NPO may exercise prior review over TV broadcasts, given Article 7 of the Constitution, after refusing Ongehoord Nederland a Zwarte Piet broadcast. The state secretary replied that the NPO is not competent for prior content review, that programme selection is constrained by limited airtime and budget, that the NPO is independent of government, and that objections can be pursued through the ordinary appeal route.
It is not for me to assess the NPO's decision.
Het is niet aan mij om het besluit van de NPO te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Strien over Samenwerking van de NPO en VRT

An MP asked the State Secretary whether she was involved in the planned intensive NPO–VRT cooperation, whether parliament should be informed and consulted, how the NPO accounts for such decisions, what the added value is, how it fits the Mediawet tasks, and how Netflix ties and funding relate. The State Secretary answered that the NPO has autonomy under the Mediawet, she had no active role but welcomes the cooperation, accountability is via the annual Terugblik, the cooperation uses existing NPO budgets, and she will ask the NPO to keep parliament informed.
I will ask the NPO to keep me informed about this cooperation and to inform your House about it as usual.
Ik zal de NPO vragen mij op de hoogte te houden van deze samenwerking en uw Kamer daarover zoals gebruikelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht  ‘In de succesvolle tv-machine van DWDD werd menig redacteur vermalen’

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science how grensoverschrijdend gedrag at DWDD, the broadcasters' response, the role of the NPO and the regeringscommissaris, and possible tightening of the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet are handled. The state secretary answers that the conduct is unacceptable, describes the NPO-commissioned external investigation and action plan, and says the Minister of SZW is examining regulatory tightening, but withholds details of confidential talks and says the precise investigation brief is not yet known.
Given the confidentiality of these conversations, I cannot go into what was concretely discussed.
Gezien de vertrouwelijkheid van deze gesprekken kan ik niet ingaan op wat er concreet is besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Excuses voor misstanden bij NPO-klokkenluider’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about salary constructions at the public broadcaster NPO, circumventing pay norms via production companies, and the status of a Commissariaat voor de Media investigation. The State Secretary said the government opposes such constructions, that the Commissariaat's investigation (with KPMG) is due in Q1 2023, that it can compel information under the Awb, and that it can impose fines or penalty payments.
The Commissariaat voor de Media has announced it will investigate the NPO and national public broadcasters for financial (circumvention) constructions under the WNT and BPPO.
het Commissariaat) heeft aangekondigd onderzoek te zullen doen bij de NPO en landelijke publieke omroepen naar financiële (omzeilings-)constructies in het kader van de WNT en het BPPO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘DPG Media lanceert Seamless ads’

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Sjoerdsma asked whether DPG Media's 'seamless ads', which can look like news articles, undermine trust in journalism and whether media should be required to label them. The Secretary of State answered that existing rules under the Civil Code, the Dutch Advertising Code and oversight by ACM and the Advertising Code Committee already require ads to be recognisable, that no new regulation is currently needed, and that the Press Council has no role here, but that the Advertising Code Committee will be asked what it can do.
I will ask the Advertising Code Committee what it could possibly mean in relation to seamless ads.
Ik zal aan de Reclame Code Commissie vragen wat zij mogelijk kunnen betekenen in relatie tot seamless ads.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over de uitgelekte mail van het directieteam van de NPO omtrent omroep Ongehoord Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Culture and Media about a leaked NPO directorate email on broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland, including the meaning of 'limit of editorial freedom reached' and whether the NPO should have asked the Commissariaat voor de Media to investigate. The State Secretary confirmed the NPO's statements, explained that the NPO has its own statutory power to impose financial sanctions and that the matter is outside her responsibility, and said the Commissariaat decides independently on investigations.
The Commissariaat decides as an independent supervisor itself which matters are investigated.
Het Commissariaat beslist als onafhankelijk toezichthouder zelf over welke zaken worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over berichten dat artiesten hun tour annuleren vanwege onder meer te hoge kosten

MP Kwint asked the state secretary how many Dutch artists have cancelled tours due to high costs, and about support for the pop sector, streaming revenue, insurance, energy costs and corona aid. The state secretary said the number of cancellations is unknown, pointed to new support schemes for pop artists and a tour desk, and deferred several structural questions to ongoing consultations and evaluations.
However, I am not aware of how many cases have led to the cancellation of tours by Dutch artists.
Het is mij echter niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen dit geleid heeft tot het annuleren van tournees van Nederlandse artiesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de pilots van de mbo-card met budget

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about which MBO schools take part in the pilot of the MBO Card with budget, whether all student types are reached, when results will be available, and whether the budget will be increased. The government answered that the card is open to all MBO schools and students, that participation is voluntary, that a monitoring and evaluation study (first results expected Q4 2023) will guide decisions on the pilot's continuation, and that the budget question will be decided on that basis.
Decisions on the further course of the pilot will be made by me on the basis of the monitoring and evaluation study carried out by research bureau ResearchNed.
Beslissingen over het verdere verloop van de pilot neem ik op basis van het monitorings- en evaluatieonderzoek dat wordt uitgevoerd door onderzoeksbureau ResearchNed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Strien over de brief Toekomst culturele basisinfrastructuur en de uitvoering van de motie Van Strien c.s

An MP from the VVD asks whether the state secretary's letter on the cultural basic infrastructure (BIS) and the new subsidy round properly implement a parliamentary motion on performance agreements, social impact, cultural entrepreneurship and innovation, and why the press release says conditions stay the same. The state secretary answers that the motion is not yet considered fulfilled, that the Raad voor Cultuur and the Auditdienst Rijk were asked for advice (due spring 2023), that conditions will not stay exactly the same, and that details will follow in the June 2023 Uitgangspuntenbrief.

I am incorporating the mentioned elements of the motion into my request for advice to the Council for Culture on the assessment procedure of the Council for the cultural basic infrastructure (BIS) 2025–2028.
Ik verwerk de genoemde onderdelen in de motie in mijn adviesaanvraag aan de Raad voor Cultuur over de beoordelingsprocedure door de Raad voor de culturele basisinfrastructuur (BIS) 2025–2028.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Westerveld over de gevolgen van de stijgende gasprijzen voor de culturele en creatieve sector

MPs Wuite and Westerveld asked the state secretary about the effects of rising gas prices on cultural and creative sector institutions such as museums, and what the government will do about energy costs and sustainability. The state secretary says she shares the concerns, points to general energy price measures, the DUMAVA subsidy and advisory programmes, and promises to inform the House on a motion and to consult the sector further.
At present, the impact of rising energy costs on the OCW sectors, including the cultural sector, is being further mapped.
Op dit moment wordt de impact van de stijgende energiekosten op de OCW-sectoren, waaronder de culturele sector, verder in beeld gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht ‘Omroepen: er moet snel iets gebeuren met ON, na ‘beschamende’ uitzending’

An MP from the CDA asked whether Ongehoord Nederland crossed a line with a broadcast and what measures should be taken, and who is responsible for checking broadcasters' compliance with conditions. The State Secretary replied that editorial independence limits government involvement, that the NPO Ombudsman and Commissariaat voor de Media are reviewing the broadcast, and that no additional conditions were imposed beyond the Mediawet and NPO codes.
In the first instance it is for the NPO Ombudsman and the Commissariaat voor de Media to review the broadcast against the NPO journalistic code and the Mediawet respectively.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de NPO Ombudsman en het Commissariaat voor de Media om de uitzending te toetsen aan respectievelijk de journalistieke code van de NPO en de Mediawet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Het mogelijk uitbuiten van kwetsbare jongeren voor (waarschijnlijk) hogere kijkcijfers

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that vulnerable young participants in the TV programme Dream School are exploited for higher ratings, including staged arguments, lack of promised aftercare, and penalty clauses of 5,000 euro for speaking to the press. The state secretary replied that broadcasters set their own content, that the NTR and producer deny staging conflicts, that aftercare has been professionalised and penalty clauses dropped since 2019, and that no further steps are warranted.
In response to the NTR's reaction, I see no reason to take further steps.
Naar aanleiding van de reactie van de NTR, zie ik geen aanleiding om nadere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het verbod op vleesreclames in Haarlem

An MP asked the Minister whether a Haarlem ban on meat advertising in public space is censorship and an unacceptable restriction on entrepreneurship, and whether it threatens pig farmers and shifts production abroad.
