The Minister replied that the ban follows a council motion, that it does not stigmatise meat eaters or restrict purchasing, that whether it is unacceptable is a matter for the courts, and that the sector would not disappear.
Whether the ban on meat advertising in Haarlem is an unacceptable infringement is not for me to answer, but possibly for the court to judge.
Vraag of het verbod op vleesreclames in Haarlem een onaanvaardbare aantasting is, is niet aan mij om te beantwoorden, maar eventueel aan de rechter om een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Groot deel van de musea in de rode cijfers'

An MP asked the state secretary about museum visitor declines, deficits and lack of reserves in 2021, and what support is available. The state secretary confirmed the drop to 11.8 million visitors, attributed it mainly to longer closures, pointed to support and a publicity campaign, and said municipalities are responsible for monitoring their own museums and that some data will follow later.
Municipalities are responsible for monitoring and supporting the institutions they finance.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het monitoren en ondersteunen van door hen gefinancierde instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over dat er wederom racistisch nepnieuws is verspreid door Ongehoord Nederland

An MP from DENK asked whether the government condemns a Ongehoord Nederland broadcast claiming 'white' people are beaten by people of colour, which used the n-word, and whether the public broadcaster should act against the broadcaster or whether it should be removed from the system. The State Secretary declined to judge programme content citing media independence, pointed to the NPO Ombudsman and the Commissariaat voor de Media investigations, and said sanctions or erkenning withdrawal would be considered only within the statutory process.
It is not for me as a minister to assess this.
Het is niet aan mij als bewindspersoon om dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner, Inge van Dijk en Palland over het beschermen en behouden van maritiem erfgoed.

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about protecting maritime and sailing heritage, including historic houseboats, and about registration, legal anchoring and a plan of action. The State Secretary answered that the national government's role is mainly support and facilitation, that existing registers and designation tools are in place, and that the Erfgoedwet evaluation and a follow-up meeting with the sector will come later.
For the national government, that role lies mainly in support and facilitation in the field of knowledge and expertise.
Voor het Rijk ligt die vooral in ondersteuning en facilitering op het vlak van kennis en kunde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over uitspraken Maarten van Rossem en opstarten van een boerderij door de Staatstelevisie

An MP asks the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science about Maarten van Rossem's remarks on a TV quiz (suggesting a farmer-hater be shot) and the public broadcaster's farm programme, and asks about Van Rossem's pay. The state secretary replies that content judgments are not hers to make, points to the Commissariaat voor de Media and the NPO Ombudsman, says the broadcaster confirms his pay is within the rules, and denies that the state runs a farm.
However, it is not for me to judge the content of individual programmes or the statements made in them.
Het is echter niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van afzonderlijke programma’s of uitlatingen die daarin worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Metselaarstekens op tiental Walcherse kerken verminkt door restauratie’

An SGP MP asked the state secretary whether heritage masonry marks on Walcheren churches were damaged by restoration, and what the RCE's role was, and whether similar problems exist elsewhere. The secretary answered that no removal or sanding was found, that weathering explains reduced visibility, and that the RCE stays in contact with municipalities and runs knowledge sessions.
Nowhere has it been established that masonry marks were sanded down or removed.
Nergens is geconstateerd dat metseltekens zijn afgeschaafd of verwijderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van Strien over het artikel 'Hoe Rick Engelkes coronamiljoenen incasseerde voor een spookmusical'

MPs Aartsen and Van Strien asked about a newspaper report that a producer received corona compensation for a ghost musical that was not scheduled in the corona period and had no tickets sold. The State Secretary explains the provisional allocation under Compensatieregeling 3, the Fonds Podiumkunsten's assessment, the later accountability and clawback process, and that no other signals of misuse have been received.
The Fonds Podiumkunsten assesses the accountability and can set the subsidy lower and recover funds.
Het Fonds Podiumkunsten beoordeelt de verantwoording en kan de subsidie lager vaststellen en middelen terugvorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Strien over NLZiet

An MP from the VVD asks the Secretary of State for Education, Culture and Science why the government does not take a clearer position on bundling Dutch content on NLZiet, whether the public broadcaster may offer a free variant under state aid and public-service rules, and whether a standpoint on NLZiet's future will be sent before summer. The Secretary calls NLZiet a welcome initiative, leaves cooperation to the parties while urging them to agree, says the public-service remit rules apply but no barrier is set to NPO joining a free variant, and promises the standpoint before the media debate.
I do not place obstacles in the way of NPO participation in a free variant of NLZiet.
Ik werp geen belemmeringen op tegen deelname van de NPO in een gratis variant van NLZiet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Ook mensen met beperking moeten makkelijk biertje kunnen halen op festival'

MP Werner (CDA) asked the state secretary for Culture about the accessibility of music festivals for people with disabilities, including the number of accessible festivals, the #OnbeperktFeest campaign, and the routekaart for inclusive festivals. The state secretary answered that accessibility is improving, that data on accessible festivals is lacking and will be discussed with the sector association, and that talks with the VNG will follow with progress reported in a letter this autumn.
I am going to talk with the Dutch Association of Pop Venues and Festivals about how we can better map the number of accessible music festivals.
Ik ga in gesprek met Nederlandse Vereniging Poppodia en Festivals over hoe we het aantal toegankelijke muziekfestivals beter in kaart kunnen brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked how the government's new framework contract for photography procurement affects photographers' administrative burden, costs, rates and market power, and whether the photographers were consulted. The government answered that a single agency will manage a pool of photographers with lower admin burdens for them, a hourly rate of 109 euros, a likely rise in costs for the state, and that the photographers were contacted in an earlier round.
The aim of this procurement is to contract a single agency that, in consultation with clients, selects a pool of photographers to carry out assignments under the framework agreement.
Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om één bureau te contracteren dat, in samenspraak met opdrachtgevers, een poule van fotografen selecteert om opdrachten binnen de raamovereenkomst uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over een klokkenluidersmelding bij de publieke omroep

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked about the handling of a whistleblower report at the public broadcaster and the applicable procedures, including whether the report was treated as a whistleblower report and what rights the whistleblower has. The State Secretary answered that the Auditdienst Rijk is investigating the facts and declined to pre-empt the outcome, while describing the applicable procedures and complaint routes (ombudsman, Huis voor klokkenluiders) and refusing to give a timeline or the number of reports.
The factual course of events surrounding this report is being investigated by the ADR, as stated in my answer to question 3.
Naar de feitelijke gang van zaken rond deze melding wordt door de ADR onderzoek gedaan, zoals gemeld in mijn antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over de beloning van topinkomens

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about top-income rules under the WNT: how many executives and supervisors fall under it, whether they exceed the cap, how enforcement works, and whether accountants' fees and supervisory pay are adequately controlled. The government answered that the WNT is broadly effective, that some overruns persist and are enforced through reclaim and penalties, and that a limited amendment to simplify the act is being prepared.
Following the evaluation, a limited amendment of the WNT is being prepared, and the House of Representatives will receive a letter on it shortly.
Naar aanleiding van de evaluatie wordt een beperkte wetswijziging van de WNT voorbereid, op korte termijn ontvangt de Tweede Kamer daarover een brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de uitspraak van de ombudsman van de publieke omroepen dat de omroep Ongehoord Nederland in publicaties de Journalistieke Code van de NPO heeft geschonden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether the NPO can act after the public broadcasters' ombudsman ruled that Ongehoord Nederland breached the NPO Journalistic Code, how this fits the public broadcasting mandate, and whether the report risks being shelved. The government referred to its answers to questions 8 to 11 and said the NPO must first form its own judgement on the report.
The NPO is now first to form a judgement on the basis of the report.
De NPO is nu eerst aan zet om op basis van het rapport een oordeel te vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de omroep Ongehoord Nederland

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the government has noted the ombudsman's finding that broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland breached the NPO Journalistic Code, and whether the conclusions can be included in answers to earlier questions. The State Secretary answered yes to both, referring to the answer to question 8.
Yes, see the answer to question 8.
Ja, zie de beantwoording van vraag 8.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van der Werf, Van Strien, De Hoop, Westerveld, Teunissen, Van der Graaf, Van Baarle, Koekkoek en Gündoğan over het verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de om

MPs asked the government how the public broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland could broadcast the 'great replacement' conspiracy theory unchallenged, and what risks and sanctions follow. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO Ombudsman found Ongehoord Nederland breached the journalistic code, that the NPO intends to impose a sanction, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media and NPO, not the minister, are responsible for judging compliance with the Mediawet.
It is for the Commissariaat to assess the broadcast of Ongehoord Nieuws in light of the requirements the Mediawet places on broadcasters.
Het is aan het Commissariaat om de uitzending van Ongehoord Nieuws te beoordelen in het licht van de eisen die de Mediawet aan omroepen stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over de nauwe banden tussen NPO en D66

An MP asked the state secretary about NPO chair Shula Rijxman's alleged ties to D66, her advice to a party colleague, her paid post after leaving the NPO, and an honour she received. The state secretary answered that he is not aware beyond media reports, that the Mediawet and Integrity Code govern broadcaster conduct, and that revoking the honour falls outside his competence.
As State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science, I am not authorised to revoke a royal honour.
Ik ben als Staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap niet bevoegd om een koninklijke onderscheiding in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de moord op Al-Jazeera’s journalist Shireen Abu Aqleh

An MP asks the government how it views the killing of Al-Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Aqleh, Israel's reported refusal of an inquiry, and what concrete steps it takes toward truth-finding and accountability. The minister condemns the killing, denies that Israel refused an inquiry, and says the government supports a transparent joint investigation, without listing concrete steps beyond raising the matter with counterparts.
As I understand it, there is no question of an Israeli refusal.
Naar mijn begrip is er geen sprake van een Israëlische weigering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over Kwart musea dreigt in financiële problemen te komen

Rep. Werner (CDA) asked the state secretary whether a quarter of Dutch museums face financial trouble due to falling visitor numbers, whether smaller and municipally funded museums are most affected, what support is planned, whether volunteer shortages exist, and whether talks with the museum association and VNG will be held. The state secretary answered that visitor numbers lag in parts of the cultural sector, cited a museum association survey, said general corona support has ended, referred to coalition agreement work and a recent letter, noted municipalities are responsible for their funded institutions, and reported ongoing consultation with the taskforce, VNG and IPO.
I am currently working on elaborating the coalition agreement, with recovery of the cultural and creative sector after corona being the main focus.
Ik werk op dit moment aan de uitwerking van het coalitieakkoord, herstel van de culturele en creatieve sector na corona vormt daarbij het zwaartepunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Strien over het bericht 'Publieke Omroep mag NPO Start uitbreiden van concurrentiewaakhond'

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that the regulator allowed the public broadcaster NPO to expand NPO Start, and about the future of the shared streaming service NLZiet, including a free variant and exclusivity. The state secretary answered that NLZiet remains a useful initiative, that the NPO has an effort obligation toward it, that a position paper on NLZiet will follow after clarity on the RTL-Talpa merger, and that the decision on the NPO Start application cannot be postponed.
I therefore want to await this investigation and the resulting decision before I come with a further position statement.
Ik wil daarom dit onderzoek en het daaruit volgende besluit eerst afwachten voor ik met een nadere positiebepaling kom.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Slob: Media in Caribisch Nederland helpen zichzelf te versterken'

Two D66 MPs asked whether local media on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba are strong and independent enough to scrutinise local government, and what steps followed a prior study. The State Secretary answered that the media sector is relatively large but faces independence and self-censorship concerns, that a plan to professionalise journalism will follow, and that the Chamber will be informed before the media budget debate.
Once the plan is ready, I will inform the Chamber about it in more detail.
Zodra het plan gereed is, zal ik de Kamer hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Àntwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over de toekomst van de zeilende beroepsvaart

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about a 2022 report on financing the future of the sailing commercial fleet (bruine vloot) as maritime heritage, and whether they would consult sector and government partners and answer before the tourism debate. The answer is only a referral: the questions were answered in a separate letter on tourism.
The written questions ... have been answered by letter 'Reaction to committee request on supplementary main lines on tourism' (Parliamentary paper 26 419, no. 96).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «Reactie op verzoek commissie over aanvullende hoofdlijnen inzake toerisme» (Kamerstuk 26 419, nr. 96 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over mogelijk verspreiden van desinformatie door Ongehoord Nederland

MP Sjoerdsma asked the state secretary whether Ongehoord Nederland spreads disinformation in its programme Ongehoord Nieuws, and whether the government would seek interim assessments from the Raad voor Cultuur and the Commissariaat voor de Media. The state secretary answered that assessing individual programmes is not for the minister, that the Commissariaat and NPO Ombudsman are responsible for enforcement, and that an interim opinion from the Raad voor Cultuur was not appropriate.
However, it is not for me to judge the content of individual programmes or statements made in them.
Het is echter niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van afzonderlijke programma's of uitlatingen die daarin worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van Strien over het bericht 'Streep door Haarlems Tsjaikovski en Stravinsky-festival: 'Dit lijken wel Sovjetpraktijken''

MPs Brekelmans and Van Strien asked whether the government would distinguish between state-linked Russian cultural institutions and independent Russian culture when Dutch venues reprogram Russian art after the invasion of Ukraine. The State Secretary answered that sanctions should target the Russian state, not Russian culture or people, and that formal cooperation with state-linked institutions is being suspended while individual artists remain welcome.
At this moment I leave it to Dutch institutions themselves to adjust their programming or not, as they see fit.
Ik laat het op dit moment aan Nederlandse instellingen zelf om hun programmering al dan niet aan te passen naar eigen inzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over stormschade en onderhoudsinventarisatie van kerkgebouwen

An MP asked the state secretary about storm damage to church buildings, the state of their maintenance, church owners' financial worries, and whether a plan is needed to address deferred maintenance and public safety. The state secretary said maintenance is generally good, pointed to the Toekomst Religieus Erfgoed programme, church visions and the SIM subsidy scheme, and saw no need for a specific new plan since owners bear primary responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Paulusma over de inzet van 1G in de culturele sector

MPs Wuite and Paulusma (D66) asked the ministers whether the 1G test-for-access requirement for large unplaced indoor events in the cultural sector would deter visitors, and what alternatives or flanking measures exist. The minister defended the 1G measure as a proportionate risk mitigation for high-risk events, rejected concerns about deterred visitors, and announced that Testen voor Toegang would end on 23 March 2022.
From 23 March, Testen voor Toegang also lapses for these events, and they can proceed without a test certificate.
Vanaf 23 maart vervalt ook voor deze evenementen Testen voor Toegang, en kunnen zij doorgaan zonder testbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de Nederlandse Livemuziek Monitor 2008-2019

An SP MP asks the state secretary about the Dutch live music monitor 2008–2019, the implementation of the Beckerman motion on the pop sector, plans to strengthen pop after the pandemic, and whether the Kwint initiative note on pop will be implemented. The state secretary welcomes the monitor, reports ongoing talks with city culture regions, promises a letter on culture recovery, and says several proposals from the note fit current policy, with a plan of action with ACCT and an upstream-scheme extension being considered.
I am currently working on a letter setting out my plans for the recovery of the cultural sector.
Momenteel werk ik aan een brief waarin ik mijn plannen voor het herstel van de culturele sector uitwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over de bescherming van deelnemers van tv-programma’s zoals the Voice of Holland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science how contestants on TV talent shows such as The Voice of Holland are protected against sexual misconduct and abuse of power, and about contract terms and the protection of minors. The State Secretary answered that she is convening a round table with the sector, has asked the Raad voor Cultuur for advice, notes that employers bear primary responsibility under the Arbo law, and says inspection and sanctions are available, while promising to inform parliament.
That is why, under our central direction, work is underway toward an integrated and coordinated approach to sexual boundary-crossing behaviour or violence.
Daarom wordt onder onze centrale regie toegewerkt naar een integrale en gecoördineerde aanpak van seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag of geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over oproepen tot geweld in uitzending FunX

MP Van Haga asked the state secretary about a FunX broadcast calling for violence against two YouTube presenters, whether this is illegal, and why FunX and the public broadcaster did not intervene. The state secretary said the public broadcaster is independent and responsible for its own content, and that courts decide whether free speech limits were exceeded if a complaint is filed.
It is not for me as State Secretary of Education, Culture and Science to judge the content of public broadcaster broadcasts.
Het is niet aan mij als Staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap om een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van uitzendingen van de publieke omroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over “het bericht dat het Rijksmuseum de term Bersiap niet langer wil gebruiken"

MP Martin Bosma (PVV) asked whether the Rijksmuseum's decision to stop using the term Bersiap, which a guest curator called racist, is acceptable and whether the minister will intervene. The state secretary replied that the museum is not removing the term but will explain it with historical context in the exhibition, and that the minister does not intend to intervene in the museum's curatorial choices.
The Rijksmuseum has stated that the museum is not deleting the term Bersiap, but will explain it and provide historical context.
Het Rijksmuseum heeft laten weten dat het museum de term Bersiap niet schrapt, maar zal uitleggen en voorzien van historische context.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Bersiap

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the Rijksmuseum's use of the term Bersiap and whether a national Bersiap monument should be investigated. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the report, said the museum will keep the term with added historical context, and saw no reason to investigate a national monument.
I currently see no reason to investigate the establishment of a national Bersiap monument.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de oprichting van een Nationaal Bersiap-monument te onderzoeken.
